<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अ</span> <i>a</i> var. <i>an_1</i> pf. privatif ou négatif; forme des substantifs composés; (rare) devant une forme verbale, donne un sens de blâme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. α, αν; lat. <i>in</i>; ang. un; fr. a, an.<br> <i>apacasi</i> tu ne sais pas cuisiner.
  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(aṃśayati)</i> diviser, distribuer.<br> <i>aṃśena</i> <i>avatṝ</i> myth. [«descendre partiellement»] se dit de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> incarnant une partie de Lui-même sur Terre comme <a href="#entry-avataara" class="skt-link">avatāra</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-kalaa" class="skt-link">kalā</a>.

  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭādaśākṣara</i> [<a href="#entry-ak_sara" class="skt-link">akṣara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-a_s_taadazaak_sara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-a_s_taadazaak_sara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-a_s_taadazaak_sarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aṣṭādaśākṣarī</i> constitué de 18 syllables.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_taadazaak_saramantra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭādaśākṣaramantra</i> [<a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_taadazaak_saramantra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a> de 18 syllabes utilisé not. pour le culte de <a href="#entry-Ujagannaatha" class="skt-link">Jagannātha</a> (<i>klīṃ</i> <i>kṣṇāya</i> <i>govindāya</i> <i>gopījanavallabhāya</i> <a href="#entry-svaahaa" class="skt-link">svāhā</a>).<br> <a href="#entry-a_s_taadazaak_sara" class="skt-link">aṣṭādaśākṣara</a> <br> <a href="#entry-a_s_taadaza" class="skt-link">aṣṭādaśa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_taadazan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭādaśan</i> [<a href="#entry-dazan" class="skt-link">daśan</a>] num. <a href="#entry-a_s_taadazan" class="skt-link">*</a> 18.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_taadhyaayii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭādhyāyī</i> [<a href="#entry-adhyaayii" class="skt-link">adhyāyī</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_taadhyaayii" class="skt-link">f.</a> gram. np. de l'Aṣṭādhyāyī «Octopartite», grammaire [<a href="#entry-zabdaanuzaasana" class="skt-link">śabdānuśāsana</a>] en huit chapitres de <a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>, composée vers-350.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_taafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭāṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-afga_1" class="skt-link">aṅga_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-a_s_taafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-a_s_taafga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-a_s_taafgaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aṣṭāṅgā</i> constitué de 8 parties, qui a 8 membres, en 8 étapes — iic. désigne not. la science médicale.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_taafgah_rdaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya</i> [<a href="#entry-h_rdaya" class="skt-link">hṛdaya</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_taafgah_rdaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. de l'Aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya <a href="#entry-sa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">saṃhitā</a>, somme de médecine et chirurgie [<a href="#entry-aayurveda" class="skt-link">āyurveda</a>] de <a href="#entry-Uvaagbha_ta" class="skt-link">Vāgbhaṭa</a>, comprenant 8000 versets [<a href="#entry-zloka" class="skt-link">śloka</a>] divisés en 120 chapitres, composé vers 600.<br> <a href="#entry-a_s_taafga" class="skt-link">aṣṭāṅga</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_taafgamaarga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭāṅgamārga</i> [<a href="#entry-maarga" class="skt-link">mārga</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_taafgamaarga" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. «chemin en 8 étapes» menant à l'abolition de la souffrance, selon l'enseignement de <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a>: la compréhension droite [<a href="#entry-samyagd_r_s_ti" class="skt-link">samyagdṛṣṭi</a>], l'intention droite [<a href="#entry-samyaksafkalpa" class="skt-link">samyaksaṅkalpa</a>], la parole droite [<a href="#entry-samyagvaac" class="skt-link">samyagvāc</a>], la conduite droite [<a href="#entry-samyakkarmaanta" class="skt-link">samyakkarmānta</a>], le mode de vie approprié [<a href="#entry-samyagaajiiva" class="skt-link">samyagājīva</a>], l'effort correct [<a href="#entry-samyagvyaayaama" class="skt-link">samyagvyāyāma</a>], l'attention juste [<a href="#entry-samyaksm_rti" class="skt-link">samyaksmṛti</a>], et la méditation correcte [<a href="#entry-samyaksamaadhi" class="skt-link">samyaksamādhi</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-aaryamaarga" class="skt-link">āryamārga</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_taafgapaata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭāṅgapāta</i> [<a href="#entry-paata" class="skt-link">pāta</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_taafgapaata" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. prosternation sur les 8 parties du corps (mains, genoux, pieds, poitrine et tête), posture de profonde obéissance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_taafgapra_naama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭāṅgapraṇāma</i> [<a href="#entry-pra_naama" class="skt-link">praṇāma</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_taafgapra_naama" class="skt-link">m.</a> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_taafgapra_nipaata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭāṅgapraṇipāta</i> [<a href="#entry-pra_nipaata" class="skt-link">praṇipāta</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_taafgapra_nipaata" class="skt-link">m.</a> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_taafgasafgraha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭāṅgasaṃgraha</i> [<a href="#entry-safgraha" class="skt-link">saṃgraha</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_taafgasa_mgraha" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. de l'Aṣṭāṅgasaṃgraha, manuel de médecine et chirurgie [<a href="#entry-aayurveda" class="skt-link">āyurveda</a>] en prose attribué à <a href="#entry-Uvaagbha_ta" class="skt-link">Vāgbhaṭa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_taafgayoga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭāṅgayoga</i> [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_taafgayoga" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. les 8 pratiques ou étapes du <a href="#entry-raajayoga" class="skt-link">rājayoga</a>, codifiées par <a href="#entry-Upata_njali_2" class="skt-link">Patañjali_2</a>: le contrôle de soi [<a href="#entry-yama_1" class="skt-link">yama_1</a>], la discipline morale [<a href="#entry-niyama" class="skt-link">niyama</a>], le contrôle de son corps [<a href="#entry-aasana" class="skt-link">āsana</a>], la discipline du souffle [<a href="#entry-praa_naayaama" class="skt-link">prāṇāyāma</a>], la rétraction des sens [<a href="#entry-pratyaahaara" class="skt-link">pratyāhāra</a>], la fixation de la pensée [<a href="#entry-dhaara_naa" class="skt-link">dhāraṇā</a>], la méditation [<a href="#entry-dhyaana" class="skt-link">dhyāna</a>] (ou qqf. <a href="#entry-tarka" class="skt-link">tarka</a> ou <a href="#entry-viik_sa_na" class="skt-link">vīkṣaṇa</a>) et la communion spirituelle ou enstase [<a href="#entry-samaadhi" class="skt-link">samādhi</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_taapada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭāpada</i> [<a href="#entry-pada" class="skt-link">pada</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_taapada" class="skt-link">n.</a> échiquier; jeu d'échecs.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_taavadhaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭāvadhāna</i> [<a href="#entry-avadhaana" class="skt-link">avadhāna</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_taavadhaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. [«attention à 8 choses différentes»] exercice de mémorisation pour un <a href="#entry-pa_n_dita" class="skt-link">paṇḍita</a>; il doit faire attention à 8 séries d'événements simultanés tout en composant une strophe sanskrite sur un sujet donné — <a href="#entry-a_s_taavadhaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-a_s_taavadhaanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aṣṭāvadhānī</i> qui sait faire 8 choses en même temps.<br> <a href="#entry-a_s_ta" class="skt-link">aṣṭa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_taavakra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭāvakra</i> [<a href="#entry-vakra" class="skt-link">vakra</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_taavakra" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [AG.] np. du jeune mystique Aṣṭāvakra «Estropié huit fois», fils du brâhmane Kahoḍa; encore dans le ventre de sa mère, il écoutait son père réciter le <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>, et le corrigeait lorsqu'il faisait une erreur; son père le maudit, et il naquit infirme; à l'âge de 12 ans il alla à la cour de <a href="#entry-Ujanakaraaja" class="skt-link">Janakarāja</a> pour l'instruire sur la nature du Soi [<a href="#entry-aatman" class="skt-link">ātman</a>]; il obtint de retrouver son père, et redressa son corps en faisant un bain sacré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_taavakragiitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭāvakragītā</i> [<a href="#entry-giitaa" class="skt-link">gītā</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_taavakragiitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de l'Aṣṭāvakragītā [AG.], poème mystique de la philosophie <a href="#entry-advaita" class="skt-link">advaita</a>, composé par un maître anonyme de l'école de <a href="#entry-Uzafkara_1" class="skt-link">Śaṅkara_1</a>; on l'appelle aussi <a href="#entry-Ua_s_taavakrasa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">Aṣṭāvakrasaṃhitā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_taavakrasa_mhitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭāvakrasaṃhitā</i> [<a href="#entry-sa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">saṃhitā</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_taavakrasa_mhitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de l'Aṣṭāvakrasaṃhitā; cf. <a href="#entry-Ua_s_taavakragiitaa" class="skt-link">Aṣṭāvakragītā</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-a_s_taavakra" class="skt-link">aṣṭāvakra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_taavi_mza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭāviṃśa</i> [<a href="#entry-vi_mza" class="skt-link">viṃśa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-a_s_taavi_mza" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-a_s_taavi_mza" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-a_s_taavi_mzii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aṣṭāviṃśī</i> vingt-huitième <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> en 28 parties.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_taavi_mzati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭāviṃśati</i> [<a href="#entry-vi_mzati" class="skt-link">viṃśati</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_taavi_mzati" class="skt-link">f.</a> vingt-huit.<br> <a href="#entry-a_s_taa" class="skt-link">aṣṭā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_tabhairava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭabhairava</i> [<a href="#entry-bhairava" class="skt-link">bhairava</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_tabhairava" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. géo. les huit temples de <a href="#entry-Ubhairava" class="skt-link">Bhairava</a> à <a href="#entry-Uvaaraa_nasii" class="skt-link">Vārāṇasī</a>-Bénarès.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_tacatvaari_mzat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭacatvāriṃśat</i> [<a href="#entry-catvaari_mzat" class="skt-link">catvāriṃśat</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_tacatvaari_mzat" class="skt-link">f.</a> 48.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_tadhaatu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭadhātu</i> [<a href="#entry-dhaatu" class="skt-link">dhātu</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_tadhaatu" class="skt-link">m.</a> les 8 métaux: fer, cuivre, zinc, mercure, plomb, étain, argent et or.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_tadiggaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭadiggaja</i> [<a href="#entry-diggaja" class="skt-link">diggaja</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_tadiggaja" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. les 8 éléphants soutenant les points cardinaux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. les 8 poètes Telugu de la cour de l'empereur <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_nadeva" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇadeva</a> <a href="#entry-Uraaya" class="skt-link">Rāya</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Ubhuvanavijaya" class="skt-link">Bhuvanavijaya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_taka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अष्टक</span> <i>aṣṭaka</i> [<a href="#entry-a_s_ta" class="skt-link">aṣṭa</a><a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-a_s_taka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-a_s_taka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-a_s_tikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aṣṭikā</i> 8-partite — <a href="#entry-a_s_taka" class="skt-link">n.</a> catégorie de 8 objets <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. not. poème en 8 vers; cf. <a href="#entry-Umadhuraa_s_taka" class="skt-link">Madhurāṣṭaka</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> livre en 8 chapitres [<a href="#entry-adhyaaya" class="skt-link">adhyāya</a>]; not. <a href="#entry-Ua_s_taadhyaayii" class="skt-link">Aṣṭādhyāyī</a>; le <a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a> en comporte 8 — <a href="#entry-a_s_taka" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du <a href="#entry-raajar_si" class="skt-link">rājarṣi</a> Aṣṭaka, fils de <a href="#entry-Uvizvaamitra" class="skt-link">Viśvāmitra</a> et <a href="#entry-Umaadhavii" class="skt-link">Mādhavī</a>; il effectua un grand sacrifice de cheval [<a href="#entry-azvamedha" class="skt-link">aśvamedha</a>] où tous les rois furent conviés; il emmena au ciel dans son char volant ses trois frères aînés <a href="#entry-Uvasumanaa" class="skt-link">Vasumanā</a>, <a href="#entry-Upratardana" class="skt-link">Pratardana</a> et <a href="#entry-Uzibi" class="skt-link">Śibi</a>; rencontrant en vol le sage <a href="#entry-Unaarada" class="skt-link">Nārada</a>, ils l'invitèrent à bord; <a href="#entry-Ua_s_taka" class="skt-link">Aṣṭaka</a> lui demanda qui devraient-ils abandonner si seulement quatre d'entre eux étaient autorisés à monter au Ciel, et <a href="#entry-Unaarada" class="skt-link">Nārada</a> répondit <a href="#entry-Ua_s_taka" class="skt-link">Aṣṭaka</a>, pour s'être vanté du don de ses vaches; si seulement trois, ce serait <a href="#entry-Upratardana" class="skt-link">Pratardana</a>, pour n'avoir pas donné son cheval à un brâhmane; si seulement deux, ce serait <a href="#entry-Uvasumanaa" class="skt-link">Vasumanā</a>, pour s'être glorifié de son char fleuri; mais si un seul était autorisé à aller au Ciel, ce serait <a href="#entry-Uzibi" class="skt-link">Śibi</a>, qui à la demande d'un brâhmane tua son fils unique <a href="#entry-Ub_rhadgarbha" class="skt-link">Bṛhadgarbha</a> pour lui servir de repas — <a href="#entry-a_s_takaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aṣṭakā</i> 8⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ jour après la pleine lune <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. oblation de ce jour, un <a href="#entry-paakayaj_na" class="skt-link">pākayajña</a>; on y sacrifie un animal aux mânes [<a href="#entry-zraaddha" class="skt-link">śrāddha</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_tama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭama</i> [<a href="#entry--ma" class="skt-link">-ma</a>] a. <a href="#entry-a_s_tama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-a_s_tama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-a_s_tamii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aṣṭamī</i> ord. huitième — <a href="#entry-a_s_tamii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aṣṭamī</i> le 8⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ jour d'un demi-cycle lunaire [<a href="#entry-pak_sa" class="skt-link">pakṣa</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. ce jour est favorable, et occasion de fêtes; cf. not. <a href="#entry-azokaa_s_tamii" class="skt-link">aśokāṣṭamī</a>, <a href="#entry-gopaa_s_tamii" class="skt-link">gopāṣṭamī</a>, <a href="#entry-janmaa_s_tamii" class="skt-link">janmāṣṭamī</a>, <a href="#entry-jyai_s_thaa_s_tamii" class="skt-link">jyaiṣṭhāṣṭamī</a>, <a href="#entry-bhii_smaa_s_tamii" class="skt-link">bhīṣmāṣṭamī</a>, <a href="#entry-bhairavaa_s_tamii" class="skt-link">bhairavāṣṭamī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_tamafgala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭamaṅgala</i> [<a href="#entry-mafgala" class="skt-link">maṅgala</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_tamafgala" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. collection de 8 objets de bon augure; not. le brâhmane, la vache, le feu, l'or, le ghee, le soleil, l'eau et le roi; ou bien le lion, le taureau, l'éléphant, le pot à eau, l'éventail, le drapeau, le tambour et la lampe; dans la religion jaïne, on doit dessiner les 8 symboles avec des grains de riz devant l'icône d'un <a href="#entry-tiirthafkara" class="skt-link">tīrthaṅkara</a> avant de lui rendre hommage; dans la tradition <a href="#entry-digambara" class="skt-link">digambara</a> ces symboles sont: le parasol [<a href="#entry-chattra" class="skt-link">chattra</a>], la bannière [<a href="#entry-dhvaja" class="skt-link">dhvaja</a>], le pot à eau [<a href="#entry-kalaza" class="skt-link">kalaśa</a>], le chasse-mouche [<a href="#entry-caamara" class="skt-link">cāmara</a>], le miroir [<a href="#entry-darpa_na" class="skt-link">darpaṇa</a>], le trône [<a href="#entry-bhadraasana" class="skt-link">bhadrāsana</a>] et l'éventail; dans la tradition <a href="#entry-zvetaambara" class="skt-link">śvetāmbara</a> ils sont: le <a href="#entry-svastika" class="skt-link">svastika</a>, le <a href="#entry-zriivatsa" class="skt-link">śrīvatsa</a>, le <a href="#entry-nandyaavarta" class="skt-link">nandyāvarta</a>, la lampe <a href="#entry-vardhamaanaka" class="skt-link">vardhamānaka</a>, le trône, le pot à eau, le miroir et la paire de poissons [<a href="#entry-miinayugala" class="skt-link">mīnayugala</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_tan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अष्टन्</span> <i>aṣṭan</i> num. <a href="#entry-a_s_tan" class="skt-link">*</a> le nombre huit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. οκτω; lat. <i>octo</i>; ang. eight; all. acht; fr. huit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_tapad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭapad</i> [<a href="#entry-pad_2" class="skt-link">pad_2</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_tapad" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. araignée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. épith. du <a href="#entry-zarabha" class="skt-link">śarabha</a> «qui a 8 pattes» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>aṣṭapāda</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_tapada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭapada</i> [<a href="#entry-pada" class="skt-link">pada</a>] a. <a href="#entry-a_s_tapada" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-a_s_tapada" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-a_s_tapadaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aṣṭapadā</i> lit. (mètre) qui a 8 pieds.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_tapraharii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭapraharī</i> [<a href="#entry-prahara" class="skt-link">prahara</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_tapraharii" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. [8×3=24] festival de chant sacré [<a href="#entry-safkiirtana" class="skt-link">saṃkīrtana</a>] et de danse durant 24 h (not. pour <a href="#entry-dolaapuur_nimaa" class="skt-link">dolāpūrṇimā</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> cérémonie de 24 h de libation d'eau lustrale sur le <a href="#entry-lifga" class="skt-link">liṅga</a> d'un sanctuaire par une épouse pour prier longue vie pour son mari (not. durant <a href="#entry-zivaraatri" class="skt-link">śivarātri</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_tasaahasraka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭasāhasraka</i> [<a href="#entry-saahasraka" class="skt-link">sāhasraka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-a_s_tasaahasraka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-a_s_tasaahasraka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-a_s_tasaahasrikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aṣṭasāhasrikā</i> consistant en 8000 (not. vers [<a href="#entry-zloka" class="skt-link">śloka</a>]) — <a href="#entry-a_s_tasaahasrikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aṣṭasāhasrikā</i> bd. np. de l'Aṣṭasāhasrikā <a href="#entry-Upraj_naapaaramitaa" class="skt-link">Prajñāpāramitā</a> en 8000 formules [<a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a>], la plus ancienne de la tradition (1⟨sup⟩er⟨/sup⟩ siècle ant.).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_s_tasiddhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aṣṭasiddhi</i> [<a href="#entry-siddhi" class="skt-link">siddhi</a>] <a href="#entry-a_s_tasiddhi" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] l'un des 8 pouvoirs surnaturels d'un <a href="#entry-siddha_1" class="skt-link">siddha_1</a> ou de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>: <a href="#entry-a_niman" class="skt-link">aṇiman</a> le pouvoir de rapetisser, <a href="#entry-mahiman" class="skt-link">mahiman</a> le pouvoir de grandir, <a href="#entry-laghiman" class="skt-link">laghiman</a> le pouvoir de se rendre léger et de léviter, <a href="#entry-kaamaavasaayitaa" class="skt-link">kāmāvasāyitā</a> le pouvoir d'éteindre ses passions, <a href="#entry-praakaamya" class="skt-link">prākāmya</a> la toute-puissance, <a href="#entry-vazitva" class="skt-link">vaśitva</a> la volonté irrésistible, <a href="#entry-praapti" class="skt-link">prāpti</a> la supraperception, et <a href="#entry-iizitva" class="skt-link">īśitva</a> la suprématie divine.<br> <i>aṇimā</i> <i>laghimā</i> <i>prāptiḥ</i> <i>prākāmyam</i> <i>mahimā</i> <i>tathā</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>īśitvaṃ</i> <i>ca</i> <i>vaśitvaṃ</i> <i>ca</i> <i>tathā</i> <i>kāmāvasāyitā</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (<a href="#entry-zloka" class="skt-link">śloka</a> mnémotechnique).
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aaprii_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">आप्री</span> <i>āprī_2</i> [<a href="#entry-aaprii_1" class="skt-link">āprī_1</a>] <a href="#entry-aaprii_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. véd. prière conciliatoire rituelle du sacrifice védique, invocation d'un aspect d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>āpryas</i> soc. les invocations ou aspects d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>; leur liste dépend des écoles de rituel; par ex. <a href="#entry-Uvaizvaanara" class="skt-link">Vaiśvānara</a> «Celui qui est à tous les hommes», épith. du Soleil ou du feu <a href="#entry-aahavaniiya" class="skt-link">āhavanīya</a>; <a href="#entry-Utanuunapaat" class="skt-link">Tanūnapāt</a> l'«Auto-engendré»; <a href="#entry-Unaraaza_msa" class="skt-link">Narāśaṃsa</a> «Louange des hommes»; <a href="#entry-Umaatarizvaa" class="skt-link">Mātariśvā</a> «Qui enfle dans la mère».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aaptya_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">आप्त्य</span> <i>āptya_1</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-aap" class="skt-link">āp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aaptya_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aaptya_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aaptyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>āptyā</i> véd. à obtenir, à atteindre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aaptya_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">आप्त्य</span> <i>āptya_2</i> [<a href="#entry-aapas" class="skt-link">āpas</a>] <a href="#entry-aaptya_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. véd. esprit des eaux; les <i>āptyās</i> sont chargés de laver les souillures rituelles, et notamment le sang versé lors des sacrifices; ils sont associés au nadir [<a href="#entry-adhastaat" class="skt-link">adhastāt</a>]; opp. <a href="#entry-saadhyaas" class="skt-link">sādhyās</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Utrita" class="skt-link">Trita</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. d'Āptya, épith. de <a href="#entry-Utrita" class="skt-link">Trita</a> «Bouc émissaire».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aapya_1">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-aap" class="skt-link">āp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aapya_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aapya_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aapyaa_1" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>āpyā_1</i> véd. à obtenir, à atteindre.

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aas_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">आस्</span> <i>ās_2</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. md. <i>(āste)</i> pft. <i>(āsām)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] <i>(āsiṣṭa)</i> fut. <i>(</i><i>āsiṣyate</i><i>)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>āsita</i><i>)</i> ppr. <i>(āsīna)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>āsitvā</i>, <i>-āsya</i><i>)</i> inf. <i>(āsitum)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>adhi</i>, <i>anu</i>, <i>upa</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> s'asseoir, être assis; se trouver; s'établir, rester; résider <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> continuer, pratiquer; être en train de [abs.] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> aboutir à [dat.] — ps. <i>(āsyate)</i> être assis — ca. <i>(āsayati)</i> placer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. ησται.<br> <i>āstām</i> interj. soit, assez.<br> <i>āsyatām</i> adr. asseyez-vous (ps. imp. «qu'il s'asseye»).<br> <i>āsāṃ</i> <i>cakre</i> s'étant assis.<br> <i>juhvata</i> <i>āsate</i> ils ont l'habitude de sacrifier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aas_3">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">आस्</span> <i>ās_3</i> <a href="#entry-aas_3" class="skt-link">n.</a> bouche, visage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>os</i>.<br> <i>āsā</i> var. <i>āsayā</i> i. adv. devant ses propres yeux; en personne <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> de vive voix.

[<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] négation en tant qu'absence.<br> <i>abhāvapratinidhidravya</i> méd. substance de remplacement pour un composé indisponible.

[<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. d'Abhaya «Sans peur», l'un des fils de <a href="#entry-Udh_rtaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Dhṛtarāṣṭra</a>; il fut tué par <a href="#entry-Ubhiima" class="skt-link">Bhīma</a> — <a href="#entry-abhaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> sûreté, sécurité; sérénité.

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhibhaa_sin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिभाषिन्</span> <i>abhibhāṣin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-abhibhaa_s" class="skt-link">abhibhāṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhibhaa_sin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhibhaa_sin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhibhaa_si_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhibhāṣiṇī</i> qui s'adresse à, qui accoste.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhibhaavin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिभाविन्</span> <i>abhibhāvin</i> [<a href="#entry-abhibhuu" class="skt-link">abhibhū</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-abhibhaavin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhibhaavin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhibhaavinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhibhāvinī</i> qui prédomine, qui soumet.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhibhava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिभव</span> <i>abhibhava</i> [<a href="#entry-abhibhuu" class="skt-link">abhibhū</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhibhava" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhibhava" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhibhavaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhibhavā</i> puissant, dominant — <a href="#entry-abhibhava" class="skt-link">m.</a> prédominance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> défaite; soumission à, domination par ⟨i. abl. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> manque de respect, mépris <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> humiliation, mortification.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhibhuu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिभू</span> <i>abhibhū</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-bhuu_1" class="skt-link">bhū_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(abhibhavati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhibhūta</i><i>)</i> dépasser, dominer, l'emporter sur; subjuguer, soumettre, maîtriser; vaincre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhibhuuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिभूत</span> <i>abhibhūta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-abhibhuu" class="skt-link">abhibhū</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhibhuuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhibhuuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhibhuutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhibhūtā</i> vaincu, défait; subjugué, soumis; humilié <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> possédé par ⟨i. iic.⟩.<br> <i>śivaḥ</i> <i>katham</i> <i>abhibhūtaḥ</i> <i>pārvatyā</i> Comment <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> fut-il vaincu par <a href="#entry-Upaarvatii" class="skt-link">Pārvatī</a>?
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhibhuuti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिभूति</span> <i>abhibhūti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-abhibhuu" class="skt-link">abhibhū</a>] <a href="#entry-abhibhuuti" class="skt-link">f.</a> supériorité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhibhuutyojas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhibhūtyojas</i> [<a href="#entry-ojas" class="skt-link">ojas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhibhuutyojas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhibhuutyojas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhibhuutyojas" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui l'emporte pas la force.<br> <a href="#entry-abhibhuuti" class="skt-link">abhibhūti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhicaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिचार</span> <i>abhicāra</i> [<a href="#entry-abhicar" class="skt-link">abhicar</a>] <a href="#entry-abhicaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. pouvoir [<a href="#entry-siddhi" class="skt-link">siddhi</a>] de destruction des ennemis; incantation, magie (à fins maléfiques); sorcellerie; son usage est un crime mineur [<a href="#entry-upapaataka" class="skt-link">upapātaka</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhicaarin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिचारिन्</span> <i>abhicārin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-abhicar" class="skt-link">abhicar</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhicaarin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhicaarin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhicaari_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhicāriṇī</i> magicien, envoûteur; sorcier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhicar">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिचर्</span> <i>abhicar</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-car" class="skt-link">car</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(abhicarati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhicarita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>vi</i><i>)</i> mal agir envers; mal se comporter; not. (pour une femme) être infidèle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> subjuguer, enchanter, ensorceler.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhidhaa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिधा</span> <i>abhidhā_1</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-dhaa_1" class="skt-link">dhā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(abhidadhāti)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>abhidheya</i><i>)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhihita</i><i>)</i> véd. couvrir, protéger <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> expliquer, dire, exprimer; s'adresser à; nommer — ps. <i>(abhidhīyate)</i> s'appeler, se nommer.<br> <i>sa</i> <i>pitāmahanāmnā'bhidhīyate</i> il s'appelle comme son grand-père.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhidhaa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिधा</span> <i>abhidhā_2</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-abhidhaa_1" class="skt-link">abhidhā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-abhidhaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> désignation, nom; dénotation; syn. <a href="#entry-aakhyaa_2" class="skt-link">ākhyā_2</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. dénotation directe, sens littéral d'un mot; il précède les métaphores et autres sens secondaires [<a href="#entry-gu_nav_rtti" class="skt-link">guṇavṛtti</a>]; opp. <a href="#entry-vya_njanaa" class="skt-link">vyañjanā</a>.<br> <i>viśeṣyaṃ</i> <i>nābhidhā</i> <i>gacchet</i> <i>kṣīṇaśaktir</i> <i>viśeṣaṇe</i> [<a href="#entry-Ukumaarila" class="skt-link">Kumārila</a>] La dénotation n'est pas une référence, son pouvoir expressif s'épuise dans la spécification.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhidhaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिधान</span> <i>abhidhāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-abhidhaa_1" class="skt-link">abhidhā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-abhidhaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> désignation, nom <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. expression (morphologique d'un <a href="#entry-kaaraka" class="skt-link">kāraka</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. «nom» d'un mantra, exprimant son but; syn. <a href="#entry-saadhyanaama" class="skt-link">sādhyanāma</a> — ifc. qui a pour nom <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. glossaire, vocabulaire de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhidhaanacintaama_ni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhidhānacintāmaṇi</i> [<a href="#entry-cintaama_ni" class="skt-link">cintāmaṇi</a>] <a href="#entry-abhidhaanacintaama_ni" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. de l'Abhidhānacintāmaṇi «Trésor de noms», dictionnaire/thesaurus [<a href="#entry-naamamaalaa" class="skt-link">nāmamālā</a>] dû à <a href="#entry-Uhemacandra" class="skt-link">Hemacandra</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-abhidhaana" class="skt-link">abhidhāna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhidhaanakoza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhidhānakośa</i> [<a href="#entry-koza" class="skt-link">kośa</a>] <a href="#entry-abhidhaanakoza" class="skt-link">m.</a> la lexicographie, l'un des 64 arts [<a href="#entry-kalaa" class="skt-link">kalā</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhidhaartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhidhārtha</i> [<a href="#entry-artha" class="skt-link">artha</a>] <a href="#entry-abhidhaartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. dénotation directe, sens littéral d'un mot; syn. <a href="#entry-mukhyaartha" class="skt-link">mukhyārtha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhidhaav">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिधाव्</span> <i>abhidhāv</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-dhaav_1" class="skt-link">dhāv_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(abhidhāvati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhidhāvita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>sam</i><i>)</i> courir vers.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhidhaav_rttimaat_rkaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhidhāvṛttimātṛkā</i> [<a href="#entry-v_rtti" class="skt-link">vṛtti</a>-<a href="#entry-maat_rkaa" class="skt-link">mātṛkā</a>] <a href="#entry-abhidhaav_rttimaat_rkaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de l'Abhidhāvṛttimātṛkā «Fondamentaux de la fonction dénotative», ouvrage de rhétorique dû à <a href="#entry-Umukula" class="skt-link">Mukula</a> <a href="#entry-Ubha_t_ta" class="skt-link">Bhaṭṭa</a>; il ne reconnaît que deux modes de signification, le sens littéral [<a href="#entry-mukhyaartha" class="skt-link">mukhyārtha</a>] et le sens figuratif [<a href="#entry-lak_sa_na" class="skt-link">lakṣaṇa</a>], niant l'autonomie du sens suggéré [<a href="#entry-vya_njanaa" class="skt-link">vyañjanā</a>] postulée par <a href="#entry-Uaanandavardhana" class="skt-link">Ānandavardhana</a> avec le concept de <a href="#entry-dhvani" class="skt-link">dhvani</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-abhidhaa_2" class="skt-link">abhidhā_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhidharma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिधर्म</span> <i>abhidharma</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-dharma" class="skt-link">dharma</a>] <a href="#entry-abhidharma" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. métaphysique, dogmes bd. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. philosophie, mystique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>abhidhamma</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhidharmah_rdaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhidharmahṛdaya</i> [<a href="#entry-h_rdaya" class="skt-link">hṛdaya</a>] <a href="#entry-abhidharmah_rdaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. de l'Abhidharmahṛdaya_1, premier condensé de la doctrine bd. <a href="#entry-vaibhaa_sika" class="skt-link">vaibhāṣika</a>, dû à <a href="#entry-Udharmottara_1" class="skt-link">Dharmottara_1</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. de l'Abhidharmahṛdaya_2, version étendue due à <a href="#entry-Uupazaanta" class="skt-link">Upaśānta</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-abhidharma" class="skt-link">abhidharma</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhidharmakoza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhidharmakośa</i> [<a href="#entry-koza" class="skt-link">kośa</a>] <a href="#entry-abhidharmakoza" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. de l'Abhidharmakośa ou Abhidharmakośabhāṣya «Compendium de philosophie», ouvrage bd. majeur de l'école nordique du <a href="#entry-Uhiinayaana" class="skt-link">Hīnayāna</a> en sanskrit, dû à <a href="#entry-Uvasubandhu" class="skt-link">Vasubandhu</a>; il révise le <a href="#entry-Usa_myuktaabhidharmah_rdaya" class="skt-link">Saṃyuktābhidharmahṛdaya</a> de <a href="#entry-Udharmatraata" class="skt-link">Dharmatrāta</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhidharmakozabhaa_sya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhidharmakośabhāṣya</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaa_sya" class="skt-link">bhāṣya</a>] <a href="#entry-abhidharmakozabhaa_sya" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. texte de l'<a href="#entry-Uabhidharmakoza" class="skt-link">Abhidharmakośa</a> de <a href="#entry-Uvasubandhu" class="skt-link">Vasubandhu</a> (vers 380); il se compose d'une glose [<a href="#entry-bhaa_sya" class="skt-link">bhāṣya</a>] et de strophes [<a href="#entry-kaarikaas" class="skt-link">kārikās</a>]; <a href="#entry-Uyazomitra" class="skt-link">Yaśomitra</a> en fit un commentaire [<a href="#entry-vyaakhyaa_2" class="skt-link">vyākhyā_2</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhidharmakozavyaakhyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhidharmakośavyākhyā</i> [<a href="#entry-vyaakhyaa_2" class="skt-link">vyākhyā_2</a>] <a href="#entry-abhidharmakozavyaakhyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de l'Abhidharmakośavyākhyā, commentaire de l'<a href="#entry-Uabhidharmakoza" class="skt-link">Abhidharmakośa</a> dû à <a href="#entry-Uyazomitra" class="skt-link">Yaśomitra</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-abhidharmakoza" class="skt-link">abhidharmakośa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhidharmasamuccaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhidharmasamuccaya</i> [<a href="#entry-samuccaya" class="skt-link">samuccaya</a>] <a href="#entry-abhidharmasamuccaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. de l'Abhidharmasamuccaya «Compendium de métaphysique», ouvrage bd. dû à <a href="#entry-Uasafga" class="skt-link">Asaṅga</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhidheya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिधेय</span> <i>abhidheya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-abhidhaa_1" class="skt-link">abhidhā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhidheya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhidheya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhidheyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhidheyā</i> à mentionner, à exprimer — <a href="#entry-abhidheya" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. signification, sens <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. substantif.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhidhyaa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिध्या</span> <i>abhidhyā_1</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-dhyaa" class="skt-link">dhyā</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(abhidhyāyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhidhyāta</i><i>)</i> méditer; penser à ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhidhyaa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिध्या</span> <i>abhidhyā_2</i> [<a href="#entry-abhidhyaa_1" class="skt-link">abhidhyā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-abhidhyaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> désir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhidhyaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिध्यान</span> <i>abhidhyāna</i> [<a href="#entry--na" class="skt-link">-na</a>] <a href="#entry-abhidhyaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de penser à; méditation; aspiration.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhidroha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिद्रोह</span> <i>abhidroha</i> [<a href="#entry-abhidruh" class="skt-link">abhidruh</a>] <a href="#entry-abhidroha" class="skt-link">m.</a> offense.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhidru">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिद्रु</span> <i>abhidru</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-dru_1" class="skt-link">dru_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(abhidravati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhidruta</i><i>)</i> accourir, courir après, courir vers; infester — ca. <i>(abhidrāvayati)</i> mettre en fuite.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhidruh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिद्रुह्</span> <i>abhidruh</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-druh_1" class="skt-link">druh_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(abhidruhyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhidrugdha</i><i>)</i> faire tort à, en vouloir à; chercher à nuire à ⟨acc. dat.⟩; offenser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhig_rr">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिगॄ</span> <i>abhigṝ</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-g_rr_2" class="skt-link">gṝ_2</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(abhigṛṇāti)</i> s'adresser (avec approbation) à; accueillir, louer; approuver, acquiescer à, autoriser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhigam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिगम्</span> <i>abhigam</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-gam" class="skt-link">gam</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(abhigacchati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhigata</i><i>)</i> aller vers, s'approcher de, suivre; rencontrer, rendre visite à <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> avoir des rapports sexuels avec.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhigama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिगम</span> <i>abhigama</i> [<a href="#entry-abhigam" class="skt-link">abhigam</a>] <a href="#entry-abhigama" class="skt-link">m.</a> approche; visite <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> approche sexuelle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhigamana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhigamana</i> [<a href="#entry--na" class="skt-link">-na</a>] <a href="#entry-abhigamana" class="skt-link">n.</a> approche, visite <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. l'approche de la divinité, un <a href="#entry-pa_ncopaasana" class="skt-link">pañcopāsana</a> selon <a href="#entry-Uraamaanuja" class="skt-link">Rāmānuja</a>; on nettoie et on purifie de bouse de vache son chemin d'accès.<br> <a href="#entry-abhigama" class="skt-link">abhigama</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhigara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिगर</span> <i>abhigara</i> [<a href="#entry-abhig_rr" class="skt-link">abhigṝ</a>] <a href="#entry-abhigara" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. approbation cérémoniale (du prêtre principal lors d'un sacrifice); opp. <a href="#entry-apagara" class="skt-link">apagara</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhigupta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिगुप्त</span> <i>abhigupta</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-gupta" class="skt-link">gupta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhigupta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhigupta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhiguptaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhiguptā</i> gardé, caché.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhih_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिहृ</span> <i>abhihṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-h_r_1" class="skt-link">hṛ_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(abhiharati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhihṛta</i><i>)</i> offrir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> enlever, arracher, déchirer — ca. <i>(abhihārayati)</i> présenter, apporter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhihaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिहार</span> <i>abhihāra</i> [act. <a href="#entry-abhih_r" class="skt-link">abhihṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-abhihaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> vol à l'arraché; attaque brusque.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhihaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिहास</span> <i>abhihāsa</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-haasa" class="skt-link">hāsa</a>] <a href="#entry-abhihaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> plaisanterie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhihan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिहन्</span> <i>abhihan</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-han_1" class="skt-link">han_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(abhihanti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhihata</i><i>)</i> frapper, abattre; tuer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhihita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिहित</span> <i>abhihita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-abhidhaa_1" class="skt-link">abhidhā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhihita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhihita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhihitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhihitā</i> exprimé, désigné; expliqué <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. actant dont le rôle [<a href="#entry-kaaraka" class="skt-link">kāraka</a>] est exprimé par le prédicat, et mis au nominatif pour s'accorder comme sujet.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhihitatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhihitatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-abhihitatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. fait d'être exprimé ou nommé.<br> <a href="#entry-abhihita" class="skt-link">abhihita</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhii_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभीष्</span> <i>abhīṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-i_s_1" class="skt-link">iṣ_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(abhīcchati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhīṣṭa</i><i>)</i> viser à, tendre à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhii_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभीष्ट</span> <i>abhīṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-abhii_s" class="skt-link">abhīṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhii_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhii_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhii_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhīṣṭā</i> désiré, aimé, cher — <a href="#entry-abhii_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> souhait.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhii_s_tadevataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhīṣṭadevatā</i> [<a href="#entry-devataa" class="skt-link">devatā</a>] <a href="#entry-abhii_s_tadevataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. déesse d'élection (invoquée not. au moment de mourir).<br> <a href="#entry-abhii_s_ta" class="skt-link">abhīṣṭa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhii_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(abhyeti)</i> pr. md. <i>(abhīte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhīta_1</i><i>)</i> s'approcher de, aller vers, se joindre à; s'incarner en.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhii_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभी</span> <i>abhī_2</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-bhii_2" class="skt-link">bhī_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhii_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhii_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhī</i> sans crainte.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhii_3">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभी</span> <i>abhī_3</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhiik_s_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभीक्ष्ण</span> <i>abhīkṣṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-k_sa_na" class="skt-link">kṣaṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhiik_s_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhiik_s_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhiik_s_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhīkṣṇā</i> constant; perpétuel.<br> <i>abhīkṣṇam</i> répétitivement, constamment, perpétuellement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhiik_s_nazas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhīkṣṇaśas</i> [<a href="#entry--zas" class="skt-link">-śas</a>] adv. constamment.<br> <a href="#entry-abhiik_s_na" class="skt-link">abhīkṣṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhiika_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhīka_1</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhiika_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhiika_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhiikaa_1" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhīkā_1</i> courageux.<br> <a href="#entry-abhii_2" class="skt-link">abhī_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhiika_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभीक</span> <i>abhīka_2</i> [<a href="#entry-abhika" class="skt-link">abhika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhiika_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhiika_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhiikaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhīkā_2</i> voluptueux; lascif, libidineux; syn. <a href="#entry-abhika" class="skt-link">abhika</a> — <a href="#entry-abhiika_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> amant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhiika_3">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभीक</span> <i>abhīka_3</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-ac" class="skt-link">ac</a>] <a href="#entry-abhiika_3" class="skt-link">n.</a> rencontre, collision.<br> <i>abhīke</i> près de, vers, en présence de ⟨g.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhiips">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभीप्स्</span> <i>abhīps</i> [dés. <a href="#entry-abhyaap" class="skt-link">abhyāp</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(abhīpsati)</i> pr. md. <i>(abhīpsate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhīpsita</i><i>)</i> rechercher, désirer, souhaiter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhiipsu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभीप्सु</span> <i>abhīpsu</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-abhiips" class="skt-link">abhīps</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhiipsu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhiipsu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhiipsu" class="skt-link">f.</a> désireux d'obtenir, qui recherche ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhiita_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभीत</span> <i>abhīta_1</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-abhii_1" class="skt-link">abhī_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhiita_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhiita_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhiitaa_1" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhītā_1</i> approché.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhiita_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभीत</span> <i>abhīta_2</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-bhiita" class="skt-link">bhīta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhiita_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhiita_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhiitaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhītā_2</i> sans crainte; qui n'a pas peur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhiitavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhītavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] adv. sans crainte.<br> <a href="#entry-abhiita_2" class="skt-link">abhīta_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhiitta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभीत्त</span> <i>abhītta</i> [<a href="#entry-abhii_3" class="skt-link">abhī_3</a>-<a href="#entry-datta" class="skt-link">datta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhiitta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhiitta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhiittaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhīttā</i> conféré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhijaata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिजात</span> <i>abhijāta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-abhijan" class="skt-link">abhijan</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhijaata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhijaata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhijaataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhijātā</i> bien né, de noble origine; beau, aimable — <a href="#entry-abhijaata" class="skt-link">n.</a> naissance noble.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhijan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिजन्</span> <i>abhijan</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-jan" class="skt-link">jan</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. md. <i>(abhijāyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhijāta</i><i>)</i> naître, naître de nouveau; être destiné à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhiji">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिजि</span> <i>abhiji</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-ji" class="skt-link">ji</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(abhijayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhijita</i><i>)</i> conquérir complètement, acquérir par la victoire — dés. <i>(abhijigīṣati)</i> essayer de conquérir, attaquer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhijit">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिजित्</span> <i>abhijit</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-abhiji" class="skt-link">abhiji</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhijit" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhijit" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhijit" class="skt-link">f.</a> victorieux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> né sous le signe de Véga — <a href="#entry-abhijit" class="skt-link">m.</a> astr. np. d'Abhijit «Victorieux», 20⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ astérisme lunaire [<a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a>], corr. à l'étoile Véga de la Lyre; <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> y préside; son symbole est une noix <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. nom du 8⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ moment de la journée [<a href="#entry-muhuurta" class="skt-link">muhūrta</a>], vers midi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhijita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिजित</span> <i>abhijita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-abhiji" class="skt-link">abhiji</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhijita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhijita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhijitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhijitā</i> conquis.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhij_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिज्ञ</span> <i>abhijña</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-abhij_naa" class="skt-link">abhijñā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhij_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhij_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhij_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhijñā</i> expérimenté, connaisseur; habile <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui connaît, familier de ⟨g. iic.⟩ — <a href="#entry-abhij_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhijñā</i> souvenir, rappel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. faculté supernaturelle du <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a>; on en compte cinq: pouvoir de se montrer sous une forme quelconque, audition ou vue à distance quelconque, influence sur les pensées d'une personne, connaissance de son état et de ses antécédents <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>abhiññā</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhij_naa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिज्ञा</span> <i>abhijñā</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-j_naa_1" class="skt-link">jñā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(abhijānāti)</i> pr. md. <i>(abhijānīte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhijñāta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>prati</i><i>)</i> savoir, reconnaître; concéder.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhij_naana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिज्ञान</span> <i>abhijñāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-abhij_naa" class="skt-link">abhijñā</a>] <a href="#entry-abhij_naana" class="skt-link">n.</a> reconnaissance; signe de reconnaissance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. permis de passage; sauf-conduit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhij_naanazakuntalaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhijñānaśakuntalā</i> [<a href="#entry-zakuntalaa" class="skt-link">śakuntalā</a>] <a href="#entry-abhij_naanazakuntalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de l'Abhijñānaśakuntalā «<a href="#entry-Uzakuntalaa" class="skt-link">Śakuntalā</a> reconnue», célèbre drame de <a href="#entry-Ukaalidaasa" class="skt-link">Kālidāsa</a> (<a href="#entry-Uzakuntalaa" class="skt-link">Śakuntalā</a> est reconnue par l'anneau que le roi <a href="#entry-Udu_syanta" class="skt-link">Duṣyanta</a> lui avait donné comme signe de reconnaissance).<br> <a href="#entry-abhij_naana" class="skt-link">abhijñāna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhika</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhikā</i> voluptueux; lascif, libidineux; syn. <a href="#entry-abhiika_2" class="skt-link">abhīka_2</a> — <a href="#entry-abhika" class="skt-link">m.</a> amant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhikaaz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिकाश्</span> <i>abhikāś</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-kaaz" class="skt-link">kāś</a>] int. <i>(abhicākaśīti)</i> illuminer, irradier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> observer attentivement, percevoir.<br> <i>tayor</i> <i>anyaḥ</i> <i>pippalaṃ</i> <i>svādvatti</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>anaśnann</i> <i>anyo</i> <i>abhicākaśīti</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [MO.] L'un d'eux mange la douce baie, l'autre sans manger perçoit intensément.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhikamp">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिकम्प्</span> <i>abhikamp</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-kamp" class="skt-link">kamp</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(abhikampate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhikampita</i><i>)</i> trembler fortement.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhila_sitaarthacintaama_ni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhilaṣitārthacintāmaṇi</i> [<a href="#entry-cintaama_ni" class="skt-link">cintāmaṇi</a>] <a href="#entry-abhila_sitaarthacintaama_ni" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. de l'Abhilaṣitārthacintāmaṇi, épith. de l'œuvre encyclopédique <a href="#entry-Umaanasollaasa" class="skt-link">Mānasollāsa</a> «Joyau qui satisfait tous les désirs».<br> <a href="#entry-abhila_sita" class="skt-link">abhilaṣita</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhilaa_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिलाष</span> <i>abhilāṣa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-abhila_s" class="skt-link">abhilaṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-abhilaa_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> envie, désir; penchant, affection — <a href="#entry-abhilaa_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhilāṣā</i> ifc. désir de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhilikh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिलिख्</span> <i>abhilikh</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-likh" class="skt-link">likh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(abhilikhati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhilikhita</i><i>)</i> peindre; graver, inscrire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhilikhita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिलिखित</span> <i>abhilikhita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-abhilikh" class="skt-link">abhilikh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhilikhita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhilikhita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhilikhitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhilikhitā</i> inscrit, gravé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhim_rd">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिमृद्</span> <i>abhimṛd</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-m_rd_1" class="skt-link">mṛd_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(abhimṛdnāti)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(abhimardati)</i> traiter violemment, détruire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhimaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिमान</span> <i>abhimāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-abhiman" class="skt-link">abhiman</a>] <a href="#entry-abhimaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> orgueil; égoïsme; préjugé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhimaanavaadin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhimānavādin</i> [<a href="#entry-vaadin" class="skt-link">vādin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhimaanavaadin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhimaanavaadin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhimaanavaadinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhimānavādinī</i> soc. tenant de l'importance de la fierté familiale; opp. <a href="#entry-gotravaadin" class="skt-link">gotravādin</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-abhimaana" class="skt-link">abhimāna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhimaanin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिमानिन्</span> <i>abhimānin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-abhiman" class="skt-link">abhiman</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhimaanin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhimaanin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhimaaninii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhimāninī</i> fier, orgueuilleux — ifc. imbu de posséder, s'imaginant être ou posséder, prétendant être.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhimaarutam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिमारुतम्</span> <i>abhimārutam</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-maaruta" class="skt-link">māruta</a>] adv. contre le vent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhimaati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिमाति</span> <i>abhimāti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-abhiman" class="skt-link">abhiman</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhimaati" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhimaati" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhimaati" class="skt-link">f.</a> insidieux — <a href="#entry-abhimaati" class="skt-link">f.</a> plan d'attaque <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ennemi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhiman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिमन्</span> <i>abhiman</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-man" class="skt-link">man</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. md. <i>(abhimanyate)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">8</span>] pr. md. <i>(abhimanute)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhimata</i><i>)</i> désirer; avoir de mauvaises intentions, menacer; blesser <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> croire, présumer; avoir une haute opinion de soi, être orgueilleux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhimanyu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिमन्यु</span> <i>abhimanyu</i> [<a href="#entry-abhiman" class="skt-link">abhiman</a>] <a href="#entry-abhimanyu" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. du vaillant Abhimanyu «le Fier», fils d'<a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a> et de <a href="#entry-Usubhadraa" class="skt-link">Subhadrā</a>, et donc appelé <a href="#entry-Usaubhadra" class="skt-link">Saubhadra</a>; il épousa <a href="#entry-Uuttaraa" class="skt-link">Uttarā</a> qui lui donna son fils <a href="#entry-Upariik_sit" class="skt-link">Parīkṣit</a>; au 13⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ jour de la grande bataille il réussit à pénétrer le puissant retranchement [<a href="#entry-cakravyuuha" class="skt-link">cakravyūha</a>] de l'armée des <a href="#entry-Ukauravaas" class="skt-link">Kauravās</a>, tua <a href="#entry-Ulak_sma_na_1" class="skt-link">Lakṣmaṇa_1</a> fils de <a href="#entry-Uduryodhana" class="skt-link">Duryodhana</a>, mais fut finalement tué traîtreusement par le fils de <a href="#entry-Udu_hzaasana" class="skt-link">Duḥśāsana</a> à l'âge de 16 ans; dans une vie antérieure [<a href="#entry-puurvajanman" class="skt-link">pūrvajanman</a>] il avait été <a href="#entry-Uvarcaa" class="skt-link">Varcā</a>, envoyé des dieux sur Terre pour servir le <a href="#entry-dharma" class="skt-link">dharma</a> pendant 16 ans avant de retrouver son père <a href="#entry-Ucandra" class="skt-link">Candra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhimarda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिमर्द</span> <i>abhimarda</i> [<a href="#entry-abhim_rd" class="skt-link">abhimṛd</a>] <a href="#entry-abhimarda" class="skt-link">m.</a> violence, attentat.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhimata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिमत</span> <i>abhimata</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-abhiman" class="skt-link">abhiman</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhimata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhimata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhimataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhimatā</i> désiré, estimé, cher, précieux — <a href="#entry-abhimata" class="skt-link">n.</a> désir, vœu — <a href="#entry-abhimata" class="skt-link">m.</a> amant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhimukha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिमुख</span> <i>abhimukha</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-mukha" class="skt-link">mukha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhimukha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhimukha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhimukhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhimukhī</i> tourné vers, se dirigeant vers ⟨dat. acc.⟩; imminent — ifc. prêt à, disposé à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhinand">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिनन्द्</span> <i>abhinand</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-nand" class="skt-link">nand</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(abhinandati)</i> pr. md. <i>(abhinandate)</i> se réjouir de, trouver son plaisir à ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> accueillir, louer, féliciter, souhaiter la bienvenue à ⟨acc.⟩ — ca. <i>(abhinandayati)</i> réjouir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhinanda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिनन्द</span> <i>abhinanda</i> [<a href="#entry-abhinand" class="skt-link">abhinand</a>] <a href="#entry-abhinanda" class="skt-link">m.</a> volupté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. d'Abhinanda, lettré brâhmane <a href="#entry-Ugau_da" class="skt-link">Gauḍa</a> du <a href="#entry-Ukazmiira" class="skt-link">Kaśmīra</a> de la fin du 9⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle, auteur du <a href="#entry-Ukaadambariikathaasara" class="skt-link">Kādambarīkathāsara</a> — <a href="#entry-abhinandaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhinandā</i> id. — ifc. désir de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhinandana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhinandana</i> [<a href="#entry--na" class="skt-link">-na</a>] <a href="#entry-abhinandana" class="skt-link">n.</a> réjouissement, réjouissance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> félicitation, éloge, célébration — <a href="#entry-abhinandana" class="skt-link">m.</a> jn. np. d'Abhinandana «Maître de la félicité», 4⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-tiirthafkara" class="skt-link">tīrthaṅkara</a> mythique; son corps est doré, le singe est son symbole.<br> <i>abhinandanam</i> félicitations!<br> <i>abhinandanagrantha</i> volume en l'honneur d'un maître.<br> <a href="#entry-abhinanda" class="skt-link">abhinanda</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhinandaniiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिनन्दनीय</span> <i>abhinandanīya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <a href="#entry-abhinand" class="skt-link">abhinand</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhinandaniiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhinandaniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhinandaniiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhinandanīyā</i> digne d'éloge; qu'on doit féliciter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhinandin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिनन्दिन्</span> <i>abhinandin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-abhinand" class="skt-link">abhinand</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhinandin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhinandin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhinandinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhinandinī</i> qui trouve son plaisir à, qui loue, qui se déclare satisfait de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhinava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिनव</span> <i>abhinava</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-nava_1" class="skt-link">nava_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhinava" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhinava" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhinavaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhinavā</i> tout nouveau; frais; renouvelé; moderne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhinavabhaaratii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhinavabhāratī</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaaratii" class="skt-link">bhāratī</a>] <a href="#entry-abhinavabhaaratii" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de l'Abhinavabhāratī, commentaire par <a href="#entry-Uabhinavagupta" class="skt-link">Abhinavagupta</a> du <a href="#entry-Unaa_tyazaastra" class="skt-link">Nāṭyaśāstra</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-abhinava" class="skt-link">abhinava</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhinavagupta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhinavagupta</i> [<a href="#entry-gupta" class="skt-link">gupta</a>] <a href="#entry-abhinavagupta" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. d'Abhinavagupta, important philosophe du <a href="#entry-Ukazmiira" class="skt-link">Kaśmīra</a> du 10⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle, élève d'<a href="#entry-Uutpaladeva" class="skt-link">Utpaladeva</a>; il est l'auteur de nombreux ouvrages de <a href="#entry-zaivasiddhaanta" class="skt-link">śaivasiddhānta</a>, not. de l'<a href="#entry-Uiizvarapratyabhij_naaviv_rttivimarzinii" class="skt-link">Īśvarapratyabhijñāvivṛttivimarśinī</a>; on lui doit aussi un commentaire [<a href="#entry-locana" class="skt-link">locana</a>] du <a href="#entry-Udhvanyaaloka" class="skt-link">Dhvanyāloka</a> expliquant l'esthétique des figures de style en littérature, et l'<a href="#entry-Uabhinavabhaaratii" class="skt-link">Abhinavabhāratī</a>, commentaire du <a href="#entry-Unaa_tyazaastra" class="skt-link">Nāṭyaśāstra</a>; il enseignait à <a href="#entry-Uzriinagara" class="skt-link">Śrīnagara</a> la pratique du sacrifice de transgression [<a href="#entry-kulayaaga" class="skt-link">kulayāga</a>], et était considéré comme incarnation de <a href="#entry-Ubhairava" class="skt-link">Bhairava</a>; <a href="#entry-Uk_semaraaja" class="skt-link">Kṣemarāja</a> fut son disciple; cf. <a href="#entry-Utantraaloka" class="skt-link">Tantrāloka</a>, <a href="#entry-Uparamaarthasaara" class="skt-link">Paramārthasāra</a>, <a href="#entry-Uparaatri_mzikaavivara_na" class="skt-link">Parātriṃśikāvivaraṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uparyantapa_ncaazikaa" class="skt-link">Paryantapañcāśikā</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubodhapa_ncadazikaa" class="skt-link">Bodhapañcadaśikā</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvivara_na_2" class="skt-link">Vivaraṇa_2</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhinaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिनय</span> <i>abhinaya</i> [act. <a href="#entry-abhinii" class="skt-link">abhinī</a>] <a href="#entry-abhinaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> gestuelle; jeu, interprétation d'un acteur; pantomime, représentation théâtrale <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. geste rituel.<br> <i>sābhinayam</i> adv. par gestes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhinayadarpa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>abhinayadarpaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-darpa_na" class="skt-link">darpaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-abhinayadarpa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. de l'Abhinayadarpaṇa «Miroir de gestuelle», manuel de gestuelle attribué à <a href="#entry-Unandikezvara_1" class="skt-link">Nandikeśvara_1</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-abhinaya" class="skt-link">abhinaya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhinet_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिनेतृ</span> <i>abhinetṛ</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-abhinii" class="skt-link">abhinī</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhinet_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhinet_r" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhinetrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhinetrī</i> danseur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhineya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिनेय</span> <i>abhineya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-abhinii" class="skt-link">abhinī</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhineya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhineya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhineyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhineyā</i> à représenter (au théâtre).<br> <i>tasyaikadeśaḥ</i> <i>abhineyārthaḥ</i> <i>kṛtaḥ</i> une portion en a déjà été adaptée au théâtre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhinii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिनी</span> <i>abhinī</i> [<a href="#entry-abhi" class="skt-link">abhi</a>-<a href="#entry-nii_1" class="skt-link">nī_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(abhinayati)</i> mimer, représenter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhiniveza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिनिवेश</span> <i>abhiniveśa</i> [<a href="#entry-abhiniviz" class="skt-link">abhiniviś</a>] <a href="#entry-abhiniveza" class="skt-link">m.</a> penchant, obsession, désir ardent; affection envers, dévotion envers ⟨loc. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> détermination, opiniâtreté, obstination; projet <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] attachement à l'existence; cf. <a href="#entry-abhinivezakleza" class="skt-link">abhiniveśakleśa</a>.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhinivezakleza">

  </div>

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhinna">

  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(abhipṛṇāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhipūrṇa</i><i>)</i> se remplir — ca. <i>(abhipūrayati)</i> remplir, donner en abondance.

[<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(abhivādayati)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>abhivādya</i><i>)</i> saluer, accueillir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> faire réciter; interpréter.<br> <i>abhivādaye</i> <i>devadatto'ham</i> (salut poli) moi, <a href="#entry-Udevadatta" class="skt-link">Devadatta</a>, te salue respectueusement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhivaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिवाद</span> <i>abhivāda</i> [act. <a href="#entry-abhivad" class="skt-link">abhivad</a>] <a href="#entry-abhivaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> salutation respectueuse, accueil; opp. <a href="#entry-ativaada" class="skt-link">ativāda</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> signification, interprétation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhivaadana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhivaadin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अभिवादिन्</span> <i>abhivādin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-abhivad" class="skt-link">abhivad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhivaadin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhivaadin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhivaadinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhivādinī</i> qui accueille <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [«qui explique»] interprète, commentateur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-abhivaadya">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-abhivad" class="skt-link">abhivad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-abhivaadya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-abhivaadya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-abhivaadyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>abhivādyā</i> à saluer — ind. ayant salué.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(abhivadati)</i> adresser la parole, dire à qqn. ⟨acc.⟩ — ca. <i>(abhivādayati)</i> saluer, accueillir.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>

  </div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(abhivyāharati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhivyāhṛta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>sam</i><i>)</i> prononcer, dire; converser.

[<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. md. <i>(abhiyuṅkte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhiyukta</i><i>)</i> convoquer, inviter à ⟨dat.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> entreprendre, se mettre à; se préparer à ⟨acc. inf.⟩, s'appliquer à — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(abhiyunakti)</i> ordonner, charger de ⟨loc.⟩; rencontrer, attaquer.<br> <i>vayaṃ</i> <i>svakarmaṇyabhiyujyāmahe</i> nous nous appliquons à notre tâche.
  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(abhiśocati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>abhiśocita</i><i>)</i> regretter amèrement, faire le deuil de qqn. ⟨acc.⟩.

[<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. md. <i>(abhrāyate)</i> se couvrir de nuages <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>imber</i>, <i>umbra</i>; fr. ombre.

  </div>
</div>
