  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akṣakumāra</i> [<a href="#entry-kumaara" class="skt-link">kumāra</a>] <a href="#entry-ak_sakumaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du jeune <a href="#entry-raak_sasa" class="skt-link">rākṣasa</a> Akṣakumāra «Œil», fils cadet de <a href="#entry-Uraava_na" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇa</a> et <a href="#entry-Umandodarii" class="skt-link">Mandodarī</a>; il fut tué par <a href="#entry-Uhanumaan" class="skt-link">Hanumān</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_sama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अक्षम</span> <i>akṣama</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-k_sama" class="skt-link">kṣama</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ak_sama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ak_sama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ak_samaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akṣamā</i> incapable de ⟨loc. inf. iic.⟩; qui ne convient pas <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> envieux, impatient — <a href="#entry-ak_samaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akṣamā</i> envie; impatience.<br> <i>tasyā</i> <i>vikāro</i> <i>vilambākṣamaḥ</i> Sa maladie ne souffre aucun retard.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_samaalaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akṣamālā</i> [<a href="#entry-maalaa" class="skt-link">mālā</a>] <a href="#entry-ak_samaalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> rosaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. d'Akṣamālā, avatar d'<a href="#entry-Uarundhatii" class="skt-link">Arundhatī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_samada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akṣamada</i> [<a href="#entry-mada" class="skt-link">mada</a>] <a href="#entry-ak_samada" class="skt-link">m.</a> passion du jeu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_samavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akṣamavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ak_samavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ak_samavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ak_samavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akṣamavatī</i> impatient.<br> <a href="#entry-ak_sama" class="skt-link">akṣama</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_san">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अक्षन्</span> <i>akṣan</i> [<a href="#entry-ak_sa" class="skt-link">akṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-ak_san" class="skt-link">n.</a> œil <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] le sens [<a href="#entry-buddhiindriya" class="skt-link">buddhīndriya</a>] de la vue; son régent [<a href="#entry-niyant_r" class="skt-link">niyantṛ</a>] est <a href="#entry-Uaaditya" class="skt-link">Āditya</a>; la perception [<a href="#entry-tanmaatra" class="skt-link">tanmātra</a>] associée est la forme [<a href="#entry-ruupa" class="skt-link">rūpa</a>]; syn. <a href="#entry-cak_sus" class="skt-link">cakṣus</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>akṣi</i> id. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> du. <i>akṣī</i> les (2) yeux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> véd. le Soleil et la Lune — <a href="#entry-ak_sii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akṣī</i> ifc. (femme) au regard ⟨iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>oculus</i>; ang. eye; fr. œil.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_sapaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akṣapāda</i> [<a href="#entry-paada" class="skt-link">pāda</a>] <a href="#entry-ak_sapaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du philosophe antique Akṣapāda <a href="#entry-Ugautama" class="skt-link">Gautama</a>, ou <a href="#entry-Ugotama_1" class="skt-link">Gotama_1</a>, logicien antique, fondateur de la doctrine <a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>, de date controversée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_sapari">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akṣapari</i> [<a href="#entry-pari" class="skt-link">pari</a>] ind. coup de dé malheureux (où le dé tourne en sens inverse du coup précédent) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> manqué d'un dé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_sapriya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akṣapriya</i> [<a href="#entry-priya" class="skt-link">priya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ak_sapriya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ak_sapriya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ak_sapriyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akṣapriyā</i> [«aimé des dés»] heureux au jeu, chanceux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> adonné au jeu, joueur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> «adonné aux dés».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_sara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अक्षर</span> <i>akṣara</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-k_sara" class="skt-link">kṣara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ak_sara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ak_sara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ak_saraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akṣarā</i> impérissable, inaltérable; éternel — <a href="#entry-ak_sara" class="skt-link">n.</a> son; phonème, syllabe <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lettre, caractère <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. la syllabe sacrée <a href="#entry-om" class="skt-link">om</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>] l'Éternel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_saraabhyaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akṣarābhyāsa</i> [<a href="#entry-abhyaasa" class="skt-link">abhyāsa</a>] <a href="#entry-ak_saraabhyaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> apprentissage de l'écriture.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_saraavali">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akṣarāvali</i> [<a href="#entry-aavali" class="skt-link">āvali</a>] <a href="#entry-ak_saraavali" class="skt-link">f.</a> chaîne de caractères.<br> <a href="#entry-ak_sara" class="skt-link">akṣara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_saramu_s_tikaakathana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akṣaramuṣṭikākathana</i> [<a href="#entry-mu_s_tikaakathana" class="skt-link">muṣṭikākathana</a>] <a href="#entry-ak_saramu_s_tikaakathana" class="skt-link">n.</a> l'art de parler avec ses doigts, l'un des 64 arts [<a href="#entry-kalaa" class="skt-link">kalā</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_saranyaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akṣaranyāsa</i> [<a href="#entry-nyaasa" class="skt-link">nyāsa</a>] <a href="#entry-ak_saranyaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> écriture.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_sarasamaamnaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akṣarasamāmnāya</i> [<a href="#entry-samaamnaaya" class="skt-link">samāmnāya</a>] <a href="#entry-ak_sarasamaamnaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. énumération des phonèmes dans les <a href="#entry-zivasuutraa_ni" class="skt-link">śivasūtrāṇi</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_sata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अक्षत</span> <i>akṣata</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-k_sata" class="skt-link">kṣata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ak_sata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ak_sata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ak_sataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akṣatā</i> non frappé, non blessé, indemne; non brisé — <a href="#entry-ak_sata" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. <i>akṣatās</i> grains non vannés (not. d'orge).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_sauhi_nii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अक्षौहिणी</span> <i>akṣauhiṇī</i> <a href="#entry-ak_sauhi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> armée complète de 10 corps d'armée [<a href="#entry-aniikinii" class="skt-link">anīkinī</a>] comprenant 21870 éléphants et chariots, 65610 chevaux et 109350 fantassins.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_sauhi_niipati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akṣauhiṇīpati</i> [<a href="#entry-pati" class="skt-link">pati</a>] <a href="#entry-ak_sauhi_niipati" class="skt-link">m.</a> général en chef.<br> <a href="#entry-ak_sauhi_nii" class="skt-link">akṣauhiṇī</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_saya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अक्षय</span> <i>akṣaya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-k_saya_2" class="skt-link">kṣaya_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ak_saya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ak_saya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ak_sayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akṣayā</i> impérissable, incorruptible, imputrescible.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_sayat_rtiiyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akṣayatṛtīyā</i> [<a href="#entry-t_rtiiyaa" class="skt-link">tṛtīyā</a>] <a href="#entry-ak_sayat_rtiiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. 3⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ jour de la quinzaine claire du mois <a href="#entry-vaizaakha" class="skt-link">vaiśākha</a>; il est présumé avoir été le premier jour du <a href="#entry-satyayuga" class="skt-link">satyayuga</a>; il assure la permanence des actions accomplies ce jour; ce jour de fête est populaire pour les mariages; on y célèbre l'anniversaire de <a href="#entry-Uparazuraama" class="skt-link">Paraśurāma</a>; il ouvre la saison des mangues.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_sayataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akṣayatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-ak_sayataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> impérissabilité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_sayatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akṣayatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-ak_sayatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> impérissabilité.<br> <a href="#entry-ak_saya" class="skt-link">akṣaya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_sayya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अक्षय्य</span> <i>akṣayya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-k_sayya" class="skt-link">kṣayya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ak_sayya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ak_sayya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ak_sayyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akṣayyā</i> indestructible.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_si">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अक्षि</span> <i>akṣi</i> cf. <a href="#entry-ak_san" class="skt-link">akṣan</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_sipak_sman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akṣipakṣman</i> [<a href="#entry-pak_sman" class="skt-link">pakṣman</a>] <a href="#entry-ak_sipak_sman" class="skt-link">n.</a> cil.<br> <a href="#entry-ak_si" class="skt-link">akṣi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_snayaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अक्ष्नया</span> <i>akṣnayā</i> ind. véd. de travers, en diagonale; d'une manière tortueuse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mal, à tort.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_sobhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अक्षोभ्य</span> <i>akṣobhya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-k_sobhya" class="skt-link">kṣobhya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ak_sobhya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ak_sobhya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ak_sobhyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akṣobhyā</i> serein, inébranlable, imperturbable — <a href="#entry-ak_sobhya" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. np. d'Akṣobhya «l'Inébranlable», <a href="#entry-jina" class="skt-link">jina</a> gardien de l'Est dans le panthéon du <a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>, représenté en gén. en <a href="#entry-bhuumisparzamudraa" class="skt-link">bhūmisparśamudrā</a>; il est le <a href="#entry-bodhisattva" class="skt-link">bodhisattva</a> de la <a href="#entry-Upraj_naapaaramitaa" class="skt-link">Prajñāpāramitā</a> — <a href="#entry-ak_sobhya" class="skt-link">n.</a> math. cent mille billions.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ak_sobhyatiirtha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akṣobhyatīrtha</i> [<a href="#entry-tiirtha" class="skt-link">tīrtha</a>] <a href="#entry-ak_sobhyatiirtha" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. d'Akṣobhyatīrtha, (1350–~1365) disciple d'<a href="#entry-Uaanandatiirtha" class="skt-link">Ānandatīrtha</a>-<a href="#entry-Umadhva" class="skt-link">Madhva</a> puis pontife de son ordre; <a href="#entry-Ujayatiirtha" class="skt-link">Jayatīrtha</a> fut son disciple.<br> <a href="#entry-ak_sobhya" class="skt-link">akṣobhya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akaa_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकाण्ड</span> <i>akāṇḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kaa_n_da" class="skt-link">kāṇḍa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akaa_n_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akaa_n_da" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akaa_n_daa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akāṇḍā</i> sans tronc <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inattendu, sans raison.<br> <i>akāṇḍe</i> adv. soudain, sans raison; de manière inattendue.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकाल</span> <i>akāla</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kaala_1" class="skt-link">kāla_1</a>] <a href="#entry-akaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> temps défavorable, contre-temps.<br> <i>akāle</i> adv. à contre-temps <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sans délai.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akaama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकाम</span> <i>akāma</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kaama" class="skt-link">kāma</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akaama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akaama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akaamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akāmā</i> sans désir, indifférent; non épris de, qui ne prend pas plaisir à <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inintentionnel; réticent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. qualifie le <a href="#entry-sandhi" class="skt-link">sandhi</a> qui élide un ‘<i>r</i>’ final devant un ‘<i>r</i>’ initial.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकार</span> <i>akāra</i> [<i>(a)</i>-<a href="#entry-kaara" class="skt-link">kāra</a>] <a href="#entry-akaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> le son ou la lettre ‘<i>a</i>’.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akaara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकारण</span> <i>akāraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kaara_na" class="skt-link">kāraṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-akaara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> absence de motif — a. <a href="#entry-akaara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akaara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akaara_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akāraṇā</i> sans raison, sans motif, sans cause.<br> <i>akāraṇam</i> var. <i>akāraṇena</i> adv. sans raison.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akaaraanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akārānta</i> [<a href="#entry-anta" class="skt-link">anta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akaaraanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akaaraanta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akaaraantaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akārāntā</i> gram. (thème de mot) terminé par ‘<i>a</i>’.<br> <a href="#entry-akaara" class="skt-link">akāra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akaaraprazle_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akārapraśleṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-prazle_sa" class="skt-link">praśleṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-akaaraprazle_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. élision d'une lettre ‘<i>a</i>’ initiale, marquée en écriture par l'<a href="#entry-avagraha" class="skt-link">avagraha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akaarya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकार्य</span> <i>akārya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kaarya" class="skt-link">kārya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akaarya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akaarya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akaaryaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akāryā</i> qui ne doit pas être fait; mauvais, défendu, interdit — <a href="#entry-akaarya" class="skt-link">n.</a> mauvaise action.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akaca">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकच</span> <i>akaca</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kaca" class="skt-link">kaca</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akaca" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akaca" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akacaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akacā</i> chauve.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akalafka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकलङ्क</span> <i>akalaṅka</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kalafka" class="skt-link">kalaṅka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akalafka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akalafka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akalafkaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akalaṅkā</i> immaculé; irréprochable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. du logicien jaïne «l'Immaculé» Akalaṅka ou Akalaṅkadeva; il vivait au Deccan au 8⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; il établit les bases logiques de l'agnosticisme [<a href="#entry-syaadvaada" class="skt-link">syādvāda</a>] et s'opposa à <a href="#entry-Ukumaarila" class="skt-link">Kumārila</a> et aux bouddhistes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akampya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकम्प्य</span> <i>akampya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kampya" class="skt-link">kampya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akampya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akampya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akampyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akampyā</i> imperturbable, inamovible.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akani_s_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकनिष्ठ</span> <i>akaniṣṭha</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kani_s_tha" class="skt-link">kaniṣṭha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akani_s_tha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akani_s_tha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akani_s_thaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akaniṣṭhā</i> qui n'est pas le plus jeune.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akani_s_thataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akaniṣṭhatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-akani_s_thataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> aînesse (fait d'être le plus vieux).<br> <a href="#entry-akani_s_tha" class="skt-link">akaniṣṭha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akanyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकन्या</span> <i>akanyā</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kanyaa" class="skt-link">kanyā</a>] <a href="#entry-akanyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> femme qui n'est plus vierge.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akarmaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकर्मक</span> <i>akarmaka</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-karmaka" class="skt-link">karmaka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akarmaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akarmaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akarmakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akarmakā</i> inactif <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. (verbe) intransitif; opp. <a href="#entry-sakarmaka" class="skt-link">sakarmaka</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akarman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकर्मन्</span> <i>akarman</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-karman" class="skt-link">karman</a>] <a href="#entry-akarman" class="skt-link">n.</a> inactivité, inaction — a. <a href="#entry-akarman" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akarman" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akarma_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akarmaṇī</i> inactif.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akart_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकर्तृ</span> <i>akartṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kart_r" class="skt-link">kartṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akart_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akart_r" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akartrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akartrī</i> non créateur, non auteur; inactif.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akart_rtva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akartṛtva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-akart_rtva" class="skt-link">n.</a> état d'inaction.<br> <a href="#entry-akart_r" class="skt-link">akartṛ</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akasmaadaagantu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akasmādāgantu</i> [<a href="#entry-aagantu" class="skt-link">āgantu</a>] <a href="#entry-akasmaadaagantu" class="skt-link">m.</a> arrivée fortuite, hôte inattendu.<br> <a href="#entry-akasmaat" class="skt-link">akasmāt</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akasmaat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकस्मात्</span> <i>akasmāt</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kasmaat" class="skt-link">kasmāt</a>] adv. sans cause apparente; tout d'un coup, soudainement; de manière inattendue; accidentellement, par hasard; en vain.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akathita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकथित</span> <i>akathita</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kathita" class="skt-link">kathita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akathita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akathita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akathitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akathitā</i> non mentionné, sous-entendu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. se dit de l'objet secondaire d'un verbe gouvernant deux accusatifs.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akeza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकेश</span> <i>akeśa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-keza" class="skt-link">keśa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akeza" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akeza" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akezaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akeśā</i> chauve <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. d'Akeśa «le Chauve», épith. de <a href="#entry-Uketu" class="skt-link">Ketu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akha_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अखण्ड</span> <i>akhaṇḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kha_n_da" class="skt-link">khaṇḍa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akha_n_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akha_n_da" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akha_n_daa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akhaṇḍā</i> entier, indivis; intégral; ininterrompu, continuel.<br> <i>akhaṇḍam</i> adv. sans interruption.<br> <i>akhaṇḍā</i> <i>dvādaśī</i> 12⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ jour de la quinzaine claire du mois <a href="#entry-maargaziir_sa" class="skt-link">mārgaśīrṣa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akha_n_dabhaarata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akhaṇḍabhārata</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaarata" class="skt-link">bhārata</a>] <a href="#entry-akha_n_dabhaarata" class="skt-link">n.</a> la Grande Inde; l'Inde éternelle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akha_n_dajyotis">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akhaṇḍajyotis</i> [<a href="#entry-jyotis" class="skt-link">jyotis</a>] <a href="#entry-akha_n_dajyotis" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. feu ininterrompu dans un temple.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akha_n_dala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अखण्डल</span> <i>akhaṇḍala</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kha_n_dala" class="skt-link">khaṇḍala</a>] <a href="#entry-akha_n_dala" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> l'Indivisible.<br> <i>akhaṇḍalaḥ</i> <i>sahasrākṣaḥ</i> <i>virūpākṣas</i> <i>trilocanaḥ</i> <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> a mille yeux, <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> a trois yeux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akha_n_dana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akhaṇḍana</i> [<a href="#entry--na" class="skt-link">-na</a>] <a href="#entry-akha_n_dana" class="skt-link">n.</a> non-division; fait de laisser entier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. non réfutation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akha_n_dapadaspho_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akhaṇḍapadasphoṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-pada" class="skt-link">pada</a>-<a href="#entry-spho_ta" class="skt-link">sphoṭa</a>] <a href="#entry-akha_n_dapadaspho_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. compréhension synthétique du sens du mot.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akha_n_davaakya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akhaṇḍavākya</i> [<a href="#entry-vaakya" class="skt-link">vākya</a>] <a href="#entry-akha_n_davaakya" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. phrase indivisible, parole continue.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akha_n_davaakyaspho_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akhaṇḍavākyasphoṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-spho_ta" class="skt-link">sphoṭa</a>] <a href="#entry-akha_n_davaakyaspho_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. théorie de <a href="#entry-Ubhart_rhari" class="skt-link">Bhartṛhari</a>, posant l'indivisibilité de la sémantique de la phrase.<br> <a href="#entry-akha_n_davaakya" class="skt-link">akhaṇḍavākya</a> <br> <a href="#entry-akha_n_da" class="skt-link">akhaṇḍa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akha_n_dita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अखण्डित</span> <i>akhaṇḍita</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kha_n_dita" class="skt-link">khaṇḍita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akha_n_dita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akha_n_dita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akha_n_ditaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akhaṇḍitā</i> intact, entier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. non réfuté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akhila">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अखिल</span> <i>akhila</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-khila" class="skt-link">khila</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akhila" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akhila" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akhilaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akhilā</i> entier, intégral, complet [«sans lacune»]; tout.<br> <i>akhilena</i> adv. entièrement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akhyaati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अख्याति</span> <i>akhyāti</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-khyaati" class="skt-link">khyāti</a>] <a href="#entry-akhyaati" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-trika" class="skt-link">trika</a>] la nescience; syn. <a href="#entry-avidyaa" class="skt-link">avidyā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akiirti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकीर्ति</span> <i>akīrti</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kiirti" class="skt-link">kīrti</a>] <a href="#entry-akiirti" class="skt-link">f.</a> honte, déshonneur, disgrâce, infâmie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akiirtikara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akīrtikara</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_1" class="skt-link">kara_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akiirtikara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akiirtikara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akiirtikaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akīrtikarā</i> déshonorant, dégradant, qui fait honte.<br> <a href="#entry-akiirti" class="skt-link">akīrti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aki_ncana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकिंचन</span> <i>akiṃcana</i> var. <i>akiñcana</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-ki_ncana" class="skt-link">kiṃcana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aki_mcana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aki_mcana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aki_mcanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akiṃcanā</i> pauvre, indigent [«qui n'a rien»].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aki_ncid">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकिंचिद्</span> <i>akiṃcid</i> var. <i>akiñcid</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-ki_ncid" class="skt-link">kiṃcid</a>] adv. rien.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aki_ncijj_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akiṃcijjña</i> [<a href="#entry-j_na" class="skt-link">jña</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aki_mcijj_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aki_mcijj_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aki_mcijj_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akiṃcijjñā</i> ignorant [«qui ne sait rien»].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aki_ncitkara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>akiṃcitkara</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_1" class="skt-link">kara_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aki_mcitkara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aki_mcitkara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aki_mcitkaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akiṃcitkarā</i> impuissant [«qui ne fait rien»].<br> <a href="#entry-aki_ncid" class="skt-link">akiṃcid</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akkaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अक्का</span> <i>akkā</i> <a href="#entry-akkaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> mère (méprisant) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sœur aînée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. d'Akkā Mahādevī, mystique <a href="#entry-zaiva" class="skt-link">śaiva</a> du 12⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; elle écrivit 430 leçons [<a href="#entry-vaacana" class="skt-link">vācana</a>] en telugu; elle voyageait et mendiait nue en prêchant l'amour de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>; elle connut l'union mystique avec <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>-<a href="#entry-Umallikaarjuna" class="skt-link">Mallikārjuna</a> à <a href="#entry-Uzriizaila" class="skt-link">Śrīśaila</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akli_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अक्लिष्ट</span> <i>akliṣṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kli_s_ta" class="skt-link">kliṣṭa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akli_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akli_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akli_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akliṣṭā</i> frais, dispos, reposé; serein <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> impeccable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. artificiel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akliibataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अक्लीबता</span> <i>aklībatā</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kliibataa" class="skt-link">klībatā</a>] <a href="#entry-akliibataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> virilité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akriyamaa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अक्रियमाण</span> <i>akriyamāṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kriyamaa_na" class="skt-link">kriyamāṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akriyamaa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akriyamaa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akriyamaa_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akriyamāṇā</i> n'étant pas accompli.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akrodha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अक्रोध</span> <i>akrodha</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-krodha" class="skt-link">krodha</a>] <a href="#entry-akrodha" class="skt-link">m.</a> suppression de la colère — a. <a href="#entry-akrodha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akrodha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akrodhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akrodhā</i> sans colère.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akruura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अक्रूर</span> <i>akrūra</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kruura" class="skt-link">krūra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akruura" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akruura" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akruuraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akrūrā</i> pas méchant, doux, gentil — <a href="#entry-akruura" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du prince <a href="#entry-yaadava" class="skt-link">yādava</a> Akrūra «Bienveillant», fils aîné de <a href="#entry-Uzvaphalka" class="skt-link">Śvaphalka</a> et de <a href="#entry-Unandinii_1" class="skt-link">Nandinī_1</a>; [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] il commanda l'armée des <a href="#entry-yaadavaas" class="skt-link">yādavās</a>; c'est un sage parmi les descendants de <a href="#entry-Uv_r_s_ni" class="skt-link">Vṛṣṇi</a> [<a href="#entry-vaar_s_neya" class="skt-link">vārṣṇeya</a>]; il est oncle paternel et ami de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>; envoyé par <a href="#entry-Uka_msa" class="skt-link">Kaṃsa</a> pour inviter <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> et <a href="#entry-Ubalaraama" class="skt-link">Balarāma</a> au festival de <a href="#entry-Ucaapapuujaa" class="skt-link">Cāpapūjā</a> afin de les tuer, il comprit le complot, avertit <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> et lui conseilla de tuer <a href="#entry-Uka_msa" class="skt-link">Kaṃsa</a>; avec son ami <a href="#entry-Uk_rtavarmaa" class="skt-link">Kṛtavarmā</a>, il incita <a href="#entry-Uzatadhanvaa" class="skt-link">Śatadhanvā</a> à assassiner <a href="#entry-Usatraajit" class="skt-link">Satrājit</a> pour qu'il s'empare du joyau magique <a href="#entry-Usyamantaka" class="skt-link">Syamantaka</a>, avant qu'il le leur confie; ils allèrent ensuite faire pénitence à <a href="#entry-Ukaazii" class="skt-link">Kāśī</a>; <a href="#entry-Uakruura" class="skt-link">Akrūra</a> revint à <a href="#entry-Udvaarakaa" class="skt-link">Dvārakā</a> pour mettre fin à une famine, et <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> et <a href="#entry-Ubalabhadra" class="skt-link">Balabhadra</a> décidèrent qu'il garderait le joyau; son épouse est <a href="#entry-Usutanu" class="skt-link">Sutanu</a>, ses fils <a href="#entry-Udevaka_1" class="skt-link">Devaka_1</a> et <a href="#entry-Uupadevaka" class="skt-link">Upadevaka</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अक्त</span> <i>akta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-a_nj" class="skt-link">añj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aktā</i> oint, fardé; humide — <a href="#entry-akta" class="skt-link">n.</a> huile, onguent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aktu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अक्तु</span> <i>aktu</i> [<a href="#entry-akta" class="skt-link">akta</a>] <a href="#entry-aktu" class="skt-link">m.</a> pommade, fard <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lumière, rayon <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fin de nuit (juste avant l'aurore).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aku_tila">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकुटिल</span> <i>akuṭila</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-ku_tila" class="skt-link">kuṭila</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aku_tila" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aku_tila" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aku_tilaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akuṭilā</i> droit, non courbe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akula">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकुल</span> <i>akula</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kula" class="skt-link">kula</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akula" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akula" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akulaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akulā</i> vil, de mauvaise famille — <a href="#entry-akula" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. d'Akula «Hors du clan», épith. de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> — <a href="#entry-akulaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akulā</i> myth. np. d'Akulā, épith. de <a href="#entry-Upaarvatii" class="skt-link">Pārvatī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. se dit des 1⟨sup⟩er⟨/sup⟩, 3⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩, 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩, 7⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩, 9⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩, 11⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩, et 13⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ jours [<a href="#entry-tithi" class="skt-link">tithi</a>] d'une demi-lunaison.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akulaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकुलक</span> <i>akulaka</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kulaka" class="skt-link">kulaka</a>] <a href="#entry-akulakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akulakā</i> (fruit) dénoyauté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akuupaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकूपार</span> <i>akūpāra</i> a. <a href="#entry-akuupaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akuupaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akuupaaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akūpārā</i> véd. illimité — <a href="#entry-akuupaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> l'océan <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. d'Akūpāra, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> «l'Illimité», incarné comme tortue cosmique soutenant le monde; cf. <a href="#entry-Ukuurma" class="skt-link">Kūrma</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-akuzala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अकुशल</span> <i>akuśala</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-kuzala" class="skt-link">kuśala</a>] a. <a href="#entry-akuzala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-akuzala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-akuzalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>akuśalā</i> mauvais — <a href="#entry-akuzala" class="skt-link">n.</a> mal.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अल</span> <i>ala</i> <a href="#entry-ala" class="skt-link">n.</a> aiguillon (d'abeille ou de scorpion).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alaabha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अलाभ</span> <i>alābha</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-laabha" class="skt-link">lābha</a>] <a href="#entry-alaabha" class="skt-link">m.</a> manque à gagner; perte.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alaabu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अलाबु</span> <i>alābu</i> <a href="#entry-alaabu" class="skt-link">f.</a> natu. bot. <i>Lagenaria vulgaris</i>, courge calebasse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>alābū</i> id. — <a href="#entry-alaabu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <i>alābu</i> son fruit; calebasse, gourde.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alabdha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अलब्ध</span> <i>alabdha</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-labdha" class="skt-link">labdha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-alabdha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-alabdha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-alabdhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>alabdhā</i> non obtenu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alabdhanidra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alabdhanidra</i> [<a href="#entry-nidraa_2" class="skt-link">nidrā_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-alabdhanidra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-alabdhanidra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-alabdhanidraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>alabdhanidrā</i> insomniaque.<br> <a href="#entry-alabdha" class="skt-link">alabdha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alabhamaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अलभमान</span> <i>alabhamāna</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-labhamaana" class="skt-link">labhamāna</a>] a. <a href="#entry-alabhamaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-alabhamaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-alabhamaanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>alabhamānā</i> qui n'attrape pas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alafgaamin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alaṃgāmin</i> [<a href="#entry-gaamin" class="skt-link">gāmin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ala_mgaamin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ala_mgaamin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ala_mgaaminii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>alaṃgāminī</i> qui garde bien les vaches; syn. <a href="#entry-anugaviina" class="skt-link">anugavīna</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alafghaniiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अलङ्घनीय</span> <i>alaṅghanīya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-lafghaniiya" class="skt-link">laṅghanīya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-alafghaniiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-alafghaniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-alafghaniiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>alaṅghanīyā</i> insurpassable; qui ne peut être dépassé (not. à la course); invincible <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui ne doit pas être transgressé ou enfreint.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alafghaniiyataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alaṅghanīyatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-alafghaniiyataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> état d'insurpassabilité; invincibilité; fait de ne pas trop s'approcher; fait de ne pas être transgressé ou enfreint.<br> <a href="#entry-alafghaniiya" class="skt-link">alaṅghanīya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alafghita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अलङ्घित</span> <i>alaṅghita</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-lafghita" class="skt-link">laṅghita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-alafghita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-alafghita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-alafghitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>alaṅghitā</i> vierge, non transgressé; (chemin) non foulé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alafk_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alaṃkṛta</i> var. <i>alaṅkṛta</i> [<a href="#entry-k_rta" class="skt-link">kṛta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ala_mk_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ala_mk_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ala_mk_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>alaṃkṛtā</i> préparé, orné; décoré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alafkaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alaṃkāra</i> var. <i>alaṅkāra</i> [<a href="#entry-kaara" class="skt-link">kāra</a>] <a href="#entry-ala_mkaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> préparation; ornement, décoration; fait d'orner <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. figure de style; ornement stylistique, tournure poétique; cf. <a href="#entry-upamaa_2" class="skt-link">upamā_2</a>, <a href="#entry-ruupaka" class="skt-link">rūpaka</a>, <a href="#entry-sasandeha" class="skt-link">sasaṃdeha</a>, <a href="#entry-diipaka" class="skt-link">dīpaka</a>, <a href="#entry-paryaayokta" class="skt-link">paryāyokta</a>, <a href="#entry-zle_sa" class="skt-link">śleṣa</a>, <a href="#entry-prazama" class="skt-link">praśama</a>, <a href="#entry-virodha" class="skt-link">virodha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. sens figuré (opp. <a href="#entry-vastu_1" class="skt-link">vastu_1</a> sens propre).<br> <i>viṣṇur</i> <i>alaṅkārapriyaḥ</i> <i>śivar</i> <i>abhiṣekapriyaḥ</i> soc. (prononcé pendant l'aspersion [<a href="#entry-abhi_seka" class="skt-link">abhiṣeka</a>] du <a href="#entry-lifga" class="skt-link">liṅga</a>) <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> est honoré par l'ornement, <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> est honoré par l'aspersion.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alafkaaracuu_daama_ni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alaṅkāracūḍāmaṇi</i> [<a href="#entry-cuu_daama_ni" class="skt-link">cūḍāmaṇi</a>] <a href="#entry-alafkaaracuu_daama_ni" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. de l'Alaṅkāracūḍāmaṇi «Sommet de l'art poétique», commentaire par <a href="#entry-Uhemacandra" class="skt-link">Hemacandra</a> de son <a href="#entry-Ukaavyaanuzaasana" class="skt-link">Kāvyānuśāsana</a>, lui-même poursuivi par son <a href="#entry-Uviveka_1" class="skt-link">Viveka_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alafkaaratilaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alaṃkāratilaka</i> [<a href="#entry-tilaka" class="skt-link">tilaka</a>] <a href="#entry-ala_mkaaratilaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. de l'Alaṅkāratilaka «Ornement des figures de style», œuvre d'esthétique due à <a href="#entry-Ubhaanudatta" class="skt-link">Bhānudatta</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alafkaaravid">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alaṃkāravid</i> [<a href="#entry-vid_3" class="skt-link">vid_3</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ala_mkaaravid" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ala_mkaaravid" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ala_mkaaravid" class="skt-link">f.</a> connaisseur en poétique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alafkaarazaastra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alaṃkāraśāstra</i> [<a href="#entry-zaastra" class="skt-link">śāstra</a>] <a href="#entry-ala_mkaarazaastra" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. poétique; esthétique; théorie littéraire.<br> <a href="#entry-alafkaara" class="skt-link">alaṃkāra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alafkari_s_nu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alaṃkariṣṇu</i> [<a href="#entry-kari_s_nu" class="skt-link">kariṣṇu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ala_mkari_s_nu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ala_mkari_s_nu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ala_mkari_s_nu" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui aime être orné; désireux de parure <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui a l'habitude d'orner; qui décore ⟨acc.⟩.<br> <i>kanyām</i> <i>alaṃkariṣṇu</i> qui sait parer une jeune fille.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alaghu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अलघु</span> <i>alaghu</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-laghu" class="skt-link">laghu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-alaghu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-alaghu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-alaghu" class="skt-link">f.</a> lourd <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> long (syllabe) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> de poids, significatif; sérieux, solennel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> intense; violent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alak_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अलक्षण</span> <i>alakṣaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-lak_sa_na" class="skt-link">lakṣaṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-alak_sa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-alak_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-alak_sa_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>alakṣaṇā</i> sans signe particulier; ordinaire, non décoré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alak_sita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अलक्षित</span> <i>alakṣita</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-lak_sita" class="skt-link">lakṣita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-alak_sita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-alak_sita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-alak_sitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>alakṣitā</i> qui passe inaperçu, non remarqué; non perçu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अलक</span> <i>alaka</i> <a href="#entry-alaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-alaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> boucle, mèche <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. myth. le peuple des Alakās, habitants d'<a href="#entry-Ualakaa" class="skt-link">Alakā</a> — <a href="#entry-alakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>alakā</i> fillette de 8 à 10 ans <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>alakapurī</i>] myth. np. d'Alakā «Bouclée», capitale de <a href="#entry-Ukubera" class="skt-link">Kubera</a>, fabuleuse réserve de trésors, située sur le flanc du <a href="#entry-Ukailaasa" class="skt-link">Kailāsa</a> dans l'<a href="#entry-Uhimaalaya" class="skt-link">Himālaya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alakanandaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alakanandā</i> [<a href="#entry-nandaa" class="skt-link">nandā</a>] <a href="#entry-alakanandaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> petite fille entre 8 et 10 ans <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. de la rivière Alakanandā, dans l'<a href="#entry-Uhimaalaya" class="skt-link">Himālaya</a>, principale tributaire du Gange; elle traverse <a href="#entry-Ubadariinaatha" class="skt-link">Badarīnātha</a>, et rejoint la <a href="#entry-Ubhaagiirathii" class="skt-link">Bhāgīrathī</a> à <a href="#entry-Udevaprayaaga" class="skt-link">Devaprayāga</a> pour former la <a href="#entry-Ugafgaa" class="skt-link">Gaṅgā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alakapurii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alakapurī</i> [<a href="#entry-purii" class="skt-link">purī</a>] <a href="#entry-alakapurii" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. np. d'Alakapurī, capitale de <a href="#entry-Ukubera" class="skt-link">Kubera</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-alaka" class="skt-link">alaka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alakta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अलक्त</span> <i>alakta</i> <a href="#entry-alakta" class="skt-link">m.</a> laque rouge de résine ou de cochenilles (les femmes s'en fardent la paume des mains et la plante des pieds).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alaktaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alaktaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-alaktaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> id.<br> <a href="#entry-alakta" class="skt-link">alakta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अलम्</span> <i>alam</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-aram" class="skt-link">aram</a>] adv. assez, suffisamment, très <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> assez de, que cesse, ne ... pas ⟨i. abs.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> adéquat ou convenable pour, adapté à ⟨dat. g. iic.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prêt à, capable de, de taille à ⟨inf.⟩.<br> <i>alaṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> préparer, orner.<br> <i>alaṃ</i> <i>kuruta</i> adr. daignez vous installer.<br> <i>alaṃ</i> <i>prajāyāḥ</i> capable de descendance.<br> <i>alaṃ</i> <i>bhuktvā</i> assez mangé.<br> <i>alaṃ</i> <i>vicārya</i> assez discuté.<br> <i>alaṃ</i> <i>śokena</i> ne soyez pas triste.<br> <i>alaṃ</i> <i>haniṣyati</i> il pourra tuer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alambhuu_s_nu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alaṃbhūṣṇu</i> [<a href="#entry-bhuu_s_nu" class="skt-link">bhūṣṇu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ala_mbhuu_s_nu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ala_mbhuu_s_nu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ala_mbhuu_s_nu" class="skt-link">f.</a> compétent, capable.<br> <a href="#entry-alam" class="skt-link">alam</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alambu_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अलम्बुष</span> <i>alambuṣa</i> <a href="#entry-alambu_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> paume de la main, avec les doigts tendus <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. d'Alambuṣa, roi vampire [<a href="#entry-raak_sasa" class="skt-link">rākṣasa</a>] du camp des <a href="#entry-Ukauravaas" class="skt-link">Kauravās</a>, fils de <a href="#entry-Uja_taasura" class="skt-link">Jaṭāsura</a>; il décapita <a href="#entry-Uiraavaan" class="skt-link">Irāvān</a> au début de la grande bataille et fut lui-même décapité par <a href="#entry-Ugha_totkaca" class="skt-link">Ghaṭotkaca</a> — <a href="#entry-alambu_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>alambuṣā</i> barrière; ligne à ne pas franchir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alambu_saayaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alambuṣāyā</i> [<a href="#entry-ayaa" class="skt-link">ayā</a>] <a href="#entry-alambu_saayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. de la nymphe Alambuṣāyā, qui enfanta de <a href="#entry-Uvizaala" class="skt-link">Viśāla</a> par <a href="#entry-Uik_svaaku" class="skt-link">Ikṣvāku</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-alambu_sa" class="skt-link">alambuṣa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अलस</span> <i>alasa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-lasa" class="skt-link">lasa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-alasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-alasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-alasaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>alasā</i> paresseux, indolent, désœuvré; sans énergie, fatigué; inerte <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> langoureux.<br> <i>alasekṣaṇa</i> à l'allure langoureuse.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alasakanyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alasakanyā</i> [<a href="#entry-kanyaa" class="skt-link">kanyā</a>] <a href="#entry-alasakanyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> arch. (sculpture) posture de jeune femme langoureuse.<br> <a href="#entry-alasa" class="skt-link">alasa</a>
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alpaanmukta">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alpaat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alpadhii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alpadhī</i> [<a href="#entry-dhii_2" class="skt-link">dhī_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-alpadhii" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-alpadhii" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-alpadhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> faible d'esprit, stupide; borné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alpaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alpakāla</i> [<a href="#entry-kaala_1" class="skt-link">kāla_1</a>] <a href="#entry-alpakaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> instant.<br> <i>alpakālam</i> adv. en un instant, en peu de temps.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alpapraa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alpaprāṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-praa_na" class="skt-link">prāṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-alpapraa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-alpapraa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-alpapraa_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>alpaprāṇā</i> qui a le souffle court; vite découragé, sans persévérance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. (phonème) non aspiré; opp. <a href="#entry-mahaapraa_na" class="skt-link">mahāprāṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alpasattva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alpasattva</i> [<a href="#entry-sattva" class="skt-link">sattva</a>] a. <a href="#entry-alpasattva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-alpasattva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-alpasattvaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>alpasattvā</i> de faible constitution, peu courageux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> méd. psychologiquement fragile.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alpavidya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alpavidya</i> [<a href="#entry-vidyaa" class="skt-link">vidyā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-alpavidya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-alpavidya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-alpavidyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>alpavidyā</i> peu éduqué; inculte.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alpaviirya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alpavīrya</i> [<a href="#entry-viirya" class="skt-link">vīrya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-alpaviirya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-alpaviirya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-alpaviiryaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>alpavīryā</i> faible, qui a peu de forces.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alpazas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>alpaśas</i> [<a href="#entry--zas" class="skt-link">-śas</a>] adv. à un faible degré, faiblement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-alpiiyas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अल्पीयस्</span> <i>alpīyas</i> [compar. <a href="#entry-alpa" class="skt-link">alpa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-alpiiyas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-alpiiyas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-alpiiyasii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>alpīyasī</i> moindre, plus petit; très petit.

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aluk">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
