  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-am">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">अम्</span> <i>am</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(amati)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] <i>(āmamat)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>amita_2</i><i>)</i> véd. aller vers <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> blesser, faire du mal — ca. <i>(āmayati)</i> rendre malade <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> être malade.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-am_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमृत</span> <i>amṛta</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-m_rta" class="skt-link">mṛta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-am_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-am_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-am_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amṛtā</i> immortel; impérissable — <a href="#entry-am_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. épith. de différents dieux, de <a href="#entry-Udhanvantari" class="skt-link">Dhanvantari</a>, etc. — <a href="#entry-am_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> immortalité; paradis; éternité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. nectar, ambroisie, source d'immortalité des dieux; breuvage apporté par <a href="#entry-Udhanvantari" class="skt-link">Dhanvantari</a> lors du barattage de la mer de lait [<a href="#entry-k_siirodamathana" class="skt-link">kṣīrodamathana</a>], il fut distribué aux dieux par <a href="#entry-Umohinii" class="skt-link">Mohinī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> aumône volontaire, moyen de subsistance convenable pour un brâhmane [<a href="#entry-_sa_tkarman" class="skt-link">ṣaṭkarman</a>] — <a href="#entry-am_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amṛtā</i> nom de diverses plantes, femmes et déesses <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. αμβροσια; fr. ambroisie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-am_rtabindu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amṛtabindu</i> [<a href="#entry-bindu" class="skt-link">bindu</a>] <a href="#entry-am_rtabindu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-am_rtabindu" class="skt-link">n.</a> goutte d'ambroisie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. de l'Amṛtabindūpaniṣad.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-am_rtamathana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amṛtamathana</i> [<a href="#entry-mathana" class="skt-link">mathana</a>] <a href="#entry-am_rtamathana" class="skt-link">n.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-k_siirodamathana" class="skt-link">kṣīrodamathana</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-am_rtasiddhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amṛtasiddhi</i> [<a href="#entry-siddhi" class="skt-link">siddhi</a>] <a href="#entry-am_rtasiddhi" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de l'Amṛtasiddhi «Nectar des pouvoirs surnaturels», texte tantr. du 11⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; il discute not. des impositions rituelles [<a href="#entry-mudraa" class="skt-link">mudrā</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-am_rta" class="skt-link">amṛta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-am_rtatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amṛtatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-am_rtatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> immortalité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-am_rtavar_sin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amṛtavarṣin</i> [<a href="#entry-var_sin" class="skt-link">varṣin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-am_rtavar_sin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-am_rtavar_sin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-am_rtavar_si_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amṛtavarṣiṇī</i> qui distribue l'ambroisie — <a href="#entry-am_rtavar_si_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amṛtavarṣiṇī</i> (mus. carnatique) mode [<a href="#entry-raaga" class="skt-link">rāga</a>] destiné à faire pleuvoir; myth. <a href="#entry-Uraava_na" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇa</a> le joua sur sa <a href="#entry-vii_naa" class="skt-link">vīṇā</a> pour éteindre l'incendie lorsque <a href="#entry-Uhanumaan" class="skt-link">Hanumān</a> mit feu à <a href="#entry-Ulafkaa" class="skt-link">Laṅkā</a> avec sa queue; appelé <a href="#entry-mallaara" class="skt-link">mallāra</a> en Inde du Nord.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-am_rtavelaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amṛtavelā</i> [<a href="#entry-velaa" class="skt-link">velā</a>] <a href="#entry-am_rtavelaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> l'heure avant l'aube.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमा</span> <i>amā</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-asau" class="skt-link">asau</a>] adv. à la maison, chez soi <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ensemble.<br> <i>amā</i> <i>kṛ</i> rester chez soi.<br> <i>amā</i> <i>vas</i> cohabiter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amaa_msaazana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमांसाशन</span> <i>amāṃsāśana</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-maa_msaazana" class="skt-link">māṃsāśana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-amaa_msaazana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amaa_msaazana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-amaa_msaazanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amāṃsāśanā</i> qui s'abstient de manger de la viande.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amaanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amānta</i> [<a href="#entry-anta" class="skt-link">anta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-amaanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amaanta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-amaantaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amāntā</i> qui se termine par la nouvelle lune — <a href="#entry-amaanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> astr. calendrier dont le début du mois commence à la nouvelle lune; il est utilisé en Inde du Sud; syn. <a href="#entry-amaavaasyaanta" class="skt-link">amāvāsyānta</a>; opp. <a href="#entry-puur_nimaanta" class="skt-link">pūrṇimānta</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amaanu_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमानुष</span> <i>amānuṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-maanu_sa" class="skt-link">mānuṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-amaanu_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amaanu_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-amaanu_sii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amānuṣī</i> [«non humain»] de nature animale <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> de nature divine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amaat_rka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमातृक</span> <i>amātṛka</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-maat_r" class="skt-link">mātṛ</a><a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-amaat_rka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amaat_rka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-amaat_rkaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amātṛkā</i> qui n'a pas de mère.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amaatya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमात्य</span> <i>amātya</i> [<a href="#entry-amaa" class="skt-link">amā</a><a href="#entry--tya" class="skt-link">-tya</a>] <a href="#entry-amaatya" class="skt-link">m.</a> qui habite la même maison; proche, parent; compagnon <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [«qui est de la maison royale»] ministre, conseiller du roi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amaavaasyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amāvāsyā</i> [<a href="#entry-vaasyaa_1" class="skt-link">vāsyā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-amaavaasyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> astr. [«quand la lune et le soleil habitent ensemble»] néoménie, (nuit de) nouvelle lune <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>amāvasyā</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amaavaasyaanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amāvāsyānta</i> [<a href="#entry-anta" class="skt-link">anta</a>] <a href="#entry-amaavaasyaanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> astr. calendrier d'Inde du Sud, où les mois commencent à la nouvelle lune; syn. <a href="#entry-amaanta" class="skt-link">amānta</a>; opp. <a href="#entry-puur_nimaanta" class="skt-link">pūrṇimānta</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-amaa" class="skt-link">amā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amaavasu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amāvasu</i> [<a href="#entry-vasu" class="skt-link">vasu</a>] <a href="#entry-amaavasu" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. d'Amāvasu, fils de <a href="#entry-Upuruuravaa" class="skt-link">Purūravā</a> et d'<a href="#entry-Uurvazii" class="skt-link">Urvaśī</a>; il fonda le royaume de <a href="#entry-Ukanyaakubja" class="skt-link">Kanyākubja</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amaayaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमाया</span> <i>amāyā</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-maayaa" class="skt-link">māyā</a>] <a href="#entry-amaayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> absence de tromperie; sincérité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमद</span> <i>amada</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-mada" class="skt-link">mada</a>] a. <a href="#entry-amada" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amada" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-amadaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amadā</i> sans passion, impassible; sans joie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amafgala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमङ्गल</span> <i>amaṅgala</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-mafgala" class="skt-link">maṅgala</a>] a. <a href="#entry-amafgala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amafgala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-amafgalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amaṅgalā</i> qui n'est pas de bon augure; défavorable — <a href="#entry-amafgala" class="skt-link">n.</a> malheur.<br> <i>pratihatam</i> <i>amaṅgalam</i> le malheur est écarté (formule pour conjurer un mauvais présage).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amahaatman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमहात्मन्</span> <i>amahātman</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-mahaatman" class="skt-link">mahātman</a>] a. <a href="#entry-amahaatman" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amahaatman" class="skt-link">n.</a> sans grandeur d'âme, sans noblesse; mesquin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमल</span> <i>amala</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-mala" class="skt-link">mala</a>] a. <a href="#entry-amala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-amalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amalā</i> propre, impeccable; immaculé, pur — <a href="#entry-amala" class="skt-link">m.</a> cristal — <a href="#entry-amala" class="skt-link">n.</a> talc — <a href="#entry-amalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amalā</i> myth. np. d'Amalā, épith. de <a href="#entry-Ulak_smii" class="skt-link">Lakṣmī</a> «l'Immaculée».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amalaananda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amalānanda</i> [<a href="#entry-aananda" class="skt-link">ānanda</a>] <a href="#entry-amalaananda" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du philosophe <a href="#entry-vedaantin" class="skt-link">vedāntin</a> Amalānanda <a href="#entry-Usarasvatii_2" class="skt-link">Sarasvatī_2</a>, auteur du <a href="#entry-Ukalpataru" class="skt-link">Kalpataru</a>, commentaire de la <a href="#entry-Ubhaamatii" class="skt-link">Bhāmatī</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-amala" class="skt-link">amala</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amaniibhaava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमनीभाव</span> <i>amanībhāva</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-manas" class="skt-link">manas</a>-<a href="#entry-bhaava" class="skt-link">bhāva</a>] <a href="#entry-amaniibhaava" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] état d'arrêt de la pensée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amantu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमन्तु</span> <i>amantu</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-mantu" class="skt-link">mantu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-amantu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amantu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-amantu" class="skt-link">f.</a> sans intention.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amar_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमर्ष</span> <i>amarṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-mar_s" class="skt-link">marṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-amar_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> impatience; colère — a. <a href="#entry-amar_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amar_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-amar_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amarṣā</i> qui ne supporte pas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amar_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amarṣaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry--na" class="skt-link">-na</a>] a. <a href="#entry-amar_sa_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amar_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-amar_sa_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amarṣaṇā</i> impatient, irrité; irritable — <a href="#entry-amar_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> impatience de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amar_sin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amarṣin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-amar_sin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amar_sin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-amar_si_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amarṣiṇī</i> impatient, irrité; qui ne laisse rien passer.<br> <a href="#entry-amar_sa" class="skt-link">amarṣa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमर</span> <i>amara</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-mara" class="skt-link">mara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-amara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-amaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amarā</i> immortel — <a href="#entry-amara" class="skt-link">m.</a> dieu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amaraavatii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amarāvatī</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] <a href="#entry-amaraavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. np. d'Amarāvatī, «l'Immortelle» capitale d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>; elle se meut dans les airs <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. d'Amarāvatī_1, capitale du pays <a href="#entry-Uandhra" class="skt-link">Andhra</a> sur la <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_naa" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇā</a>; on y trouve un <a href="#entry-stuupa" class="skt-link">stūpa</a> du 2⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; grand lieu de pélerinage shivaïte, c'est un <a href="#entry-pa_ncaraamak_setra" class="skt-link">pañcarāmakṣetra</a>, le <a href="#entry-zivalifga" class="skt-link">śivaliṅga</a> <a href="#entry-Uamarezvara" class="skt-link">Amareśvara</a> y fut installé par <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. de la principauté d'Amarāvatī_2 du royaume hindouïsé du <a href="#entry-Ucampaa_1" class="skt-link">Campā_1</a> au Sud-Vietnam.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amaraka_n_taka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amarakaṇṭaka</i> [<a href="#entry-ka_n_taka" class="skt-link">kaṇṭaka</a>] <a href="#entry-amaraka_n_taka" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. du «pic des immortels» Amarakaṇṭaka, dans les Monts <a href="#entry-Uvindhya" class="skt-link">Vindhya</a>, où prennent leur source la <a href="#entry-Unarmadaa" class="skt-link">Narmadā</a> et la <a href="#entry-Uzo_naa" class="skt-link">Śoṇā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amarako_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amarakoṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-koza" class="skt-link">kośa</a>] <a href="#entry-amarako_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. de l'Amarakoṣa ou «Thésaurus d'<a href="#entry-Uamarasi_mha" class="skt-link">Amarasiṃha</a>», lexique de sanskrit dû à <a href="#entry-Uamarasi_mha" class="skt-link">Amarasiṃha</a>; aussi appelé <a href="#entry-Unaamalifgaanuzaasana" class="skt-link">Nāmaliṅgānuśāsana</a> et <a href="#entry-Utrikaa_ndhaze_sa" class="skt-link">Trikāṇdhaśeṣa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amarako_sodghaa_tana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amarakoṣodghāṭana</i> [<a href="#entry-udghaa_tana" class="skt-link">udghāṭana</a>] <a href="#entry-amarako_sodghaa_tana" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. de l'Amarakoṣodghāṭana «Révélation du lexique», commentaire de l'<a href="#entry-Uamarako_sa" class="skt-link">Amarakoṣa</a> dû à <a href="#entry-Uk_siirasvaamii" class="skt-link">Kṣīrasvāmī</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-amarako_sa" class="skt-link">amarakoṣa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amaranaatha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amaranātha</i> [<a href="#entry-naatha" class="skt-link">nātha</a>] <a href="#entry-amaranaatha" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. d'Amaranātha «Seigneur immortel», grotte-sanctuaire shivaïte du <a href="#entry-Ukazmiira" class="skt-link">Kaśmīra</a>, abritant un <a href="#entry-lifga" class="skt-link">liṅga</a> de glace.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amarasi_mha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amarasiṃha</i> [<a href="#entry-si_mha" class="skt-link">siṃha</a>] <a href="#entry-amarasi_mha" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. d'Amarasiṃha «Lion immortel», lexicographe bouddhiste de la cour du roi <a href="#entry-Uvikramaaditya" class="skt-link">Vikramāditya</a>, auteur de l'<a href="#entry-Uamarako_sa" class="skt-link">Amarakoṣa</a>, aussi appelé <a href="#entry-Unaamalifgaanuzaasana" class="skt-link">Nāmaliṅgānuśāsana</a>; il est l'un des neuf joyaux [<a href="#entry-navaratna" class="skt-link">navaratna</a>] de la cour du roi <a href="#entry-Uvikramaaditya" class="skt-link">Vikramāditya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amaravat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amaravat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] adv. à l'instar des dieux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amarazakti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amaraśakti</i> [<a href="#entry-zakti" class="skt-link">śakti</a>] <a href="#entry-amarazakti" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. [PT.] np. du roi Amaraśakti «Puissance éternelle», qui demanda à <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nuzarmaa" class="skt-link">Viṣṇuśarmā</a> d'éduquer ses trois crétins de fils.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amarezvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amareśvara</i> [<a href="#entry-iizvara" class="skt-link">īśvara</a>] <a href="#entry-amarezvara" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. de l'Amareśvara, <a href="#entry-zivalifga" class="skt-link">śivaliṅga</a> installé par <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> à <a href="#entry-Uamaraavatii_1" class="skt-link">Amarāvatī_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amaropama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amaropama</i> [<a href="#entry-upama" class="skt-link">upama</a>] a. <a href="#entry-amaropama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amaropama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-amaropamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amaropamā</i> semblable à un dieu.<br> <a href="#entry-amara" class="skt-link">amara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amarottama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amarottama</i> [<a href="#entry-uttama" class="skt-link">uttama</a>] a. <a href="#entry-amarottama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amarottama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-amarottamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amarottamā</i> suprême parmi les dieux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amartya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमर्त्य</span> <i>amartya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-martya" class="skt-link">martya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-amartya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amartya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-amartyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amartyā</i> immortel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amaru">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमरु</span> <i>amaru</i> <a href="#entry-amaru" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. du roi Amaru ou Amaruka, auteur présumé de l'<a href="#entry-Uamaruzataka" class="skt-link">Amaruśataka</a>; il aurait vécu au 8⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; une légende raconte que <a href="#entry-Uzafkaraacaarya" class="skt-link">Śaṅkarācārya</a> entra par magie dans son corps mourant pour avoir l'expérience de la sexualité avec ses épouses.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amaruzataka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amaruśataka</i> [<a href="#entry-zataka" class="skt-link">śataka</a>] <a href="#entry-amaruzataka" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. de l'Amaruśataka, recueil de 100 poèmes attribué au roi <a href="#entry-Uamaru" class="skt-link">Amaru</a>; de saveur érotique [<a href="#entry-z_rfgaararasa" class="skt-link">śṛṅgārarasa</a>], il traite du jeu amoureux; <a href="#entry-Uravicandra" class="skt-link">Ravicandra</a> en donna une interprétation ascétique cachée, attribuant le poème à <a href="#entry-Uzafkaraacaarya" class="skt-link">Śaṅkarācārya</a> incarné en <a href="#entry-Uamaru" class="skt-link">Amaru</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-amaru" class="skt-link">amaru</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amba">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अम्ब</span> <i>amba</i> cf. <a href="#entry-ambaa" class="skt-link">ambā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amba_s_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अम्बष्ठ</span> <i>ambaṣṭha</i> [<a href="#entry-amba" class="skt-link">amba</a>-<a href="#entry-stha" class="skt-link">stha</a>] <a href="#entry-amba_s_tha" class="skt-link">m.</a> nom d'un pays et de ses habitants <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. fils d'un homme de classe <a href="#entry-braahma_na" class="skt-link">brāhmaṇa</a> et d'une femme de classe <a href="#entry-vaizya" class="skt-link">vaiśya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. médecin [<a href="#entry-vaidya" class="skt-link">vaidya</a>] ayant émigré de l'Inde du Sud au Bengale.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ambaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अम्बा</span> <i>ambā</i> <a href="#entry-ambaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> mère <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. d'Ambā, fille aînée du roi de <a href="#entry-Ukaazi" class="skt-link">Kāśi</a>; promise au roi <a href="#entry-Uzaalva" class="skt-link">Śālva</a>, elle fut enlevée par <a href="#entry-Ubhii_sma" class="skt-link">Bhīṣma</a> puis répudiée par <a href="#entry-Uzaalva" class="skt-link">Śālva</a>; elle demanda en vain à tous les princes de combattre <a href="#entry-Ubhii_sma" class="skt-link">Bhīṣma</a>; par de grandes austérités elle obtint la pitié de <a href="#entry-Usubrahma_nya" class="skt-link">Subrahmaṇya</a>, qui lui offrit une guirlande de lotus éternellement fraîche qui permettrait à celui qui la porterait de vaincre <a href="#entry-Ubhii_sma" class="skt-link">Bhīṣma</a>; elle supplia de nouveau tous les princes en vain, notamment le roi <a href="#entry-Udrupada" class="skt-link">Drupada</a>; en partant du palais de ce dernier elle laissa la guirlande à sa porte; elle demanda alors vengeance à <a href="#entry-Uraama_1" class="skt-link">Rāma_1</a> <a href="#entry-Ujaamadagnya" class="skt-link">Jāmadagnya</a> qui combattit <a href="#entry-Ubhii_sma" class="skt-link">Bhīṣma</a> sans succès; elle partit dans l'<a href="#entry-Uhimaalaya" class="skt-link">Himālaya</a> faire de terribles pénitences et <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> lui accorda de renaître transsexuelle comme <a href="#entry-Uzikha_n_dii" class="skt-link">Śikhaṇḍī</a> pour tuer <a href="#entry-Ubhii_sma" class="skt-link">Bhīṣma</a>; elle fit un grand bûcher au bord de la <a href="#entry-Uyamunaa" class="skt-link">Yamunā</a>, dans lequel elle se jeta en disant «Mort à <a href="#entry-Ubhii_sma" class="skt-link">Bhīṣma</a>»; elle renaquit comme la fille <a href="#entry-Uzikha_n_dinii" class="skt-link">Śikhaṇḍinī</a> du roi <a href="#entry-Udrupada" class="skt-link">Drupada</a>; un jour elle retrouva la guirlande à la porte de son palais et la mit autour de son cou; par des pénitences elle changea de sexe, et devint <a href="#entry-Uzikha_n_dii" class="skt-link">Śikhaṇḍī</a> — voc. <i>amba</i> adr. Madame <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tamil ammaa.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ambaa_daa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ambāḍā</i> <a href="#entry-ambaa_daa" class="skt-link">f.</a> mère <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>ambālā</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ambaalikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ambālikā</i> <a href="#entry-ambaalikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> petite mère (terme affectueux) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. d'Ambālikā «Petite Mère», épith. de <a href="#entry-Udurgaa" class="skt-link">Durgā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. d'Ambālikā_1, 3⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ fille du roi de <a href="#entry-Ukaazi" class="skt-link">Kāśi</a>, enlevée par <a href="#entry-Ubhii_sma" class="skt-link">Bhīṣma</a> pour épouser <a href="#entry-Uvicitraviirya" class="skt-link">Vicitravīrya</a>; veuve sans héritier, on lui fit épouser l'ascète <a href="#entry-Uvyaasa" class="skt-link">Vyāsa</a>; étant blanche de peur lors de leur union, son fils <a href="#entry-Upaa_n_du" class="skt-link">Pāṇḍu</a> naquit blanc.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ambaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अम्बक</span> <i>ambaka</i> <a href="#entry-ambaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> œil.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ambara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अम्बर</span> <i>ambara</i> [<a href="#entry-anuv_r" class="skt-link">anuvṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-ambara" class="skt-link">n.</a> vêtement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ciel, espace, éther <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> math. symb. le nombre 0 — ifc. vêtu de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ambarii_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अम्बरीष</span> <i>ambarīṣa</i> <a href="#entry-ambarii_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du <a href="#entry-raajar_si" class="skt-link">rājarṣi</a> Ambarīṣa, auteur d'hymnes du <a href="#entry-U_rgveda" class="skt-link">Ṛgveda</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uzuna_hzepha_1" class="skt-link">Śunaḥśepha_1</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du roi d'<a href="#entry-Uayodhyaa" class="skt-link">Ayodhyā</a> Ambarīṣa_1, fils de <a href="#entry-Uprazuzruka" class="skt-link">Praśuśruka</a>-<a href="#entry-Uprasuzruta" class="skt-link">Prasuśruta</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Unahu_sa_1" class="skt-link">Nahuṣa_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ambha_hpati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ambhaḥpati</i> [<a href="#entry-pati" class="skt-link">pati</a>] <a href="#entry-ambha_hpati" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. d'Ambhaḥpati, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvaru_na" class="skt-link">Varuṇa</a> «Maître des eaux».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ambhas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अम्भस्</span> <i>ambhas</i> [<a href="#entry-abhra" class="skt-link">abhra</a>] <a href="#entry-ambhas" class="skt-link">n.</a> eau; not. les eaux célestes <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> puissance; capacité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>ambhāṃsi</i> myth. les 4 puissances: les dieux [<a href="#entry-devaas" class="skt-link">devās</a>], les hommes [<a href="#entry-naraas" class="skt-link">narās</a>], les mânes [<a href="#entry-pitaras" class="skt-link">pitaras</a>] et les titans [<a href="#entry-asuraas" class="skt-link">asurās</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sg. math. symb. le nombre 4.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ambhoja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ambhoja</i> [<a href="#entry-ja" class="skt-link">ja</a>] <a href="#entry-ambhoja" class="skt-link">n.</a> [«né de l'eau»] lotus (de jour); syn. <a href="#entry-abja" class="skt-link">abja</a>, <a href="#entry-ambuja" class="skt-link">ambuja</a>, <a href="#entry-ambhoruha" class="skt-link">ambhoruha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ambhojanman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ambhojanman</i> [<a href="#entry-janman" class="skt-link">janman</a>] <a href="#entry-ambhojanman" class="skt-link">n.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-ambhoja" class="skt-link">ambhoja</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ambhoruha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ambhoruha</i> [<a href="#entry-ruha" class="skt-link">ruha</a>] <a href="#entry-ambhoruha" class="skt-link">n.</a> [«qui croît dans l'eau»] lotus.<br> <a href="#entry-ambhas" class="skt-link">ambhas</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ambikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ambikā</i> [<a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] <a href="#entry-ambikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> petite mère (terme affectueux) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. d'Ambikā «Petite Mère», aspect terrible de <a href="#entry-Udurgaa" class="skt-link">Durgā</a>, <a href="#entry-zakti" class="skt-link">śakti</a> de <a href="#entry-Urudra" class="skt-link">Rudra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. d'Ambikā_1, 2⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ fille du roi de <a href="#entry-Ukaazi" class="skt-link">Kāśi</a>, enlevée par <a href="#entry-Ubhii_sma" class="skt-link">Bhīṣma</a> pour épouser <a href="#entry-Uvicitraviirya" class="skt-link">Vicitravīrya</a>; veuve sans héritier, on lui fit épouser l'ascète <a href="#entry-Uvyaasa" class="skt-link">Vyāsa</a>; ayant fermé les yeux lors de leur union, son fils <a href="#entry-Udh_rtaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Dhṛtarāṣṭra</a> naquit aveugle; sollicitée de nouveau par <a href="#entry-Uvyaasa" class="skt-link">Vyāsa</a>, elle se fit remplacer par sa servante déguisée, de qui naquit <a href="#entry-Uvidura" class="skt-link">Vidura</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-ambaa" class="skt-link">ambā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ambu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अम्बु</span> <i>ambu</i> var. <i>ambhas</i> [<a href="#entry-abhra" class="skt-link">abhra</a>] <a href="#entry-ambu" class="skt-link">n.</a> eau.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ambudhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ambudhi</i> [<a href="#entry-dhi" class="skt-link">dhi</a>] <a href="#entry-ambudhi" class="skt-link">m.</a> [«réceptacle de l'eau»] océan; syn. <a href="#entry-abdhi" class="skt-link">abdhi</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> math. symb. le nombre 4.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ambuja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ambuja</i> [<a href="#entry-ja" class="skt-link">ja</a>] <a href="#entry-ambuja" class="skt-link">n.</a> [«né de l'eau»] lotus; syn. <a href="#entry-abja" class="skt-link">abja</a>, <a href="#entry-ambhoja" class="skt-link">ambhoja</a> — <a href="#entry-ambuja" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ambujaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ambujā</i> nom propre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amburaazi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amburāśi</i> [<a href="#entry-raazi" class="skt-link">rāśi</a>] <a href="#entry-amburaazi" class="skt-link">m.</a> [«amas d'eau»] mer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ambuvaacii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ambuvācī</i> <a href="#entry-ambuvaacii" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. festival de quatre jours, commençant le dixième jour [<a href="#entry-dazamii" class="skt-link">daśamī</a>] de la quinzaine sombre [<a href="#entry-k_r_s_napak_sa" class="skt-link">kṛṣṇapakṣa</a>] du mois d'été <a href="#entry-aa_saa_dha" class="skt-link">āṣāḍha</a>; on y célèbre à <a href="#entry-Ukaamagiri" class="skt-link">Kāmagiri</a> la menstruation de la déesse <a href="#entry-Ukaamaakhyaa" class="skt-link">Kāmākhyā</a>; dans cette période la terre est impure, et l'agriculture prohibée; le temple est fermé pendant trois jours, et réouvert le quatrième avec une grande fête de fertilité.<br> <a href="#entry-ambu" class="skt-link">ambu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमी</span> <i>amī</i> [nom. pl. <a href="#entry-asau" class="skt-link">asau</a>] ind. ceux là.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amii_saam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमीषाम्</span> <i>amīṣām</i> [g. pl. <a href="#entry-asau" class="skt-link">asau</a>] ind. de ceux là.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amii_su">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमीषु</span> <i>amīṣu</i> [loc. pl. <a href="#entry-asau" class="skt-link">asau</a>] ind. en ceux là.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amiibhis">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमीभिस्</span> <i>amībhis</i> [i. pl. <a href="#entry-asau" class="skt-link">asau</a>] ind. par ceux là.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amiibhyas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमीभ्यस्</span> <i>amībhyas</i> [dat. pl. <a href="#entry-asau" class="skt-link">asau</a>] ind. à ceux là — abl. de ceux là.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amiimaa_msya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमीमांस्य</span> <i>amīmāṃsya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-miimaa_msya" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-amiimaa_msya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amiimaa_msya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-amiimaa_msyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amīmāṃsyā</i> indiscutable, dont on ne peut douter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amiiva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमीव</span> <i>amīva</i> [<a href="#entry-am" class="skt-link">am</a>] <a href="#entry-amiiva" class="skt-link">n.</a> chagrin, douleur — <a href="#entry-amiiva" class="skt-link">m.</a> esprit malin — <a href="#entry-amiivaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amīvā</i> maladie; fléau, peste.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amiivacaatana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amīvacātana</i> [<a href="#entry-caatana" class="skt-link">cātana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-amiivacaatana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amiivacaatana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-amiivacaatanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amīvacātanī</i> qui écarte la maladie, qui guérit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amiivahan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amīvahan</i> [<a href="#entry-han_2" class="skt-link">han_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-amiivahan" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amiivahan" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-amiivahanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amīvahanī</i> qui apaise la douleur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui tue l'esprit malin.<br> <a href="#entry-amiiva" class="skt-link">amīva</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amita_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमित</span> <i>amita_1</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-mita_1" class="skt-link">mita_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-amita_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amita_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-amitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amitā</i> démesuré, indéfini; immense, sans borne, infini.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amita_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमित</span> <i>amita_2</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-am" class="skt-link">am</a>] a. <a href="#entry-amita_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amita_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-amitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amitā</i> blessé; malade.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amitaabha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amitābha</i> [<a href="#entry-aabhaa_2" class="skt-link">ābhā_2</a>] <a href="#entry-amitaabha" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. np. d'Amitābha «Lumière éternelle», <a href="#entry-jina" class="skt-link">jina</a> gardien de l'Ouest dans le panthéon du <a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>, représenté en gén. en <a href="#entry-dhyaana" class="skt-link">dhyāna</a> <a href="#entry-mudraa" class="skt-link">mudrā</a>; son paradis est <a href="#entry-Usukhaavatii_1" class="skt-link">Sukhāvatī_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amitaayus">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amitāyus</i> [<a href="#entry-aayus" class="skt-link">āyus</a>] <a href="#entry-amitaayus" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. np. d'Amitāyu «l'Éternel», épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uamitaabha" class="skt-link">Amitābha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amitaujas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amitra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अमित्र</span> <i>amitra</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-mitra" class="skt-link">mitra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-amitra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-amitra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-amitraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>amitrā</i> ennemi — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(amitrayati)</i> être hostile envers.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amitrakhaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amitrasenaa">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amla">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] l'acidité, un type de goût [<a href="#entry-rasa" class="skt-link">rasa</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hi. <i>imlī</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amlikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amoghasafkalpa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>amoghasaṃkalpa</i> [<a href="#entry-safkalpa" class="skt-link">saṃkalpa</a>] <a href="#entry-amoghasa_mkalpa" class="skt-link">m.</a> volonté irrésistible.<br> <i>carati</i> <i>amoghasaṃkalpo</i> <i>devavac</i> <i>cākhilaṃ</i> <i>jagat</i> [<a href="#entry-Usuzruta" class="skt-link">Suśruta</a>] Il parcourt le monde entier avec une volonté irrésistible, tel un dieu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-amoghasiddhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">अन्</span> <i>an_2</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(aniti)</i> fut. <i>(</i><i>aniṣyati</i><i>)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>pra</i><i>)</i> respirer, souffler, exhaler <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> vivre, être vivant; se mouvoir — ca. <i>(ānayati)</i> faire vivre; animer — dés. <i>(aniniṣati)</i> vouloir respirer; vouloir vivre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. ανεμος; lat. <i>anima</i>; fr. âme, animal.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अन</span> <i>ana</i> cf. <a href="#entry-ayam" class="skt-link">ayam</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ana_dvah">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनड्वह्</span> <i>anaḍvah</i> [<a href="#entry-anas" class="skt-link">anas</a>-<a href="#entry-vah_2" class="skt-link">vah_2</a>] <a href="#entry-ana_dvah" class="skt-link">m.</a> bœuf (qui tire le chariot) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> taureau; astr. la constellation du Taureau.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ana_niiyas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनणीयस्</span> <i>anaṇīyas</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-a_niiyas" class="skt-link">aṇīyas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ana_niiyas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ana_niiyas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ana_niiyasii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anaṇīyasī</i> pas du tout minuscule; vaste, puissant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ana_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनष्ट</span> <i>anaṣṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-na_s_ta" class="skt-link">naṣṭa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ana_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ana_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ana_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anaṣṭā</i> qui n'est pas perdu; non détruit, indemne — iic. qui n'est pas privé de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ana_s_tapazu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anaṣṭapaśu</i> [<a href="#entry-pazu" class="skt-link">paśu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ana_s_tapazu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ana_s_tapazu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ana_s_tapazu" class="skt-link">f.</a> dont le troupeau est indemne.<br> <a href="#entry-ana_s_ta" class="skt-link">anaṣṭa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaadara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनादर</span> <i>anādara</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aadara" class="skt-link">ādara</a>] <a href="#entry-anaadara" class="skt-link">m.</a> absence d'égards; insulte.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaadh_r_s_ti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनाधृष्टि</span> <i>anādhṛṣṭi</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aadh_r_s_ti" class="skt-link">ādhṛṣṭi</a>] <a href="#entry-anaadh_r_s_ti" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. du prince <a href="#entry-v_r_s_ni" class="skt-link">vṛṣṇi</a> Anādhṛṣṭi «Inattaquable», fils d'<a href="#entry-Uugrasena" class="skt-link">Ugrasena</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaadh_r_sya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनाधृष्य</span> <i>anādhṛṣya</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aadh_r_sya" class="skt-link">ādhṛṣya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaadh_r_sya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaadh_r_sya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaadh_r_syaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anādhṛṣyā</i> inabordable, inattaquable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaadi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनादि</span> <i>anādi</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aadi" class="skt-link">ādi</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaadi" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaadi" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaadi" class="skt-link">f.</a> sans commencement (se dit not. du <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>); existant de toute éternité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. se dit d'un suffix non mentionné dans la classe des affixes primaire [<a href="#entry-u_naadi" class="skt-link">uṇādi</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaaditva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anāditva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-anaaditva" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. fait d'exister de toute éternité.<br> <a href="#entry-anaadi" class="skt-link">anādi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaagas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनागस्</span> <i>anāgas</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aagas" class="skt-link">āgas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaagas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaagas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaagas" class="skt-link">f.</a> sans péché, innocent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaagata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनागत</span> <i>anāgata</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aagata" class="skt-link">āgata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaagata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaagata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaagataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anāgatā</i> non (encore) arrivé; à venir, futur; imminent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. [<a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>] qualifie un <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a> à venir, tel que <a href="#entry-Umaitreya" class="skt-link">Maitreya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui ne s'est pas produit, évité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaagatava_mza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anāgatavaṃśa</i> [<a href="#entry-va_mza" class="skt-link">vaṃśa</a>] <a href="#entry-anaagatava_mza" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. chronique du futur <a href="#entry-buddha" class="skt-link">buddha</a> <a href="#entry-Umaitreya" class="skt-link">Maitreya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaagatava_mzadezanaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anāgatavaṃśadeśanā</i> [<a href="#entry-dezanaa" class="skt-link">deśanā</a>] <a href="#entry-anaagatava_mzadezanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> bd. np. de l'Anāgatavaṃśadeśanā «Annonce de la venue du futur <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a> (<a href="#entry-Umaitreya" class="skt-link">Maitreya</a>)», texte du <a href="#entry-Umahaayaana" class="skt-link">Mahāyāna</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-anaagatava_mza" class="skt-link">anāgatavaṃśa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaagatavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anāgatavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaagatavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaagatavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaagatavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anāgatavatī</i> relatif au futur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaagatavidhaat_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anāgatavidhātṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-vidhaat_r" class="skt-link">vidhātṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaagatavidhaat_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaagatavidhaat_r" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaagatavidhaatrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anāgatavidhātrī</i> ordonnateur du futur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prémonition.<br> <a href="#entry-anaagata" class="skt-link">anāgata</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaahata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनाहत</span> <i>anāhata</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aahata" class="skt-link">āhata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaahata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaahata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaahataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anāhatā</i> «non frappé» (se dit d'un son primordial); inaudible, ineffable — <a href="#entry-anaahata" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. le Son Subtil; son siège est <a href="#entry-anaahatacakra" class="skt-link">anāhatacakra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaahatacakra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anāhatacakra</i> [<a href="#entry-cakra" class="skt-link">cakra</a>] <a href="#entry-anaahatacakra" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] 4⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-cakra" class="skt-link">cakra</a> du <a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>, situé au niveau du cœur; il est représenté par un lotus de 12 pétales d'or; deux triangles entrelacés y symbolisent l'élément air, et portent le <a href="#entry-biijamantra" class="skt-link">bījamantra</a> ‘<i>yaṃ</i>’; ce <a href="#entry-cakra" class="skt-link">cakra</a> contrôle le sens du toucher; de ce centre émane le Son Subtil.<br> <a href="#entry-anaahata" class="skt-link">anāhata</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaamaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनामक</span> <i>anāmaka</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-naamaka" class="skt-link">nāmaka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaamaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaamaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaamakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anāmakā</i> anonyme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> infâme, innommable — <a href="#entry-anaamaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> mois intercalaire (pour rattraper l'année solaire) — <a href="#entry-anaamaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> hémorroïdes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaaman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनामन्</span> <i>anāman</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-naaman" class="skt-link">nāman</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaaman" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaaman" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaamnii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anāmnī</i> anonyme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> infâme, innommable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaamatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anāmatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-anaamatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> anonymat.<br> <a href="#entry-anaaman" class="skt-link">anāman</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaamaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनामय</span> <i>anāmaya</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aamaya" class="skt-link">āmaya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaamaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaamaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaamayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anāmayā</i> bien portant, en bonne santé — <a href="#entry-anaamaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> santé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaamayitnu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनामयित्नु</span> <i>anāmayitnu</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aamayitnu" class="skt-link">āmayitnu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaamayitnu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaamayitnu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaamayitnu" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui ne rend pas malade; salubre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui guérit; curatif.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaami_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनामिष</span> <i>anāmiṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aami_sa" class="skt-link">āmiṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaami_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaami_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaami_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anāmiṣā</i> sans fruit, infructueux, stérile; désintéressé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sans viande, non carné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaamikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनामिका</span> <i>anāmikā</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-naamika" class="skt-link">nāmika</a>] <a href="#entry-anaamikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> auriculaire [«l'anonyme»].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaarabhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनारभ्य</span> <i>anārabhya</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aarabhya" class="skt-link">ārabhya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaarabhya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaarabhya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaarabhyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anārabhyā</i> qui ne doit pas être entrepris <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> impossible à entreprendre.<br> <i>na</i> <i>hi</i> <i>vacanaśatenāpy</i> <i>anārabhyo</i> <i>'rthaḥ</i> <i>śakyovidhātum</i> [<a href="#entry-Uzaabarabhaa_sya" class="skt-link">Śābarabhāṣya</a>] On ne peut enjoindre d'accomplir un acte impossible, fût-ce avec 100 injonctions.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaaruhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनारुह्य</span> <i>anāruhya</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aaruhya" class="skt-link">āruhya</a>] adv. sans avoir surmonté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaarya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनार्य</span> <i>anārya</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aarya" class="skt-link">ārya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaarya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaarya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaaryaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anāryā</i> déloyal, perfide; ignoble, vil, bas <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> étranger, barbare.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaasadita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनासदित</span> <i>anāsadita</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aasadita" class="skt-link">āsadita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaasadita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaasadita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaasaditaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anāsaditā</i> non rencontré; non obtenu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui n'est pas arrivé, qui ne s'est pas produit; inexistant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaasvaadita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनास्वादित</span> <i>anāsvādita</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aasvaadita" class="skt-link">āsvādita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaasvaadita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaasvaadita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaasvaaditaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anāsvāditā</i> non goûté, non apprécié.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaatha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनाथ</span> <i>anātha</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-naatha" class="skt-link">nātha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaatha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaatha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaathaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anāthā</i> sans tuteur, sans protecteur; orphelin <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sans ressources, pauvre — <a href="#entry-anaathaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anāthā</i> veuve.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaatma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनात्म</span> <i>anātma</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-anaatman" class="skt-link">anātman</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaatmaj_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anātmajña</i> [<a href="#entry-j_na" class="skt-link">jña</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaatmaj_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaatmaj_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaatmaj_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anātmajñā</i> qui ne possède pas la sagesse; ignorant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> stupide.<br> <i>mā</i> <i>tāvat</i> <i>anātmajñe</i> Ne sois pas aussi butée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaatmalak_sa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anātmalakṣaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-lak_sa_na" class="skt-link">lakṣaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-anaatmalak_sa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> bd. «signes de l'inexistence du Soi», np. de l'Anattalakkhaṇasutta, ouvrage du canon bd. <a href="#entry-paali" class="skt-link">pāli</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaatman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनात्मन्</span> <i>anātman</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aatman" class="skt-link">ātman</a>] <a href="#entry-anaatman" class="skt-link">m.</a> qui n'est pas soi; un autre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. inexistence du Soi; doctrine du déni de l'Âme; syn. <a href="#entry-nairaatmya" class="skt-link">nairātmya</a> — a. <a href="#entry-anaatman" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaatman" class="skt-link">n.</a> non spirituel, matériel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> dépourvu de conscience; dénué de compréhension <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>anatta</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaatmavaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anātmavāda</i> [<a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">vāda</a>] <a href="#entry-anaatmavaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. doctrine de la non-existence du Soi.<br> <a href="#entry-anaatma" class="skt-link">anātma</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaav_r_s_ti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनावृष्टि</span> <i>anāvṛṣṭi</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aav_r_s_ti" class="skt-link">āvṛṣṭi</a>] <a href="#entry-anaav_r_s_ti" class="skt-link">f.</a> absence de pluie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaav_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनावृत</span> <i>anāvṛta</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aav_rta" class="skt-link">āvṛta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaav_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaav_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaav_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anāvṛtā</i> découvert; déshabillé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ouvert, non dissimulé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaayaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनायक</span> <i>anāyaka</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-naayaka" class="skt-link">nāyaka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaayaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaayaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaayakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anāyakā</i> qui n'a pas de chef <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> anarchique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaayatta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनायत्त</span> <i>anāyatta</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aayatta" class="skt-link">āyatta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaayatta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaayatta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaayattaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anāyattā</i> indépendant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaayattav_rttitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anāyattavṛttitā</i> [<a href="#entry-v_rttitaa" class="skt-link">vṛttitā</a>] <a href="#entry-anaayattav_rttitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> fait d'avoir une existence indépendante.<br> <a href="#entry-anaayatta" class="skt-link">anāyatta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaayu_sya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनायुष्य</span> <i>anāyuṣya</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aayu_sya" class="skt-link">āyuṣya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaayu_sya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaayu_sya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaayu_syaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anāyuṣyā</i> malsain; empoisonné, mortel, fatal.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaayudha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनायुध</span> <i>anāyudha</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aayudha" class="skt-link">āyudha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaayudha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaayudha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaayudhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anāyudhā</i> sans arme, sans défense.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaazramin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनाश्रमिन्</span> <i>anāśramin</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aazramin" class="skt-link">āśramin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaazramin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaazramin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaazraminii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anāśraminī</i> soc. qui ne suit pas les stades de la vie brahmanique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anabhidhaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनभिधान</span> <i>anabhidhāna</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-abhidhaana" class="skt-link">abhidhāna</a>] <a href="#entry-anabhidhaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de ne pas exprimer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. forme non autorisée; forme sans dénotation; forme non attestée; forme non conforme à l'usage.<br> <i>anabhidhānāt</i> gram. [<a href="#entry-Upata_njali_1" class="skt-link">Patañjali_1</a>] ça ne se dit pas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anabhihita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनभिहित</span> <i>anabhihita</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-abhihita" class="skt-link">abhihita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anabhihita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anabhihita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anabhihitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anabhihitā</i> non exprimé.<br> <i>anabhihite</i> gram. [<a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>] lorsque (le rôle [<a href="#entry-kaaraka" class="skt-link">kāraka</a>]) n'est pas déjà exprimé (il peut l'être par les règles de désinence qui suivent).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anabhii_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनभीष्ट</span> <i>anabhīṣṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-abhii_s_ta" class="skt-link">abhīṣṭa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anabhii_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anabhii_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anabhii_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anabhīṣṭā</i> non souhaité, indésirable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anabhij_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनभिज्ञ</span> <i>anabhijña</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-abhij_na" class="skt-link">abhijña</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anabhij_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anabhij_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anabhij_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anabhijñā</i> ignorant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> non familier de ⟨g. iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anadhigata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनधिगत</span> <i>anadhigata</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-adhigata" class="skt-link">adhigata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anadhigata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anadhigata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anadhigataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anadhigatā</i> non approché, laissé à l'écart; non étudié; non atteint.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anadhigatazaastra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anadhigataśāstra</i> [<a href="#entry-zaastra" class="skt-link">śāstra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anadhigatazaastra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anadhigatazaastra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anadhigatazaastraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anadhigataśāstrā</i> [«qui a négligé ses études»] inculte, non instruit.<br> <a href="#entry-anadhigata" class="skt-link">anadhigata</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anadhikaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनधिकार</span> <i>anadhikāra</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-adhikaara" class="skt-link">adhikāra</a>] <a href="#entry-anadhikaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> absence d'autorité; incompétence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anadhikaarin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनधिकारिन्</span> <i>anadhikārin</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-adhikaarin" class="skt-link">adhikārin</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anadhikaarin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anadhikaarin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anadhikaari_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anadhikāriṇī</i> non autorisé; inapte, incapable, incompétent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anadhyavasaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनध्यवसाय</span> <i>anadhyavasāya</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-adhyavasaaya" class="skt-link">adhyavasāya</a>] <a href="#entry-anadhyavasaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> irrésolution, hésitation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anadhyavasita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनध्यवसित</span> <i>anadhyavasita</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-adhyavasita" class="skt-link">adhyavasita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anadhyavasita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anadhyavasita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anadhyavasitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anadhyavasitā</i> irrésolu, hésitant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anadhyayana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनध्ययन</span> <i>anadhyayana</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-adhyayana" class="skt-link">adhyayana</a>] <a href="#entry-anadhyayana" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. interruption des études védiques; vacances — <a href="#entry-anadhyaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <i>anadhyāya</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anadyatana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनद्यतन</span> <i>anadyatana</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-adyatana" class="skt-link">adyatana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anadyatana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anadyatana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anadyatanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anadyatanā</i> gram. se dit d'un temps (passé ou futur) ne s'appliquant pas au jour présent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनङ्ग</span> <i>anaṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-afga_1" class="skt-link">aṅga_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anafga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anafgaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anaṅgā</i> incorporel — <a href="#entry-anafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. d'Anaṅga «l'Incorporel», épith. du dieu <a href="#entry-Ukaama" class="skt-link">Kāma</a> (dont le corps fut consumé par le feu de la colère de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> dont il avait troublé l'ascèse).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anafgabhiima">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anaṅgabhīma</i> [<a href="#entry-bhiima" class="skt-link">bhīma</a>] <a href="#entry-anafgabhiima" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du roi Anaṅgabhīma III, de la dynastie Gaṅga; il régna sur le <a href="#entry-Ukalifga" class="skt-link">Kaliṅga</a> de 1211 à 1238; il établit le culte d'État de <a href="#entry-Upuru_sottama" class="skt-link">Puruṣottama</a> (plus tard appelé <a href="#entry-Ujagannaatha" class="skt-link">Jagannātha</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anafgarafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anaṅgaraṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-rafga" class="skt-link">raṅga</a>] <a href="#entry-anafgarafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. de l'Anaṅgaraṅga «Théâtre de l'Amour», ouvrage érotique dû à <a href="#entry-Ukalyaa_na" class="skt-link">Kalyāṇa</a> <a href="#entry-Umalla" class="skt-link">Malla</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-anafga" class="skt-link">anaṅga</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anagha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनघ</span> <i>anagha</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-agha" class="skt-link">agha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anagha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anagha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaghaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anaghā</i> sans faute; irréprochable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaikaantika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनैकान्तिक</span> <i>anaikāntika</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aikaantika" class="skt-link">aikāntika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaikaantika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaikaantika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaikaantikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anaikāntikā</i> variable, instable; multifonction — <a href="#entry-anaikaantika" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>] paradoxe de l'ambiguité du membre médian.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anak_sara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनक्षर</span> <i>anakṣara</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ak_sara" class="skt-link">akṣara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anak_sara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anak_sara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anak_saraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anakṣarā</i> muet; qui ne sait pas parler.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनल</span> <i>anala</i> [<a href="#entry-an_2" class="skt-link">an_2</a><a href="#entry--ala" class="skt-link">-ala</a>] <a href="#entry-anala" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. d'Anala, le Feu, l'un des 8 Trésors [<a href="#entry-vasu" class="skt-link">vasu</a>]; épith. d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a> symbolisant la puissance de la durée <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. np. d'Anala «Longévité», personnifiant l'an 50 d'un cycle de vie [<a href="#entry-sa_mvatsara" class="skt-link">saṃvatsara</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-analo_s_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>analoṣṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-u_s_na" class="skt-link">uṣṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-analo_s_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-analo_s_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-analo_s_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>analoṣṇā</i> brûlant comme le feu.<br> <a href="#entry-anala" class="skt-link">anala</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-analpa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनल्प</span> <i>analpa</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-alpa" class="skt-link">alpa</a>] iic. beaucoup de, nombreux; très.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-analpagho_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>analpaghoṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-gho_sa" class="skt-link">ghoṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-analpagho_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-analpagho_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-analpagho_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>analpaghoṣā</i> très bruyant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-analpamanyu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>analpamanyu</i> [<a href="#entry-manyu" class="skt-link">manyu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-analpamanyu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-analpamanyu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-analpamanyu" class="skt-link">f.</a> très en colère.<br> <a href="#entry-analpa" class="skt-link">analpa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anamiiva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनमीव</span> <i>anamīva</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-amiiva" class="skt-link">amīva</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anamiiva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anamiiva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anamiivaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anamīvā</i> sans maladie ou malaise, en bonne santé — <a href="#entry-anamiiva" class="skt-link">n.</a> bien-être.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ananda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनन्द</span> <i>ananda</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-nanda" class="skt-link">nanda</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ananda" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ananda" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anandaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anandā</i> sans joie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anannaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनन्नास</span> <i>anannāsa</i> var. <i>anaṃnāsa</i> <a href="#entry-anannaasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> natu. bot. <i>Ananas comosus</i>, ananas; aussi appelé <i>bahunetraphala</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ananta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनन्त</span> <i>ananta</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-anta" class="skt-link">anta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ananta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ananta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anantaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anantā</i> infini, illimité; éternel — <a href="#entry-ananta" class="skt-link">n.</a> éternité — <a href="#entry-ananta" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. d'Ananta «Éternel», épith. du dragon d'éternité [<a href="#entry-naaga" class="skt-link">nāga</a>] <a href="#entry-Uze_sa" class="skt-link">Śeṣa</a>, fils de <a href="#entry-Ukazyapa" class="skt-link">Kaśyapa</a> et de <a href="#entry-Ukadruu" class="skt-link">Kadrū</a>; durant la création il demeure aux enfers [<a href="#entry-paataala" class="skt-link">pātāla</a>] et à la fin du Monde [<a href="#entry-kalpaanta" class="skt-link">kalpānta</a>] <a href="#entry-Urudra" class="skt-link">Rudra</a> émane de ses têtes pour détruire l'Univers; il s'incarna sur Terre comme <a href="#entry-Ubalaraama" class="skt-link">Balarāma</a>-<a href="#entry-Usafkar_sa_na" class="skt-link">Saṃkarṣaṇa</a>; <a href="#entry-Uvaasuki" class="skt-link">Vāsuki</a> est son frère, <a href="#entry-Umanasaa" class="skt-link">Manasā</a> sa sœur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anantacaturdazii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anantacaturdaśī</i> [<a href="#entry-caturdazii" class="skt-link">caturdaśī</a>] <a href="#entry-anantacaturdazii" class="skt-link">f.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-anantavrata" class="skt-link">anantavrata</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anantamuula">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anantamūla</i> [<a href="#entry-muula" class="skt-link">mūla</a>] <a href="#entry-anantamuula" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. bot. <i>Hemidesmus Indicus</i>, salsepareille indienne, liane gentianée; la racine de cet arbuste sarmenteux est utilisée en médecine; syn. <a href="#entry-zaaribaa" class="skt-link">śāribā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anantanaatha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anantanātha</i> [<a href="#entry-naatha" class="skt-link">nātha</a>] <a href="#entry-anantanaatha" class="skt-link">m.</a> jn. np. d'Anantanātha «Maître de l'Éternité», 14⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-tiirthafkara" class="skt-link">tīrthaṅkara</a> mythique; son corps est doré, son symbole est un faucon ou un ours.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anantapaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anantapāra</i> [<a href="#entry-paara" class="skt-link">pāra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anantapaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anantapaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anantapaaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anantapārā</i> sans limites.<br> <i>anantapāraṃ</i> <i>kila</i> <i>śabdaśāstraṃ</i> <i>svalpaṃ</i> <i>tathāyur</i> <i>bahavaś</i> <i>ca</i> <i>vighnāḥ</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>sāraṃ</i> <i>tato</i> <i>grāhyam</i> <i>apāsya</i> <i>phalgu</i> <i>haṃsair</i> <i>yathā</i> <i>kṣīram</i> <i>ivāmbumadhyāt</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> La science du langage est certes sans fin, mais aussi la vie est courte et les obstacles nombreux. Ainsi il faut saisir l'essentiel en laissant le superflu, comme les oies font du lait mélangé à l'eau.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anantara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनन्तर</span> <i>anantara</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-antara" class="skt-link">antara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anantara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anantara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anantaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anantarā</i> qui suit immédiatement (dans le temps, l'espace, le rang); adjacent — <a href="#entry-anantara" class="skt-link">n.</a> contiguïté — acc. <i>anantaram</i> adv. immédiatement après, alors; après quoi, à partir de là <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> juste à côté — prép. cl. aussitôt après ⟨g. abl. iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anantarakaaliina">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anantarakālīna</i> [<a href="#entry-kaaliina" class="skt-link">kālīna</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anantarakaaliina" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anantarakaaliina" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anantarakaaliinaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anantarakālīnā</i> qui se produit à un autre temps.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anantarakaaliinatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anantarakālīnatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-anantarakaaliinatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. fait de marquer la progression dans le temps.<br> <a href="#entry-anantarakaaliina" class="skt-link">anantarakālīna</a> <br> <a href="#entry-anantara" class="skt-link">anantara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anantasuutra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anantasūtra</i> [<a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a>] <a href="#entry-anantasuutra" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. cordon sacré; cf. <a href="#entry-upaviita" class="skt-link">upavīta</a>, <a href="#entry-yaj_nasuutra" class="skt-link">yajñasūtra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anantavaasudeva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
