    <i>anantavāsudeva</i> [<a href="#entry-vaasudeva" class="skt-link">vāsudeva</a>] <a href="#entry-anantavaasudeva" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. d'Anantavāsudeva, épith. de <a href="#entry-Ubalaraama" class="skt-link">Balarāma</a> fils de <a href="#entry-Uvasudeva" class="skt-link">Vasudeva</a> et incarnation d'<a href="#entry-Uananta" class="skt-link">Ananta</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. du temple vishnouite <a href="#entry-Uanantavaasudeva" class="skt-link">Anantavāsudeva</a> construit au bord du <a href="#entry-Ubindusarovara" class="skt-link">Bindusarovara</a> à <a href="#entry-Ubhuvanezvarii_1" class="skt-link">Bhuvaneśvarī_1</a> en 1278.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anantavarman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anantavarman</i> [<a href="#entry-varman" class="skt-link">varman</a>] <a href="#entry-anantavarman" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du roi Anantavarmā <a href="#entry-Ucodagafga" class="skt-link">Codagaṅga</a> (1078–1147); originaire de la dynastie Gaṅga du <a href="#entry-Ukar_naa_ta" class="skt-link">Karṇāṭa</a>, il conquit le <a href="#entry-Ukalifga" class="skt-link">Kaliṅga</a> vers 1108 comme <a href="#entry-Ugafgezvara" class="skt-link">Gaṅgeśvara</a>; il établit sa capitale à <a href="#entry-Uka_taka" class="skt-link">Kaṭaka</a> (mod. Cuttack), et fit construire le temple de <a href="#entry-Ujagannaatha" class="skt-link">Jagannātha</a> à <a href="#entry-Upurii" class="skt-link">Purī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. [DKC.] np. du jeune roi Anantavarmā_1, fils de <a href="#entry-Upu_nyavarmaa" class="skt-link">Puṇyavarmā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anantavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anantavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] <a href="#entry-anantavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [ChU.] l'Illimité ou partition [<a href="#entry-paada" class="skt-link">pāda</a>] du <a href="#entry-brahman" class="skt-link">brahman</a> en quatre espaces: la Terre [<a href="#entry-Up_rthivii" class="skt-link">Pṛthivī</a>], l'Atmosphère [<a href="#entry-Uantarik_sa" class="skt-link">Antarikṣa</a>], le Ciel [<a href="#entry-Udyau" class="skt-link">Dyau</a>] et l'Océan [<a href="#entry-Usamudra" class="skt-link">Samudra</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anantavrata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anantavrata</i> [<a href="#entry-vrata" class="skt-link">vrata</a>] <a href="#entry-anantavrata" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. festival de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>-<a href="#entry-Uanantazaayin" class="skt-link">Anantaśāyin</a>, célébré le 14⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ jour [<a href="#entry-caturdazii" class="skt-link">caturdaśī</a>] du mois de <a href="#entry-bhaadra" class="skt-link">bhādra</a>; au <a href="#entry-Umahaaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Mahārāṣṭra</a>, il se termine par l'immersion [<a href="#entry-visarjana" class="skt-link">visarjana</a>] d'une idole de <a href="#entry-Uga_neza" class="skt-link">Gaṇeśa</a>, installée 10 jours plus tôt pour <a href="#entry-ga_nezacaturthii" class="skt-link">gaṇeśacaturthī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anantazaayin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anantaśāyin</i> [<a href="#entry-zaayin" class="skt-link">śāyin</a>] <a href="#entry-anantazaayin" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. d'Anantaśāyin, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>-<a href="#entry-Unaaraaya_na" class="skt-link">Nārāyaṇa</a> «reposant sur <a href="#entry-Uananta" class="skt-link">Ananta</a>».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anantazayana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anantaśayana</i> [<a href="#entry-zayana" class="skt-link">śayana</a>] <a href="#entry-anantazayana" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. d'Anantaśayana, capitale du <a href="#entry-Ukerala" class="skt-link">Kerala</a>, nommée en l'honneur de <a href="#entry-zrii" class="skt-link">śrī</a> <a href="#entry-Upadmanaabhasvaamii" class="skt-link">Padmanābhasvāmī</a>, dont le temple est au centre de la ville; elle fut connue comme Thiruvithamkūr-Travancore, puis comme Trivandrum, et depuis 1991 comme Thiruvananthapuram.<br> <i>anantaśayanasaṃsṛtagranthāvalli</i> série d'ouvrages en sanskrit de Trivandrum.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anantaziir_saa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anantaśīrṣā</i> [<a href="#entry-ziir_sa" class="skt-link">śīrṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-anantaziir_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. np. d'Anantaśīrṣā «Aube de l'Éternité», épouse du serpent-roi <a href="#entry-Uze_sa" class="skt-link">Śeṣa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anantezvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ananteśvara</i> [<a href="#entry-iizvara" class="skt-link">īśvara</a>] <a href="#entry-anantezvara" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. du temple Ananteśvara dédié à <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> à <a href="#entry-Uavantipura" class="skt-link">Avantipura</a>, construit par le roi <a href="#entry-Uavantivarmaa" class="skt-link">Avantivarmā</a> (9⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. du temple Ananteśvara_1 à <a href="#entry-Uu_dupii" class="skt-link">Uḍupī</a>; on dit que <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> sous sa forme primordiale réside dans son <a href="#entry-lifga" class="skt-link">liṅga</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-ananta" class="skt-link">ananta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ananu_s_thaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अननुष्ठान</span> <i>ananuṣṭhāna</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-anu_s_thaana" class="skt-link">anuṣṭhāna</a>] <a href="#entry-ananu_s_thaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> inaccomplissement; négligence (not. de ses devoirs religieux).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ananya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनन्य</span> <i>ananya</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-anya" class="skt-link">anya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ananya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ananya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ananyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ananyā</i> non différent, non autre; identique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sans second; unique; seul <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> n'ayant pas d'autre intérêt.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ananyaartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनन्यार्थ</span> <i>ananyārtha</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-anyaartha" class="skt-link">anyārtha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ananyaartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ananyaartha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ananyaarthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ananyārthā</i> non soumis à un autre objet, principal <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. sans contresens.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anapatya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनपत्य</span> <i>anapatya</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-apatya" class="skt-link">apatya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anapatya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anapatya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anapatyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anapatyā</i> sans descendance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anapav_rjya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनपवृज्य</span> <i>anapavṛjya</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-apav_rjya" class="skt-link">apavṛjya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anapav_rjya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anapav_rjya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anapav_rjyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anapavṛjyā</i> qui ne doit pas être abandonné (not. chemin); sans fin (not. route) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qu'il ne faut pas terminer; inexhaustible.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anapek_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनपेक्ष</span> <i>anapekṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-apek_saa" class="skt-link">apekṣā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anapek_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anapek_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anapek_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anapekṣā</i> sans égard, sans considération; non pertinent, injustifié — <a href="#entry-anapek_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anapekṣā</i> inattention, négligence; non égard.<br> <i>anapekṣam</i> sans considération; sans examen sérieux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anapek_sita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनपेक्षित</span> <i>anapekṣita</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-apek_sita" class="skt-link">apekṣita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anapek_sita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anapek_sita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anapek_sitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anapekṣitā</i> négligé, ignoré <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> non nécessaire, injustifié; inattendu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. non étayé par une justification; non contrôlé.<br> <i>nānapekṣitam</i> <i>ucyate</i> [<a href="#entry-Umallinaatha_1" class="skt-link">Mallinātha_1</a>] On ne doit rien énoncer sans justification.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anapek_sitahetu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anapekṣitahetu</i> [<a href="#entry-hetu" class="skt-link">hetu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anapek_sitahetu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anapek_sitahetu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anapek_sitahetu" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui ne tient pas compte de la cause.<br> <a href="#entry-anapek_sita" class="skt-link">anapekṣita</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anara_nya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनरण्य</span> <i>anaraṇya</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ara_nya" class="skt-link">araṇya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anara_nya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anara_nya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anara_nyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anaraṇyā</i> myth. np. du roi Anaraṇya «Civilisé», fils de <a href="#entry-Utrasadasyu" class="skt-link">Trasadasyu</a> de la lignée solaire [<a href="#entry-suuryava_mza" class="skt-link">sūryavaṃśa</a>]; il est père de <a href="#entry-Uharyazva" class="skt-link">Haryaśva</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du roi Anaraṇya_1, fils de <a href="#entry-Ubaa_na_1" class="skt-link">Bāṇa_1</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Up_rthu_1" class="skt-link">Pṛthu_1</a>; il combattit en vain <a href="#entry-Uraava_na" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇa</a>, et en mourant au combat le maudit d'être vaincu par <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anarghya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनर्घ्य</span> <i>anarghya</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-arghya" class="skt-link">arghya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anarghya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anarghya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anarghyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anarghyā</i> inestimable; sans prix.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anarghyatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anarghyatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-anarghyatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait d'être inestimable.<br> <a href="#entry-anarghya" class="skt-link">anarghya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anarha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनर्ह</span> <i>anarha</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-arha" class="skt-link">arha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anarha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anarha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anarhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anarhā</i> indigne; qui ne mérite pas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anarhat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनर्हत्</span> <i>anarhat</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-arhat" class="skt-link">arhat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anarhat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anarhat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anarhantii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anarhantī</i> qui ne mérite pas (une punition ou une récompense) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> indigne; inadéquat.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनर्थ</span> <i>anartha</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-artha" class="skt-link">artha</a>] <a href="#entry-anartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> désavantage; infortune, malheur — a. <a href="#entry-anartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anartha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anarthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anarthā</i> sans but, inutile; malheureux, qui porte malheur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anarthada_n_davrata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anarthadaṇḍavrata</i> [<a href="#entry-da_n_da" class="skt-link">daṇḍa</a>-<a href="#entry-vrata" class="skt-link">vrata</a>] <a href="#entry-anarthada_n_davrata" class="skt-link">n.</a> jn. l'absence de péché gratuit, un vœu méritoire [<a href="#entry-gu_navrata" class="skt-link">guṇavrata</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-anartha" class="skt-link">anartha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anarthaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anarthaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anarthaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anarthaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anarthakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anarthakā</i> inutile, sans valeur; absurde, sans signification; gratuit, sans but.<br> <i>anarthakā</i> <i>hi</i> <i>mantrāḥ</i> [<a href="#entry-Ukautsa_1" class="skt-link">Kautsa_1</a>] Les mantras védiques sont sans signification.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनस्</span> <i>anas</i> <a href="#entry-anas" class="skt-link">n.</a> char; chariot, charrette (de transport lourd) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>onus</i>; fr. onéreux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anasuuya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनसूय</span> <i>anasūya</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-asuuya" class="skt-link">asūya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anasuuya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anasuuya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anasuuyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anasūyā</i> non envieux; bienveillant — <a href="#entry-anasuuyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anasūyā</i> absence de cupidité, de convoitise, de jalousie; bienveillance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. d'Anasūyā «Bienveillante» fille de <a href="#entry-Udak_sa" class="skt-link">Dakṣa</a>, épouse d'<a href="#entry-Uatri" class="skt-link">Atri</a>; [BrP.] elle apaisa <a href="#entry-Uziilavatii" class="skt-link">Śīlavatī</a> qui pour épargner <a href="#entry-Uugrazravaa" class="skt-link">Ugraśravā</a> avait empêché le lever du Soleil; en récompense, la <a href="#entry-trimuurti" class="skt-link">trimūrti</a> se réincarna comme ses enfants <a href="#entry-Ucandra" class="skt-link">Candra</a>, <a href="#entry-Udattaatreya" class="skt-link">Dattātreya</a> et <a href="#entry-Udurvaasaa" class="skt-link">Durvāsā</a>; [BvP.] <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>, <a href="#entry-Uhari" class="skt-link">Hari</a> et <a href="#entry-Uzambhu" class="skt-link">Śambhu</a> rendirent visite à <a href="#entry-Uatri" class="skt-link">Atri</a> pour exhaucer ses vœux, mais celui-ci était immergé dans la contemplation du <a href="#entry-brahman" class="skt-link">brahman</a>; ils devinrent amoureux d'<a href="#entry-Uanasuuyaa" class="skt-link">Anasūyā</a> et tentèrent de la séduire, mais elle les maudit d'être la risée des hommes, tant qu'ils ne se seraient pas réincarnés comme ses fils.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anasuuyaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anasūyaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anasuuyaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anasuuyaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anasuuyikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anasūyikā</i> non envieux; bienveillant.<br> <a href="#entry-anasuuya" class="skt-link">anasūya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anativ_rtti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनतिवृत्ति</span> <i>anativṛtti</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ativ_rtti" class="skt-link">ativṛtti</a>] <a href="#entry-anativ_rtti" class="skt-link">f.</a> fait d'être congru.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anavaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनवाय</span> <i>anavāya</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-avaaya" class="skt-link">avāya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anavaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anavaaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anavaayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anavāyā</i> ininterrompu; qui ne se soumet pas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anavadya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनवद्य</span> <i>anavadya</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-avadya" class="skt-link">avadya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anavadya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anavadya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anavadyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anavadyā</i> irréprochable, immaculé, sans défaut, sans reproche.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anavadyaafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anavadyāṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-afga_1" class="skt-link">aṅga_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anavadyaafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anavadyaafga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anavadyaafgii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anavadyāṅgī</i> dont le corps est sans défaut.<br> <a href="#entry-anavadya" class="skt-link">anavadya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anavagiita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनवगीत</span> <i>anavagīta</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-avagiita" class="skt-link">avagīta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anavagiita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anavagiita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anavagiitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anavagītā</i> non blâmé, non tourné en dérision <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> non fastidieux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anavakaaza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनवकाश</span> <i>anavakāśa</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-avakaaza" class="skt-link">avakāśa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anavakaaza" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anavakaaza" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anavakaazaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anavakāśā</i> inopportun; qui ne se produit pas <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. inapplicable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anavakaazatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anavakāśatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-anavakaazatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. inapplicabilité.<br> <a href="#entry-anavakaaza" class="skt-link">anavakāśa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anavama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनवम</span> <i>anavama</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-avama" class="skt-link">avama</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anavama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anavama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anavamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anavamā</i> non inférieur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> élevé; haut; noble.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anavamarzam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनवमर्शम्</span> <i>anavamarśam</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-avamarzam" class="skt-link">avamarśam</a>] adv. afin de ne pas rentrer en contact.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anavasaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनवसाद</span> <i>anavasāda</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-avasaada" class="skt-link">avasāda</a>] <a href="#entry-anavasaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> accomplissement de ses tâches sans s'accorder de repos.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anavasara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनवसर</span> <i>anavasara</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-avasara" class="skt-link">avasara</a>] <a href="#entry-anavasara" class="skt-link">m.</a> moment défavorable; not. période intercalaire de doublement du mois <a href="#entry-aa_saa_dha" class="skt-link">āṣāḍha</a>; aussi période où les divinités de <a href="#entry-Upurii" class="skt-link">Purī</a> sont confinées, entre <a href="#entry-snaanapuur_nimaa" class="skt-link">snānapūrṇimā</a> et <a href="#entry-rathayaatraa" class="skt-link">rathayātrā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anavasthaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनवस्था</span> <i>anavasthā</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-avasthaa_2" class="skt-link">avasthā_2</a>] <a href="#entry-anavasthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> instabilité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. régression à l'infini.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anavasthaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनवस्थान</span> <i>anavasthāna</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-avasthaana" class="skt-link">avasthāna</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anavasthaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anavasthaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anavasthaanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anavasthānā</i> instable — <a href="#entry-anavasthaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> vent — <a href="#entry-anavasthaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> instabilité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anavasthiti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनवस्थिति</span> <i>anavasthiti</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-avasthiti" class="skt-link">avasthiti</a>] <a href="#entry-anavasthiti" class="skt-link">f.</a> instabilité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anavatapta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनवतप्त</span> <i>anavatapta</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-avatapta" class="skt-link">avatapta</a>] <a href="#entry-anavatapta" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. nom d'un serpent mythique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. nom du lac merveilleux Anavatapta «qui ne se réchauffe pas», situé dans l'<a href="#entry-Uhimaalaya" class="skt-link">Himālaya</a> (<a href="#entry-Umaanasasarovara" class="skt-link">Mānasasarovara</a>); il donne naissance à 4 fleuves (dont la <a href="#entry-Uzatadru" class="skt-link">Śatadru</a>) «dont les eaux libèrent de la boue des péchés»; aussi appelé <a href="#entry-Uraava_nahrada" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇahrada</a>; il est représenté à Angkor par le Neak Pean.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anavek_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनवेक्ष</span> <i>anavekṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-avek_saa" class="skt-link">avekṣā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anavek_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anavek_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anavek_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anavekṣā</i> rude, sans égards <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inattentif — <a href="#entry-anavek_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anavekṣā</i> absence d'égards.<br> <i>anavekṣam</i> adv. sans considération; sans tenir compte.<br> <i>anavekṣamāṇa</i> a. m. n. inattentif; indifférent; inattentionné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anayaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनया</span> <i>anayā</i> [i. <a href="#entry-iyam" class="skt-link">iyam</a>] ind. par cette.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anazana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनशन</span> <i>anaśana</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-azana_2" class="skt-link">aśana_2</a>] <a href="#entry-anazana" class="skt-link">n.</a> jeûne; suicide par le jeûne — a. <a href="#entry-anazana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anazana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anazanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anaśanā</i> qui ne mange pas, qui jeûne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anazanataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anaśanatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-anazanataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> jeûne.<br> <a href="#entry-anazana" class="skt-link">anaśana</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anazita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनशित</span> <i>anaśita</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-azita" class="skt-link">aśita</a>] <a href="#entry-anazita" class="skt-link">n.</a> jeûne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anaznat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनश्नत्</span> <i>anaśnat</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-aznat" class="skt-link">aśnat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anaznat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anaznat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anaznatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anaśnatī</i> qui ne mange pas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anazru">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनश्रु</span> <i>anaśru</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-azru" class="skt-link">aśru</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anazru" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anazru" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anazru" class="skt-link">f.</a> sans larmes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anazva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनश्व</span> <i>anaśva</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-azva" class="skt-link">aśva</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anazva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anazva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anazvaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anaśvā</i> sans cheval.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-andha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अन्ध</span> <i>andha</i> a. <a href="#entry-andha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-andha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-andhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>andhā</i> aveugle; aveuglé; qui empêche de voir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sombre; secret, occulte — ifc. aveuglé par — <a href="#entry-andha" class="skt-link">n.</a> obscurité — <a href="#entry-andha" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. le peuple des Andhās — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(andhayati)</i> aveugler.<br> <i>andhīkṛ</i> rendre aveugle.<br> <i>andhībhū</i> devenir aveugle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-andhagaja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>andhagaja</i> [<a href="#entry-gaja" class="skt-link">gaja</a>] <a href="#entry-andhagaja" class="skt-link">m.</a> (copulatif) aveugle et éléphant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-andhagajanyaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>andhagajanyāya</i> [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] <a href="#entry-andhagajanyaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. «maxime de l'aveugle et de l'éléphant»; elle explique les contradictions de différents aveugles pour décrire un éléphant par ses parties; [<a href="#entry-Utaaraanaatha" class="skt-link">Tārānātha</a>] dit qu'elle exprime la diversité des points de vue sur <a href="#entry-Uiizvara" class="skt-link">Īśvara</a> par des ignorants.<br> <a href="#entry-andhagaja" class="skt-link">andhagaja</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-andhaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>andhaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-andhaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-andhaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-andhakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>andhakā</i> aveugle — <a href="#entry-andhaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de l'<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a> Andhaka «Aveugle», né d'une goutte de sueur de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> quand <a href="#entry-Upaarvatii" class="skt-link">Pārvatī</a> lui couvrit les yeux avec les mains; il fut élevé par <a href="#entry-Uhira_nyaak_sa" class="skt-link">Hiraṇyākṣa</a>, et fut couronné roi des démons [<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a>]; ses cousins s'étant ligués pour le détrôner, il fit de grandes austérités, en jeûnant debout sur une jambe pendant 1000 ans; il implora <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> de recouvrer la vue et de ne pouvoir être tué ni par un homme, ni par un démon, ni par un dieu, même <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> lui-même; de plus toute goutte de son sang le recréerait; <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> lui accorda ce vœu, pourvu qu'il énonçât les circonstances de sa propre mort; il choisit de mourir s'il tombait amoureux de sa mère; il devint alors un tyran sur les trois mondes pendant des millions d'années; [<a href="#entry-Uharavijaya" class="skt-link">Haravijaya</a>] un jour il visita le Mont <a href="#entry-Umandara" class="skt-link">Mandara</a> où <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> se trouvait avec <a href="#entry-Upaarvatii" class="skt-link">Pārvatī</a>; au terme d'une longue bataille <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> le transperça de son trident, alors que <a href="#entry-Udevii" class="skt-link">Devī</a> buvait son sang; son squelette desséché devint <a href="#entry-Ubh_rfgii" class="skt-link">Bhṛṅgī</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uharavijaya" class="skt-link">Haravijaya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. race de guerriers — <a href="#entry-andhikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>andhikā</i> nuit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-andhakaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>andhakāra</i> [<a href="#entry-kaara" class="skt-link">kāra</a>] <a href="#entry-andhakaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-andhakaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> ténèbres.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-andhapafgu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>andhapaṅgu</i> [<a href="#entry-pafgu" class="skt-link">paṅgu</a>] <a href="#entry-andhapafgu" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. maxime [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] de l'aveugle et du paralytique; elle prône la coopération entre les hommes.<br> <a href="#entry-andha" class="skt-link">andha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-andhas_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अन्धस्</span> <i>andhas_1</i> [<a href="#entry-andha" class="skt-link">andha</a>] <a href="#entry-andhas_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> véd. obscurité; cécité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-andhas_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अन्धस्</span> <i>andhas_2</i> <a href="#entry-andhas_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> véd. plante ou jus de <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-andhataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>andhatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-andhataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> cécité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-andhatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>andhatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-andhatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> cécité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-andhra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अन्ध्र</span> <i>andhra</i> <a href="#entry-andhra" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. nom du pays Andhra du sud de l'Inde (pays Telugu) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>andhrās</i> son peuple, les Andhrās <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> basse caste de chasseurs — <a href="#entry-andhrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>andhrī</i> femme du pays <a href="#entry-Uandhra" class="skt-link">Andhra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anedya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनेद्य</span> <i>anedya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-nedya" class="skt-link">nedya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anedya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anedya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anedyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anedyā</i> qui ne doit pas être blâmé; sans faute, innocent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anehas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनेहस्</span> <i>anehas</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ehas" class="skt-link">ehas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anehas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anehas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anehas" class="skt-link">f.</a> sans rival, incomparable; inatteignable — <a href="#entry-anehas" class="skt-link">m.</a> temps.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aneka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनेक</span> <i>aneka</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-eka" class="skt-link">eka</a>] pn. <a href="#entry-aneka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aneka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anekaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anekā</i> [«non unique»] multiple, nombreux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>anekās</i> plusieurs.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anekaanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनेकान्त</span> <i>anekānta</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ekaanta" class="skt-link">ekānta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anekaanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anekaanta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anekaantaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anekāntā</i> non exclusif; incertain.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anekaantavaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anekāntavāda</i> [<a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">vāda</a>] <a href="#entry-anekaantavaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> incertitude, doute <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. scepticisme, agnosticisme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> jn. doctrine de la nature multiforme de la réalité; elle postule que toute expression linguistique de la réalité est nécessairement incomplète, et que les différents points de vue partiels sont mutuellement incohérents; elle a développé la doctrine des points de vue [<a href="#entry-nayavaada" class="skt-link">nayavāda</a>]; elle s'oppose à l'éternalisme [<a href="#entry-nityavaada" class="skt-link">nityavāda</a>] du <a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a> et à la doctrine bd. de la nature transitoire de toutes choses [<a href="#entry-k_sa_nikavaada" class="skt-link">kṣaṇikavāda</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anekaantavaadin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anekāntavādin</i> [<a href="#entry-vaadin" class="skt-link">vādin</a>] <a href="#entry-anekaantavaadin" class="skt-link">m.</a> sceptique; agnostique; jaïn; matérialiste [<a href="#entry-aajiivika" class="skt-link">ājīvika</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anekaantazaasana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anekāntaśāsana</i> [<a href="#entry-zaasana" class="skt-link">śāsana</a>] <a href="#entry-anekaantazaasana" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. doctrine de l'agnosticisme jaïn.<br> <a href="#entry-anekaanta" class="skt-link">anekānta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anekaartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anekārtha</i> [<a href="#entry-artha" class="skt-link">artha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anekaartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anekaartha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anekaarthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anekārthā</i> aux usages variés <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. homophone, homonyme; polysémique.<br> <i>anekārthā</i> <i>hi</i> <i>dhātavaḥ</i> Les racines verbales sont en fait polysémiques.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anekaarthanaamamaalaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anekārthanāmamālā</i> [<a href="#entry-naamamaalaa" class="skt-link">nāmamālā</a>] <a href="#entry-anekaarthanaamamaalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de l'Anekārthanāmamālā «Guirlande d'homonymes», lexique de mots homophones dû à <a href="#entry-Udhana_njaya_1" class="skt-link">Dhanañjaya_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anekadhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anekadhā</i> [<a href="#entry--dhaa" class="skt-link">-dhā</a>] adv. plusieurs fois; souvent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anekasamaveta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anekasamaveta</i> [<a href="#entry-samaveta" class="skt-link">samaveta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anekasamaveta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anekasamaveta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anekasamavetaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anekasamavetā</i> phil. inhérent à de multiples entités.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anekasamavetatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anekasamavetatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-anekasamavetatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. propriété d'être présent en de multiples entités.<br> <a href="#entry-anekasamaveta" class="skt-link">anekasamaveta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anekataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anekatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-anekataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> multiplicité; diversité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anekatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anekatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-anekatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> multiplicité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anekazabdadarzana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनेकशब्ददर्शन</span> <i>anekaśabdadarśana</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-ekazabdadarzana" class="skt-link">ekaśabdadarśana</a>] <a href="#entry-anekazabdadarzana" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. point de vue selon lequel il y a possiblement plusieurs mots ayant la même réalisation phonétique, de sens différents; opp. <a href="#entry-ekazabdadarzana" class="skt-link">ekaśabdadarśana</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anekazas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anekaśas</i> [<a href="#entry--zas" class="skt-link">-śas</a>] adv. en grand nombre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anekhaarthasafgraha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anekhārthasaṃgraha</i> [<a href="#entry-safgraha" class="skt-link">saṃgraha</a>] <a href="#entry-anekhaarthasa_mgraha" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. de l'Anekhārthasaṃgraha, catalogue d'homonymes dû à <a href="#entry-Uhemacandra" class="skt-link">Hemacandra</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-anekaartha" class="skt-link">anekārtha</a> <br> <a href="#entry-aneka" class="skt-link">aneka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anena">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनेन</span> <i>anena</i> [i. <a href="#entry-ayam" class="skt-link">ayam</a>] ind. par ce, par ceci — adv. de ce fait.<br> <i>anena</i> <i>...</i> <i>vivakṣitaḥ</i> gram. par ceci on entend ...<br> <i>anena</i> <i>...</i> <i>iti</i> <i>vivakṣyate</i> gram. id.<br> <i>anena</i> <i>...</i> <i>sūcitaḥ</i> gram. par ceci on suggère ...
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anenas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनेनस्</span> <i>anenas</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-enas" class="skt-link">enas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anenas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anenas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anenas" class="skt-link">f.</a> non coupable — <a href="#entry-anenas" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. du roi Anenā «Innocent», fils de <a href="#entry-Ukakutstha" class="skt-link">Kakutstha</a> de la lignée solaire [<a href="#entry-suuryava_mza" class="skt-link">sūryavaṃśa</a>]; il est père de <a href="#entry-Up_rthulaazva" class="skt-link">Pṛthulāśva</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ani_s_ta">

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनिष्ट</span> <i>aniṣṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-i_s_ta_1" class="skt-link">iṣṭa_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ani_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ani_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ani_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aniṣṭā</i> non désiré; désagréable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mal, mauvais, fautif; désapprouvé; défendu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ani_s_tacintana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aniṣṭacintana</i> [<a href="#entry-cintana" class="skt-link">cintana</a>] <a href="#entry-ani_s_tacintana" class="skt-link">n.</a> mauvaise pensée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ani_s_tatva">

    <i>aniṣṭatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-ani_s_tatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> indésirabilité; faute; interdiction.<br> <a href="#entry-ani_s_ta" class="skt-link">aniṣṭa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ani_s_tvaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनिष्ट्वा</span> <i>aniṣṭvā</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-i_s_tvaa" class="skt-link">iṣṭvā</a>] adv. sans avoir sacrifié.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ani_t">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनिट्</span> <i>aniṭ</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-i_t" class="skt-link">iṭ</a>] nota. gram. se dit des racines se conjuguant sans ‘<i>i</i>’ intercalaire (opp. <a href="#entry-se_t" class="skt-link">seṭ</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anidra">

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनिद्र</span> <i>anidra</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-nidraa_2" class="skt-link">nidrā_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anidra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anidra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anidraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anidrā</i> éveillé; privé de sommeil — <a href="#entry-anidraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anidrā</i> état de veille; manque de sommeil.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aniika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनीक</span> <i>anīka</i> [<a href="#entry-an_2" class="skt-link">an_2</a><a href="#entry--iika" class="skt-link">-īka</a>] <a href="#entry-aniika" class="skt-link">n.</a> visage, face; (au fig.) apparence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> face coupante (d'un couteau, d'une hache) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> front; (synecdoque) troupe, corps d'armée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aniikavidaara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anīkavidāraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-vidaara_na" class="skt-link">vidāraṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-aniikavidaara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> «qui brise une armée», np. de prince.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aniikinii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anīkinī</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] <a href="#entry-aniikinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> corps d'armée, comprenant 2187 (3⟨sup⟩7⟨/sup⟩) éléphants et chars, 6561 chevaux et 10935 fantassins (soit 27 divisions [<a href="#entry-vaahinii" class="skt-link">vāhinī</a>]).<br> <a href="#entry-aniika" class="skt-link">anīka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aniipsita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनीप्सित</span> <i>anīpsita</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-iipsita" class="skt-link">īpsita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aniipsita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aniipsita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aniipsitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anīpsitā</i> non désiré, indésirable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. qualifie un objet [<a href="#entry-karman" class="skt-link">karman</a>] écarté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aniitij_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनीतिज्ञ</span> <i>anītijña</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-niitij_na" class="skt-link">nītijña</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aniitij_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aniitij_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aniitij_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anītijñā</i> mal élevé, indiscret, qui se conduit mal.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aniiyar">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनीयर्</span> <i>anīyar</i> nota. gram. suffixe <a href="#entry-k_rt_2" class="skt-link">kṛt_2</a> du pfp. en <i>-anīya</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aniiza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनीश</span> <i>anīśa</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-iiza" class="skt-link">īśa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aniiza" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aniiza" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aniizaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anīśā</i> qui n'est pas maître de ⟨g.⟩; impuissant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui n'a pas de maître; libre — <a href="#entry-aniizaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anīśā</i> impuissance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anila">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनिल</span> <i>anila</i> [<a href="#entry-an_2" class="skt-link">an_2</a>] <a href="#entry-anila" class="skt-link">m.</a> vent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. d'Anila, le Vent, l'un des 8 Trésors [<a href="#entry-vasu" class="skt-link">vasu</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-Uvaayu" class="skt-link">Vāyu</a>, <a href="#entry-Upavana" class="skt-link">Pavana</a>, <a href="#entry-marut" class="skt-link">marut</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anime_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनिमेष</span> <i>animeṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-nime_sa" class="skt-link">nimeṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anime_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anime_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anime_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>animeṣā</i> cf. <a href="#entry-animi_sa" class="skt-link">animiṣa</a>.<br> <i>animeṣam</i> avec vigilance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-animi_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनिमिष</span> <i>animiṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-nimi_sa" class="skt-link">nimiṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-animi_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-animi_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-animi_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>animiṣā</i> qui ne cligne pas des yeux; au regard fixe; vigilant — <a href="#entry-animi_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. dieu [«au regard fixe»] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> poisson.<br> <i>animiṣam</i> avec vigilance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-animi_saak_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>animiṣākṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-ak_sa" class="skt-link">akṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-animi_saak_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-animi_saak_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-animi_saak_sii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>animiṣākṣī</i> au regard fixe.<br> <a href="#entry-animi_sa" class="skt-link">animiṣa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anindita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनिन्दित</span> <i>anindita</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-nindita" class="skt-link">nindita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anindita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anindita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aninditaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aninditā</i> irréprochable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anindra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनिन्द्र</span> <i>anindra</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-indra" class="skt-link">indra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anindra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anindra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anindraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anindrā</i> véd. barbare [<a href="#entry-dasyu" class="skt-link">dasyu</a>] «qui n'honore pas <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aniravasita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनिरवसित</span> <i>aniravasita</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-niravasita" class="skt-link">niravasita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aniravasita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aniravasita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aniravasitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aniravasitā</i> soc. non exclu (se dit d'un <a href="#entry-zuudra" class="skt-link">śūdra</a> ou étranger fréquentable).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anirdezya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनिर्देश्य</span> <i>anirdeśya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-nirdezya" class="skt-link">nirdeśya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anirdezya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anirdezya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anirdezyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anirdeśyā</i> inexplicable; indéfinissable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anirdi_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनिर्दिष्ट</span> <i>anirdiṣṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-nirdi_s_ta" class="skt-link">nirdiṣṭa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anirdi_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anirdi_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anirdi_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anirdiṣṭā</i> non précisé, non spécifié; indéfini.<br> <i>kvānirdiṣṭakāraṇaṃ</i> <i>gamyate</i> où allez vous sans but défini?.<br> <i>anirdiṣṭāḥ</i> <i>pratyayā</i> <i>bhāve</i> <i>bhavanti</i> [<a href="#entry-Uparibhaa_senduzekhara" class="skt-link">Paribhāṣenduśekhara</a>] Sauf explicitement spécifié, un suffixe dénote l'action complétée du verbe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aniruddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनिरुद्ध</span> <i>aniruddha</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-niruddha" class="skt-link">niruddha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aniruddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aniruddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aniruddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aniruddhā</i> autonome, libre d'agir, qui ne rencontre pas d'obstacle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. d'Aniruddha «qui se manifeste sans obstruction», fils de <a href="#entry-Upradyumna" class="skt-link">Pradyumna</a>, déifié comme aspect [<a href="#entry-vyuuha" class="skt-link">vyūha</a>] de <a href="#entry-Uvaasudeva" class="skt-link">Vāsudeva</a>; il épousa <a href="#entry-Uu_saa_1" class="skt-link">Uṣā_1</a>, et <a href="#entry-Uvajra" class="skt-link">Vajra</a> est leur fils; phil. [<a href="#entry-pa_ncaraatra" class="skt-link">pañcarātra</a>] il est déifié comme aspect [<a href="#entry-vyuuha" class="skt-link">vyūha</a>] de <a href="#entry-Uvaasudeva" class="skt-link">Vāsudeva</a>-<a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>; au ciel spirituel il est la direction du Nord <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. d'Aniruddha_1, auteur d'un commentaire [<a href="#entry-v_rtti" class="skt-link">vṛtti</a>] du <a href="#entry-Usaafkhyasuutra" class="skt-link">Sāṃkhyasūtra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anirukta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनिरुक्त</span> <i>anirukta</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-nirukta" class="skt-link">nirukta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anirukta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anirukta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aniruktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aniruktā</i> inexpliqué; indistinct, sans structure, indéfini; illimité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> véd. l'ineffable, 1⟨sup⟩er⟨/sup⟩ niveau du langage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anirvacaniiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनिर्वचनीय</span> <i>anirvacanīya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-nirvacaniiya" class="skt-link">nirvacanīya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anirvacaniiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anirvacaniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anirvacaniiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anirvacanīyā</i> inexplicable, impossible à préciser <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. dont on ne peut rien affirmer; not. le <a href="#entry-brahman" class="skt-link">brahman</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> dont on ne doit pas discuter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anirvacaniiyakhyaati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anirvacanīyakhyāti</i> [<a href="#entry-khyaati" class="skt-link">khyāti</a>] <a href="#entry-anirvacaniiyakhyaati" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>] théorie de la perception de l'inexplicable (seul le substrat universel [<a href="#entry-brahman" class="skt-link">brahman</a>] étant réel).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anirvacaniiyataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anirvacanīyatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-anirvacaniiyataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>] inexplicabilité du monde, illusion du monde phénoménal.<br> <a href="#entry-anirvacaniiya" class="skt-link">anirvacanīya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anirvi_n_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनिर्विण्ण</span> <i>anirviṇṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-nirvi_n_na" class="skt-link">nirviṇṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anirvi_n_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anirvi_n_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anirvi_n_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anirviṇṇā</i> non découragé; non déprimé; serein.<br> <i>sa</i> <i>niścayena</i> <i>yoktavyo</i> <i>yogo</i> <i>'nirviṇṇacetasā</i> [BhG.] Le yoga doit être pratiqué avec résolution et dans un état d'esprit serein.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anitya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनित्य</span> <i>anitya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-nitya" class="skt-link">nitya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anitya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anitya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anityaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anityā</i> périssable, destructible; éphémère, impermanent; inconstant; instantané <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> incertain; indécis.<br> <i>anityam</i> adv. de temps en temps, exceptionnellement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> toujours, éternellement; continuellement, régulièrement, tous les jours.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anityataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anityatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-anityataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> bd. impermanence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anityatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anityatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-anityatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> impermanence; indécision, incertitude.<br> <a href="#entry-anitya" class="skt-link">anitya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anivaarita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनिवारित</span> <i>anivārita</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-nivaarita" class="skt-link">nivārita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anivaarita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anivaarita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anivaaritaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anivāritā</i> non empêché, autorisé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anivaarya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनिवार्य</span> <i>anivārya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-nivaarya" class="skt-link">nivārya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anivaarya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anivaarya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anivaaryaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anivāryā</i> qui ne doit pas être empêché; inévitable, irrésistible.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anivezana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनिवेशन</span> <i>aniveśana</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-nivezana" class="skt-link">niveśana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anivezana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anivezana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anivezanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aniveśanā</i> sans-abri, qui n'est pas établi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anivizamaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनिविशमान</span> <i>aniviśamāna</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-nivizamaana" class="skt-link">niviśamāna</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anivizamaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anivizamaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anivizamaanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aniviśamānā</i> sans repos.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aniyaamaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनियामक</span> <i>aniyāmaka</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-niyaamaka" class="skt-link">niyāmaka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aniyaamaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aniyaamaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aniyaamikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aniyāmikā</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] qui ne contrôle pas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aniyama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनियम</span> <i>aniyama</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-niyama" class="skt-link">niyama</a>] <a href="#entry-aniyama" class="skt-link">m.</a> absence de règle, non obligation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> non respect de la discipline; irrégularité; incertitude.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aniyata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनियत</span> <i>aniyata</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-niyata" class="skt-link">niyata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aniyata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aniyata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aniyataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aniyatā</i> irrégulier; incontrôlé, non régulé; incertain, relâché, douteux; incorrect.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aniza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनिश</span> <i>aniśa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-niza" class="skt-link">niśa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aniza" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aniza" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anizaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aniśā</i> ininterrompu [«sans nuit»].<br> <i>aniśam</i> adv. toujours (sans arrêt).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अन्न</span> <i>anna</i> [<a href="#entry-ad_1" class="skt-link">ad_1</a><a href="#entry--na" class="skt-link">-na</a>] <a href="#entry-anna" class="skt-link">n.</a> aliment, nourriture; riz bouilli; céréale <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>annona</i>; ang. oat.<br> <i>jñānam</i> <i>annam</i> [ZS.] La connaissance est nourriture.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-annaadya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>annādya</i> [<a href="#entry-aadya_1" class="skt-link">ādya_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-annaadya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-annaadya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-annaadyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>annādyā</i> nourriture; nourriture appropriée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-annaadyakaama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>annādyakāma</i> [<a href="#entry-kaama" class="skt-link">kāma</a>] a. <a href="#entry-annaadyakaama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-annaadyakaama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-annaadyakaamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>annādyakāmā</i> qui a faim.<br> <a href="#entry-annaadya" class="skt-link">annādya</a> <br> <a href="#entry-anna" class="skt-link">anna</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-annado_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>annadoṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-do_sa" class="skt-link">doṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-annado_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. faute commise en violant un interdit alimentaire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-annamaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>annamaya</i> [<a href="#entry-maya" class="skt-link">maya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-annamaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-annamaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-annamayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>annamayā</i> formé de nourriture, matériel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-annamayakoza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>annamayakośa</i> [<a href="#entry-koza" class="skt-link">kośa</a>] <a href="#entry-annamayakoza" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>] l'enveloppe matérielle, formant avec <a href="#entry-praa_namayakoza" class="skt-link">prāṇamayakośa</a> le corps grossier [<a href="#entry-sthuulazariira" class="skt-link">sthūlaśarīra</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-annamaya" class="skt-link">annamaya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-annambha_t_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अन्नम्भट्ट</span> <i>annambhaṭṭa</i> var. <i>annaṃbhaṭṭa</i> <a href="#entry-annambha_t_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du philosophe Annambhaṭṭa; il vivait en <a href="#entry-Uandhra" class="skt-link">Andhra</a> au 17⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; il est l'auteur du traité condensé de <a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a> <a href="#entry-Utarkasafgraha" class="skt-link">Tarkasaṃgraha</a>, et de son commentaire <a href="#entry-Utarkadiipikaa" class="skt-link">Tarkadīpikā</a>; on lui doit aussi la <a href="#entry-Umitaak_saraa" class="skt-link">Mitākṣarā</a>, commentaire de l'<a href="#entry-Ua_s_taadhyaayii" class="skt-link">Aṣṭādhyāyī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-annapraazana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>annaprāśana</i> [<a href="#entry-praazana" class="skt-link">prāśana</a>] <a href="#entry-annapraazana" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. premier repas d'un enfant avec du riz, <a href="#entry-sa_mskaara" class="skt-link">saṃskāra</a> effectué au 6 ème mois.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-annapuur_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>annapūrṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-puur_na" class="skt-link">pūrṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-annapuur_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-annapuur_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-annapuur_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>annapūrṇā</i> plein de nourriture — <a href="#entry-annapuur_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>annapūrṇā</i> myth. np. d'Annapūrṇā, épith. de <a href="#entry-Udurgaa" class="skt-link">Durgā</a> «Nourissière» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. chaîne de montagnes de l'<a href="#entry-Uhimaalaya" class="skt-link">Himālaya</a>, qui culmine à 8091 m à l'Ouest du Népal.
  </div>
</div>

    <i>annarasa</i> [<a href="#entry-rasa" class="skt-link">rasa</a>] <a href="#entry-annarasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> saveur de la nourriture.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अन्त</span> <i>anta</i> <a href="#entry-anta" class="skt-link">m.</a> vicinité, proximité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> limite; bord, lisière, bout, fin; mort; délivrance, solution, issue — ifc. se terminant par, qui s'achève en; le dernier des; qui a pour but <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ang. end; all. Ende.<br> <i>ante</i> adv. finalement, à la fin.<br> <i>antevāsin</i> m. [«qui habite dans le voisinage»] élève (habitant près de la maison de son maître).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anta_h">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anta_hkara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>antaḥkaraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-kara_na" class="skt-link">karaṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-anta_hkara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] «l'instrument interne», constitué des 3 sens psychiques ou fonctions intellectuelles: le Mental [<a href="#entry-manas" class="skt-link">manas</a>], l'Intellect [<a href="#entry-buddhi" class="skt-link">buddhi</a>], et le Moi [<a href="#entry-ahafkaara" class="skt-link">ahaṃkāra</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-tattva" class="skt-link">tattva</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>] on ajoute la Conscience [<a href="#entry-citta" class="skt-link">citta</a>], et on parle alors d'<i>antaḥkaraṇa</i> <a href="#entry-catu_s_taya" class="skt-link">catuṣṭaya</a>, l'instrument interne quadruple.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anta_hpura">

(roi) qui a 16 épouses dans son harem.

  </div>
</div>

  </div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-antaadi">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-antaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-antakaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-antakara">

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-antama">

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-antapaala">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-antar">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अन्तर्</span> <i>antar</i> [<a href="#entry-anta" class="skt-link">anta</a>] adv. à l'intérieur, entre, au milieu, dedans — prép. dans, entre, parmi, interne à, à l'intérieur de ⟨loc.⟩ — iic. ⟨ifc.⟩ interne <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>inter</i>; fr. interne.<br> <i>antarbhū</i> être contenu; être inhérent; être intrinsèque.<br> <i>antarbhāva</i> inclus, contenu dans ⟨loc.⟩; interne; inhérent; intrinsèque.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-antara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अन्तर</span> <i>antara</i> [<a href="#entry-antar" class="skt-link">antar</a>] a. <a href="#entry-antara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-antara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-antaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>antarā</i> intérieur; proche, intime <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> interne — <a href="#entry-antara" class="skt-link">n.</a> intérieur, place; milieu, contenu; intervalle, différence; distance entre deux choses; période, passage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> occasion, occurrence, circonstance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sûreté; garantie — ifc. autre que, différent de; autres.<br> <i>antaram</i> var. <i>antare</i> adv. à l'intérieur de, entre, parmi; à cause de, en référence à, en ce qui concerne ⟨g. acc.⟩.<br> <i>antareṇa</i> adv. id. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sauf ⟨acc.⟩.<br> <i>jalāntare</i> adv. dans l'eau.<br> <i>vanāntara</i> <i>saṃcārin</i> m. qui se déplace dans les bois.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-antaraa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अन्तरा</span> <i>antarā</i> [<a href="#entry-antar" class="skt-link">antar</a>] adv. au milieu; à l'intérieur; entre les deux; parmi; entre; sur le trajet <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pendant ce temps; de temps en temps; pour un certain temps <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> entre, pendant ⟨acc. loc.⟩.<br> <i>triśaṅkurivāntarā</i> <i>tiṣṭha</i> qui balance entre deux positions (comme <a href="#entry-Utrizafku" class="skt-link">Triśaṅku</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-antaraatman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>antarātman</i> [<a href="#entry-aatman" class="skt-link">ātman</a>] <a href="#entry-antaraatman" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. l'âme; le cœur.<br> <a href="#entry-antara" class="skt-link">antara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-antaraaya">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-antarafga">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-antarajaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-antaravaasaka">

</div>

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अन्तर्धान</span> <i>antardhāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-antardhaa_1" class="skt-link">antardhā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-antardhaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> disparition; invisibilité; cachette.<br> <i>antardhāna</i> <i>i</i> disparaître.

    <i>antargata</i> [<a href="#entry-gata" class="skt-link">gata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-antargata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-antargata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-antargataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>antargatā</i> à l'intérieur, interne; intime; caché, disparu.

[<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(antareti)</i> pr. md. <i>(antarite)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>antarita</i><i>)</i> aller au milieu; faire diversion; retirer, cacher; omettre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> exclure de ⟨abl. g.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> disparaître — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(antarayati)</i> s'interposer; dissimuler, faire disparaître.

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-antarik_saloka">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-antarita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अन्तरित</span> <i>antarita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-antari" class="skt-link">antari</a>] a. <a href="#entry-antarita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-antarita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-antaritaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>antaritā</i> interne; caché, dissimulé, protégé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> parti, disparu; exclu, empêché — <a href="#entry-antarita" class="skt-link">m.</a> math. reste arithmétique.

[«qui achève l'acquisition des connaissances»] à la fin des études.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-antye_s_ti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>antyeṣṭi</i> [<a href="#entry-i_s_ti_2" class="skt-link">iṣṭi_2</a>] <a href="#entry-antye_s_ti" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. rite de cérémonie funéraire; après la toilette du mort, on lui met un vêtement neuf et une guirlande de fleurs; il est porté sur une civière au champ crématoire [<a href="#entry-zmazaana" class="skt-link">śmaśāna</a>] où il est incinéré sur un bûcher allumé par le fils aîné; un pot de terre rempli d'eau et percé est porté par un parent qui fait 3 fois le tour du bûcher, puis il est brisé; syn. <a href="#entry-m_rtyusa_mskaara" class="skt-link">mṛtyusaṃskāra</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-antya" class="skt-link">antya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनु</span> <i>anu</i> prép. le long de, vers; derrière, à la suite de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> avec, selon, d'après, conformément à, à l'imitation de ⟨acc.⟩ — adv. plus tard, derrière; de nouveau, ensuite <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. ανα.<br> <i>anujyeṣṭham</i> en commençant par l'aîné.<br> <i>nadīm</i> <i>anu</i> <i>sthitā</i> <i>senā</i> l'armée se tient le long de la rivière.<br> <i>anvarjunaṃ</i> <i>yoddhāraḥ</i> les combattants sont inférieurs à <a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a>.
  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(anutiṣṭhati)</i> pr. md. <i>(anutiṣṭhate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anuṣṭhita</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>anuṣṭheya</i><i>)</i> suivre, accomplir; obéir, exécuter.

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(anuṣṭobhati)</i> véd. célébrer de concert (not. un <a href="#entry-saaman" class="skt-link">sāman</a>).

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

</div>

  </div>
</div>

</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anu_svadham">

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anu_1">

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनु</span> <i>anu_1</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>] <a href="#entry-anu_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> homme non-<a href="#entry-aarya" class="skt-link">ārya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. du roi Anu ou Anudruhyu «Cadet de <a href="#entry-Udruhyu" class="skt-link">Druhyu</a>», fils de <a href="#entry-Uyayaati" class="skt-link">Yayāti</a> et <a href="#entry-Uzarmi_s_thaa" class="skt-link">Śarmiṣṭhā</a>, frère cadet de <a href="#entry-Upuru" class="skt-link">Puru</a> et aîné de <a href="#entry-Udruhyu" class="skt-link">Druhyu</a>; il reçut en partage le Nord <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. myth. les Anavas, les étrangers du Nord; les iraniens.

</div>

</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(anunibadhnāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anubaddha</i><i>)</i> attacher; tenir (par une obligation); lier à la suite, mettre en succession — pr. md. <i>(anubadhnīte)</i> être suivi de; causer, provoquer; adhérer à, supporter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anubandha">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anugiitaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुगीता</span> <i>anugītā</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-giitaa" class="skt-link">gītā</a>] <a href="#entry-anugiitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de l'Anugītā, section du 14⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ livre du <a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a> décrivant les instructions spirituelles de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> à <a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a> à la fin de la guerre du <a href="#entry-Ukuruk_setra" class="skt-link">Kurukṣetra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(anugṛhṇāti)</i> pr. md. <i>(anugṛhṇīte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anugṛhīta</i><i>)</i> favoriser, protéger, aider.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anugraha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुग्रह</span> <i>anugraha</i> [act. <a href="#entry-anugrah" class="skt-link">anugrah</a>] <a href="#entry-anugraha" class="skt-link">m.</a> (marque de) faveur, bonne disposition, aide, encouragement; opp. <a href="#entry-nigraha" class="skt-link">nigraha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. la grâce, l'une des 5 manifestations divines [<a href="#entry-pa_ncak_rtya" class="skt-link">pañcakṛtya</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-zaiva" class="skt-link">śaiva</a>] la délivrance par <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> «qui vous prend sous son aile» <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-tantra" class="skt-link">tantra</a>] délivrance de la possession par une <a href="#entry-yoginii" class="skt-link">yoginī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anugu">

  </div>
</div>

  </div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(anujīvati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anujīvita</i><i>)</i> vivre selon, vivre comme; vivre de, dépendre de.

  </div>

  </div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुकीर्त्</span> <i>anukīrt</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-kiirt" class="skt-link">kīrt</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(anukīrtayati)</i> mentionner, raconter.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anukram">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(anukrāmati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anukrānta</i><i>)</i> aller vers; suivre (un chemin) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> énumérer.
  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anukrama">

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुक्रम</span> <i>anukrama</i> [act. <a href="#entry-anukram" class="skt-link">anukram</a>] <a href="#entry-anukrama" class="skt-link">m.</a> succession, liste; ordre, méthode <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> table des matières d'un ouvrage.<br> <i>anukramam</i> var. <i>anukramāt</i>, <i>anukrameṇa</i> adv. selon le rang, dans le bon ordre.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anukrama_na">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anukriyaa">

[<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] afin de (en analyse sémantique [<a href="#entry-zabdabodha" class="skt-link">śabdabodha</a>]) — <a href="#entry-anukuula" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de suivre le courant ou la pente <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> faveur.

[<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(anulimpati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anulipta</i><i>)</i> oindre, consacrer par l'onction — pr. md. <i>(anulimpate)</i> se frotter d'huile (après le bain).
  </div>
</div>
