  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuloma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुलोम</span> <i>anuloma</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-loman" class="skt-link">loman</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anuloma" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anuloma" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anulomaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anulomā</i> soc. [«dans le sens du poil»] naturel, régulier; agréable; à l'endroit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. conforme (se dit d'un mariage hypergame où la femme a un statut inférieur ou égal à l'homme); opp. <a href="#entry-pratiloma" class="skt-link">pratiloma</a> — <a href="#entry-anulomaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anulomā</i> soc. femme de plus basse caste que son époux — <a href="#entry-anuloma" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. <i>anulomās</i> soc. [«descendants d'une <a href="#entry-anulomaa" class="skt-link">anulomā</a>»] déclassés; hors-castes.<br> <i>anulomam</i> dans le bon ordre.<br> <i>anulomena</i> à l'endroit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anulomaviloma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anulomaviloma</i> [<a href="#entry-viloma" class="skt-link">viloma</a>] <a href="#entry-anulomaviloma" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] mode de respiration où l'on alterne inhalation par la narine gauche et expiration par la narine droite <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. poésie [<a href="#entry-kaavya" class="skt-link">kāvya</a>] à deux lectures.<br> <i>anulomavilomena</i> dans le bon sens et à rebours.<br> <a href="#entry-anuloma" class="skt-link">anuloma</a>
  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. md. <i>(anumimīte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anumita</i><i>)</i> concevoir; inférer, conclure — ca. <i>(anumāpayati)</i> démontrer — ps. <i>(anumīyate)</i> être inféré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anumaana">

[<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] l'inférence, un des 4 moyens de connaissance légitime [<a href="#entry-pramaa_na" class="skt-link">pramāṇa</a>]; on distingue 3 procédés de preuve: <a href="#entry-anvayavyatirekin" class="skt-link">anvayavyatirekin</a> (positif et négatif) <a href="#entry-kevalaanvayin" class="skt-link">kevalānvayin</a> (seulement positif) et <a href="#entry-kevalavyatirekin" class="skt-link">kevalavyatirekin</a> (seulement négatif).<br> <i>anumānena</i> adv. en concluant d'après.
  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. md. <i>(anumanyate)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">8</span>] pr. md. <i>(anumanute)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anumata</i><i>)</i> accorder, approuver, permettre, autoriser — ca. <i>(anumānayati)</i> demander la permission, l'autorisation; prendre congé.
  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(anumantrayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anumantrita</i><i>)</i> consacrer par un <a href="#entry-mantra" class="skt-link">mantra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> énoncer au sujet de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> demander congé.

[<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] inférence; syn. <a href="#entry-anumaana" class="skt-link">anumāna</a> — <a href="#entry-anumiti" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. ce qui est inféré; conclusion.<br> <i>parāmarśajanyaṃ</i> <i>jñānam</i> <i>anumitiḥ</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-Utarkasafgraha" class="skt-link">Tarkasaṃgraha</a>] la conclusion est la connaissance produite par l'inférence.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anunaasika">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anupalabdha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुपलब्ध</span> <i>anupalabdha</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-upalabdha" class="skt-link">upalabdha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anupalabdha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anupalabdha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anupalabdhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anupalabdhā</i> non perçu, non reconnu; incompris.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anupalabdhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुपलब्धि</span> <i>anupalabdhi</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-upalabdhi" class="skt-link">upalabdhi</a>] <a href="#entry-anupalabdhi" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. non appréhension; non compréhension.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anupama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुपम</span> <i>anupama</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-upama" class="skt-link">upama</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anupama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anupama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anupamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anupamā</i> incomparable; sans égal; unique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> excellent, suprême; meilleur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anupare">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुपरे</span> <i>anupare</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-pare" class="skt-link">pare</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(anupareti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anupareta</i><i>)</i> suivre (un chemin).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anupasarga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुपसर्ग</span> <i>anupasarga</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-upasarga" class="skt-link">upasarga</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anupasarga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anupasarga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anupasargaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anupasargā</i> gram. se dit d'une racine ou forme verbale non précédée d'un préverbe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anupasecana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुपसेचन</span> <i>anupasecana</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-upasecana" class="skt-link">upasecana</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anupasecana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anupasecana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anupasecanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anupasecanā</i> sec (se dit not. d'un plat sans sauce).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anupask_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुपस्कृत</span> <i>anupaskṛta</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-upask_rta" class="skt-link">upaskṛta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anupask_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anupask_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anupask_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anupaskṛtā</i> non terminé, non poli; pas cuit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> d'origine; sans faute.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anupraas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुप्रास्</span> <i>anuprās</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-praas" class="skt-link">prās</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(anuprāsyati)</i> jeter à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anupraasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुप्रास</span> <i>anuprāsa</i> [<a href="#entry-anupraas" class="skt-link">anuprās</a>] <a href="#entry-anupraasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. allitération <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. rhét. figure de style poétique [<a href="#entry-alafkaara" class="skt-link">alaṃkāra</a>] d'allitération; cf. <a href="#entry-yamaka" class="skt-link">yamaka</a>, <a href="#entry-Usubandhu" class="skt-link">Subandhu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuprasthaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुप्रस्था</span> <i>anuprasthā</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-prasthaa" class="skt-link">prasthā</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(anupratiṣṭhati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anuprasthita</i><i>)</i> partir à la suite de, suivre — ca. <i>(anuprasthāpayati)</i> faire suivre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anupraviz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुप्रविश्</span> <i>anupraviś</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-praviz" class="skt-link">praviś</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(anupraviśati)</i> entrer à la suite de; entrer, attaquer.<br> <i>bhāvam</i> <i>anupraviś</i> s'accommoder de la volonté de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuprayaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुप्रया</span> <i>anuprayā</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-prayaa" class="skt-link">prayā</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(anuprayāti)</i> suivre, accompagner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuprayoga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुप्रयोग</span> <i>anuprayoga</i> [<a href="#entry-anuprayuj" class="skt-link">anuprayuj</a>] <a href="#entry-anuprayoga" class="skt-link">m.</a> utilisation additionnelle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. auxiliaire (not. parfait périphrastique).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuprayuj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुप्रयुज्</span> <i>anuprayuj</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-prayuj" class="skt-link">prayuj</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(anuprayunakti)</i> pr. md. <i>(anuprayuṅkte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anuprayukta</i><i>)</i> employer après; ajouter après ⟨abl.⟩; suivre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuprayukta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुप्रयुक्त</span> <i>anuprayukta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-anuprayuj" class="skt-link">anuprayuj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anuprayukta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anuprayukta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anuprayuktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anuprayuktā</i> employé après; ajouté après ⟨abl.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuprek_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुप्रेक्ष्</span> <i>anuprekṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-prek_s" class="skt-link">prekṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(anuprekṣate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anuprekṣita</i><i>)</i> suivre avec les yeux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anupuurva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुपूर्व</span> <i>anupūrva</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-puurva" class="skt-link">pūrva</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anupuurva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anupuurva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anupuurvaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anupūrvā</i> régulier, bien ordonné; symétrique.<br> <i>anupūrvam</i> var. <i>anupūrveṇa</i> adv. l'un après l'autre; en ordre régulier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> depuis le début; de haut en bas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anupuurvazas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुपूर्वशस्</span> <i>anupūrvaśas</i> [<a href="#entry--zas" class="skt-link">-śas</a>] adv. l'un après l'autre; syn. <a href="#entry-anupuurvam" class="skt-link">anupūrvam</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuraadha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुराध</span> <i>anurādha</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-raadhaa" class="skt-link">rādhā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anuraadha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anuraadha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anuraadhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anurādhā</i> astr. né sous le signe des <a href="#entry-Uanuraadhaas" class="skt-link">Anurādhās</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. d'Anurādha, ministre du prince cinghalais <a href="#entry-Uvijaya_2" class="skt-link">Vijaya_2</a> — <a href="#entry-anuraadhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anurādhā</i> pl. <i>anurādhās</i> astr. np. d'Anurādhās «(étoiles) après <a href="#entry-Uraadhaa_2" class="skt-link">Rādhā_2</a>», 15⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ astérisme lunaire [<a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a>], corr. à δ du Scorpion; <a href="#entry-Umitra" class="skt-link">Mitra</a> y préside; son symbole est une rangée d'offrandes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuraadhapura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anurādhapura</i> [<a href="#entry-pura" class="skt-link">pura</a>] <a href="#entry-anuraadhapura" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. d'Anurādhapura, ancienne capitale de Ceylan fondée par <a href="#entry-Uanuraadha" class="skt-link">Anurādha</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-anuraadha" class="skt-link">anurādha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuraaga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुराग</span> <i>anurāga</i> [act. <a href="#entry-anura_nj" class="skt-link">anurañj</a>] <a href="#entry-anuraaga" class="skt-link">m.</a> penchant, affection; amour, passion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. l'éveil du sentiment amoureux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuraagavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anurāgavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anuraagavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anuraagavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anuraagavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anurāgavatī</i> amoureux, passionné.<br> <a href="#entry-anuraaga" class="skt-link">anurāga</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuraagin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुरागिन्</span> <i>anurāgin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-anura_nj" class="skt-link">anurañj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anuraagin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anuraagin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anuraagi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anurāgiṇī</i> amoureux, passionné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anurakta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुरक्त</span> <i>anurakta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-anura_nj" class="skt-link">anurañj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anurakta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anurakta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anuraktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anuraktā</i> aimé, affectionné; épris de, dévoué à, aimant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuratham">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुरथम्</span> <i>anuratham</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-ratha" class="skt-link">ratha</a>] adv. derrière le char.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anura_nj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुरञ्ज्</span> <i>anurañj</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-ra_nj" class="skt-link">rañj</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(anurajyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anurakta</i><i>)</i> être dévoué à, être attiré par, s'attacher à, s'éprendre de ⟨loc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anurodha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुरोध</span> <i>anurodha</i> [act. <a href="#entry-anurudh" class="skt-link">anurudh</a>] <a href="#entry-anurodha" class="skt-link">m.</a> considération, égard, obligeance — ifc. selon, en tenant compte de.<br> <i>anurodhena</i> adv. en égard à.<br> <i>tadvacanānurodhena</i> en tenant compte de ses instructions.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anurodhin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुरोधिन्</span> <i>anurodhin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-anurudh" class="skt-link">anurudh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anurodhin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anurodhin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anurodhinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anurodhinī</i> qui montre des égards; obligeant, attentionné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anurudh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुरुध्</span> <i>anurudh</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-rudh_2" class="skt-link">rudh_2</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(anuruṇaddhi)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anuruddha</i><i>)</i> être attaché, dévoué, fidèle à.<br> <i>saṃketam</i> <i>anurudhyasva</i> reste fidèle à ton engagment.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuruupa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुरूप</span> <i>anurūpa</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-ruupa" class="skt-link">rūpa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anuruupa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anuruupa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anuruupaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anurūpā</i> conforme, correspondant, analogue; convenable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anus_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुसृ</span> <i>anusṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-s_r" class="skt-link">sṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(anusarati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anusṛta</i><i>)</i> suivre; se diriger vers — ca. <i>(anusārayati)</i> poursuivre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anusaar">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुसार्</span> <i>anusār</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-anus_r" class="skt-link">anusṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(anusārayati)</i> poursuivre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anusaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुसार</span> <i>anusāra</i> [act. <a href="#entry-anus_r" class="skt-link">anusṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-anusaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> fait de suivre; usage; condition naturelle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ordre établi, usage courant; conformité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> autorité, légalité; prescription.<br> <i>anusāreṇa</i> prép. cl. conformément à, par suite de, selon ⟨g. iic.⟩.<br> <i>tadvacanānusāreṇa</i> conformément à ses instructions.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anusaaraka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुसारक</span> <i>anusāraka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-anus_r" class="skt-link">anusṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anusaaraka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anusaaraka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anusaarikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anusārikā</i> qui suit; qui se conforme à <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui investigue, qui examine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anusaarin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुसारिन्</span> <i>anusārin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-anus_r" class="skt-link">anusṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anusaarin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anusaarin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anusaari_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anusāriṇī</i> qui suit; qui correspond, qui ressemble.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anusandhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुसंधा</span> <i>anusaṃdhā</i> var. <i>anusandhā</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-sandhaa_1" class="skt-link">saṃdhā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(anusaṃdadhāti)</i> explorer, inspecter; composer, ordonner; viser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anusandhaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुसंधान</span> <i>anusaṃdhāna</i> var. <i>anusandhāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-anusandhaa" class="skt-link">anusandhā</a>] <a href="#entry-anusa_mdhaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> investigation, enquête, inspection; arrangement, planification <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> plan, schéma; connexion; détermination.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anusandheya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुसंधेय</span> <i>anusaṃdheya</i> var. <i>anusandheya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-anusandhaa" class="skt-link">anusandhā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anusa_mdheya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anusa_mdheya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anusandheyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anusandheyā</i> qui mérite d'être investigué ou inspecté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anusara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुसर</span> <i>anusara</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-anus_r" class="skt-link">anusṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anusara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anusara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anusarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anusarī</i> qui accompagne; qui se conforme à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anusara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुसरण</span> <i>anusaraṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-anus_r" class="skt-link">anusṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-anusara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de suivre; fait de se conformer, d'agréer; engagement, accord <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fait de chercher, de suivre à la trace; poursuite — ifc. conformité à ⟨iic.⟩; conséquence de ⟨iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anusm_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुस्मृ</span> <i>anusmṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-sm_r" class="skt-link">smṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(anusmarati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anusmṛta</i><i>)</i> se souvenir de; se rappeller de ⟨acc.⟩ — ca. <i>(anusmarayati)</i> ca. <i>(anusmārayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anusmārita</i><i>)</i> rappeler qqc. ⟨acc.⟩ à qqn. ⟨acc.⟩.<br> <i>tasmāt</i> <i>sarveṣu</i> <i>kāleṣu</i> <i>mām</i> <i>anusmara</i> <i>yudhya</i> <i>ca</i> [BhG.] Ainsi pense toujours à moi, et combats.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anusm_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुस्मृत</span> <i>anusmṛta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-anusm_r" class="skt-link">anusmṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anusm_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anusm_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anusm_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anusmṛtā</i> rappelé; dont on garde le souvenir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anusm_rti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुस्मृति</span> <i>anusmṛti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-anusm_r" class="skt-link">anusmṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-anusm_rti" class="skt-link">f.</a> (bon) souvenir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. de l'Anusmṛti, épisode du <a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a> (recension du Sud) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. pratiques d'évocation not. du <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>anusatti</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anust_rr">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुस्तॄ</span> <i>anustṝ</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-st_rr" class="skt-link">stṝ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(anustṛṇoti)</i> pr. md. <i>(anustṛṇute)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anustīrṇa</i><i>)</i> couvrir les membres d'un mort (not. des membres ⟨i.⟩ d'un animal sacrifié lors de la cérémonie funèbre).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anustara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुस्तरण</span> <i>anustaraṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-anust_rr" class="skt-link">anustṝ</a>] <a href="#entry-anustara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. cérémonie funèbre, où le corps du mort est recouvert des membres d'une vache sacrifiée — <a href="#entry-anustara_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anustaraṇī</i> soc. vache sacrificielle.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anusvaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुस्वार</span> <i>anusvāra</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-svara" class="skt-link">svara</a>] <a href="#entry-anusvaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. [«(signe) après la voyelle»] phonème de nasalisation, écrit en <a href="#entry-devanaagarii" class="skt-link">devanāgarī</a> par un point [<a href="#entry-bindu" class="skt-link">bindu</a>] au dessus de la syllabe, et représenté en transcription par <i>ṃ</i>; cf. <a href="#entry-parasavar_na" class="skt-link">parasavarṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anutaapa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुताप</span> <i>anutāpa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-anutap" class="skt-link">anutap</a>] <a href="#entry-anutaapa" class="skt-link">m.</a> repentir, regrets, remords.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anutap">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुतप्</span> <i>anutap</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-tap" class="skt-link">tap</a>] ps. <i>(anutapyate)</i> se repentir, regretter, éprouver du remords — ca. <i>(anutāpayati)</i> faire de la peine à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anutta_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुत्त</span> <i>anutta_1</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-anudaa" class="skt-link">anudā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anutta_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anutta_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anuttaa_1" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anuttā_1</i> admis, accordé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anutta_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुत्त</span> <i>anutta_2</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-nutta" class="skt-link">nutta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anutta_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anutta_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anuttaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anuttā_2</i> inébranlable; invincible.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuttama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुत्तम</span> <i>anuttama</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-uttama" class="skt-link">uttama</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anuttama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anuttama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anuttamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anuttamā</i> [«qui n'a pas de meilleur»] le plus haut, insurpassable, inégalable, suprême; éminent, excellent, très précieux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui n'est pas le meilleur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. non utilisé à la 1⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ personne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuttara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुत्तर</span> <i>anuttara</i> [<a href="#entry-an_1" class="skt-link">an_1</a>-<a href="#entry-uttara_1" class="skt-link">uttara_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anuttara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anuttara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anuttaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anuttarā</i> [«sans supérieur»] meilleur; excellent; insurpassable — <a href="#entry-anuttara" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-trika" class="skt-link">trika</a>] état de conscience suprême, sans opposition entre l'état de délivrance [<a href="#entry-mok_sa" class="skt-link">mokṣa</a>] et la vie mondaine [<a href="#entry-sa_msaara" class="skt-link">saṃsāra</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuucaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनूचान</span> <i>anūcāna</i> [ppft. md. <a href="#entry-anuvac" class="skt-link">anuvac</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anuucaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anuucaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anuucaanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anūcānā</i> érudit; qui connaît le <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>; qui sait répéter le <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a> et les <a href="#entry-veda_sa_dafga" class="skt-link">vedaṣaḍaṅga</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuudya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनूद्य</span> <i>anūdya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-anuvad" class="skt-link">anuvad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anuudya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anuudya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anuudyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anūdyā</i> à expliquer — <a href="#entry-anuudya" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>] prédication d'une injonction.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuukta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनूक्त</span> <i>anūkta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-anuvac" class="skt-link">anuvac</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anuukta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anuukta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anuuktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anūktā</i> récité, étudié; entendu dire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuupa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनूप</span> <i>anūpa</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-ap" class="skt-link">ap</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anuupa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anuupa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anuupaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anūpā</i> situé près de l'eau; humide, lacustre, marécageux — <a href="#entry-anuupa" class="skt-link">m.</a> terrain humide, marais; bord de rivière; opp. <a href="#entry-jaafgala" class="skt-link">jāṅgala</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuv_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुवृ</span> <i>anuvṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-v_r_1" class="skt-link">vṛ_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(anuvṛṇoti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anuvṛta</i><i>)</i> recouvrir, envelopper.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuv_rt">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुवृत्</span> <i>anuvṛt</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-v_rt_1" class="skt-link">vṛt_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(anuvartate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anuvṛtta</i><i>)</i> suivre; reconduire; imiter, ressembler à ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuv_rtta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुवृत्त</span> <i>anuvṛtta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-anuv_rt" class="skt-link">anuvṛt</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anuv_rtta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anuv_rtta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anuv_rttaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anuvṛttā</i> qui suit, qui est conforme à, qui imite <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rond, arrondi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuv_rtti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुवृत्ति</span> <i>anuvṛtti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-anuv_rt" class="skt-link">anuvṛt</a>] <a href="#entry-anuv_rtti" class="skt-link">f.</a> séquence; durée; souvenir; rémanence, influence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prise en considération, approbation; fait de se conformer à <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. similarité de comportement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. [<a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>] ellipse, application par tacite reconduction d'éléments de contexte d'une règle [<a href="#entry-suutra" class="skt-link">sūtra</a>] donnée précédemment; portée d'une telle règle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. [théâtre] politesse, courtoisie.<br> <i>anuvṛttyā</i> adv. par suite de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuv_rttipratyaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anuvṛttipratyaya</i> [<a href="#entry-pratyaya" class="skt-link">pratyaya</a>] <a href="#entry-anuv_rttipratyaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. connaissance de la similarité de comportement; syn. <a href="#entry-anugataj_naana" class="skt-link">anugatajñāna</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuv_rttipratyayahetu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anuvṛttipratyayahetu</i> [<a href="#entry-hetu" class="skt-link">hetu</a>] <a href="#entry-anuv_rttipratyayahetu" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>-<a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>] ce qui cause la similarité de comportement; cette définition d'universel [<a href="#entry-saamaanya" class="skt-link">sāmānya</a>] fut remplacée, dans le <a href="#entry-navyanyaaya" class="skt-link">navyanyāya</a> d'<a href="#entry-Uudayana_1" class="skt-link">Udayana_1</a>, par les trois qualifications d'identité [<a href="#entry-ekatva" class="skt-link">ekatva</a>], d'éternité [<a href="#entry-nityatva" class="skt-link">nityatva</a>] et d'occurrence multiple [<a href="#entry-anekasamavetatva" class="skt-link">anekasamavetatva</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-anuv_rttipratyaya" class="skt-link">anuvṛttipratyaya</a> <br> <a href="#entry-anuv_rtti" class="skt-link">anuvṛtti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuvaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुवाद</span> <i>anuvāda</i> [act. <a href="#entry-anuvad" class="skt-link">anuvad</a>] <a href="#entry-anuvaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> répétition; confirmation; explication, glose <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>] prédication d'une injonction [<a href="#entry-vidhi" class="skt-link">vidhi</a>] dans un <a href="#entry-braahma_na" class="skt-link">brāhmaṇa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. glose d'une phrase.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuvaadaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anuvādaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anuvaadaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anuvaadaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anuvaadikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anuvādikā</i> qui explique, qui corrobore; en harmonie avec — <a href="#entry-anuvaadaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> interpréte; traducteur.<br> <a href="#entry-anuvaada" class="skt-link">anuvāda</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuvaadya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुवाद्य</span> <i>anuvādya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-anuvad" class="skt-link">anuvad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anuvaadya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anuvaadya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anuvaadyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anuvādyā</i> à expliquer — <a href="#entry-anuvaadya" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>] prédication d'une injonction.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuvaaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुवाक</span> <i>anuvāka</i> [<a href="#entry-anuvac" class="skt-link">anuvac</a>] <a href="#entry-anuvaaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> subdivision d'un ouvrage, chapitre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuvac">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुवच्</span> <i>anuvac</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-vac" class="skt-link">vac</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(anuvakti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anūkta</i><i>)</i> réciter (not. les formules pour un rite); étudier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuvacana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुवचन</span> <i>anuvacana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-anuvac" class="skt-link">anuvac</a>] <a href="#entry-anuvacana" class="skt-link">n.</a> étude, enseignement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuvad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुवद्</span> <i>anuvad</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-vad" class="skt-link">vad</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(anuvadati)</i> répéter; confirmer; expliquer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> imiter; traduire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuvaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुवह</span> <i>anuvaha</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-vaha" class="skt-link">vaha</a>] <a href="#entry-anuvaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. d'Anuvaha, vent de l'une des 7 voies du ciel [<a href="#entry-maarga" class="skt-link">mārga</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. de l'une des 7 langues d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuvinaz">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुविनश्</span> <i>anuvinaś</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-vinaz" class="skt-link">vinaś</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(anuvinaśyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>anuvinaṣṭa</i><i>)</i> périr (après ou avec ⟨acc.⟩).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuvrata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुव्रत</span> <i>anuvrata</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-vrata" class="skt-link">vrata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anuvrata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anuvrata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anuvrataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anuvratā</i> fidèle à son vœu, à ses engagements; loyal, obéissant; dévoué à ⟨acc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anuvyaakhyaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अनुव्याख्यान</span> <i>anuvyākhyāna</i> [<a href="#entry-anu" class="skt-link">anu</a>-<a href="#entry-vyaakhyaana" class="skt-link">vyākhyāna</a>] <a href="#entry-anuvyaakhyaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. section d'un texte <a href="#entry-braahma_na" class="skt-link">brāhmaṇa</a> expliquant un passage obscur d'une autre section <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. de l'Anuvyākhyāna, commentaire <a href="#entry-vai_s_nava" class="skt-link">vaiṣṇava</a> du <a href="#entry-Ubrahmasuutra" class="skt-link">Brahmasūtra</a> par <a href="#entry-Umadhva" class="skt-link">Madhva</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Unyaayasudhaa" class="skt-link">Nyāyasudhā</a>.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anyonya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अन्योन्य</span> <i>anyonya</i> [red. <a href="#entry-anya" class="skt-link">anya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anyonya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anyonya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anyonyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anyonyā</i> l'un l'autre; réciproque — <a href="#entry-anyonya" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. débat de lettrés sur le <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>.<br> <i>anyo'nya</i> id.<br> <i>anyonyam</i> var. <i>anyonyatas</i> adv. mutuellement.<br> <i>anyonyam</i> <i>pratihṛcchaya</i> amour réciproque.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anyonyaabhaava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>anyonyābhāva</i> [<a href="#entry-abhaava" class="skt-link">abhāva</a>] <a href="#entry-anyonyaabhaava" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-navyanyaaya" class="skt-link">navyanyāya</a>] («absence mutuelle») distinction, non-identité; différence relative; incompatibilité; contradiction mutuelle, l'un des sens de la négation [<a href="#entry-na" class="skt-link">na</a>]; opp. <a href="#entry-sa_msargaabhaava" class="skt-link">saṃsargābhāva</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-anyonya" class="skt-link">anyonya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-anyuuna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अन्यून</span> <i>anyūna</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-nyuuna" class="skt-link">nyūna</a>] a. <a href="#entry-anyuuna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-anyuuna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-anyuunaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anyūnā</i> parfait — <a href="#entry-anyuunaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>anyūnā</i> myth. np. de la nymphe [<a href="#entry-apsaras" class="skt-link">apsaras</a>] Anyūnā «Parfaite».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ap">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अप्</span> <i>ap</i> var. <i>ab</i> <a href="#entry-ap" class="skt-link">f.</a> pl. <i>āpas</i> phil. les Eaux, l'une des 9 substances [<a href="#entry-dravya_1" class="skt-link">dravya_1</a>] du <a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] l'élément [<a href="#entry-bhuuta" class="skt-link">bhūta</a>] eau; son <a href="#entry-pa_ncabhuutasthala" class="skt-link">pañcabhūtasthala</a> est <a href="#entry-Ujambukezvara" class="skt-link">Jambukeśvara</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>aqua</i>; fr. eau; hi. <i>Doab</i>.<br> <i>āpo</i> <i>jyotir</i> <i>āpo</i> <i>'mṛtam</i> Les Eaux sont la Lumière, les Eaux sont l'Immortalité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अप</span> <i>apa</i> prép. séparément, hors de; sans; à partir de; émanant de; opp. <a href="#entry-upa" class="skt-link">upa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. απο; lat. <i>ab</i>; ang. of.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apaa_niniiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपाणिनीय</span> <i>apāṇinīya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-paa_niniiya" class="skt-link">pāṇinīya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-apaa_niniiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-apaa_niniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-apaa_niniiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>apāṇinīyā</i> gram. non conforme à <a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apaa_nipaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपाणिपाद</span> <i>apāṇipāda</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-paa_nipaada" class="skt-link">pāṇipāda</a>] a. <a href="#entry-apaa_nipaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-apaa_nipaada" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-apaa_nipaadaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>apāṇipādā</i> phil. [MO.] qui n'agit pas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apaac">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपाच्</span> <i>apāc</i> var. <i>apāñc</i> [<a href="#entry-apa" class="skt-link">apa</a>-<a href="#entry-ac" class="skt-link">ac</a>] a. <a href="#entry-apaac" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-apaac" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-apaacii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>apācī</i> situé derrière; tourné dans l'arrière <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tourné vers l'Ouest.<br> <i>apāk</i> adv. vers l'Ouest.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apaadaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपादान</span> <i>apādāna</i> [<a href="#entry-apa" class="skt-link">apa</a>-<a href="#entry-aadaana" class="skt-link">ādāna</a>] <a href="#entry-apaadaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> écart <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. [<a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>] rôle thématique [<a href="#entry-kaaraka" class="skt-link">kāraka</a>] s'exprimant en gén. à l'ablatif: point de la situation dont l'action s'éloigne, ou objet de peur, ou actant dont on se cache, ou origine de l'agent ou de son information.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apaafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपाङ्ग</span> <i>apāṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-apa" class="skt-link">apa</a>-<a href="#entry-afga_1" class="skt-link">aṅga_1</a>] <a href="#entry-apaafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> coin extérieur de l'œil.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apaafkteya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपाङ्क्तेय</span> <i>apāṅkteya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-paafkteya" class="skt-link">pāṅkteya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-apaafkteya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-apaafkteya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-apaafkteyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>apāṅkteyā</i> soc. non fréquentable, déchu de sa caste <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>apāṅktya</i> f. id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apaak_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपाकृ</span> <i>apākṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-apa" class="skt-link">apa</a>-<a href="#entry-aak_r" class="skt-link">ākṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">8</span>] pr. <i>(apākaroti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>apākṛta</i><i>)</i> éloigner; rejeter, abandonner <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> payer, acquitter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apaaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपाक</span> <i>apāka</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-paaka" class="skt-link">pāka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-apaaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-apaaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-apaakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>apākā</i> cru; pas mûr <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pas cuit; non cuisiné.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apaakara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपाकरण</span> <i>apākaraṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-apaak_r" class="skt-link">apākṛ</a>] <a href="#entry-apaakara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> réfutation.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apaala">

    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपाल</span> <i>apāla</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-paala" class="skt-link">pāla</a>] a. <a href="#entry-apaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-apaala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-apaalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>apālā</i> sans défense — <a href="#entry-apaalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>apālā</i> véd. np. d'Apālā «Sans défense», fille d'<a href="#entry-Uatri" class="skt-link">Atri</a>; [RV.] son mari la répudia pour sa maladie de peau; [JB.] elle trouva dans la rivière une tige de <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a> et la mâcha; <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> accourut pour boire le <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a> de sa bouche.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apaam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपाम्</span> <i>apām</i> [g. pl. <a href="#entry-ap" class="skt-link">ap</a>] ind. des eaux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपान</span> <i>apāna</i> [<a href="#entry-apa" class="skt-link">apa</a>-<a href="#entry-aana" class="skt-link">āna</a>] <a href="#entry-apaana" class="skt-link">m.</a> anus <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>apānavāyu</i>] phil. [<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] le souffle d'excrétion, l'un des 5 souffles vitaux [<a href="#entry-praa_na" class="skt-link">prāṇa</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-muulabandha" class="skt-link">mūlabandha</a>.
  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apaannapaat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(apāvṛṇoti)</i> pr. md. <i>(apāvṛṇute)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>apāvṛta</i><i>)</i> ouvrir, découvrir, dévoiler.<br> <i>pratnakīrtim</i> <i>apāvṛṇu</i> Découvre la gloire du passé!

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(apāśrayati)</i> pr. md. <i>(apāśrayate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>apāśrita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>vi</i><i>)</i> avoir recours à, utiliser, pratiquer.
  </div>

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apabhra_mz">

[<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(apabhraṃśate)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(apabhraśyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>apabhraṣṭa</i><i>)</i> tomber de ⟨abl.⟩, choir; déchoir — ca. <i>(apabhraṃśayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>apabhraṃśita</i><i>)</i> faire tomber ou déchoir; dégrader.

[«sanskrit dégradé»] se dit de dialectes moyen-indiens <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. mot vernaculaire ou non conforme au sanskrit (opp. <a href="#entry-tadbhava" class="skt-link">tadbhava</a>); cf. <a href="#entry-tatsama" class="skt-link">tatsama</a>.

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apanud">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपनुद्</span> <i>apanud</i> [<a href="#entry-apa" class="skt-link">apa</a>-<a href="#entry-nud" class="skt-link">nud</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(apanudati)</i> enlever, rejeter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apanuda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपनुद</span> <i>apanuda</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-apanud" class="skt-link">apanud</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-apanuda" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-apanuda" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-apanudaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>apanudā</i> qui enlève ⟨iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apanutti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपनुत्ति</span> <i>apanutti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-apanud" class="skt-link">apanud</a>] <a href="#entry-apanutti" class="skt-link">f.</a> fait d'enlever, de renvoyer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. expiation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apapaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपपाद</span> <i>apapāda</i> [<a href="#entry-apa" class="skt-link">apa</a>-<a href="#entry-paada" class="skt-link">pāda</a>] a. <a href="#entry-apapaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-apapaada" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-apapaadaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>apapādā</i> qui a de mauvais pieds <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sans chaussures.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपर</span> <i>apara</i> [compar. <a href="#entry-apa" class="skt-link">apa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-apara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-apara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aparaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aparā</i> postérieur, plus tard, au-delà, après, qui suit; à l'Ouest; opp. <a href="#entry-puurva" class="skt-link">pūrva</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> junior, plus petit, plus bas <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> autre, étranger — pn. <a href="#entry-apara" class="skt-link">m.</a> l'autre; un autre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>apare</i> les autres — <a href="#entry-aparii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aparī</i> pl. les jours prochains, le futur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> all. aber; ang. after.<br> <i>aparaṃ</i> <i>ca</i> conj. de plus, en outre.<br> <i>aparatas</i> adv. ailleurs.<br> <i>aparathā</i> adv. autrement.<br> <i>eka</i> <i>...</i> <i>apara</i> l'un ... l'autre.<br> <i>eke</i> <i>...</i> <i>apare</i> les uns ... les autres.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparaaddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपराद्ध</span> <i>aparāddha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-aparaadh" class="skt-link">aparādh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aparaaddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aparaaddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aparaaddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aparāddhā</i> qui a manqué le but; qui a commis une faute (envers ⟨g.⟩); coupable — <a href="#entry-aparaaddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> pécheur, coupable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparaadh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपराध्</span> <i>aparādh</i> [<a href="#entry-apa" class="skt-link">apa</a>-<a href="#entry-raadh" class="skt-link">rādh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. <i>(aparādhnoti)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(aparādhati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>aparāddha</i><i>)</i> manquer le but <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> offenser, faire injure à, manquer à, commettre une faute envers ⟨g.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparaadha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपराध</span> <i>aparādha</i> [<a href="#entry-aparaadh" class="skt-link">aparādh</a>] <a href="#entry-aparaadha" class="skt-link">m.</a> faute, offense; transgression, péché; erreur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparaadhak_samaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aparādhakṣamā</i> [<a href="#entry-k_samaa" class="skt-link">kṣamā</a>] <a href="#entry-aparaadhak_samaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> pardon des fautes <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. posture de demande de pardon: la main droite saisit le lobe de l'oreille gauche, la main gauche celui de l'oreille droite, le pénitent debout fait une série de flexions en pliant les genoux.<br> <a href="#entry-aparaadha" class="skt-link">aparādha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparaaditya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aparāditya</i> [<a href="#entry-aaditya" class="skt-link">āditya</a>] <a href="#entry-aparaaditya" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. d'Aparāditya «Autre Soleil», épith. du roi <a href="#entry-Uaparaarka" class="skt-link">Aparārka</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparaafmukha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपराङ्मुख</span> <i>aparāṅmukha</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-paraafmukha" class="skt-link">parāṅmukha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aparaafmukha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aparaafmukha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aparaafmukhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aparāṅmukhī</i> qui ne se détourne pas, qui ne tourne pas le dos.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparaah_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aparāhṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-ahna" class="skt-link">ahna</a>] <a href="#entry-aparaah_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> après-midi (dernière garde de la journée); syn. <a href="#entry-paraah_na" class="skt-link">parāhṇa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-apara" class="skt-link">apara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparaajita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपराजित</span> <i>aparājita</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-paraajita" class="skt-link">parājita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aparaajita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aparaajita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aparaajitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aparājitā</i> invaincu; invincible — <a href="#entry-aparaajita" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. d'Aparājita «Invincible», épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> ou <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. d'Aparājita_1 l'un des 4 éléphants cosmiques [<a href="#entry-gajapati" class="skt-link">gajapati</a>] supportant le monde — <a href="#entry-aparaajitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aparājitā</i> la direction [<a href="#entry-diz_2" class="skt-link">diś_2</a>] du Nord-Est <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. d'Aparājitā, épith. de <a href="#entry-Udurgaa" class="skt-link">Durgā</a> l'Invincible; on la célèbre à <a href="#entry-mahaanavamii" class="skt-link">mahānavamī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> natu. bot. <i>Clitoria ternatea</i>, légumineuse grimpante aux fleurs bleu vif; syn. <a href="#entry-girikar_nikaa" class="skt-link">girikarṇikā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparaajitap_rcchaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aparājitapṛcchā</i> [<a href="#entry-p_rcchaa" class="skt-link">pṛcchā</a>] <a href="#entry-aparaajitap_rcchaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit. np. de l'Aparājitapṛcchā, traité d'architecture.<br> <a href="#entry-aparaajita" class="skt-link">aparājita</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparaarka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aparārka</i> [<a href="#entry-arka" class="skt-link">arka</a>] <a href="#entry-aparaarka" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. d'Aparārka-<a href="#entry-Uaparaaditya" class="skt-link">Aparāditya</a> «Autre Soleil», roi <a href="#entry-Uzilaahaara" class="skt-link">Śilāhāra</a> du début du 12⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; il est l'auteur du commentaire <a href="#entry-Uaparaarkayaaj_navalkiiyadharmazaastranibandha" class="skt-link">Aparārkayājñavalkīyadharmaśāstranibandha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparaarkayaaj_navalkiiyadharmazaastranibandha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aparārkayājñavalkīyadharmaśāstranibandha</i> [<a href="#entry-yaaj_navalkiiya" class="skt-link">yājñavalkīya</a>-<a href="#entry-dharmazaastra" class="skt-link">dharmaśāstra</a>-<a href="#entry-nibandha" class="skt-link">nibandha</a>] <a href="#entry-aparaarkayaaj_navalkiiyadharmazaastranibandha" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. de l'Aparārkayājñavalkīyadharmaśāstranibandha, énorme commentaire de la <a href="#entry-Uyaaj_navalkyasm_rti" class="skt-link">Yājñavalkyasmṛti</a> dû au roi <a href="#entry-Uaparaarka" class="skt-link">Aparārka</a>; il y déclare non orthodoxes les sectes <a href="#entry-zaiva" class="skt-link">śaiva</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-aparaarka" class="skt-link">aparārka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparasapara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aparasapara</i> [red.] <a href="#entry-aparasapara" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. <i>aparasaparās</i> l'un après l'autre; les uns les autres.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपरत्व</span> <i>aparatva</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-paratva" class="skt-link">paratva</a>] <a href="#entry-aparatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> proximité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>] la propriété [<a href="#entry-gu_na" class="skt-link">guṇa</a>] de proximité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparazikha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aparaśikha</i> [<a href="#entry-zikhaa" class="skt-link">śikhā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aparazikha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aparazikha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aparazikhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aparaśikhā</i> soc. qui porte la mèche réservée en arrière (en queue de cheval); opp. <a href="#entry-puurvazikha" class="skt-link">pūrvaśikha</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apari_niiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपरिणीय</span> <i>apariṇīya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-pari_niiya" class="skt-link">pariṇīya</a>] adv. n'ayant pas épousé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apariccheda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपरिच्छेद</span> <i>apariccheda</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-pariccheda" class="skt-link">pariccheda</a>] <a href="#entry-apariccheda" class="skt-link">m.</a> incertitude.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparigraha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपरिग्रह</span> <i>aparigraha</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-parigraha" class="skt-link">parigraha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aparigraha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aparigraha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aparigrahaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aparigrahā</i> indépendant; indifférent aux biens matériels — <a href="#entry-aparigraha" class="skt-link">m.</a> privation de biens; refus des dons; frugalité; renoncement à la fortune, vœu de pauvreté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. l'absence de convoitise, une des vertus [<a href="#entry-yama_1" class="skt-link">yama_1</a>] du <a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> jn. l'absence d'attachement, un vœu mineur [<a href="#entry-a_nuvrata" class="skt-link">aṇuvrata</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparihaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपरिहार</span> <i>aparihāra</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-parihaara" class="skt-link">parihāra</a>] <a href="#entry-aparihaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> fait de ne pas éviter; obligation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparihaarya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपरिहार्य</span> <i>aparihārya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-parihaarya" class="skt-link">parihārya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aparihaarya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aparihaarya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aparihaaryaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aparihāryā</i> inévitable; inéluctable; obligé, qu'on ne peut omettre.<br> <i>aparihārye</i> <i>arthe</i> <i>na</i> <i>tvaṃ</i> <i>śocitumarhasi</i> [BhG.] Tu ne dois pas déplorer l'inévitable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apariik_sita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपरीक्षित</span> <i>aparīkṣita</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-pariik_sita" class="skt-link">parīkṣita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-apariik_sita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-apariik_sita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-apariik_sitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aparīkṣitā</i> non testé, inexaminé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inconsidéré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apariik_sitakaaritva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aparīkṣitakāritva</i> [<a href="#entry-kaaritva" class="skt-link">kāritva</a>] <a href="#entry-apariik_sitakaaritva" class="skt-link">n.</a> «Conduite inconsidérée», titre du 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ livre du <a href="#entry-Upa_ncatantra" class="skt-link">Pañcatantra</a>, qui montre le danger de la précipitation.<br> <a href="#entry-apariik_sita" class="skt-link">aparīkṣita</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparijaata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपरिजात</span> <i>aparijāta</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-parijaata" class="skt-link">parijāta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aparijaata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aparijaata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aparijaataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aparijātā</i> non complètement développé (not. embryon); prématuré; mort-né.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparimita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपरिमित</span> <i>aparimita</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-parimita" class="skt-link">parimita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aparimita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aparimita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aparimitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aparimitā</i> non mesuré; illimité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparok_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपरोक्ष</span> <i>aparokṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-parok_sa" class="skt-link">parokṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aparok_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aparok_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aparok_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aparokṣā</i> proche, direct, manifeste, perceptible; présent, actuel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. dont on a l'expérience directe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparyaapta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपर्याप्त</span> <i>aparyāpta</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-paryaapta" class="skt-link">paryāpta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aparyaapta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aparyaapta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aparyaaptaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aparyāptā</i> incomplet, imparfait <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> illimité, innombrable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aparyaaptavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aparyāptavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aparyaaptavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aparyaaptavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aparyaaptavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aparyāptavatī</i> incompétent à ⟨inf.⟩.<br> <a href="#entry-aparyaapta" class="skt-link">aparyāpta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apas_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपसृ</span> <i>apasṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-apa" class="skt-link">apa</a>-<a href="#entry-s_r" class="skt-link">sṛ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(apasarati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>apasṛta</i><i>)</i> s'éloigner, s'enfuir, disparaître; échapper à ⟨abl.⟩ — ca. <i>(apasārayati)</i> chasser, éloigner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apas_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपसृत</span> <i>apasṛta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-apas_r" class="skt-link">apasṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-apas_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-apas_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-apas_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>apasṛtā</i> libéré de; disparu; écoulé (temps).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apas_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपस्</span> <i>apas_1</i> cf. <a href="#entry-ap" class="skt-link">ap</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apas_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपस्</span> <i>apas_2</i> <a href="#entry-apas_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> travail <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>opus</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apasada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apasalavi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apasmaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. md. <i>(apavṛṅkte)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>apavṛkta</i><i>)</i> écarter, chasser; exclure; déchirer — ca. <i>(apavarjayati)</i> abandonner, se débarrasser de; se détourner de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> transmettre, léguer; donner.<br> <i>adhvānam</i> <i>apavṛj</i> suivre le chemin.
  </div>
</div>

[<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] objection.

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ape">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apek_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपेक्ष्</span> <i>apekṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-apa" class="skt-link">apa</a>-<a href="#entry-iik_s" class="skt-link">īkṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(apekṣate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>apekṣita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ā</i>, <i>vi</i><i>)</i> respecter, prendre égard à <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> attendre; avoir en vue, désirer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apek_saa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपेक्षा</span> <i>apekṣā</i> [act. <a href="#entry-apek_s" class="skt-link">apekṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-apek_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> fait de regarder autour; prise en considération <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> égard, considération, respect envers ⟨iic. g.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> désir, attente, espérance; prérequis <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] dépendance de ⟨iic.⟩; connection entre la cause et l'effet, entre l'individu et l'espèce.<br> <i>apekṣayā</i> adv. ifc. par égard pour, concernant ⟨iic.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>] faculté d'être soigneux, méthodique, rigoureux, clair.<br> <a href="#entry-apek_saa" class="skt-link">apekṣā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apek_sin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-api">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपि</span> <i>api</i> conj. cl. et, aussi, encore, également; même <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pourtant, toutefois, quoique, malgré cela <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (après num.) exprime la totalité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (après interr.) exprime l'indéfini — prép. interr. (en début de phrase) est-ce que? <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> plût au ciel que ⟨opt.⟩! peut-être — pf. sur, près de (qqf. abrégé en <a href="#entry-pi_1" class="skt-link">pi_1</a>).<br> <i>api</i> <i>...</i> <i>api</i> aussi bien ... que; à la fois ... et.<br> <i>api</i> <i>ca</i> même; et de plus <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. lien entre deux strophes discontinues.<br> <i>api</i> <i>tu</i> mais pourtant.<br> <i>kutrāpi</i> en quelque endroit que ce soit.<br> <i>kenāpi</i> pour une raison quelconque.<br> <i>ko</i> <i>'pi</i> quelqu'un, un certain; quelque chose, je ne sais quel.<br> <i>na</i> <i>ko</i> <i>'pi</i> rien, personne.<br> <i>cāpi</i> et.<br> <i>tathā</i> <i>'pi</i> var. <i>tadapi</i> néanmoins, cependant.<br> <i>dvāvapi</i> tous les deux.<br> <i>nāpi</i> ni, et ne pas, mais ne pas, non plus.<br> <i>yo</i> <i>'pi</i> quiconque.<br> <i>vāpi</i> ou bien.<br> <i>na</i> <i>...</i> <i>nāpi</i> ni ... ni.<br> <i>na</i> <i>...</i> <i>vāpi</i> ni ... ni.<br> <i>sarve</i> <i>'pi</i> tous absolument.<br> <i>mām</i> <i>api</i> moi aussi.<br> <i>kadā</i> <i>cid</i> <i>api</i> <i>na</i> absolument jamais.<br> <i>svam</i> <i>apīta</i> ce qui est sien.<br> <i>api</i> <i>stuyād</i> <i>vṛṣalam</i> Il louerait même un hors-caste.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apidhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपिधा</span> <i>apidhā</i> [<a href="#entry-api" class="skt-link">api</a>-<a href="#entry-dhaa_1" class="skt-link">dhā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(apidadhāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>apihita</i><i>)</i> fermer, couvrir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> cacher.
  </div>
</div>

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apoh">

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apoha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apohavaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>apohavāda</i> [<a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">vāda</a>] <a href="#entry-apohavaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> contestation; exclusion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. déconstruction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. doctrine du nominalisme discriminant; elle postule que la catégorisation par des universaux n'est que l'exclusion des propriétés contraires, et est essentiellement arbitraire.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apraamaa_nya">

</div>

  </div>
</div>

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apratyak_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apratyaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अप्रत्यय</span> <i>apratyaya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-pratyaya" class="skt-link">pratyaya</a>] <a href="#entry-apratyaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> défiance, doute <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. (morphème) non suffixe <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. (mot) ne comportant pas de suffixe.

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aprav_rtti">

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apravaasa">

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aprayoga">
