<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aprayucchat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अप्रयुच्छत्</span> <i>aprayucchat</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-prayucchat" class="skt-link">prayucchat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aprayucchat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aprayucchat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aprayucchatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aprayucchatī</i> attentif.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aprayukta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अप्रयुक्त</span> <i>aprayukta</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-prayukta" class="skt-link">prayukta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aprayukta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aprayukta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aprayuktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aprayuktā</i> non employé, inutilisé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. non attesté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apriya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अप्रिय</span> <i>apriya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-priya" class="skt-link">priya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-apriya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-apriya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-apriyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>apriyā</i> non aimé, indésirable; antipathique, désagréable — <a href="#entry-apriya" class="skt-link">m.</a> ennemi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apsaras">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अप्सरस्</span> <i>apsaras</i> [<a href="#entry-ap" class="skt-link">ap</a>-<a href="#entry-saras" class="skt-link">saras</a>] <a href="#entry-apsaras" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. nymphe céleste; les <i>apsarasas</i> sont filles de <a href="#entry-Ukazyapa" class="skt-link">Kaśyapa</a>, ou bien issues du barattage de la mer de lait [<a href="#entry-k_siirodamathana" class="skt-link">kṣīrodamathana</a>]; elles sont compagnes des musiciens-centaures [<a href="#entry-gandharvaas" class="skt-link">gandharvās</a>], amantes des dieux [<a href="#entry-deva" class="skt-link">deva</a>] comme des démons [<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a>]; elles font répandre leur semence aux sages [<a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a>]; leur voile magique [<a href="#entry-tiraskari_nii" class="skt-link">tiraskariṇī</a>] les dissimule aux mortels; la tradition dit qu'elles sont sept, ou dix; cf. <a href="#entry-Upu_njikasthalaa" class="skt-link">Puñjikasthalā</a>-<a href="#entry-Ua_njanaa" class="skt-link">Añjanā</a>, <a href="#entry-Uanyuunaa" class="skt-link">Anyūnā</a>, <a href="#entry-Uurvazii" class="skt-link">Urvaśī</a>, <a href="#entry-Ugh_rtaacii" class="skt-link">Ghṛtācī</a>, <a href="#entry-Ucitralekhaa" class="skt-link">Citralekhā</a>, <a href="#entry-Ujaanapadii" class="skt-link">Jānapadī</a>, <a href="#entry-Utilottamaa" class="skt-link">Tilottamā</a>, <a href="#entry-Udevarati" class="skt-link">Devarati</a>, <a href="#entry-Upu_njikasthalaa" class="skt-link">Puñjikasthalā</a>, <a href="#entry-Upu_n_dariikaa" class="skt-link">Puṇḍarīkā</a>, <a href="#entry-Umanoramaa" class="skt-link">Manoramā</a>, <a href="#entry-Umenakaa" class="skt-link">Menakā</a>, <a href="#entry-Urambhaa" class="skt-link">Rambhā</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvaraananaa" class="skt-link">Varānanā</a>, <a href="#entry-Usugandhaa" class="skt-link">Sugandhā</a>, <a href="#entry-Usuratama_njarii" class="skt-link">Suratamañjarī</a>, <a href="#entry-Uhemaa" class="skt-link">Hemā</a> — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. md. <i>(apsarāyate)</i> se comporter comme une nymphe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apsu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अप्सु</span> <i>apsu</i> [loc. pl. <a href="#entry-ap" class="skt-link">ap</a>] ind. dans les eaux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apsuyoni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>apsuyoni</i> [<a href="#entry-yoni" class="skt-link">yoni</a>] a. <a href="#entry-apsuyoni" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-apsuyoni" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-apsuyoni" class="skt-link">f.</a> issu des eaux.<br> <a href="#entry-apsu" class="skt-link">apsu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apunarbhava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपुनर्भव</span> <i>apunarbhava</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-punarbhava" class="skt-link">punarbhava</a>] <a href="#entry-apunarbhava" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. non renaissance; libération.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aputra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपुत्र</span> <i>aputra</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-putra" class="skt-link">putra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aputra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aputra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aputraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aputrā</i> sans fils.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apuupa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपूप</span> <i>apūpa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-puupa" class="skt-link">pūpa</a>] <a href="#entry-apuupa" class="skt-link">m.</a> gâteau, biscuit; pain <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> froment.<br> <i>apūpān</i> <i>iva</i> <i>bhakṣayati</i> <i>māṣān</i> Il mange des fèves comme des gâteaux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apuupavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>apūpavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-apuupavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-apuupavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-apuupavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>apūpavatī</i> accompagné d'un gâteau.<br> <a href="#entry-apuupa" class="skt-link">apūpa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apuurva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अपूर्व</span> <i>apūrva</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-puurva" class="skt-link">pūrva</a>] a. <a href="#entry-apuurva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-apuurva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-apuurvaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>apūrvā</i> sans prédécesseur, sans précédent; nouveau; original; novateur, innovant; incomparable; extraordinaire — <a href="#entry-apuurva" class="skt-link">m.</a> nouveauté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>] [«ce qui n'existait pas auparavant»] force initiée par le rite efficace; bénéfice d'une action rituelle; son influence sur le <a href="#entry-karma" class="skt-link">karma</a> individuel; causalité (liant le rite à son fruit).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apuurvataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>apūrvatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-apuurvataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> fait d'être sans précédent; incomparabilité; originalité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apuurvatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>apūrvatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-apuurvatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait d'être sans précédent; incomparabilité; originalité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apuurvavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>apūrvavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] adv. de manière singulière; comme jamais auparavant.<br> <a href="#entry-apuurva" class="skt-link">apūrva</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-apyaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अप्यय</span> <i>apyaya</i> [<a href="#entry-api" class="skt-link">api</a>-<a href="#entry-aya" class="skt-link">aya</a>] <a href="#entry-apyaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> fin, disparition; destruction.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ar_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्ण</span> <i>arṇa</i> <a href="#entry-ar_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ar_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> flot, courant, vague; mer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> syllabe.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ar_nava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्णव</span> <i>arṇava</i> [<a href="#entry-ar_na" class="skt-link">arṇa</a><a href="#entry--va" class="skt-link">-va</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ar_nava" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ar_nava" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ar_navaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arṇavā</i> agité de vague, houleux, bouillonnant; aqueux, marin — <a href="#entry-ar_nava" class="skt-link">m.</a> mer (houleuse); flots, vagues, écume.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ar_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्ष्</span> <i>arṣ</i> cf. <a href="#entry-_r_s" class="skt-link">ṛṣ</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर</span> <i>ara</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-_r" class="skt-link">ṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-araa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arā</i> rapide — <a href="#entry-ara" class="skt-link">m.</a> rayon d'une roue <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> jn. division du temps.<br> <i>aram</i> adv. prêt, bien disposé; assez, convenablement.<br> <i>araṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> préparer.<br> <i>araṃ</i> <i>gam</i> s'occuper de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरण</span> <i>araṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-ra_na" class="skt-link">raṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ara_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>araṇā</i> retiré, étranger; éloigné, distant; isolé — <a href="#entry-ara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> refuge.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ara_ni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरणि</span> <i>araṇi</i> <a href="#entry-ara_ni" class="skt-link">f.</a> bâton à feu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sa partie supérieure; syn. <a href="#entry-azvattha" class="skt-link">aśvattha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> du. <i>araṇī</i> ses deux parties.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ara_nya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरण्य</span> <i>araṇya</i> [<a href="#entry-ara_na" class="skt-link">araṇa</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] <a href="#entry-ara_nya" class="skt-link">n.</a> bois, forêt; nature sauvage <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lieu isolé, désert; cf. <a href="#entry-dharmaara_nya" class="skt-link">dharmāraṇya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ara_nyaanii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>araṇyānī</i> [<a href="#entry--aanii" class="skt-link">-ānī</a>] <a href="#entry-ara_nyaanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> grande forêt; nature sauvage.<br> <a href="#entry-ara_nya" class="skt-link">araṇya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ara_nyaraajya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>araṇyarājya</i> [<a href="#entry-raajya" class="skt-link">rājya</a>] <a href="#entry-ara_nyaraajya" class="skt-link">n.</a> souveraineté sur la forêt.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ara_nyarodana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>araṇyarodana</i> [<a href="#entry-rodana" class="skt-link">rodana</a>] <a href="#entry-ara_nyarodana" class="skt-link">n.</a> [«pleurer dans les bois»] prêcher dans le désert.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ara_nyavaasin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>araṇyavāsin</i> [<a href="#entry-vaasin_1" class="skt-link">vāsin_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ara_nyavaasin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ara_nyavaasin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ara_nyavaasinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>araṇyavāsinī</i> qui vit retiré dans la forêt.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ara_nye">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरण्ये</span> <i>araṇye</i> [loc. <a href="#entry-ara_nya" class="skt-link">araṇya</a>] iic.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ara_nyetilaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>araṇyetilaka</i> [<a href="#entry-tilaka" class="skt-link">tilaka</a>] <a href="#entry-ara_nyetilaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. évènement inattendu [«comme des grains de sésame dans la forêt»].<br> <a href="#entry-ara_nye" class="skt-link">araṇye</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-araaddhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अराद्धि</span> <i>arāddhi</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-raaddhi" class="skt-link">rāddhi</a>] <a href="#entry-araaddhi" class="skt-link">f.</a> insuccès, échec.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-araajaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अराजक</span> <i>arājaka</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-raajaka" class="skt-link">rājaka</a>] <a href="#entry-araajaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> absence de roi, anarchie — a. <a href="#entry-araajaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-araajaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-araajakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arājakā</i> sans roi.<br> <i>arājake</i> <i>janapade</i> quand le pays est en anarchie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-araajakataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arājakatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-araajakataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> état d'anarchie.<br> <a href="#entry-araajaka" class="skt-link">arājaka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-araati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अराति</span> <i>arāti</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-raati" class="skt-link">rāti</a>] <a href="#entry-araati" class="skt-link">f.</a> défaveur; inimitié, hostilité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>arātayas</i> sorcières — <a href="#entry-araati" class="skt-link">m.</a> ennemi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-araatribhojana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरात्रिभोजन</span> <i>arātribhojana</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-raatribhojana" class="skt-link">rātribhojana</a>] <a href="#entry-araatribhojana" class="skt-link">n.</a> jn. défense de prendre un repas le soir, une observance majeure [<a href="#entry-mahaavrata" class="skt-link">mahāvrata</a>] des renonçants <a href="#entry-jaina" class="skt-link">jaina</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aragha_t_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>araghaṭṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-gha_t_ta" class="skt-link">ghaṭṭa</a>] <a href="#entry-aragha_t_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> roue ou poulie de puits.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aranaatha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aranātha</i> [<a href="#entry-naatha" class="skt-link">nātha</a>] <a href="#entry-aranaatha" class="skt-link">m.</a> jn. np. d'Aranātha «Maître du Temps», 18⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-tiirthafkara" class="skt-link">tīrthaṅkara</a> mythique; son corps est jaune d'or, son symbole est un poisson; on lui associe aussi le diagramme <a href="#entry-nandyaavarta" class="skt-link">nandyāvarta</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-ara" class="skt-link">ara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arapas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरपस्</span> <i>arapas</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-rapas" class="skt-link">rapas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arapas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arapas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arapas" class="skt-link">f.</a> sans infirmité; indemne; bien portant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरस</span> <i>arasa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-rasa" class="skt-link">rasa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arasaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arasā</i> sans goût, insipide; faible <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui n'a pas le sens du goût — <a href="#entry-arasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> absence de sève, absence de jus.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arasaj_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरसज्ञ</span> <i>arasajña</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-rasaj_na" class="skt-link">rasajña</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arasaj_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arasaj_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arasaj_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arasajñā</i> qui n'a pas de goût pour; qui ne s'intéresse pas à.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arasaj_nataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arasajñatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-arasaj_nataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> méd. perte du sens du goût, ageusia; syn. <a href="#entry-rasaaj_naana" class="skt-link">rasājñāna</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-arasaj_na" class="skt-link">arasajña</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरति</span> <i>arati</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-rati" class="skt-link">rati</a>] <a href="#entry-arati" class="skt-link">f.</a> déplaisir, peine; anxiété; détresse; chagrin, regret, deuil <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> colère <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> maladie biliaire — a. <a href="#entry-arati" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arati" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arati" class="skt-link">f.</a> mécontent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aratni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरत्नि</span> <i>aratni</i> <a href="#entry-aratni" class="skt-link">m.</a> coudée, aune; mesure de longueur, de 24 doigts [<a href="#entry-afgula" class="skt-link">aṅgula</a>] (environ 46 cm) — <a href="#entry-aratni" class="skt-link">f.</a> coude.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aravinda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरविन्द</span> <i>aravinda</i> <a href="#entry-aravinda" class="skt-link">m.</a> lotus (de jour), nymphea.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aravindanaabhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aravindanābhi</i> [<a href="#entry-naabhi" class="skt-link">nābhi</a>] <a href="#entry-aravindanaabhi" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. d'Aravindanābhi, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>-<a href="#entry-Unaaraaya_na" class="skt-link">Nārāyaṇa</a> «Dont le nombril porte un lotus».<br> <a href="#entry-aravinda" class="skt-link">aravinda</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arbha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्भ</span> <i>arbha</i> a. <a href="#entry-arbha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arbha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arbhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arbhā</i> véd. petit, insignifiant — <a href="#entry-arbha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <i>arbha</i> véd. garçon, enfant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. ορφανος; lat. <i>orbus</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arbhaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arbhaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arbhaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arbhaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arbhakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arbhakā</i> petit; fragile — <a href="#entry-arbhaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> garçon, enfant; petit d'animal.<br> <i>namo</i> <i>mahadbhyo</i> <i>namo</i> <i>arbhakedbhyo</i> <i>namo</i> <i>yuvabhyo</i> <i>nama</i> <i>āśinebhyaḥ</i> [RV.] Hommage aux grands, hommage aux petits, hommage aux jeunes, hommage aux vieux.<br> <a href="#entry-arbha" class="skt-link">arbha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arbuda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्बुद</span> <i>arbuda</i> <a href="#entry-arbuda" class="skt-link">n.</a> quantité innombrable; cent millions; cf. <a href="#entry-mahaarbuda" class="skt-link">mahārbuda</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tumeur, grosseur; multitude, troupe — <a href="#entry-arbuda" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. np. d'Arbuda, démon-hydre [<a href="#entry-naaga" class="skt-link">nāga</a>] vaincu par <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>; il descend de <a href="#entry-Ukadruu" class="skt-link">Kadrū</a> [<a href="#entry-kaadraveya" class="skt-link">kādraveya</a>] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. du Mont Arbuda_1, mod. Mont Abū, sur un plateau à 1200 m au Rajasthan, près du <a href="#entry-Ugurjara" class="skt-link">Gurjara</a>; c'est un lieu de pélerinage Jaïne important.<br> <i>arbudadhā</i> adv. par millions.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arbudaara_nya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arbudāraṇya</i> [<a href="#entry-ara_nya" class="skt-link">araṇya</a>] <a href="#entry-arbudaara_nya" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. de l'Arbudāraṇya, site forestier du Mont Abū [<a href="#entry-Uarbuda_1" class="skt-link">Arbuda_1</a>]; c'est la région d'origine des <a href="#entry-gurjaraas" class="skt-link">gurjarās</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-arbuda" class="skt-link">arbuda</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arbudaparvata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arbudaparvata</i> [<a href="#entry-parvata" class="skt-link">parvata</a>] <a href="#entry-arbudaparvata" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. du Mont <a href="#entry-Uarbuda_1" class="skt-link">Arbuda_1</a>, point culminant (1722 m) de la chaîne <a href="#entry-Uaaraavalii" class="skt-link">Ārāvalī</a>, à l'ouest du Deccan; mod. Mont Abū; c'est un important lieu de pélerinage Jaïne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arbudazikhara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arbudaśikhara</i> [<a href="#entry-zikhara" class="skt-link">śikhara</a>] <a href="#entry-arbudazikhara" class="skt-link">m.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-arbudaparvata" class="skt-link">arbudaparvata</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arc">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्च्</span> <i>arc</i> cf. <a href="#entry-_rc_1" class="skt-link">ṛc_1</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arcaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्चा</span> <i>arcā</i> [<a href="#entry-arc" class="skt-link">arc</a>] <a href="#entry-arcaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> culte, adoration <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> idole.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arcaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्चक</span> <i>arcaka</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-_rc_1" class="skt-link">ṛc_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arcaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arcaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arcakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arcakā</i> qui honore; qui adore — <a href="#entry-arcaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> adorateur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mod. officiant de temple.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arcana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्चन</span> <i>arcana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-arc" class="skt-link">arc</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arcana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arcana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arcanii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arcanī</i> ifc. qui honore, qui adore, qui vénère — <a href="#entry-arcana" class="skt-link">n.</a> hommage rendu (à une divinité, un supérieur) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. cérémonie au temple où le prêtre célébrant énonce le nom, le <a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a> de naissance et le <a href="#entry-gotra" class="skt-link">gotra</a> du fidèle aux fins de bénédiction — <a href="#entry-arcanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arcanā</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arcaniiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्चनीय</span> <i>arcanīya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] <a href="#entry-_rc_1" class="skt-link">ṛc_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arcaniiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arcaniiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arcaniiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arcanīyā</i> à honorer; vénérable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arci">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्चि</span> <i>arci</i> [<a href="#entry-_rc_1" class="skt-link">ṛc_1</a>] <a href="#entry-arci" class="skt-link">m.</a> rayon, flamme — <a href="#entry-arcis" class="skt-link">n.</a> <i>arcis</i> id. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> splendeur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arcita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्चित</span> <i>arcita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-_rc_1" class="skt-link">ṛc_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arcita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arcita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arcitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arcitā</i> honoré, considéré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arcya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्च्य</span> <i>arcya</i> [abs. <a href="#entry-_rc_1" class="skt-link">ṛc_1</a>] ind. ayant honoré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ard">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्द्</span> <i>ard</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(ardati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>ardita</i><i>)</i> tourbillonner, être agité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inquiéter, tourmenter, blesser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ardana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्दन</span> <i>ardana</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-ard" class="skt-link">ard</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ardana" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ardana" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ardanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ardanā</i> qui tourmente, destructeur — <a href="#entry-ardana" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. d'Ardana, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> «qui tourmente» — <a href="#entry-ardana" class="skt-link">n.</a> peine, torture, destruction.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ardh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्ध्</span> <i>ardh</i> [ca. <a href="#entry-_rdh" class="skt-link">ṛdh</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. <i>(ardhayati)</i> satisfaire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ardha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्ध</span> <i>ardha</i> a. <a href="#entry-ardha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ardha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ardhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ardhā</i> demi, semi — <a href="#entry-ardha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ardha" class="skt-link">n.</a> la moitié — loc. <i>ardhe</i> adv. au milieu de — iic. (avec ordinal) réduit d'une moitié.<br> <i>ardhatṛtīya</i> deux et demi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ardhaantaraikapadataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ardhāntaraikapadatā</i> [<a href="#entry-antara" class="skt-link">antara</a>-<a href="#entry-ekapada" class="skt-link">ekapada</a>] <a href="#entry-ardhaantaraikapadataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> gram. utilisation dans un hémistiche d'un mot grammatiquement lié dans l'autre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ardhacandra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ardhacandra</i> [<a href="#entry-candra" class="skt-link">candra</a>] <a href="#entry-ardhacandra" class="skt-link">m.</a> demi-lune; flèche à pointe en forme de demi-lune; motif des plumes de paon, etc. <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. notation pour l'<a href="#entry-anusvaara" class="skt-link">anusvāra</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-candrabindu" class="skt-link">candrabindu</a>.<br> <i>ardhacandraṃ</i> <i>dā</i> saisir à la nuque.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ardhadhaatu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ardhadhātu</i> [<a href="#entry-dhaatu" class="skt-link">dhātu</a>] <a href="#entry-ardhadhaatu" class="skt-link">m.</a> cf. <a href="#entry-aardhadhaatuka" class="skt-link">ārdhadhātuka</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ardhadharmapuujaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ardhadharmapūjā</i> [<a href="#entry-dharma" class="skt-link">dharma</a>-<a href="#entry-puujaa" class="skt-link">pūjā</a>] <a href="#entry-ardhadharmapuujaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. rite de don de la moitié de son mérite religieux [<a href="#entry-dharma" class="skt-link">dharma</a>] à un pécheur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ardhagafgaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ardhagaṅgā</i> [<a href="#entry-gafgaa" class="skt-link">gaṅgā</a>] <a href="#entry-ardhagafgaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> myth. np. d'Ardhagaṅgā «Moitié du Gange», épith. de la <a href="#entry-Ukaaverii" class="skt-link">Kāverī</a>, moitié séparée de la <a href="#entry-Ugafgaa" class="skt-link">Gaṅgā</a> par <a href="#entry-Ujahnu" class="skt-link">Jahnu</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ardhakukku_tiinyaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ardhakukkuṭīnyāya</i> [<a href="#entry-kukku_tii" class="skt-link">kukkuṭī</a>-<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] <a href="#entry-ardhakukku_tiinyaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [«logique de la demi-poule»] dicton [<a href="#entry-subhaa_sita" class="skt-link">subhāṣita</a>] exigeant la cohérence de la rhétorique.<br> <i>na</i> <i>hi</i> <i>kukkuṭyā</i> <i>ekadeśaḥ</i> <i>pacyata</i> <i>ekadeśaḥ</i> <i>prasavāya</i> <i>kalpate</i> [<a href="#entry-Ukumaarila" class="skt-link">Kumārila</a>] On ne peut pas avoir d'une part la poule au pot, et d'autre part le fait qu'elle soit en mesure de pondre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ardhama_n_dapa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ardhamaṇḍapa</i> [<a href="#entry-ma_n_dapa" class="skt-link">maṇḍapa</a>] <a href="#entry-ardhama_n_dapa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ardhama_n_dapa" class="skt-link">n.</a> (arch.) hall d'entrée dans un temple.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ardhamaagadhii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ardhamāgadhī</i> [<a href="#entry-maagadhii" class="skt-link">māgadhī</a>] <a href="#entry-ardhamaagadhii" class="skt-link">f.</a> dialecte de la langue <a href="#entry-maagadhii" class="skt-link">māgadhī</a>, utilisé pour les textes sacrés de la tradition <a href="#entry-jaina" class="skt-link">jaina</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ardhanaariizvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ardhanārīśvara</i> [<a href="#entry-naarii" class="skt-link">nārī</a>-<a href="#entry-iizvara" class="skt-link">īśvara</a>] <a href="#entry-ardhanaariizvara" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. d'Ardhanārīśvara le «Seigneur Androgyne», épith. de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> [«à moitié femme»]; cf. <a href="#entry-Ubh_rfgii" class="skt-link">Bhṛṅgī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ardharca">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ardharca</i> [<a href="#entry-_rca" class="skt-link">ṛca</a>] <a href="#entry-ardharca" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ardharca" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. hémistiche, demi-stance (marquée par une pause [<a href="#entry-avasaana" class="skt-link">avasāna</a>] dans la récitation, avec absence de liaison [<a href="#entry-sandhi" class="skt-link">sandhi</a>]).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ardharcaadi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ardharcādi</i> [<a href="#entry-aadi" class="skt-link">ādi</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ardharcaadi" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ardharcaadi" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ardharcaadi" class="skt-link">f.</a> gram. se dit d'un groupe [<a href="#entry-ga_na" class="skt-link">gaṇa</a>] de mots employés au neutre aussi bien qu'au masculin.<br> <a href="#entry-ardharca" class="skt-link">ardharca</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ardhav_rddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ardhavṛddha</i> [<a href="#entry-v_rddha" class="skt-link">vṛddha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ardhav_rddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ardhav_rddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ardhav_rddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ardhavṛddhā</i> d'âge moyen.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ardhaviraama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ardhavirāma</i> [<a href="#entry-viraama" class="skt-link">virāma</a>] <a href="#entry-ardhaviraama" class="skt-link">m.</a> milieu d'une stance, indiqué en écriture par le simple <a href="#entry-da_n_da" class="skt-link">daṇḍa</a>; opp. <a href="#entry-puur_naviraama" class="skt-link">pūrṇavirāma</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ardhavisarga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ardhavisarga</i> [<a href="#entry-visarga" class="skt-link">visarga</a>] <a href="#entry-ardhavisarga" class="skt-link">m.</a> phon. marque les sons védiques <a href="#entry-jihvaamuuliiya" class="skt-link">jihvāmūlīya</a> et <a href="#entry-upadhmaaniiya" class="skt-link">upadhmānīya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ardhika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्धिक</span> <i>ardhika</i> [<a href="#entry-ardha" class="skt-link">ardha</a><a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ardhika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ardhika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ardhikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ardhikā</i> formant la moitié de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ardhin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्धिन्</span> <i>ardhin</i> [<a href="#entry-ardha" class="skt-link">ardha</a><a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ardhin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ardhin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ardhinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ardhinī</i> recevant la moitié de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ardhokta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ardhokta</i> [<a href="#entry-ukta" class="skt-link">ukta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ardhokta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ardhokta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ardhoktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ardhoktā</i> à moitié dit.<br> <a href="#entry-ardha" class="skt-link">ardha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ardita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्दित</span> <i>ardita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-ard" class="skt-link">ard</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ardita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ardita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arditaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arditā</i> affligé, tourmenté, blessé; tué.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-are">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरे</span> <i>are</i> [voc. <a href="#entry-ari" class="skt-link">ari</a>] interj. (appel) hé! holà! eh bien!
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-argala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्गल</span> <i>argala</i> <a href="#entry-argala" class="skt-link">m.</a> verrou, barre (de porte).<br> <i>argalaṃ</i> <i>dā</i> tirer le verrou.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-argalita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्गलित</span> <i>argalita</i> [<a href="#entry-argala" class="skt-link">argala</a>] a. <a href="#entry-argalita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-argalita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-argalitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>argalitā</i> verrouillé, fermé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-argha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्घ</span> <i>argha</i> [<a href="#entry-arh" class="skt-link">arh</a>] <a href="#entry-argha" class="skt-link">m.</a> valeur, prix <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> don honorifique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arghya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्घ्य</span> <i>arghya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-arh" class="skt-link">arh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arghya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arghya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arghyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arghyā</i> qui a de la valeur; estimé; qui mérite d'être offert — <a href="#entry-arghya" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. eau d'hommage présentée à l'hôte [<a href="#entry-atithi" class="skt-link">atithi</a>]; son vase; oblation à <a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a>, aux <a href="#entry-pitaras" class="skt-link">pitaras</a>, etc.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्ह्</span> <i>arh</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(arhati)</i> pr. md. <i>(arhate)</i> aor. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] <i>(ārhīt)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>arhita</i><i>)</i> ppr. <i>(arhat)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>arghya</i><i>)</i> être digne de, mériter, avoir droit à ⟨acc.⟩; être autorisé à ⟨inf.⟩; devoir faire ⟨acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pouvoir, être capable de — ca. <i>(arhayati)</i> donner le droit de, autoriser, permettre.<br> <i>...</i> <i>arhasi</i> adr. veuille, daigne, je te prie de ... ⟨inf.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्ह</span> <i>arha</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-arh" class="skt-link">arh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arhā</i> digne de ⟨iic.⟩, méritant; susceptible de; propre à ⟨g. acc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> requis de, autorisé à ⟨inf.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> valeur, coût — <a href="#entry-arhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arhā</i> culte — <a href="#entry-arha" class="skt-link">n.</a> pl. <i>arhāṇi</i> dévotions.<br> <i>kāryārhā</i> f. (femme) digne de s'occuper d'une affaire.<br> <i>pūjārhā</i> f. (femme) qui mérite le respect.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arha_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arhaṇa</i> [<a href="#entry--na" class="skt-link">-na</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arha_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arha_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arha_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arhaṇā</i> ifc. qui mérite, qui a le droit de — <a href="#entry-arha_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> mérite; honneur; culte; fait de traiter qqn. ⟨g.⟩ avec respect <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> trophée.<br> <a href="#entry-arha" class="skt-link">arha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arhat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्हत्</span> <i>arhat</i> [ppr. <a href="#entry-arh" class="skt-link">arh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arhat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arhat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arhantii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arhantī</i> méritant, bon; digne, honorable, respectable — <a href="#entry-arhat" class="skt-link">m.</a> bd. vénérable, saint <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> jn. saint; syn. <a href="#entry-tiirthafkara" class="skt-link">tīrthaṅkara</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ari">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरि</span> <i>ari</i> [<a href="#entry-_r" class="skt-link">ṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ari" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ari" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ari" class="skt-link">f.</a> fidèle; zélé, fervent, pieux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> avide; envieux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hostile — <a href="#entry-ari" class="skt-link">m.</a> ennemi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ari_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरिष्ट</span> <i>ariṣṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-ri_s_ta" class="skt-link">riṣṭa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ari_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ari_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ari_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ariṣṭā</i> véd. indemne, sain et sauf <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> de mauvais augure; désastreux — <a href="#entry-ari_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> signe favorable, chance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> infortune, mauvais présage — <a href="#entry-ari_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du démon [<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a>] Ariṣṭa «Infortune», fils de <a href="#entry-Ubali" class="skt-link">Bali</a>, à l'aspect d'un énorme taureau furieux; il fut vaincu par <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>, qui le poignarda avec sa propre corne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ari_s_tanemi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ariṣṭanemi</i> [<a href="#entry-nemi" class="skt-link">nemi</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ari_s_tanemi" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ari_s_tanemi" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ari_s_tanemi" class="skt-link">f.</a> dont la jante de roue est intacte — <a href="#entry-ari_s_tanemi" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. np. d'Ariṣṭanemi, associé de <a href="#entry-Utaark_sya" class="skt-link">Tārkṣya</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Usumati_2" class="skt-link">Sumati_2</a>; plus tard il fut identifié à <a href="#entry-Ugaru_da" class="skt-link">Garuḍa</a> comme fils de <a href="#entry-Uvinataa" class="skt-link">Vinatā</a>; on lui attribue un hymne du RV.; cf. <a href="#entry-Uparapura_njaya" class="skt-link">Parapurañjaya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> jn. épith. de <a href="#entry-Uneminaatha" class="skt-link">Neminātha</a>, 22⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ <a href="#entry-tiirthafkara" class="skt-link">tīrthaṅkara</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-ari_s_ta" class="skt-link">ariṣṭa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ari_s_tataati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ariṣṭatāti</i> [<a href="#entry-taati" class="skt-link">tāti</a>] <a href="#entry-ari_s_tataati" class="skt-link">f.</a> bonheur; santé; chance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरिन्</span> <i>arin</i> [<a href="#entry-ara" class="skt-link">ara</a><a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] <a href="#entry-arin" class="skt-link">n.</a> [«qui a des rayons»] roue <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. not. <a href="#entry-cakra" class="skt-link">cakra</a> de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> — <a href="#entry-ari_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <i>ari_1</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arindama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ariṃdama</i> var. <i>arindama</i> [<a href="#entry-dama" class="skt-link">dama</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ari_mdama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ari_mdama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ari_mdamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ariṃdamā</i> qui subjugue son ennemi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arisamaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arisamāsa</i> [<a href="#entry-samaasa" class="skt-link">samāsa</a>] <a href="#entry-arisamaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. [«rassemblement d'ennemis»] composé irrégulier (par ex. de sanskrit et de prakrit).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arisuudana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arisūdana</i> [<a href="#entry-suudana" class="skt-link">sūdana</a>] <a href="#entry-arisuudana" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de Arisūdana, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> «qui détruit l'ennemi».<br> <a href="#entry-ari" class="skt-link">ari</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arit_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरितृ</span> <i>aritṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-_r" class="skt-link">ṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arit_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arit_r" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aritrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aritrī</i> rameur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aritra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरित्र</span> <i>aritra</i> [<a href="#entry-_r" class="skt-link">ṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aritra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aritra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aritraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aritrā</i> qui propulse, qui conduit — <a href="#entry-aritra" class="skt-link">m.</a> rame; gouvernail.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्ज्</span> <i>arj</i> cf. <a href="#entry-_rj" class="skt-link">ṛj</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arjana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्जन</span> <i>arjana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-_rj" class="skt-link">ṛj</a>] <a href="#entry-arjana" class="skt-link">n.</a> gain, acquisition.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arjita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्जित</span> <i>arjita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-_rj" class="skt-link">ṛj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arjita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arjita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arjitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arjitā</i> acquis.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arjuna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्जुन</span> <i>arjuna</i> [<a href="#entry-_rj" class="skt-link">ṛj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arjuna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arjuna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arjunii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arjunī</i> blanc, clair, argenté; brillant — <a href="#entry-arjuna" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. du héros Arjuna «Immaculé», l'un des 5 <a href="#entry-paa_n_davaas" class="skt-link">pāṇḍavās</a>, fils de <a href="#entry-Upaa_n_du" class="skt-link">Pāṇḍu</a> du clan des <a href="#entry-Ubharataas" class="skt-link">Bharatās</a>; il fut conçu des amours du dieu <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> et de <a href="#entry-Ukuntii" class="skt-link">Kuntī</a>, et ainsi appelé <a href="#entry-Upaartha" class="skt-link">Pārtha</a>; il représente l'Homme comme son cousin maternel <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> représente Dieu, selon la dualité des jumeaux <a href="#entry-Unara" class="skt-link">Nara</a>-<a href="#entry-Unaaraaya_na" class="skt-link">Nārāyaṇa</a>; archer insurpassable, il possédait l'arc magique <a href="#entry-Ugaa_n_diiva" class="skt-link">Gāṇḍīva</a> de <a href="#entry-Uvaru_na" class="skt-link">Varuṇa</a>, que lui avait remis <a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>; il était le meilleur élève de <a href="#entry-Udro_na" class="skt-link">Droṇa</a>, qui lui donna l'arme <a href="#entry-brahmaziras" class="skt-link">brahmaśiras</a>; pour payer son maître il soumit le roi <a href="#entry-Udrupada" class="skt-link">Drupada</a>, puis il conquit de nombreux autres royaumes; il combattit le <a href="#entry-gandharva" class="skt-link">gandharva</a> <a href="#entry-Uafgaarapar_na" class="skt-link">Aṅgāraparṇa</a>, qui lui enseigna la science de vision extralucide [<a href="#entry-caak_su_sii" class="skt-link">cākṣuṣī</a>]; au <a href="#entry-svaya_mvara" class="skt-link">svayaṃvara</a> de la princesse <a href="#entry-Udraupadii" class="skt-link">Draupadī</a>, déguisé en brâhmane, il remporta l'épreuve, mais à son retour sa mère <a href="#entry-Ukuntii" class="skt-link">Kuntī</a> ordonna qu'il partageât son prix avec ses frères, et <a href="#entry-Udraupadii" class="skt-link">Draupadī</a> dut devenir l'épouse commune des cinq <a href="#entry-paa_n_davaas" class="skt-link">pāṇḍavās</a>, accomplissant ainsi la promesse faite dans une vie antérieure à <a href="#entry-Uindrasenaa_1" class="skt-link">Indrasenā_1</a>; son cousin <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> lui donna en mariage sa sœur <a href="#entry-Usubhadraa" class="skt-link">Subhadrā</a>, qu'il épousa après l'avoir enlevée, selon le mode de mariage <a href="#entry-k_satriya" class="skt-link">kṣatriya</a>; il épousa aussi <a href="#entry-Ucitraafgadaa" class="skt-link">Citrāṅgadā</a>, dont il eut pour fils <a href="#entry-Ubabhruvaahana" class="skt-link">Babhruvāhana</a>; il s'unit à la nymphe-serpent [<a href="#entry-naagii" class="skt-link">nāgī</a>] <a href="#entry-Uuluupii" class="skt-link">Ulūpī</a>, dont il eut pour fils <a href="#entry-Uiraavaan" class="skt-link">Irāvān</a>; il suivit en exil son frère le roi <a href="#entry-Uyudhi_s_thira" class="skt-link">Yudhiṣṭhira</a>, avec ses frères et leur épouse commune <a href="#entry-Udraupadii" class="skt-link">Draupadī</a>; à leur 13⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ année d'exil, il se dissimula comme le travesti <a href="#entry-Ub_rhanna_daa" class="skt-link">Bṛhannaḍā</a> à la cour du roi <a href="#entry-Uviraa_ta" class="skt-link">Virāṭa</a>; il se prépara à la bataille fratricide, not. en séjournant 5 ans aux cieux chez <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>; <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>-<a href="#entry-Upinaakin" class="skt-link">Pinākin</a> lui enseigna l'arme <a href="#entry-Upaazupata" class="skt-link">Pāśupata</a>; <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> lui servit de cocher dans la bataille du <a href="#entry-Ukuruk_setra" class="skt-link">Kurukṣetra</a>, où Il lui révéla Sa nature divine dans la <a href="#entry-Ubhagavadgiitaa" class="skt-link">Bhagavadgītā</a>, qui est un dialogue entre Dieu et l'Homme recevant son devoir [<a href="#entry-dharma" class="skt-link">dharma</a>] de se réaliser par l'action juste [<a href="#entry-karmayoga" class="skt-link">karmayoga</a>]; lors de la bataille, il fit tomber de son char son aïeul <a href="#entry-Ubhii_sma" class="skt-link">Bhīṣma</a>; il dut combattre son <a href="#entry-guru" class="skt-link">guru</a> Droṇa; il combattit l'invincible <a href="#entry-Ukar_na" class="skt-link">Karṇa</a>, et le tua lorsque son char s'enlisa; pour ces actes négatifs il est <a href="#entry-Ubiibhatsu" class="skt-link">Bībhatsu</a> qui répugne à la tâche; après la grande bataille, il suivit le cheval du sacrifice de <a href="#entry-Uyudhi_s_thira" class="skt-link">Yudhiṣṭhira</a> pour soumettre tous les rois de la Terre; au <a href="#entry-Uma_nipura" class="skt-link">Maṇipura</a> il défia son fils <a href="#entry-Ubabhruvaahana" class="skt-link">Babhruvāhana</a>, qui le transperça de flèches; il fut ressuscité par <a href="#entry-Uuluupii" class="skt-link">Ulūpī</a>; lorsque <a href="#entry-Udharmaraaja" class="skt-link">Dharmarāja</a> décida leur renoncement [<a href="#entry-tyaaga" class="skt-link">tyāga</a>], il suivit ses frères et leur femme commune dans leur marche vers le Ciel, vêtus d'écorce; dans la forêt, <a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a> lui demanda de rendre l'arc <a href="#entry-Ugaa_n_diiva" class="skt-link">Gāṇḍīva</a> en le jetant à la rivière, pour qu'il retournât à <a href="#entry-Uvaru_na" class="skt-link">Varuṇa</a>; il mourut en chemin, son <a href="#entry-dharma" class="skt-link">dharma</a> n'étant pas parfait, car il s'était vanté de tuer tous ses ennemis en une seule journée; cf. <a href="#entry-Uiraavaan" class="skt-link">Irāvān</a>, <a href="#entry-Uaindri" class="skt-link">Aindri</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukirii_tin" class="skt-link">Kirīṭin</a>, <a href="#entry-Ugu_daakeza" class="skt-link">Guḍākeśa</a>, <a href="#entry-Ujaya" class="skt-link">Jaya</a>, <a href="#entry-Uji_s_nu" class="skt-link">Jiṣṇu</a>, <a href="#entry-Utaapatya" class="skt-link">Tāpatya</a>, <a href="#entry-Udevadatta" class="skt-link">Devadatta</a>, <a href="#entry-Udhana_njaya" class="skt-link">Dhanañjaya</a>, <a href="#entry-Unandigho_sa" class="skt-link">Nandighoṣa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uparantapa" class="skt-link">Parantapa</a>, <a href="#entry-Uphaalguna" class="skt-link">Phālguna</a>, <a href="#entry-Ubhaarata" class="skt-link">Bhārata</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvaanaraketu" class="skt-link">Vānaraketu</a>, <a href="#entry-Uvijaya" class="skt-link">Vijaya</a>, <a href="#entry-Uzvetavahana" class="skt-link">Śvetavahana</a>, <a href="#entry-Usavyasaacin" class="skt-link">Savyasācin</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. d'Arjuna_1 <a href="#entry-Ukaartaviirya" class="skt-link">Kārtavīrya</a>, fils du roi <a href="#entry-Uk_rtaviirya" class="skt-link">Kṛtavīrya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> natu. bot. <i>Terminalia arjuna</i>, arbre Arjuna, une combretacée; il est employé en médecine pour réduire le cholestérol; syn. <a href="#entry-marudha" class="skt-link">marudha</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. chaîne de moyenne montagne au <a href="#entry-Umahaaraa_s_tra" class="skt-link">Mahārāṣṭra</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>argentum</i>; fr. argent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arka">

</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">10</span>] pr. md. <i>(arthayate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>arthita</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>arthanīya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>abhi</i>, <i>pra</i>, <i>prati</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> demander, solliciter ⟨2 acc.⟩; implorer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> donner la signification de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-artha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्थ</span> <i>artha</i> [<a href="#entry-_r" class="skt-link">ṛ</a><a href="#entry--tha" class="skt-link">-tha</a>] <a href="#entry-artha" class="skt-link">m.</a> but, cause, motif; intention; sens, signification <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> chose, objet; affaire; fait, réalité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> récompense; utilité, intérêt <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> possession, propriété, biens, richesse, avoir; avantage, profit (de ⟨i.⟩); pouvoir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. l'acquisition de biens matériels, un des buts de l'existence [<a href="#entry-puru_saartha" class="skt-link">puruṣārtha</a>]; myth. il est personnifié comme Artha le Riche <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. sens, signification d'un mot; notion à exprimer, sémantique; but communicatif <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. l'un des trois usages d'un mot: sens propre [<a href="#entry-abhidhaa_2" class="skt-link">abhidhā_2</a>], sens figuratif [<a href="#entry-lak_sa_naa" class="skt-link">lakṣaṇā</a>] et sens suggestif [<a href="#entry-vya_njanaa" class="skt-link">vyañjanā</a>] — acc. <i>artham</i> adv. à cause de; en vue de, afin de, pour obtenir; à l'usage de; en guise de, comme ⟨g. iic.⟩ — g. <i>arthāya</i> id. — loc. <i>arthe</i> id. — i. <i>arthena</i> id. — dat. <i>arthāt</i> adv. selon le cas — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(arthāpayati)</i> demander.<br> <i>ko</i> <i>'rtho</i> ⟨i.⟩ à quoi bon?<br> <i>tadartha</i> qui a tel objet, utile à cela; qui existe en vue de.<br> <i>evamartham</i> qui a tel objet, utile à cela; qui existe en vue de.<br> <i>yathārtham</i> selon le sens.<br> <i>arthasya</i> <i>puruṣo</i> <i>dāso</i> <i>dāsas</i> <i>tvartho</i> <i>na</i> <i>kasya</i> <i>cit</i> [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] L'homme est l'esclave du pouvoir, mais le pouvoir n'est l'esclave de rien.<br> <i>arthena</i> <i>balavān</i> <i>sarvo</i> <i>'py</i> <i>arthād</i> <i>bhavati</i> <i>paṇḍitaḥ</i> [PT.] C'est par l'argent que tout homme est fort, c'est de l'argent que vient même le <a href="#entry-pa_n_dita" class="skt-link">paṇḍita</a>.<br> <i>yasyārthās</i> <i>tasya</i> <i>mitrāṇi</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>yasyārthās</i> <i>tasya</i> <i>bāndhavāḥ</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>yasyārthās</i> <i>sa</i> <i>pumālṁloke</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>yasyārthās</i> <i>sa</i> <i>ca</i> <i>paṇḍitaḥ</i> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [PT.] Qui a de l'argent a des amis; qui a de l'argent a de la famille; qui a de l'argent est un homme en ce monde; celui qui a de l'argent est même un grand savant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arthaalafkaara">

[«embellissement du sens»] figure de style poétique; opp. <a href="#entry-zabdaalafkaara" class="skt-link">śabdālaṃkāra</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-artha" class="skt-link">artha</a>

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arthapaala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arthapāla</i> [<a href="#entry-paala" class="skt-link">pāla</a>] <a href="#entry-arthapaala" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. np. d'Arthapāla, l'un des 10 héros du <a href="#entry-Udazakumaaracarita" class="skt-link">Daśakumāracarita</a>; fils des amours de <a href="#entry-Ukaamapaala" class="skt-link">Kāmapāla</a> et de la princesse <a href="#entry-Ukaantimatii" class="skt-link">Kāntimatī</a>, il fut abandonné dans les bois, et recueilli par la <a href="#entry-yak_sii" class="skt-link">yakṣī</a> <a href="#entry-Utaaraavalii" class="skt-link">Tārāvalī</a>, avant d'être adopté par la reine <a href="#entry-Uvasumatii" class="skt-link">Vasumatī</a> pour servir de camarade à son fils <a href="#entry-Uraajavaahana" class="skt-link">Rājavāhana</a>; il alla à <a href="#entry-Ukaazii" class="skt-link">Kāśī</a> où il délivra son père condamné à tort.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arthapara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arthapara</i> [<a href="#entry-para" class="skt-link">para</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arthapara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arthapara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arthaparaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arthaparā</i> intéressé, avare; affairiste.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arthapati">

[DKC.] np. d'Arthapati «Affairiste», riche caravanier, concurrent de <a href="#entry-Udhanamitra" class="skt-link">Dhanamitra</a>, berné par <a href="#entry-Uapahaaravarmaa" class="skt-link">Apahāravarmā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. d'Arthapati_1, père de <a href="#entry-Ucitrabhaanu" class="skt-link">Citrabhānu</a>, grand-père de <a href="#entry-Ubaa_na_2" class="skt-link">Bāṇa_2</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arthaphala">

    <i>arthaphala</i> [<a href="#entry-phala" class="skt-link">phala</a>] <a href="#entry-arthaphala" class="skt-link">n.</a> fruit d'une transaction.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arthaphalabhogaviraaga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>] désintéressement des fruits de l'action, une qualification de l'aspirant à la libération [<a href="#entry-saadhanacatu_s_taya" class="skt-link">sādhanacatuṣṭaya</a>].
