<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arthaprak_rti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arthaprakṛti</i> [<a href="#entry-prak_rti" class="skt-link">prakṛti</a>] <a href="#entry-arthaprak_rti" class="skt-link">f.</a> instrument principal pour accomplir un but <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. [dramaturgie] l'un des 5 ressorts dramatiques: <a href="#entry-biija" class="skt-link">bīja</a> le germe à l'origine de l'action, <a href="#entry-bindu" class="skt-link">bindu</a> la goutte qui devient nappe comme un goutte d'huile sur l'eau, <a href="#entry-pataakaa" class="skt-link">patākā</a> la chaîne des épisodes, <a href="#entry-prakarii" class="skt-link">prakarī</a> l'incident singulier, et <a href="#entry-kaarya" class="skt-link">kārya</a> le dénouement; un récit dramatique canonique doit utiliser ces moyens d'action en passant par les étapes de déroulement [<a href="#entry-kaaryaavasthaa" class="skt-link">kāryāvasthā</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-pa_ncasandhi" class="skt-link">pañcasandhi</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-artharuupa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>artharūpa</i> [<a href="#entry-ruupa" class="skt-link">rūpa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-artharuupa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-artharuupa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-artharuupaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>artharūpā</i> consistant en.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arthasaadhaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arthasādhaka</i> [<a href="#entry-saadhaka" class="skt-link">sādhaka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arthasaadhaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arthasaadhaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arthasaadhikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arthasādhikā</i> utile, efficace, profitable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arthasafgraha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arthasaṃgraha</i> [<a href="#entry-safgraha" class="skt-link">saṃgraha</a>] <a href="#entry-arthasa_mgraha" class="skt-link">m.</a> accumulation de richesses; trésor <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. de l'Arthasaṃgraha «recueil de sémantique», texte de <a href="#entry-puurvamiimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">pūrvamīmāṃsā</a> de Laugākṣi Bhāskara (1882), basé sur le <a href="#entry-Umiimaa_msaanyaayaprakaaza" class="skt-link">Mīmāṃsānyāyaprakāśa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arthatas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arthatas</i> [<a href="#entry--tas" class="skt-link">-tas</a>] adv. en vue de; pour le profit de, concernant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> en fait, vraiment <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> concernant le sens.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arthatattva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arthatattva</i> [<a href="#entry-tattva" class="skt-link">tattva</a>] <a href="#entry-arthatattva" class="skt-link">n.</a> véritable nature de l'affaire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arthatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arthatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-arthatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de servir à, usage.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arthavaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arthavāda</i> [<a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">vāda</a>] <a href="#entry-arthavaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. glose (not. d'hymnes védiques) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. texte liant le rituel à sa justification mythique ou cosmologique dans la littérature <a href="#entry-braahma_na" class="skt-link">brāhmaṇa</a>; opp. <a href="#entry-vidhi" class="skt-link">vidhi</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arthavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्थवत्</span> <i>arthavat</i> [<a href="#entry-artha" class="skt-link">artha</a><a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arthavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arthavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arthavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arthavatī</i> riche; significatif; valable, utile — <a href="#entry-arthavattaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arthavattā</i> richesse; utilité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arthavij_naana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arthavijñāna</i> [<a href="#entry-vij_naana" class="skt-link">vijñāna</a>] <a href="#entry-arthavij_naana" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. compréhension fine de l'enseignement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arthazaastra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arthaśāstra</i> [<a href="#entry-zaastra" class="skt-link">śāstra</a>] <a href="#entry-arthazaastra" class="skt-link">n.</a> gestion politique, administration du royaume; économie; morale <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. de l'Arthaśāstra, traité d'économie politique de <a href="#entry-Ukau_tilya" class="skt-link">Kauṭilya</a>, ministre de <a href="#entry-Ucandragupta" class="skt-link">Candragupta</a> <a href="#entry-Umaurya" class="skt-link">Maurya</a> (?313–289 ant.); il comprend 15 sections [<a href="#entry-adhikara_na" class="skt-link">adhikaraṇa</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arthazakti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arthaśakti</i> [<a href="#entry-zakti" class="skt-link">śakti</a>] <a href="#entry-arthazakti" class="skt-link">f.</a> gram. pouvoir du signifié.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arthazaktimuula">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arthaśaktimūla</i> [<a href="#entry-muula" class="skt-link">mūla</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arthazaktimuula" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arthazaktimuula" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arthazaktimuulaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arthaśaktimūlā</i> gram. [«qui a son origine dans le pouvoir du sens»] se dit d'un sens suggéré [<a href="#entry-dhvani" class="skt-link">dhvani</a>] issu du signifié; opp. <a href="#entry-zabdazaktimuula" class="skt-link">śabdaśaktimūla</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-arthazakti" class="skt-link">arthaśakti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arthin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्थिन्</span> <i>arthin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-arth" class="skt-link">arth</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arthin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arthin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arthinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arthinī</i> qui désire, qui recherche; cupide; solliciteur, quémandeur; plaideur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pauvre, nécessiteux; mendiant, suppliant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui se propose; amant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arthita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्थित</span> <i>arthita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-arth" class="skt-link">arth</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arthita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arthita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arthitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arthitā</i> demandé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arthya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्थ्य</span> <i>arthya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-arth" class="skt-link">arth</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arthya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arthya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arthyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arthyā</i> riche.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्ति</span> <i>arti</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-aarti" class="skt-link">ārti</a>] <a href="#entry-arti" class="skt-link">f.</a> souffrance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-artihara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>artihara</i> [<a href="#entry-hara" class="skt-link">hara</a>] a. <a href="#entry-artihara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-artihara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-artiharaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>artiharā</i> qui supprime la souffrance.<br> <a href="#entry-arti" class="skt-link">arti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aru">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरु</span> <i>aru</i> <a href="#entry-aru" class="skt-link">m.</a> le soleil — acc. <i>arum</i> [<i>arus</i>] cf. <a href="#entry-aruntuda" class="skt-link">aruṃtuda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aru_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरुण</span> <i>aruṇa</i> a. <a href="#entry-aru_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aru_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aru_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aruṇā</i> <a href="#entry-aru_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aruṇī</i> rougeâtre; rouge (couleur de l'aurore) — <a href="#entry-aru_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> la couleur rouge rosé; l'aurore <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. d'Aruṇa, demi-dieu personnifiant l'Aurore, cocher du char de <a href="#entry-Usuurya" class="skt-link">Sūrya</a>; il est le fils estropié de <a href="#entry-Ukazyapa" class="skt-link">Kaśyapa</a> et <a href="#entry-Uvinataa" class="skt-link">Vinatā</a> et le frère aîné de <a href="#entry-Ugaru_da" class="skt-link">Garuḍa</a>; son épouse est <a href="#entry-Uzyenii" class="skt-link">Śyenī</a>; <a href="#entry-Usampaati" class="skt-link">Sampāti</a> et <a href="#entry-Uja_taayu" class="skt-link">Jaṭāyu</a> sont ses fils — <a href="#entry-aru_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> rubis.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aru_naacala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aruṇācala</i> [<a href="#entry-acala" class="skt-link">acala</a>] <a href="#entry-aru_naacala" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. de l'Aruṇācala «Mont de Feu», colline du Tamil Nadu près de mod. Tiruvannamalai portant un temple dédié à <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>-<a href="#entry-Uzafkara_1" class="skt-link">Śaṅkara_1</a> sous la forme du <a href="#entry-tejolifga" class="skt-link">tejoliṅga</a> <a href="#entry-Uaru_naacalezvara" class="skt-link">Aruṇācaleśvara</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uraama_na" class="skt-link">Rāmaṇa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. de l'Aruṇācala_1 «Montagne éclairée par l'aube», région montagneuse de l'extrême Nord-Est de l'Inde, à l'est du Bhutan.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aru_naacalezvara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aruṇācaleśvara</i> [<a href="#entry-iizvara" class="skt-link">īśvara</a>] <a href="#entry-aru_naacalezvara" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. d'Aruṇācaleśvara, «Seigneur de la colonne de feu», forme ignée [<a href="#entry-tejolifga" class="skt-link">tejoliṅga</a>] de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>; son sanctuaire est à Tiruvannamalai au Tamil Nadu; c'est le <a href="#entry-pa_ncabhuutasthala" class="skt-link">pañcabhūtasthala</a> associé à l'élément feu [<a href="#entry-tejas" class="skt-link">tejas</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-aru_naacala" class="skt-link">aruṇācala</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aru_naanuja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aruṇānuja</i> [<a href="#entry-anuja" class="skt-link">anuja</a>] <a href="#entry-aru_naanuja" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. «frère cadet d'<a href="#entry-Uaru_na" class="skt-link">Aruṇa</a>», épith. de <a href="#entry-Ugaru_da" class="skt-link">Garuḍa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-aru_na" class="skt-link">aruṇa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aru_ni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरुणि</span> <i>aruṇi</i> <a href="#entry-aru_ni" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. np. du <a href="#entry-muni" class="skt-link">muni</a> Aruṇi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aru_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरुष</span> <i>aruṣa</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-aru_na" class="skt-link">aruṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aru_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aru_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aru_sii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aruṣī</i> rougeâtre — <a href="#entry-aru_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> Soleil <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. myth. les chevaux rouges d'<a href="#entry-Uagni" class="skt-link">Agni</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aruci">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरुचि</span> <i>aruci</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-ruci" class="skt-link">ruci</a>] <a href="#entry-aruci" class="skt-link">f.</a> manque d'appêtit, dégoût <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> aversion (envers ⟨<a href="#entry-upari" class="skt-link">upari</a> g.⟩).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aruja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरुज</span> <i>aruja</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-ruj_2" class="skt-link">ruj_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aruja" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aruja" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arujaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arujā</i> qui ne fait pas souffrir (tumeur) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> sain, non malade <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> enjoué — <a href="#entry-aruja" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. bot. <i>Cassia fistula</i>, arbre aux feuilles composées, aux jolies fleurs jaunes en grappes pendantes, utilisé en médecine; syn. <a href="#entry-aaragvadha" class="skt-link">āragvadha</a>, <a href="#entry-k_rtamaala" class="skt-link">kṛtamāla</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arundhatii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरुन्धती</span> <i>arundhatī</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-rundhat" class="skt-link">rundhat</a>] <a href="#entry-arundhatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> natu. plante grimpante médicinale <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. d'Arundhatī «Découverte», épouse de <a href="#entry-Uvasi_s_tha" class="skt-link">Vasiṣṭha</a>; aux cérémonies de mariage le marié l'invoque comme exemple de fidélité conjugale et le prêtre montre à la future épouse l'étoile Alcor qui la symbolise; on l'associe aussi à <a href="#entry-ku_n_dalinii" class="skt-link">kuṇḍalinī</a> et aux plantes médicinales; cf. <a href="#entry-Umaitraavaru_nii" class="skt-link">Maitrāvaruṇī</a>, <a href="#entry-Uak_samaalaa" class="skt-link">Akṣamālā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. l'étoile Alcor de la Grande Ourse; peu visible, on la découvre en la désignant indirectement par son compagnon, l'étoile principale Mizar, qui symbolise son époux <a href="#entry-Uvasi_s_tha" class="skt-link">Vasiṣṭha</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uk_rttikaas" class="skt-link">Kṛttikās</a>.<br> <i>iyamarundhatī</i> <i>bhagavatī</i> <i>sūkṣmā</i> <i>ya</i> <i>enām</i> <i>na</i> <i>paśyati</i> <i>sa</i> <i>ṣaṇmāsān</i> <i>mriyate</i> Cette divine <a href="#entry-Uarundhatii" class="skt-link">Arundhatī</a> est minuscule; celui qui ne peut la voir mourra dans les 6 mois.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arundhatiidarzananyaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arundhatīdarśananyāya</i> [<a href="#entry-darzana" class="skt-link">darśana</a>-<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] <a href="#entry-arundhatiidarzananyaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [«logique de la vision d'<a href="#entry-Uarundhatii" class="skt-link">Arundhatī</a>»] procédé rhét. d'explication indirecte par approximation (on montre l'étoile Alcor en montrant d'abord la Grande Ourse, puis Mizar).<br> <a href="#entry-arundhatii" class="skt-link">arundhatī</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aruntuda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aruṃtuda</i> [<a href="#entry-tuda" class="skt-link">tuda</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aru_mtuda" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aru_mtuda" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aru_mtudaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aruṃtudā</i> qui blesse.<br> <a href="#entry-arus" class="skt-link">arus</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arus">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरुस्</span> <i>arus</i> a. <a href="#entry-arus" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arus" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arus" class="skt-link">f.</a> blessé — <a href="#entry-arus" class="skt-link">n.</a> cicatrice, blessure.<br> <i>arūkṛ</i> blesser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aruupa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अरूप</span> <i>arūpa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-ruupa" class="skt-link">rūpa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aruupa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aruupa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aruupaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arūpā</i> sans forme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> informe; difforme — <a href="#entry-aruupa" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. émancipation; syn. <a href="#entry-nirvaa_na" class="skt-link">nirvāṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्व</span> <i>arva</i> iic. prêt, proche.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arvaac">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्वाच्</span> <i>arvāc</i> var. <i>arvāñc</i> [<a href="#entry-arva" class="skt-link">arva</a>-<a href="#entry-ac" class="skt-link">ac</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arvaac" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arvaac" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arvaacii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arvācī</i> tourné de ce côté; tourné vers le bas.<br> <i>arvāk</i> adv. à côté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arvaaciina">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्वाचीन</span> <i>arvācīna</i> [<a href="#entry-arvaac" class="skt-link">arvāc</a><a href="#entry--iina" class="skt-link">-īna</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arvaaciina" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arvaaciina" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arvaaciinaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arvācīnā</i> tourné vers; qui préfère <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> récent.<br> <i>arvācinam</i> adv. de ce côté de ⟨abl.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> en avant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arvaacin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्वाचिन्</span> <i>arvācin</i> [<a href="#entry-arvaac" class="skt-link">arvāc</a><a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arvaacin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arvaacin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arvaacinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arvācinī</i> tourné vers.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arvaak">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्वाक्</span> <i>arvāk</i> [nom. <a href="#entry-arvaac" class="skt-link">arvāc</a>] adv. par ici; de ce côté-ci; devant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> près de, à coté de ⟨loc.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à partir de ⟨abl.⟩.<br> <i>arvāk</i> <i>kṛ</i> mettre devant.<br> <i>arvāṅ</i> <i>nud</i> pousser vers l'avant, vers le bas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arvaakkaalika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arvākkālika</i> [<a href="#entry-kaalika" class="skt-link">kālika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arvaakkaalika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arvaakkaalika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arvaakkaalikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arvākkālikā</i> plus proche dans le temps; postérieur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arvaakkaalikataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>arvākkālikatā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-arvaakkaalikataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> postériorité.<br> <a href="#entry-arvaakkaalika" class="skt-link">arvākkālika</a> <br> <a href="#entry-arvaak" class="skt-link">arvāk</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arvat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्वत्</span> <i>arvat</i> [<a href="#entry-ara" class="skt-link">ara</a><a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arvat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arvat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arvatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arvatī</i> rapide, véloce — <a href="#entry-arvat" class="skt-link">m.</a> cheval; coursier — <a href="#entry-arvan" class="skt-link">m.</a> <i>arvan</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्य</span> <i>arya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-_r" class="skt-link">ṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aryaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aryā</i> [«qui sert avec zèle»] dévoué, fidèle, loyal; favorable, attentionné — <a href="#entry-arya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <i>arya</i> noble, maître <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. homme de la 3⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ caste [<a href="#entry-var_na" class="skt-link">varṇa</a>]; syn. <a href="#entry-vaizya" class="skt-link">vaiśya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aryaman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्यमन्</span> <i>aryaman</i> [<a href="#entry-arya" class="skt-link">arya</a><a href="#entry--man" class="skt-link">-man</a>] <a href="#entry-aryaman" class="skt-link">m.</a> proche, intime; garçon d'honneur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. véd. np. d'Aryamā «Parrain», radieux [<a href="#entry-aaditya" class="skt-link">āditya</a>] mineur, adjoint de <a href="#entry-Umitra" class="skt-link">Mitra</a>, garant de l'ordre de la société <a href="#entry-aarya" class="skt-link">ārya</a>, patron du mariage; il garde notamment l'exogamie: il faut se marier hors de son clan [<a href="#entry-gotra" class="skt-link">gotra</a>]; il préside les mânes [<a href="#entry-pitaras" class="skt-link">pitaras</a>] et protège les chemins; il symbolise l'hospitalité, et est le dieu des Coutumes; astr. il régit le <a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a> <a href="#entry-Uuttaraphalgunii" class="skt-link">Uttaraphalgunī</a> (β du Lion).<br> <i>aryamṇaḥ</i> <i>panthās</i> [<a href="#entry-pathin" class="skt-link">pathin</a>] la Voie Lactée [«chemin d'<a href="#entry-Uaryamaa" class="skt-link">Aryamā</a>»].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arzas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्शस्</span> <i>arśas</i> <a href="#entry-arzas" class="skt-link">n.</a> hémorrhoïdes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-arzasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अर्शस</span> <i>arśasa</i> [<a href="#entry-arzas" class="skt-link">arśas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-arzasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-arzasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-arzasaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>arśasā</i> souffrant d'hémorrhoïdes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-as_rj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असृज्</span> <i>asṛj</i> <a href="#entry-as_rj" class="skt-link">n.</a> sang.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-as_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">अस्</span> <i>as_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(asti)</i> pft. <i>(āsa)</i> impft. <i>(āsīt)</i> opt. <i>(syāt)</i> imp. <i>(edhi)</i> ppr. <i>(sat)</i> être, exister; être présent; devenir; avoir lieu, habiter <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> échoir à, appartenir à qqn. ⟨g.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>est</i>; ang. is; all. ist; fr. être.<br> <i>asmi</i> je suis.<br> <i>asti</i> adv. il y a; qu'il en soit ainsi.<br> <i>asti</i> <i>mama</i> j'ai.<br> <i>...</i> <i>asti</i> salut à ...<br> <i>astu</i> [imp.] soit! d'accord!<br> <i>evam</i> <i>astu</i> ainsi soit il; bien.<br> <i>evam</i> <i>syāt</i> il se pourrait.<br> <i>āsa</i> il advint que.<br> <i>āsīt</i> adv. il était une fois.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-as_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">अस्</span> <i>as_2</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(asyati)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(asati)</i> pft. <i>(āsa)</i> impft. <i>(āsyat)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>asta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ati</i>, <i>adhi</i>, <i>abhi</i>, <i>ut</i>, <i>ni</i>, <i>nis</i>, <i>pari</i>, <i>pra</i>, <i>vi</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> jeter, lancer; brandir (une arme) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rejeter, repousser — ps. <i>(asyate)</i> être lancé; être rejeté — ca. <i>(āsayati)</i> faire lancer; faire jeter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asa_mhata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असंहत</span> <i>asaṃhata</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-sa_mhata" class="skt-link">saṃhata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asa_mhata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asa_mhata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asa_mhataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asaṃhatā</i> isolé, dispersé; désuni, en désaccord.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asa_mhraadayat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असंह्रादयत्</span> <i>asaṃhrādayat</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-sa_mhraadayat" class="skt-link">saṃhrādayat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asa_mhraadayat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asa_mhraadayat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asa_mhraadayatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asaṃhrādayatī</i> qui ne fait pas cliqueter.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asa_msk_rta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असंस्कृत</span> <i>asaṃskṛta</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-sa_msk_rta" class="skt-link">saṃskṛta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asa_msk_rta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asa_msk_rta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asa_msk_rtaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asaṃskṛtā</i> non préparé, non décoré; non consacré; brut <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> non raffiné, grossier (langage).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asa_myuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असंयुत</span> <i>asaṃyuta</i> var. <i>asaṃyutta</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-sa_myuta" class="skt-link">saṃyuta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asa_myuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asa_myuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asa_myutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asaṃyutā</i> non joint, séparé.<br> <i>asaṃyutta</i> <i>hastau</i> mains non jointes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asa_mzakti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असंशक्ति</span> <i>asaṃśakti</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-sa_mzakti" class="skt-link">saṃśakti</a>] <a href="#entry-asa_mzakti" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. [YV.] l'indifférence aux pouvoirs surnaturels, 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ niveau de connaissance [<a href="#entry-j_naanabhuumikaa" class="skt-link">jñānabhūmikā</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asa_mzaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असंशय</span> <i>asaṃśaya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-sa_mzaya" class="skt-link">saṃśaya</a>] <a href="#entry-asa_mzaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> absence de doute; certitude.<br> <i>asaṃśayam</i> adv. sans aucun doute.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asaadhaara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असाधारण</span> <i>asādhāraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-saadhaara_na" class="skt-link">sādhāraṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asaadhaara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asaadhaara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asaadhaara_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asādhāraṇā</i> seul en son genre, unique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asaadhu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असाधु</span> <i>asādhu</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-saadhu" class="skt-link">sādhu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asaadhu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asaadhu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asaadhu" class="skt-link">f.</a> mauvais; méchant; faux — <a href="#entry-asaadhu" class="skt-link">m.</a> mauvais homme — <a href="#entry-asaadhu" class="skt-link">n.</a> mal; malheur; faute — interj. (désapprobation) malheur! honte!.<br> <i>asādhunā</i> défavorablement.<br> <i>sādhvasādhunī</i> le bien et le mal.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asaadhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असाध्य</span> <i>asādhya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-saadhya" class="skt-link">sādhya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asaadhya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asaadhya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asaadhyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asādhyā</i> impossible, irréalisable, dont on ne peut venir à bout.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asaaphalya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असाफल्य</span> <i>asāphalya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-saaphalya" class="skt-link">sāphalya</a>] <a href="#entry-asaaphalya" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. échec; objection.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असार</span> <i>asāra</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-saara" class="skt-link">sāra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asaara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asaaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asārā</i> sans substance, sans vigueur, sans valeur; inutile, inadéquat — <a href="#entry-asaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> inutilité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asaarataa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>asāratā</i> [<a href="#entry--taa" class="skt-link">-tā</a>] <a href="#entry-asaarataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> faiblesse; inutilité; inadéquation.<br> <a href="#entry-asaara" class="skt-link">asāra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asabhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असभ्य</span> <i>asabhya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-sabhya" class="skt-link">sabhya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asabhya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asabhya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asabhyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asabhyā</i> impropre, malpoli, vulgaire; not. langage vulgaire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asacchuudra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असच्छूद्र</span> <i>asacchūdra</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-sacchuudra" class="skt-link">sacchūdra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asacchuudra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asacchuudra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asacchuudraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asacchūdrā</i> soc. <a href="#entry-zuudra" class="skt-link">śūdra</a> de mauvaise conduite.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asadhaara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असधारण</span> <i>asadhāraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-sadhaara_na" class="skt-link">sadhāraṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asadhaara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asadhaara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asadhaara_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asadhāraṇī</i> spécial, particulier, spécifique <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rare, extraordinaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] caractérise la perception [<a href="#entry-pratyak_sa" class="skt-link">pratyakṣa</a>] spécifique; on en dénombre 3 sortes: <a href="#entry-saamaanyalak_sa_na" class="skt-link">sāmānyalakṣaṇa</a> qui utilise l'analogie, et reconnaît un type universel par son signe, <a href="#entry-j_naanalak_sa_na" class="skt-link">jñānalakṣaṇa</a> qui fait appel aux connaissances, not. au sens commun ou à la mémoire, et <a href="#entry-yogaja" class="skt-link">yogaja</a>, perception obtenue par le <a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a> — <a href="#entry-asadhaara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> propriété spécifique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asadvaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>asadvāda</i> [<a href="#entry-vaada" class="skt-link">vāda</a>] <a href="#entry-asadvaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> doctrine hétérodoxe; discours trompeur.<br> <a href="#entry-asat" class="skt-link">asat</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asafga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असङ्ग</span> <i>asaṅga</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-safga" class="skt-link">saṅga</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asafga" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asafgaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asaṅgā</i> détaché, libre; indépendant; qui se meut sans obstacle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> détaché du monde, indifférent, libéré — <a href="#entry-asafga" class="skt-link">m.</a> absence d'attachement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. d'Asaṅga «Libéré», frère de <a href="#entry-Uvasubandhu" class="skt-link">Vasubandhu</a>, philosophe bouddhiste du 5⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle de doctrine idéaliste [<a href="#entry-vij_naanavaada" class="skt-link">vijñānavāda</a>]; ont lui doit not. l'<a href="#entry-Uabhidharmasamuccaya" class="skt-link">Abhidharmasamuccaya</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asafgata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असंगत</span> <i>asaṃgata</i> var. <i>asaṅgata</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-safgata" class="skt-link">saṃgata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asa_mgata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asa_mgata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asa_mgataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asaṃgatā</i> non conforme, inconvenant; malvenu, déplacé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asafkhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असंख्य</span> <i>asaṃkhya</i> var. <i>asaṅkhya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-safkhya" class="skt-link">saṃkhya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asa_mkhya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asa_mkhya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asa_mkhyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asaṃkhyā</i> innombrable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asafkhyeya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असंख्येय</span> <i>asaṃkhyeya</i> var. <i>asaṅkhyeya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-safkhyeya" class="skt-link">saṃkhyeya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asa_mkhyeya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asa_mkhyeya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asa_mkhyeyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asaṃkhyeyā</i> innombrable — <a href="#entry-asa_mkhyeya" class="skt-link">n.</a> multitude; nombre incommensurable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असह</span> <i>asaha</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-saha_1" class="skt-link">saha_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asaha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asahaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asahā</i> impatient; qui ne supporte pas, qui n'endure pas <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> incapable de ⟨inf.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asak_rt">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असकृत्</span> <i>asakṛt</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-sak_rt" class="skt-link">sakṛt</a>] adv. répétitivement; souvent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> math. par un procédé itératif, par récurrence.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asakta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असक्त</span> <i>asakta</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-sakta" class="skt-link">sakta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asakta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asakta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asaktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asaktā</i> non arrêté, non empêché <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> libre, indépendant <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. détaché du monde et des passions.<br> <i>asaktam</i> adv. sans obstacle; sans résistance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> avec désintéressement.<br> <i>tasmād</i> <i>asaktaḥ</i> <i>satataṃ</i> <i>kāryaṃ</i> <i>karma</i> <i>samācara</i> [BhG.] Ainsi, désintéressé, accomplis toujours l'action nécessaire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asakti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असक्ति</span> <i>asakti</i> [<a href="#entry-asakta" class="skt-link">asakta</a>] <a href="#entry-asakti" class="skt-link">f.</a> détachement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. détachement du monde et des passions.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असम</span> <i>asama</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-sama" class="skt-link">sama</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asama" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asama" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asamaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asamā</i> inégal.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asamartha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असमर्थ</span> <i>asamartha</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-samartha" class="skt-link">samartha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asamartha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asamartha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asamarthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asamarthā</i> impropre; inutile; incapable (de ⟨inf. dat. loc.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. (mot composé) ne formant pas un constituant syntaxique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asamavaayi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असमवायि</span> <i>asamavāyi</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-asamavaayin" class="skt-link">asamavāyin</a>.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

[<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] non inhérent, non intrinsèque; contingent, accidentel.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asama_njasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असमञ्जस</span> <i>asamañjasa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-sama_njasa" class="skt-link">samañjasa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asama_njasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asama_njasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asama_njasaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asamañjasā</i> inapproprié, malvenu; incapable — <a href="#entry-asama_njasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> bon à rien — <a href="#entry-asama_njasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> impropriété, non conformité; inopportunité — <a href="#entry-asama_njas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <i>asamañjas</i> var. <i>asamañja</i> myth. np. d'Asamañjā ou Asamañja «Impie», fils du roi <a href="#entry-Usagara" class="skt-link">Sagara</a> par <a href="#entry-Ukezinii_1" class="skt-link">Keśinī_1</a>; il était pervers, s'amusant à noyer les enfants dans la <a href="#entry-Usarayuu" class="skt-link">Sarayū</a>, et fut renié par son père; son fils <a href="#entry-Ua_mzumaan" class="skt-link">Aṃśumān</a> était juste et bon.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asambaddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असंबद्ध</span> <i>asaṃbaddha</i> var. <i>asambaddha</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-sambaddha" class="skt-link">saṃbaddha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asa_mbaddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asa_mbaddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asa_mbaddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asaṃbaddhā</i> détaché, déconnecté; dissocié <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> incohérent.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असंबन्ध</span> <i>asaṃbandha</i> var. <i>asambandha</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-sambandha" class="skt-link">saṃbandha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asa_mbandha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asa_mbandha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asa_mbandhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asaṃbandhā</i> sans lien de parenté; sans relation.
  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">

</div>

  </div>
</div>

  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असंभूति</span> <i>asaṃbhūti</i> var. <i>asambhūti</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-sambhuuti" class="skt-link">saṃbhūti</a>] <a href="#entry-asa_mbhuuti" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. le Non-manifesté.

[<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] qualifie l'état où le <a href="#entry-yogin" class="skt-link">yogin</a>, par l'arrêt de la pensée, a perdu la conscience du monde; cf. <a href="#entry-cittav_rttinirodha" class="skt-link">cittavṛttinirodha</a>.
  </div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असन</span> <i>asana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-as_2" class="skt-link">as_2</a>] <a href="#entry-asana" class="skt-link">n.</a> qui sert à lancer; fait de lancer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> natu. bot. <i>Pterocarpus marsupium</i>, arbre <i>kino</i>, aux fleurs papillionacées jaunes; utilisé médicalement, not. sa résine; syn. <a href="#entry-biijaka" class="skt-link">bījaka</a> — <a href="#entry-asanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asanā</i> véd. missile; flèche.

</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asapi_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asaruupa">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asat">

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

[<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] doctrine réfutant la nécessaire pré-existence d'un effet dans sa cause; opp. <a href="#entry-satkaaryavaada" class="skt-link">satkāryavāda</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-asatkaarya" class="skt-link">asatkārya</a>
  </div>

    <i>asatkhyāti</i> [<a href="#entry-khyaati" class="skt-link">khyāti</a>] <a href="#entry-asatkhyaati" class="skt-link">f.</a> bd. théorie de la perception de l'irréel.

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asatkhyaativaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asatya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असत्य</span> <i>asatya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-satya" class="skt-link">satya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asatya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asatya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asatyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asatyā</i> faux, trompeur — <a href="#entry-asatya" class="skt-link">n.</a> fausseté; tromperie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asatyasandha">

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asau">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असौ</span> <i>asau</i> pn. dém. <a href="#entry-asau" class="skt-link">m.</a> ce, cet, celui-là, celle-là, ces-là (au loin) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> tel; untel — <a href="#entry-asau" class="skt-link">f.</a> cette, celle-là, celles-là — n. cf. <a href="#entry-adas" class="skt-link">adas</a>.<br> <i>asāv</i> <i>amutra</i> <i>ayam</i> <i>asmin</i> Celui-là dans ce monde là, celui-ci dans ce monde ci.

</div>

  </div>
</div>

(règle) non appliquée dans le contexte courant.

</div>

(règle) dont on ignore l'application dans le contexte courant.<br> <a href="#entry-asiddha" class="skt-link">asiddha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asiddhi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asidhaaraa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asidhaaraavrata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>asidhārāvrata</i> [<a href="#entry-vrata" class="skt-link">vrata</a>] <a href="#entry-asidhaaraavrata" class="skt-link">n.</a> vœu très difficile; not. pour un <a href="#entry-brahmacaarin" class="skt-link">brahmacārin</a>, de passer la nuit dans le lit d'une jolie femme sans éprouver de désir.<br> <a href="#entry-asidhaaraa" class="skt-link">asidhārā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asidhenu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>asidhenu</i> [<a href="#entry-dhenu" class="skt-link">dhenu</a>] <a href="#entry-asidhenu" class="skt-link">f.</a> [«ce qui est à l'épée ce que le veau est à la vache»] dague.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asikalaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>asikalaha</i> [<a href="#entry-kalaha" class="skt-link">kalaha</a>] <a href="#entry-asikalaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> combat à l'épée.

</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असित</span> <i>asita</i> a. <a href="#entry-asita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asiknii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asiknī</i> noir, sombre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. du roi d'<a href="#entry-Uayodhyaa" class="skt-link">Ayodhyā</a> Asita «le Sombre», fils de <a href="#entry-Ubharata_4" class="skt-link">Bharata_4</a>, père de <a href="#entry-Usagara" class="skt-link">Sagara</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. np. d'Asita_1, ermite qui reconnut le nouveau-né <a href="#entry-Usiddhaartha" class="skt-link">Siddhārtha</a> comme le futur <a href="#entry-Ubuddha" class="skt-link">Buddha</a>; il pleura, triste de devoir mourir avant que de pouvoir connaître son enseignement — <a href="#entry-asiknii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asiknī</i> nuit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. d'Asiknī «Nuit», fille de l'<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a> <a href="#entry-Upa_ncajana" class="skt-link">Pañcajana</a>, épouse de <a href="#entry-Udak_sa" class="skt-link">Dakṣa</a>, et mère de <a href="#entry-Usatii" class="skt-link">Satī</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. de la rivière Asiknī_1 «aux eaux sombres», tributaire de l'Indus (mod. Chenab); Alexandre la franchit difficilement (Akesines).
  </div>
</div>

[<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] pure expérience du soi.

  </div>
</div>

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asuniiti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>asunīti</i> [<a href="#entry-niiti" class="skt-link">nīti</a>] <a href="#entry-asuniiti" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. conduite de vie dans l'au-delà <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. le monde des esprits; sa personnification Asunīti «Celle qui conduit les esprits».<br> <a href="#entry-asu" class="skt-link">asu</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asunva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असुन्व</span> <i>asunva</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-sunva" class="skt-link">sunva</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asunva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asunva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asunvaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asunvā</i> véd. [«qui ne presse pas (le <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a>)»] indifférent aux dieux, athée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असुर</span> <i>asura</i> [<a href="#entry-asu" class="skt-link">asu</a><a href="#entry--ra" class="skt-link">-ra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asurii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asurī</i> immatériel, surnaturel — <a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">m.</a> véd. [«maître du souffle vital»] un titan-<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a>, être surnaturel précédant l'organisation du cosmos <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>asurās</i> myth. les titans; parmi eux les radieux [<a href="#entry-aaditya" class="skt-link">āditya</a>], notamment <a href="#entry-Uvaru_na" class="skt-link">Varuṇa</a> et <a href="#entry-Umitra" class="skt-link">Mitra</a>, se rangèrent parmi les dieux; les autres devinrent des êtres néfastes, ennemis des êtres de lumière [<a href="#entry-sura" class="skt-link">sura</a>]; ils disputèrent en vain aux dieux [<a href="#entry-deva" class="skt-link">deva</a>] l'élixir d'immortalité [<a href="#entry-am_rta" class="skt-link">amṛta</a>] lors du barratage de l'océan de lait primordial [<a href="#entry-k_siirodamathana" class="skt-link">kṣīrodamathana</a>]; leur précepteur est <a href="#entry-Uuzanaa" class="skt-link">Uśanā</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-daitya" class="skt-link">daitya</a>, <a href="#entry-daanava" class="skt-link">dānava</a>, <a href="#entry-Unaraka" class="skt-link">Naraka</a> — <a href="#entry-asurii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asurī</i> myth. démon femelle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> avestique ahura; lex. a-sura.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asuravivaaha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>asuravivāha</i> [<a href="#entry-vivaaha" class="skt-link">vivāha</a>] <a href="#entry-asuravivaaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. mode de mariage par achat de la mariée.<br> <a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asurya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असुर्य</span> <i>asurya</i> [<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asurya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asurya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asuryaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asuryā</i> immatériel; divin <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> relatif aux <a href="#entry-asuraas" class="skt-link">asurās</a> — <a href="#entry-asurya" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. spiritualité; nature divine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asut_rp">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>asutṛp</i> [<a href="#entry-t_rp_2" class="skt-link">tṛp_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asut_rp" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asut_rp" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asut_rp" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui dérobe ou profite de la vie d'un autre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> épicurien, voué aux joies du monde.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asut_rp_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असुतृप्</span> <i>asutṛp_2</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-sut_rp" class="skt-link">sutṛp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asut_rp_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asut_rp_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asut_rp_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> insatiable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asut_rpa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>asutṛpa</i> a. <a href="#entry-asut_rpa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asut_rpa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asut_rpaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asutṛpā</i> id.<br> <a href="#entry-asut_rp" class="skt-link">asutṛp</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asutyaaga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>asutyāga</i> [<a href="#entry-tyaaga" class="skt-link">tyāga</a>] <a href="#entry-asutyaaga" class="skt-link">m.</a> suicide.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asuurya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असूर्य</span> <i>asūrya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-suurya" class="skt-link">sūrya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asuurya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asuurya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asuuryaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asūryā</i> à l'ombre, dans l'obscurité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> démoniaque, impie; maléfique.<br> <i>asūryaṃpaśya</i> a. m. n. [«qui ne voit pas la lumière du jour»] se dit des femmes d'un harem.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asuuya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">असूय</span> <i>asūya</i> [<a href="#entry-asu" class="skt-link">asu</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asuuya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asuuya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asuuyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asūyā</i> [«qui en veut à la vie»] envieux, malveillant — <a href="#entry-asuuyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asūyā</i> envie, malveillance; jalousie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> impatience; mécontentement, indignation; fait de détracter — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(asūyati)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. md. <i>(asūyate)</i> être impatient; être mécontent; être jaloux; envier ⟨dat.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> en vouloir à ⟨acc.⟩; s'irriter de ⟨acc. g.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asvapat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अस्वपत्</span> <i>asvapat</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-svapat" class="skt-link">svapat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asvapat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asvapat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asvapat" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui ne dort pas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asvastha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अस्वस्थ</span> <i>asvastha</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-svastha" class="skt-link">svastha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asvastha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asvastha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asvasthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asvasthā</i> malsain, malade; mal à l'aise <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> dépendant; qui ne se contrôle pas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asveda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अस्वेद</span> <i>asveda</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-sveda" class="skt-link">sveda</a>] a. <a href="#entry-asveda" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-asveda" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-asvedaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>asvedā</i> sans sueur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अस्य</span> <i>asya</i> [g. <a href="#entry-ayam" class="skt-link">ayam</a>] ind. de ce.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asyaam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अस्याम्</span> <i>asyām</i> [loc. <a href="#entry-iyam" class="skt-link">iyam</a>] ind. dans cette.<br> <i>asyām</i> <i>rātryām</i> adv. cette nuit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asyaas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अस्यास्</span> <i>asyās</i> [abl. <a href="#entry-iyam" class="skt-link">iyam</a>] ind. de cette — g. id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-asyai">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अस्यै</span> <i>asyai</i> [dat. <a href="#entry-iyam" class="skt-link">iyam</a>] ind. à cette.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-at">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">अत्</span> <i>at</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-a_t" class="skt-link">aṭ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(atati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>atita</i><i>)</i> véd. aller, courir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-at_rpta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अतृप्त</span> <i>atṛpta</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-t_rpta" class="skt-link">tṛpta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-at_rpta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-at_rpta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-at_rptaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>atṛptā</i> insatisfait, non rassasié; insatiable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-at_rpti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अतृप्ति</span> <i>atṛpti</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-t_rpti" class="skt-link">tṛpti</a>] <a href="#entry-at_rpti" class="skt-link">f.</a> insatisfaction; insatiabilité, boulimie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-atadruupa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अतद्रूप</span> <i>atadrūpa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-tadruupa" class="skt-link">tadrūpa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-atadruupa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-atadruupa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-atadruupaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>atadrūpā</i> de forme différente.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-atala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अतल</span> <i>atala</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-tala" class="skt-link">tala</a>] a. <a href="#entry-atala" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-atala" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-atalaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>atalā</i> sans fond — <a href="#entry-atala" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. np. du monde [<a href="#entry-loka" class="skt-link">loka</a>] Atala, premier enfer souterrain.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-atandra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अतन्द्र</span> <i>atandra</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-tandraa" class="skt-link">tandrā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-atandra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-atandra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-atandraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>atandrā</i> alerte; reposé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-atandrin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>atandrin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-atandrin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-atandrin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-atandrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>atandrī</i> alerte; reposé.<br> <a href="#entry-atandra" class="skt-link">atandra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-atandrita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अतन्द्रित</span> <i>atandrita</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-tandrita" class="skt-link">tandrita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-atandrita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-atandrita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-atandritaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>atandritā</i> alerte; reposé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-atanu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अतनु</span> <i>atanu</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-tanu_1" class="skt-link">tanu_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-atanu" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-atanu" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-atanvii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>atanvī</i> important, significatif.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-atas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अतस्</span> <i>atas</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-ayam" class="skt-link">ayam</a>] adv. (substitut de l'abl. de <a href="#entry-ayam" class="skt-link">ayam</a>) d'ici; de là <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> à partir de cet endroit; dès ce moment, alors <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pour cela; c'est pourquoi, donc, en conséquence.<br> <i>ata_eva</i> adv. pour cela même; c'est pourquoi.<br> <i>ata_ūrdhvam</i> adv. à partir de là; ensuite.<br> <i>ataḥ</i> <i>param</i> adv. au delà.<br> <i>ato</i> <i>'nya</i> autre que cela.<br> <i>ato</i> <i>nimittam</i> adv. à cause de cela.<br> <i>ato</i> <i>'rtham</i> adv. pour cet objet, à cette fin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-atasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अतस</span> <i>atasa</i> [<a href="#entry-at" class="skt-link">at</a>] <a href="#entry-atasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> vent, air — <a href="#entry-atasii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>atasī</i> natu. bot. <i>Linum usitatissimum</i>, lin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-atha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अथ</span> <i>atha</i> conj. d'abord, et maintenant, ensuite; même; mais, par contre; alors, si <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> et encore, et alors (annonce le début d'un chapitre ou d'une prière).<br> <i>atho</i> [<a href="#entry-u" class="skt-link">u</a>] adv. (<a href="#entry-prag_rhya" class="skt-link">pragṛhya</a>) et ensuite; et aussi.<br> <i>athavā</i> adv. ou aussi, alternativement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ou plutôt, mais; de plus, car.<br> <i>athāpi</i> [<a href="#entry-api" class="skt-link">api</a>] adv. qui plus est; de plus; ainsi.<br> <i>atha</i> <i>kim</i> adv. oui; certainement (comment en serait-il autrement?); et alors?.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-athaatas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>athātas</i> [<a href="#entry-atas" class="skt-link">atas</a>] adv. à partir d'ici; maintenant.<br> <a href="#entry-atha" class="skt-link">atha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-atharva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अथर्व</span> <i>atharva</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-atharvan" class="skt-link">atharvan</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-atharvan">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अथर्वन्</span> <i>atharvan</i> <a href="#entry-atharvan" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. d'Atharvā, premier géniteur [<a href="#entry-prajaapati" class="skt-link">prajāpati</a>] issu de l'esprit de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a>, prêtre fondateur du sacrifice; il est aussi appelé <a href="#entry-Uafgiraa" class="skt-link">Aṅgirā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>atharvāṇas</i> soc. famille de brâhmanes védiques, descendants d'<a href="#entry-Uatharvaa" class="skt-link">Atharvā</a>, gardiens de l'<a href="#entry-Uatharvaveda" class="skt-link">Atharvaveda</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. les hymnes de l'<a href="#entry-Uatharvaveda" class="skt-link">Atharvaveda</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-atharvaveda">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>atharvaveda</i> [<a href="#entry-veda" class="skt-link">veda</a>] <a href="#entry-atharvaveda" class="skt-link">m.</a> l'Atharvaveda, le quatrième <a href="#entry-Uveda" class="skt-link">Veda</a>, qui comprend 731 hymnes; il se compose d'incantations, de chants, de charmes magiques et de prières; il est connu par deux recensions, dites <a href="#entry-zaunaka" class="skt-link">śaunaka</a> et <a href="#entry-paippalaada" class="skt-link">paippalāda</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-afgirasas" class="skt-link">aṅgirasas</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-atharvaziras">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>atharvaśiras</i> [<a href="#entry-ziras" class="skt-link">śiras</a>] <a href="#entry-atharvaziras" class="skt-link">n.</a> lit. np. de la leçon [<a href="#entry-upani_sad" class="skt-link">upaniṣad</a>] Atharvaśiras; elle décrit not. les observances de la doctrine <a href="#entry-paazupata" class="skt-link">pāśupata</a> [<a href="#entry-paazupatavrata" class="skt-link">pāśupatavrata</a>]; aussi appelée Atharvaśikhā ou Atharvaśīrṣa; des versions tardives existent, dédiées aux 5 dieux du <a href="#entry-pa_ncaayatana" class="skt-link">pañcāyatana</a>, not. le Gaṇapatyatharvaśīrṣa.<br> <a href="#entry-atharva" class="skt-link">atharva</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अति</span> <i>ati</i> pf. sur, au-delà — prép. très, trop — adv. en excès, en grande proportion <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> ne convenant pas à ce moment <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. ετι; lat. <i>et</i>.<br> <i>atikambalam</i> [<a href="#entry-kambala" class="skt-link">kambala</a>] adv. après la période où l'on porte un manteau.<br> <i>ati</i> <i>siktaṃ</i> <i>tvayā</i> tu as trop arrosé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ati_s_that">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. de l'ogre [<a href="#entry-raak_sasa" class="skt-link">rākṣasa</a>] Atikāya «au Corps immense», fils de <a href="#entry-Uraava_na" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇa</a> et <a href="#entry-Umandodarii" class="skt-link">Mandodarī</a>, renaissance de <a href="#entry-Ukai_tabha" class="skt-link">Kaiṭabha</a>; il obtint trois vœux de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> à la suite d'une grande ascèse: l'arme <a href="#entry-brahmaastra" class="skt-link">brahmāstra</a>, une cuirasse de diamants merveilleuse et le pouvoir de n'être dérangé par aucun désir importun; de taille gigantesque, il conduisait un char de mille chevaux; il fut tué en combat singulier par <a href="#entry-Ulak_sma_na" class="skt-link">Lakṣmaṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ativistara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अतिविस्तर</span> <i>ativistara</i> [<a href="#entry-ati" class="skt-link">ati</a>-<a href="#entry-vistara" class="skt-link">vistara</a>] <a href="#entry-ativistara" class="skt-link">m.</a> développement excessif, excès de détails.<br> <i>alam</i> <i>ativistareṇa</i> trève de longueurs; assez de détails oiseux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ativyaapti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

[<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] inadéquation de la description d'un concept par généralité excessive, l'une des 3 fautes [<a href="#entry-do_sa" class="skt-link">doṣa</a>] d'une définition, avec l'incomplétude [<a href="#entry-avyaapti" class="skt-link">avyāpti</a>] et l'inapplicabilité [<a href="#entry-asambhava" class="skt-link">asambhava</a>].
  </div>
</div>

[<a href="#entry-paazupata" class="skt-link">pāśupata</a>] sacrifice transcendantal.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-atiyogayaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>atiyogayāna</i> [<a href="#entry-yaana" class="skt-link">yāna</a>] <a href="#entry-atiyogayaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> bd. discipline du <a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a> suprême, dernière étape du Vajrayāna; elle correspond au <i>dzogchen</i> de l'ordre tibétain Nyingma.<br> <a href="#entry-atiyoga" class="skt-link">atiyoga</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-atizaya">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-atra_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

Monsieur (ici-présent, forme polie de il) — <a href="#entry-atrabhavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>atrabhavatī</i> Madame.<br> <a href="#entry-atra_1" class="skt-link">atra_1</a>

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-atri">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अत्रि</span> <i>atri</i> [relié à <a href="#entry-atti" class="skt-link">atti</a>] <a href="#entry-atri" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. du sage Atri «Dévoreur», fils de l'esprit de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> [<a href="#entry-maanasaputra" class="skt-link">mānasaputra</a>], patriache [<a href="#entry-saptar_si" class="skt-link">saptarṣi</a>] et géniteur [<a href="#entry-prajaapati" class="skt-link">prajāpati</a>]; son épouse est <a href="#entry-Uanasuuyaa" class="skt-link">Anasūyā</a>; faisant de dures austérités, les larmes lui vinrent aux yeux, dont l'éclat remplit l'univers et donna naissance à <a href="#entry-Ucandra" class="skt-link">Candra</a>; il est associé à l'étoile Megrez de la Grande Ourse; <a href="#entry-Uanasuuyaa" class="skt-link">Anasūyā</a> obtint que la <a href="#entry-trimuurti" class="skt-link">trimūrti</a> se réincarnât comme ses enfants <a href="#entry-Ucandra" class="skt-link">Candra</a>, <a href="#entry-Udattaatreya" class="skt-link">Dattātreya</a> et <a href="#entry-Udurvaasaa" class="skt-link">Durvāsā</a>; cf. <a href="#entry-Uugrazravaa" class="skt-link">Ugraśravā</a>; [RV.] il est père d'<a href="#entry-Uapaalaa" class="skt-link">Apālā</a>; [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] on le dit aussi père de <a href="#entry-Ubharadvaaja" class="skt-link">Bharadvāja</a>.
  </div>
</div>

[<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(avadhīrayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>avadhīrita</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>avadhīrya</i><i>)</i> traiter avec mépris; rejeter.
