    <i>avamanyaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avamanyaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avamanyaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avamanyakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avamanyakā</i> qui méprise ⟨g.⟩.<br> <a href="#entry-avamanya" class="skt-link">avamanya</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avamarza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवमर्श</span> <i>avamarśa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-avam_rz" class="skt-link">avamṛś</a>] <a href="#entry-avamarza" class="skt-link">m.</a> toucher; contact <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [<i>avamarśasandhi</i>] lit. [dramaturgie] coup de théâtre; c'est l'une des 5 articulations de récits dramatiques [<a href="#entry-pa_ncasandhi" class="skt-link">pañcasandhi</a>] — <a href="#entry-avamarzaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avamarśā</i> ifc. contact avec.<br> <i>avamarśam</i> afin de rentrer en contact.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avamatya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवमत्य</span> <i>avamatya</i> [abs. <a href="#entry-avaman" class="skt-link">avaman</a>] ind. ayant méprisé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avamih">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवमिह्</span> <i>avamih</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-mih" class="skt-link">mih</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(avamehati)</i> uriner sur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avamocana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवमोचन</span> <i>avamocana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-avamuc" class="skt-link">avamuc</a>] <a href="#entry-avamocana" class="skt-link">n.</a> relâchement; mise en liberté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [«où l'on dételle les chevaux»] halte, lieu de repos.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avamuc">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवमुच्</span> <i>avamuc</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-muc_1" class="skt-link">muc_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(avamuñcati)</i> relâcher; libérer; désarnacher.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avanaama">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवनाम</span> <i>avanāma</i> [act. <a href="#entry-avanam" class="skt-link">avanam</a>] <a href="#entry-avanaama" class="skt-link">m.</a> fait de s'incliner, révérence.<br> <i>avanāmībhū</i> se pencher, s'incliner.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avanam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवनम्</span> <i>avanam</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-nam" class="skt-link">nam</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(avanamati)</i> pr. md. <i>(avanamate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>avanata</i><i>)</i> courber, incliner, pencher <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'incliner, courber la tête — ca. <i>(avanāmayati)</i> incliner, courber.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avanata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवनत</span> <i>avanata</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-avanam" class="skt-link">avanam</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avanata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avanata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avanataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avanatā</i> courbé; creusé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bandé (arc).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avanatakaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>avanatakāya</i> [<a href="#entry-kaaya" class="skt-link">kāya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avanatakaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avanatakaaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avanatakaayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avanatakāyā</i> dont le corps est courbé.<br> <a href="#entry-avanata" class="skt-link">avanata</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avani">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवनि</span> <i>avani</i> <a href="#entry-avani" class="skt-link">f.</a> lit ou cours d'une rivière; cours d'eau; terrain.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avantaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>avantaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avantaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avantaka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avantikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avantikā</i> géo. qui habite le pays <a href="#entry-Uavanti" class="skt-link">Avanti</a> — <a href="#entry-avantaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> pl. <i>avantakās</i> soc. le peuple des Avantakās — <a href="#entry-avantikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avantikā</i> géo. np. de la ville sacrée d'Avantikā ou Avantikāpurī, ancien nom d'<a href="#entry-Uujjayinii" class="skt-link">Ujjayinī</a>; <a href="#entry-Ucandragupta_2" class="skt-link">Candragupta_2</a>-<a href="#entry-Uvikramaaditya" class="skt-link">Vikramāditya</a> en fit sa capitale au 4⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle; <a href="#entry-Ukaalidaasa" class="skt-link">Kālidāsa</a> y écrivit le <a href="#entry-Umeghaduuta" class="skt-link">Meghadūta</a>; <a href="#entry-Uvairisi_mha" class="skt-link">Vairisiṃha</a>-<a href="#entry-Uparamaara" class="skt-link">Paramāra</a> transféra la capitale du <a href="#entry-Umaalava" class="skt-link">Mālava</a> à <a href="#entry-Udhaaraa" class="skt-link">Dhārā</a> au 9⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. langue des <a href="#entry-Uavantakaas" class="skt-link">Avantakās</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avanti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवन्ति</span> <i>avanti</i> <a href="#entry-avanti" class="skt-link">m.</a> géo. np. du pays Avanti, aussi appelé <a href="#entry-Umaalava" class="skt-link">Mālava</a> (district d'<a href="#entry-Uujjayinii" class="skt-link">Ujjayinī</a>, au nord-ouest du Deccan) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. de la rivière d'<a href="#entry-Uavanti" class="skt-link">Avanti</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>avantayas</i> ses habitants, les Avantayas — <a href="#entry-avantii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avantī</i> femme du pays d'<a href="#entry-Uavanti" class="skt-link">Avanti</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. np. de la ville d'Avantī (mod. <a href="#entry-Uujjayinii" class="skt-link">Ujjayinī</a>); cf. <a href="#entry-Uavantikaa" class="skt-link">Avantikā</a>, <a href="#entry-Upu_spakara_n_dinii" class="skt-link">Puṣpakaraṇḍinī</a>, <a href="#entry-Uindradyumna" class="skt-link">Indradyumna</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avantipura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>avantipura</i> [<a href="#entry-pura" class="skt-link">pura</a>] <a href="#entry-avantipura" class="skt-link">n.</a> géo. np. d'Avantipura, ville du <a href="#entry-Ukazmiira" class="skt-link">Kaśmīra</a> fondée par le roi <a href="#entry-Uavantivarmaa" class="skt-link">Avantivarmā</a> sur les rives de la Vitastā (mod. Jhelum), à 17 km en amont de <a href="#entry-Uzriinagara" class="skt-link">Śrīnagara</a> — <a href="#entry-avantipurii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avantipurī</i> cf. <a href="#entry-Uavantikaa" class="skt-link">Avantikā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avantivardhana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>avantivardhana</i> [<a href="#entry-vardhana" class="skt-link">vardhana</a>] <a href="#entry-avantivardhana" class="skt-link">m.</a> lit. [<a href="#entry-Ub_rhatkathaa" class="skt-link">Bṛhatkathā</a>] np. du prince Avantivardana, fils de <a href="#entry-Ugopaala_3" class="skt-link">Gopāla_3</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avantivarman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>avantivarman</i> [<a href="#entry-varman" class="skt-link">varman</a>] <a href="#entry-avantivarman" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. du roi Avantivarmā, qui créa la dynastie <a href="#entry-Uutpala" class="skt-link">Utpala</a> au <a href="#entry-Ukazmiira" class="skt-link">Kaśmīra</a>; il régna de 855 à 883; il fonda la ville d'<a href="#entry-Uavantipura" class="skt-link">Avantipura</a>, où il fit construire le temple de <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>-<a href="#entry-Uanantezvara" class="skt-link">Ananteśvara</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-avanti" class="skt-link">avanti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avapaa_tikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवपाटिका</span> <i>avapāṭikā</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-paa_tikaa" class="skt-link">pāṭikā</a>] <a href="#entry-avapaa_tikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> circoncision <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> <i>vapāṭikā</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avapaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवपान</span> <i>avapāna</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-paana" class="skt-link">pāna</a>] <a href="#entry-avapaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de boire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> abreuvoir; mare.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avapaata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवपात</span> <i>avapāta</i> [act. <a href="#entry-avapat" class="skt-link">avapat</a>] <a href="#entry-avapaata" class="skt-link">m.</a> saut, descente; action de se jeter vers le bas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avapat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवपत्</span> <i>avapat</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-pat_1" class="skt-link">pat_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(avapatati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>avapatita</i><i>)</i> tomber, sauter en bas, piquer, fondre sur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avaplu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवप्लु</span> <i>avaplu</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-plu" class="skt-link">plu</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(avaplavate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>avapluta</i><i>)</i> sauter à bas de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avar_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवर्ण</span> <i>avarṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-var_na" class="skt-link">varṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avar_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avar_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avar_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avarṇā</i> soc. hors du système des 4 classes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवर</span> <i>avara</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a><a href="#entry--ra" class="skt-link">-ra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avaraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avarā</i> bas, inférieur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> cadet, plus récent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui précède ⟨abl.⟩; opp. <a href="#entry-para" class="skt-link">para</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avaraja">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>avaraja</i> [<a href="#entry-ja" class="skt-link">ja</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avaraja" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avaraja" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avarajaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avarajā</i> puîné, plus jeune — <a href="#entry-avaraja" class="skt-link">m.</a> frère cadet (opp. <a href="#entry-agraja" class="skt-link">agraja</a>, syn. <a href="#entry-anuja" class="skt-link">anuja</a>) — ifc. frère cadet de — <a href="#entry-avarajaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avarajā</i> sœur cadette.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avarapara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>avarapara</i> [<a href="#entry-para" class="skt-link">para</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avarapara" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avarapara" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avaraparaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avaraparā</i> qui précède et qui suit.<br> <i>avaraparam</i> l'un sur l'autre; en succession.<br> <a href="#entry-avara" class="skt-link">avara</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avaratas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>avaratas</i> [<a href="#entry--tas" class="skt-link">-tas</a>] adv. au moins.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avarodha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवरोध</span> <i>avarodha</i> [act. <a href="#entry-avarudh" class="skt-link">avarudh</a>] <a href="#entry-avarodha" class="skt-link">m.</a> séclusion, isolation <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gynécée, harem <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>avarodhās</i> les femmes du harem.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avaroha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवरोह</span> <i>avaroha</i> [act. <a href="#entry-avaruh" class="skt-link">avaruh</a>] <a href="#entry-avaroha" class="skt-link">m.</a> descente <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mus. descente de ton <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> racines aériennes (not. du banian) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> liane grimpante.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avaroha_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवरोहण</span> <i>avarohaṇa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-avaruh" class="skt-link">avaruh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avaroha_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avaroha_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avarohi_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avarohiṇā</i> qui descend — <a href="#entry-avaroha_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> descente; descente de ⟨abl.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> endroit de descente.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avarohin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवरोहिन्</span> <i>avarohin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-avaruh" class="skt-link">avaruh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avarohin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avarohin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avarohi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avarohiṇī</i> qui descend — <a href="#entry-avarohin" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. banian.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avaropita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवरोपित</span> <i>avaropita</i> [ca. pp. <a href="#entry-avaruh" class="skt-link">avaruh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avaropita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avaropita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avaropitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avaropitā</i> que l'on a fait descendre (de ⟨abl.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rétrogradé, dégradé; déchu (not. de son état de prince).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avaropya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवरोप्य</span> <i>avaropya</i> [ca. pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-avaruh" class="skt-link">avaruh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avaropya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avaropya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avaropyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avaropyā</i> qui doit être descendu — ind. ayant été descendu ou déchu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avaruddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवरुद्ध</span> <i>avaruddha</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-avarudh" class="skt-link">avarudh</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avaruddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avaruddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avaruddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avaruddhā</i> retenu, arrêté, stoppé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mis au secret; emprisonné; banni.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avaruddhikaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>avaruddhikā</i> [<a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] <a href="#entry-avaruddhikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. femme cloîtrée au harem.<br> <a href="#entry-avaruddha" class="skt-link">avaruddha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avarudh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवरुध्</span> <i>avarudh</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-rudh_2" class="skt-link">rudh_2</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(avaruṇaddhi)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>avaruddha</i><i>)</i> retenir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avaruh">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवरुह्</span> <i>avaruh</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-ruh_1" class="skt-link">ruh_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(avarohati)</i> pr. md. <i>(avarohate)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>prati</i><i>)</i> descendre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> déchoir — ca. <i>(avarohayati)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>avaropya</i><i>)</i> var. <i>avaropayati</i> faire descendre; priver de ⟨abl.⟩, diminuer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avas_r_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवसृष्ट</span> <i>avasṛṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-avas_rj" class="skt-link">avasṛj</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avas_r_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avas_r_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avas_r_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avasṛṣṭā</i> relâché: envoyé — ifc. tombé de; tombé sur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avas_rj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवसृज्</span> <i>avasṛj</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-s_rj_1" class="skt-link">sṛj_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(avasṛjati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>avasṛṣṭa</i><i>)</i> relâcher, répandre; faire couler, faire tomber <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> abandonner (sa colère, sa vie, etc.) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mettre au monde; produire; relâcher.<br> <i>rudhiraughān</i> <i>avāsṛjan</i> [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] (les <a href="#entry-raak_sasaas" class="skt-link">rākṣasās</a>) firent pleuvoir des flots de sang.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avas_rp">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवसृप्</span> <i>avasṛp</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-s_rp" class="skt-link">sṛp</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(avasarpati)</i> se coucher (soleil); se retirer (mer à marée basse) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'approcher en secret.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avas_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवस्</span> <i>avas_1</i> [<a href="#entry-av" class="skt-link">av</a>] <a href="#entry-avas_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> faveur, protection; grâce <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> appréciation, plaisir; désir, souhait.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avas_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवस्</span> <i>avas_2</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>] adv. vers le bas <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> en bas de ⟨abl. i.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवस</span> <i>avasa</i> [<a href="#entry-av" class="skt-link">av</a>] <a href="#entry-avasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> nourriture, provision.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवसा</span> <i>avasā</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-saa_1" class="skt-link">sā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">4</span>] pr. <i>(avasyati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>avasita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>adhi</i>, <i>nis</i>, <i>vi</i><i>)</i> finir, terminer; aller à sa fin, cesser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवसाद</span> <i>avasāda</i> [act. <a href="#entry-avasad" class="skt-link">avasad</a>] <a href="#entry-avasaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> manque d'énergie ou de stamina; lassitude, fatigue, épuisement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> défaite <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> méd. dépression.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवसान</span> <i>avasāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-avasaa" class="skt-link">avasā</a>] <a href="#entry-avasaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> fin, terme, extrémité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> [«où l'on dételle les chevaux»] halte, lieu de repos; résidence <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. pause; elle est notée en écriture par le <a href="#entry-da_n_da" class="skt-link">daṇḍa</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phon. temps d'arrêt de la parole; il est marqué par un espace dans le texte écrit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. fin d'un mot; partie droite d'un composé; fin d'une phrase — <a href="#entry-avasaanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avasānā</i> ifc. conclusion, finition, cessation de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवसाय</span> <i>avasāya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-avasaa" class="skt-link">avasā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avasaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avasaaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avasaayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avasāyā</i> à détruire — <a href="#entry-avasaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> destruction, complétion.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasaayin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवसायिन्</span> <i>avasāyin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-avasaa" class="skt-link">avasā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avasaayin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avasaayin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avasaayinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avasāyinī</i> qui détruit.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasad">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवसद्</span> <i>avasad</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-sad_1" class="skt-link">sad_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(avasīdati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>avasanna</i><i>)</i> succomber, tomber dans le malheur — ca. <i>(avasādayati)</i> calmer; épuiser; couler; ruiner, détruire.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasalavi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवसलवि</span> <i>avasalavi</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-salavi" class="skt-link">salavi</a>] adv. à gauche; opp. <a href="#entry-prasalavi" class="skt-link">prasalavi</a>; syn. <a href="#entry-apasalavi" class="skt-link">apasalavi</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasanna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवसन्न</span> <i>avasanna</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-avasad" class="skt-link">avasad</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avasanna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avasanna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avasannaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avasannā</i> enfoncé, coulé; pressuré; qui croûle (sous un fardeau) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> profond (blessure); opp. <a href="#entry-utsanna" class="skt-link">utsanna</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> déprimé, découragé; malheureux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> terminé; aboli (not. vision d'un aveugle) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> soc. (droit) qui a perdu un litige.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवसर</span> <i>avasara</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-sara" class="skt-link">sara</a>] <a href="#entry-avasara" class="skt-link">m.</a> pluie [«descente (d'eau)»] <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lieu propice <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> occasion heureuse, moment favorable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] opportunité pour approfondir l'enquête.<br> <i>avasare</i> en cette heureuse occasion.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasarga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवसर्ग</span> <i>avasarga</i> [act. <a href="#entry-avas_rj" class="skt-link">avasṛj</a>] <a href="#entry-avasarga" class="skt-link">m.</a> fait de relâcher; relâchement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fait de suivre son inclination.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasarpa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवसर्प</span> <i>avasarpa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-avas_rp" class="skt-link">avasṛp</a>] <a href="#entry-avasarpa" class="skt-link">m.</a> espion.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasarpa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवसर्पण</span> <i>avasarpaṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-avas_rp" class="skt-link">avasṛp</a>] <a href="#entry-avasarpa_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> myth. endroit où <a href="#entry-Umanu" class="skt-link">Manu</a> posa le pied en descendant de l'arche.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasarpin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवसर्पिन्</span> <i>avasarpin</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-avas_rp" class="skt-link">avasṛp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avasarpin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avasarpin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avasarpi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avasarpiṇī</i> qui décroît, qui reflue — <a href="#entry-avasarpi_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avasarpiṇī</i> jn. cycle descendant, période cosmique de descente graduelle; opp. <a href="#entry-utsarpi_nii" class="skt-link">utsarpiṇī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasarpita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवसर्पित</span> <i>avasarpita</i> [ca. pp. <a href="#entry-avas_rp" class="skt-link">avasṛp</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avasarpita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avasarpita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avasarpitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avasarpitā</i> qu'on a fait refluer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasic">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवसिच्</span> <i>avasic</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-sic" class="skt-link">sic</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">6</span>] pr. <i>(avasiñcati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>avasikta</i><i>)</i> asperger, arroser; verser sur ⟨acc. loc.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasikta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवसिक्त</span> <i>avasikta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-avasic" class="skt-link">avasic</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avasikta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avasikta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avasiktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avasiktā</i> versé sur; aspergé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवसित</span> <i>avasita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-avasaa" class="skt-link">avasā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avasita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avasita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avasitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avasitā</i> terminé, complété; fini; déterminé, fixé; compris <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> véd. qui s'est fixé, qui a pris pour résidence — <a href="#entry-avasita" class="skt-link">n.</a> résidence.<br> <i>gaṅgām</i> <i>anvasitā</i> <i>purī</i> la ville est située le long du Gange.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avastaat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>avastāt</i> adv. en dessous; sous ⟨g.⟩ <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> avant, antérieurement à.<br> <a href="#entry-avas_2" class="skt-link">avas_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasthaa_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवस्था</span> <i>avasthā_1</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-sthaa_1" class="skt-link">sthā_1</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(avatiṣṭhati)</i> pr. md. <i>(avatiṣṭhate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>avasthita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>vi</i><i>)</i> prendre place, se tenir, s'arrêter <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> s'établir; habiter, rester; exister, être stable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasthaa_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवस्था</span> <i>avasthā_2</i> [act. <a href="#entry-avasthaa_1" class="skt-link">avasthā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-avasthaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> condition, degré; stade; état, situation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasthaana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवस्थान</span> <i>avasthāna</i> [act. <a href="#entry-avasthaa_1" class="skt-link">avasthā_1</a>] <a href="#entry-avasthaana" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de se tenir; situation, condition; établissement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> séjour, résidence; stabilité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasthaatraya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>avasthātraya</i> [<a href="#entry-traya" class="skt-link">traya</a>] <a href="#entry-avasthaatraya" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. les trois états de conscience: la veille [<a href="#entry-jaagrat" class="skt-link">jāgrat</a>], le rêve [<a href="#entry-svapna" class="skt-link">svapna</a>] et le sommeil profond [<a href="#entry-su_supti" class="skt-link">suṣupti</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-avasthaa_2" class="skt-link">avasthā_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasthita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवस्थित</span> <i>avasthita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-avasthaa_1" class="skt-link">avasthā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avasthita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avasthita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avasthitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avasthitā</i> présent, qui se tient prêt; déterminé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> debout, ferme, stable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avasthiti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवस्थिति</span> <i>avasthiti</i> [act. <a href="#entry-avasthita" class="skt-link">avasthita</a>] <a href="#entry-avasthiti" class="skt-link">f.</a> stabilité.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avastu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवस्तु</span> <i>avastu</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vastu_1" class="skt-link">vastu_1</a>] <a href="#entry-avastu" class="skt-link">n.</a> chose sans valeur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. insubstantialité; immatérialité; irréalité de la matière.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avat_rr">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवतॄ</span> <i>avatṝ</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-t_rr" class="skt-link">tṝ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(avatarati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>avatīrṇa</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>avatīrya</i><i>)</i> descendre — ca. <i>(avatārayati)</i> faire descendre.<br> <i>aṃśena</i> <i>avatṝ</i> myth. se dit de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a> incarnant une partie de Lui-même comme <a href="#entry-avataara" class="skt-link">avatāra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avata_msa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवतंस</span> <i>avataṃsa</i> <a href="#entry-avata_msa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avata_msa" class="skt-link">n.</a> guirlande; boucle d'oreille, ornement — <a href="#entry-avata_msaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avataṃsā</i> ifc. id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avataara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवतार</span> <i>avatāra</i> [act. <a href="#entry-avat_rr" class="skt-link">avatṝ</a>] <a href="#entry-avataara" class="skt-link">m.</a> descente; apparition <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. incarnation divine (not. de <a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>); cf. <a href="#entry-dazaavataara" class="skt-link">daśāvatāra</a>, <a href="#entry-puur_naavataara" class="skt-link">pūrṇāvatāra</a>, <a href="#entry-a_mza" class="skt-link">aṃśa</a>, <a href="#entry-kalaa" class="skt-link">kalā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fr. avatar.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avatap">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवतप्</span> <i>avatap</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-tap" class="skt-link">tap</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(avatapati)</i> pr. md. <i>(avatapate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>avatapta</i><i>)</i> chauffer vers le bas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avatapta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवतप्त</span> <i>avatapta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-avatap" class="skt-link">avatap</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avatapta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avatapta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avataptaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avataptā</i> chauffé (not. par le soleil).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avatara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवतर</span> <i>avatara</i> [act. <a href="#entry-avat_rr" class="skt-link">avatṝ</a>] <a href="#entry-avatara" class="skt-link">m.</a> descente, entrée.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avatara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवतरण</span> <i>avataraṇa</i> [act. <a href="#entry-avat_rr" class="skt-link">avatṝ</a>] <a href="#entry-avatara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de descendre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. traduction.<br> <i>vasantasamayāvatāraḥ</i> venue du printemps.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avatta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवत्त</span> <i>avatta</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-avadaa_1" class="skt-link">avadā_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avatta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avatta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avattaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avattā</i> découpé — <a href="#entry-avatta" class="skt-link">m.</a> morceau découpé, not. de l'offrande.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avayava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवयव</span> <i>avayava</i> [obj. <a href="#entry-avayu" class="skt-link">avayu</a>] <a href="#entry-avayava" class="skt-link">m.</a> partie, membre, portion; opp. <a href="#entry-samudaaya" class="skt-link">samudāya</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] élément d'un syllogisme — <a href="#entry-avayavaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avayavā</i> ifc. part de, portion de; membre de.<br> <i>avayavāvayavībhāva</i> gram. relation entre la partie et le tout.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avayavadharma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>avayavadharma</i> [<a href="#entry-dharma" class="skt-link">dharma</a>] <a href="#entry-avayavadharma" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. propriété caractéristique d'une partie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avayavazas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>avayavaśas</i> [<a href="#entry--zas" class="skt-link">-śas</a>] adv. membre à membre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avayavin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>avayavin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avayavin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avayavin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avayavinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avayavinī</i> qui a des subdivisions; composite; entier — <a href="#entry-avayavinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avayavinī</i> phil. syllogisme.<br> <a href="#entry-avayava" class="skt-link">avayava</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avayu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवयु</span> <i>avayu</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-yu_2" class="skt-link">yu_2</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">3</span>] pr. <i>(avayuyoti)</i> séparer (de ⟨abl.⟩) — ca. <i>(avayāvayati)</i> écarter, tenir à distance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avaza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवश</span> <i>avaśa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vaza" class="skt-link">vaśa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avaza" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avaza" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avazaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avaśā</i> indépendant, libre; rétif, insoumis, désobéissant; incontrôlé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avaze_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवशेष</span> <i>avaśeṣa</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-avazi_s" class="skt-link">avaśiṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-avaze_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> reste — ifc. dont il (ne) reste (que) ⟨iic.⟩.<br> <i>kathāvaśeṣaḥ</i> [«dont il ne reste que son histoire»] décédé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avazi_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवशिष्</span> <i>avaśiṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-zi_s" class="skt-link">śiṣ</a>] ps. <i>(avaśiṣyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>avaśiṣṭa</i><i>)</i> rester, demeurer, survivre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avazi_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवशिष्ट</span> <i>avaśiṣṭa</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-avazi_s" class="skt-link">avaśiṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avazi_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avazi_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avazi_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avaśiṣṭā</i> épargné, restant, survivant — ifc. dont il (ne) reste (que); restant de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avazya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवश्य</span> <i>avaśya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vazya" class="skt-link">vaśya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avazya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avazya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avazyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avaśyā</i> insoumis, rétif.<br> <i>avaśyam</i> adv. nécessairement; certainement, sans aucun doute.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avazyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवश्या</span> <i>avaśyā</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-zyaa" class="skt-link">śyā</a>] <a href="#entry-avazyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> rosée; givre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avazyaaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवश्याय</span> <i>avaśyāya</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-zyaaya" class="skt-link">śyāya</a>] <a href="#entry-avazyaaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> rosée; givre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ave">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवे</span> <i>ave</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-i" class="skt-link">i</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">2</span>] pr. <i>(avaiti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>aveta</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>sam</i><i>)</i> approcher <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> considérer comme; comprendre, savoir (⟨inf.⟩).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avek_s">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवेक्ष्</span> <i>avekṣ</i> [<a href="#entry-ava" class="skt-link">ava</a>-<a href="#entry-iik_s" class="skt-link">īkṣ</a>] v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. md. <i>(avekṣate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>avekṣita</i><i>)</i> pfp. <i>(</i><i>avekṣya</i><i>)</i> considérer, observer, remarquer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> prendre égard à, prendre en considération.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avek_saa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवेक्षा</span> <i>avekṣā</i> [act. <a href="#entry-avek_s" class="skt-link">avekṣ</a>] <a href="#entry-avek_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> regard circulaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> égards, considération.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avek_sya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवेक्ष्य</span> <i>avekṣya</i> [pfp. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] <a href="#entry-avek_s" class="skt-link">avekṣ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avek_sya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avek_sya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avek_syaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avekṣyā</i> digne d'égards; à prendre en considération.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अवि</span> <i>avi</i> <a href="#entry-avi" class="skt-link">m.</a> mouton — <a href="#entry-avi" class="skt-link">f.</a> brebis <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>ovis</i>; ang. ewe; fr. ovin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avi_saya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अविषय</span> <i>aviṣaya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vi_saya" class="skt-link">viṣaya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avi_saya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avi_saya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avi_sayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aviṣayā</i> en dehors du domaine, hors-champ, hors-limite; sans objet <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui ne vous regarde pas, qui n'est pas votre affaire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> illegal, impossible, interdit; impropre à ⟨g.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avibhakta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अविभक्त</span> <i>avibhakta</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vibhakta" class="skt-link">vibhakta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avibhakta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avibhakta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avibhaktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avibhaktā</i> indivis, non séparé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avibhaktadaayaada">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>avibhaktadāyāda</i> [<a href="#entry-daayaada" class="skt-link">dāyāda</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avibhaktadaayaada" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avibhaktadaayaada" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avibhaktadaayaadaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avibhaktadāyādā</i> soc. se dit de parents [<a href="#entry-sapi_n_da" class="skt-link">sapiṇḍa</a>] qui partagent les oblations [<a href="#entry-pi_n_da" class="skt-link">piṇḍa</a>] lors d'une cérémonie d'hommage aux mânes [<a href="#entry-zraaddha" class="skt-link">śrāddha</a>].<br> <a href="#entry-avibhakta" class="skt-link">avibhakta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avibhaktatva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>avibhaktatva</i> [<a href="#entry--tva" class="skt-link">-tva</a>] <a href="#entry-avibhaktatva" class="skt-link">n.</a> phil. l'indivis; le non distingué.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avibhakti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अविभक्ति</span> <i>avibhakti</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vibhakti" class="skt-link">vibhakti</a>] iic. gram. (mot) non fléchi; thème.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avibhaktinirdeza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>avibhaktinirdeśa</i> [<a href="#entry-nirdeza" class="skt-link">nirdeśa</a>] <a href="#entry-avibhaktinirdeza" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. référence à un mot dépourvu d'inflexion.<br> <a href="#entry-avibhakti" class="skt-link">avibhakti</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avicaara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अविचार</span> <i>avicāra</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vicaara" class="skt-link">vicāra</a>] <a href="#entry-avicaara" class="skt-link">m.</a> absence de discernement; absence de réflexion.<br> <i>avicāram</i> adv. sans hésitation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avicaara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अविचारण</span> <i>avicāraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vicaara_na" class="skt-link">vicāraṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-avicaara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> absence de délibération; absence d'hésitation.<br> <i>avicāraṇāt</i> adv. sans hésitation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avicaara_niiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अविचारणीय</span> <i>avicāraṇīya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vicaara_niiya" class="skt-link">vicāraṇīya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avicaara_niiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avicaara_niiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avicaara_niiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avicāraṇīyā</i> qui ne nécessite pas délibération <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inconcevable (se dit des dieux).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avicaarita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अविचारित</span> <i>avicārita</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vicaarita" class="skt-link">vicārita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avicaarita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avicaarita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avicaaritaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avicāritā</i> qui n'a pas été discuté <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui ne mérite pas discussion; indiscutable; certain, clair.<br> <i>avicāritam</i> adv. sans hésitation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avicaarya_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अविचार्य</span> <i>avicārya_1</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vicaarya_1" class="skt-link">vicārya_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avicaarya_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avicaarya_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avicaaryaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avicāryā</i> indiscutable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avicaarya_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अविचार्य</span> <i>avicārya_2</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vicaarya_2" class="skt-link">vicārya_2</a>] ind. sans discussion; n'ayant pas réfléchi.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avicalita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अविचलित</span> <i>avicalita</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vicalita" class="skt-link">vicalita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avicalita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avicalita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avicalitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avicalitā</i> qui ne dévie pas; qui reste concentré (esprit) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui ne dévie pas de ⟨abl.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avicchindat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अविच्छिन्दत्</span> <i>avicchindat</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vicchindat" class="skt-link">vicchindat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avicchindat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avicchindat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avicchindatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avicchindatī</i> qui ne sépare pas, qui n'interrompt pas.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avicchinna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अविच्छिन्न</span> <i>avicchinna</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vicchinna" class="skt-link">vicchinna</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avicchinna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avicchinna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avicchinnaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avicchinnā</i> sans limitation; non séparé, ininterrompu; continu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avidaasin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अविदासिन्</span> <i>avidāsin</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vidas" class="skt-link">vidas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avidaasin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avidaasin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avidaasinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avidāsinī</i> qui ne s'épuise pas; qui ne se dessèche pas (étang); pérenne.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avidhaanatas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अविधानतस्</span> <i>avidhānatas</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vidhaanatas" class="skt-link">vidhānatas</a>] adv. non conformément aux règles, irrégulièrement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avidhavaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अविधवा</span> <i>avidhavā</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vidhavaa" class="skt-link">vidhavā</a>] <a href="#entry-avidhavaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui n'est pas veuve.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avidheya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अविधेय</span> <i>avidheya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vidheya" class="skt-link">vidheya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avidheya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avidheya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avidheyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avidheyā</i> désobéissant, insoumis <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> méd. not. malade non docile (à qui l'on peut refuser le traitement).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avidita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अविदित</span> <i>avidita</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vidita" class="skt-link">vidita</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avidita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avidita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aviditaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aviditā</i> inconnu <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> qui ne connaît pas, ignorant de ⟨g.⟩.<br> <i>avidite</i> dans l'ignorance de ⟨g.⟩.<br> <i>aviditam</i> sans connaître (⟨g.⟩) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> afin que personne ne sache.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avidvas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अविद्वस्</span> <i>avidvas</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vidvas" class="skt-link">vidvas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avidvas" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avidvas" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avidu_sii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aviduṣī</i> ignorant, imprudent; sot, insensé, stupide.<br> <i>avidvāṃsas</i> les ignorants.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avidya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अविद्य</span> <i>avidya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vidyaa" class="skt-link">vidyā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avidya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avidya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avidyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avidyā</i> ignorant; inculte — f. cf. <a href="#entry-avidyaa" class="skt-link">avidyā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avidyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अविद्या</span> <i>avidyā</i> [f. <a href="#entry-avidya" class="skt-link">avidya</a>] <a href="#entry-avidyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> ignorance <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. la nescience; syn. <a href="#entry-akhyaati" class="skt-link">akhyāti</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. [<a href="#entry-vedaanta" class="skt-link">vedānta</a>] l'illusion, personnifiée par <a href="#entry-Umaayaa" class="skt-link">Māyā</a>; ce concept clé d'<a href="#entry-advaita" class="skt-link">advaita</a> fut combattu dans le <a href="#entry-vizi_s_taadvaita" class="skt-link">viśiṣṭādvaita</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. l'ignorance, 1⟨sup⟩re⟨/sup⟩ cause de souffrance [<a href="#entry-pratiityasamutpaada" class="skt-link">pratītyasamutpāda</a>].
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avidyaamaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

</div>

  </div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>

  </div>
</div>

  </div>
</div>

[<a href="#entry-miimaa_msaa" class="skt-link">mīmāṃsā</a>] que l'on n'a pas l'intention d'exprimer littéralement; figuratif.

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avyaaptav_rtti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>avyāptavṛtti</i> [<a href="#entry-v_rtti" class="skt-link">vṛtti</a>] <a href="#entry-avyaaptav_rtti" class="skt-link">f.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-nyaaya" class="skt-link">nyāya</a>] manifestation incomplète; propriété non exclusive.<br> <a href="#entry-avyaapta" class="skt-link">avyāpta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avyaapti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अव्याप्ति</span> <i>avyāpti</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vyaapti" class="skt-link">vyāpti</a>] <a href="#entry-avyaapti" class="skt-link">f.</a> gram. sous-généralisation; extension insuffisante; incomplétude; opp. <a href="#entry-ativyaapti" class="skt-link">ativyāpti</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avyagra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अव्यग्र</span> <i>avyagra</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vyagra" class="skt-link">vyagra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avyagra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avyagra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avyagraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avyagrā</i> calme, réfléchi; inoccupé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> occupé d'une seule chose — acc. <i>avyagram</i> adv. posément, délibérément, à loisir.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avyakta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अव्यक्त</span> <i>avyakta</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vyakta" class="skt-link">vyakta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avyakta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avyakta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avyaktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avyaktā</i> invisible, indécelable, imperceptible; non-manifeste — <a href="#entry-avyakta" class="skt-link">m.</a> phil. [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] la Nature Primordiale [<a href="#entry-muulaprak_rti" class="skt-link">mūlaprakṛti</a>] sous sa forme du Non-manifesté ou Indéterminé, esprit subtil dont découlent tous les phénomènes du monde matériel de la Manifestation.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avyapadezya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अव्यपदेश्य</span> <i>avyapadeśya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vyapadezya" class="skt-link">vyapadeśya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avyapadezya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avyapadezya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avyapadezyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avyapadeśyā</i> phil. non verbalisé; non énonçable, inexprimable, qui ne peut être verbalisé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avyaya_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>avyaya_1</i> [<a href="#entry-aya" class="skt-link">aya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avyaya_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avyaya_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avyayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avyayā</i> concernant le mouton <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fait de peau de mouton <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> véd. not. filtre utilisé pour préparer le <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-avi" class="skt-link">avi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avyaya_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अव्यय</span> <i>avyaya_2</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vyaya" class="skt-link">vyaya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avyaya_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avyaya_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avyayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avyayā</i> invariable, inaltérable, immuable; constant; indestructible, impérissable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> avare <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. indéclinable — <a href="#entry-avyaya_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> avarice — <a href="#entry-avyaya_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. mot indéclinable; composé nominal invariable à tous les genres et nombres, héritant sa fonction d'adverbe de son premier membre.<br> <i>avyayībhū</i> gram. devenir indéclinable (se dit d'un mot formant un composé adverbial figé avec un premier membre indéclinable, comme <a href="#entry-yathaazakti" class="skt-link">yathāśakti</a>).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avyayii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अव्ययी</span> <i>avyayī</i> iiv. de <a href="#entry-avyaya_2" class="skt-link">avyaya_2</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avyayiibhaava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>avyayībhāva</i> [<a href="#entry-bhaava" class="skt-link">bhāva</a>] <a href="#entry-avyayiibhaava" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. [«conversion en indéclinable»] utilisation d'un composé nominal de premier membre indéclinable comme adverbe figé (indéclinable).<br> <a href="#entry-avyayii" class="skt-link">avyayī</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avyutpanna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अव्युत्पन्न</span> <i>avyutpanna</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vyutpanna" class="skt-link">vyutpanna</a>] a. <a href="#entry-avyutpanna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-avyutpanna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-avyutpannaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>avyutpannā</i> non dérivé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gram. se dit des substantifs indérivables d'une racine.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-avyutpattipak_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अव्युत्पत्तिपक्ष</span> <i>avyutpattipakṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-vyutpattipak_sa" class="skt-link">vyutpattipakṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-avyutpattipak_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> gram. antithèse du dogme instituant que tout nominal est dérivé d'une racine verbale; ce point de vue est défendu par <a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अय</span> <i>aya</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-i" class="skt-link">i</a>] ifc. a. <a href="#entry-aya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ayā</i> qui va <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fait d'aller <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> chance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aya_h">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अयः</span> <i>ayaḥ</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-ayas" class="skt-link">ayas</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aya_hzuula">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ayaḥśūla</i> [<a href="#entry-zuula" class="skt-link">śūla</a>] <a href="#entry-aya_hzuula" class="skt-link">n.</a> pieu de fer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aya_hzuulika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ayaḥśūlika</i> [<a href="#entry--ika" class="skt-link">-ika</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aya_hzuulika" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aya_hzuulika" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aya_hzuulikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ayaḥśūlikā</i> qui utilise la violence; assassin.<br> <a href="#entry-aya_hzuula" class="skt-link">ayaḥśūla</a> <br> <a href="#entry-aya_h" class="skt-link">ayaḥ</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayaas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अयास्</span> <i>ayās</i> ind. véd. (a.) agile <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (n.) feu.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayaj_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अयज्ञ</span> <i>ayajña</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-yaj_na" class="skt-link">yajña</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ayaj_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ayaj_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ayaj_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ayajñā</i> soc. qui ne pratique pas le sacrifice védique.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayam">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अयम्</span> <i>ayam</i> pn. dém. <a href="#entry-ayam" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-iyam" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>iyam</i> <a href="#entry-idam" class="skt-link">n.</a> <i>idam</i> ce, cet, ces (ici); celui-ci; voici, ce qui suit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> il; le.<br> <i>ayaṃ</i> <i>janaḥ</i> cette personne-ci; moi-même.<br> <i>ayam</i> <i>asmi</i> me voici.<br> <i>ime</i> <i>smaḥ</i> nous voici.<br> <i>mām</i> <i>imam</i> moi ici.<br> <i>ko</i> <i>'yam</i> <i>āyāti</i> qui vient ici?
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अयन</span> <i>ayana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-i" class="skt-link">i</a>] <a href="#entry-ayana" class="skt-link">n.</a> chemin, trajet, parcours <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. demi-année (parcours du Soleil d'un solstice à l'autre); solstice; cf. <a href="#entry-uttaraaya_na" class="skt-link">uttarāyaṇa</a>, <a href="#entry-dak_si_naayana" class="skt-link">dakṣiṇāyana</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayanaa_mza">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ayanāṃśa</i> [<a href="#entry-a_mza" class="skt-link">aṃśa</a>] <a href="#entry-ayanaa_mza" class="skt-link">m.</a> astr. précession des équinoxes (différence entre le zodiaque tropique [<a href="#entry-saayana" class="skt-link">sāyana</a>] et le zodiaque sidéral [<a href="#entry-nirayana" class="skt-link">nirayana</a>]).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayanaanta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ayanānta</i> [<a href="#entry-anta" class="skt-link">anta</a>] <a href="#entry-ayanaanta" class="skt-link">m.</a> astr. solstice.<br> <a href="#entry-ayana" class="skt-link">ayana</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayanagho_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ayanaghoṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-gho_sa" class="skt-link">ghoṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-ayanagho_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [GG.] np. d'Ayanaghoṣa, vacher de <a href="#entry-Uv_rndaavana" class="skt-link">Vṛndāvana</a>, époux de <a href="#entry-Uraadhaa" class="skt-link">Rādhā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अयस्</span> <i>ayas</i> <a href="#entry-ayas" class="skt-link">n.</a> véd. bronze, cuivre; métal <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (après 1200 ant.) fer <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>aes</i>; ang. ore; fr. airain.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayasmaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ayasmaya</i> [<a href="#entry-maya" class="skt-link">maya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ayasmaya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ayasmaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ayasmayii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ayasmayī</i> véd. en fer; métallique — <a href="#entry-ayasmayii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ayasmayī</i> myth. np. d'Ayasmayī «En fer», l'une des 3 villes des anti-dieux [<a href="#entry-asura" class="skt-link">asura</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-tripura" class="skt-link">tripura</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayata">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अयत</span> <i>ayata</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-yata" class="skt-link">yata</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ayata" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ayata" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ayataa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ayatā</i> incontrôlé, sans contrainte.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayathaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अयथा</span> <i>ayathā</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-yathaa" class="skt-link">yathā</a>] adv. improprement; non conformément.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayathaamaatram">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ayathāmātram</i> [<a href="#entry-maatra" class="skt-link">mātra</a>] adv. phon. improprement vis-à-vis de la mesure (défaut de prononciation d'une voyelle).<br> <a href="#entry-ayathaa" class="skt-link">ayathā</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aye">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अये</span> <i>aye</i> interj. oh! ah! (surprise) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> eh! holà! (appel).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अयि</span> <i>ayi</i> interj. hé! holà! s'il vous plaît! oh là là!
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayo">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अयो</span> <i>ayo</i> cf. <a href="#entry-ayas" class="skt-link">ayas</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayoda_n_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ayodaṇḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-da_n_da" class="skt-link">daṇḍa</a>] <a href="#entry-ayoda_n_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> barre de fer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayoddh_r">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अयोद्धृ</span> <i>ayoddhṛ</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-yoddh_r" class="skt-link">yoddhṛ</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ayoddh_r" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ayoddh_r" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ayoddhrii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ayoddhrī</i> non-combattant; lâche.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayodhya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अयोध्य</span> <i>ayodhya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-yodhya" class="skt-link">yodhya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ayodhya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ayodhya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ayodhyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ayodhyā</i> invincible — f. cf. <a href="#entry-ayodhyaa" class="skt-link">ayodhyā</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayodhyaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अयोध्या</span> <i>ayodhyā</i> [f. <a href="#entry-ayodhya" class="skt-link">ayodhya</a>] <a href="#entry-ayodhyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> géo. np. de la ville d'Ayodhyā «l'Invincible», fondée par <a href="#entry-Uik_svaaku" class="skt-link">Ikṣvāku</a>, capitale de la lignée solaire [<a href="#entry-suuryava_mza" class="skt-link">sūryavaṃśa</a>] et notamment du roi <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a>; c'est l'une des 7 villes sacrées [<a href="#entry-saptapurii" class="skt-link">saptapurī</a>]; la rivière <a href="#entry-Usarayuu" class="skt-link">Sarayū</a> y coule; mod. Oudh, près de Faizabad dans l'Uttar Pradesh <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>Ayojjhā</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayoga">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अयोग</span> <i>ayoga</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-yoga" class="skt-link">yoga</a>] <a href="#entry-ayoga" class="skt-link">m.</a> séparation; disjonction <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> séparation d'un être aimé <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> non conformité; inutilité, inefficacité; impossibilité <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> traitement médical inapproprié <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> astr. conjonction d'astres défavorable.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayogava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अयोगव</span> <i>ayogava</i> <a href="#entry-ayogava" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ayogavii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ayogavī</i> soc. caste mêlée; se dit du descendant d'un homme <a href="#entry-zuudra" class="skt-link">śūdra</a> et d'une femme <a href="#entry-vaizyaa" class="skt-link">vaiśyā</a>; not. caste de charpentiers.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayogavaaha">
