    <i>ayogavāha</i> [<a href="#entry-vaaha" class="skt-link">vāha</a>] <a href="#entry-ayogavaaha" class="skt-link">m.</a> phon. [«non listé avec les autres phonèmes»] désigne l'<a href="#entry-anusvaara" class="skt-link">anusvāra</a>, le <a href="#entry-visarga" class="skt-link">visarga</a> et leurs variantes.<br> <a href="#entry-ayoga" class="skt-link">ayoga</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayogu_da">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ayoguḍa</i> [<a href="#entry-gu_da" class="skt-link">guḍa</a>] <a href="#entry-ayogu_da" class="skt-link">m.</a> boulet de fer.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayomu_s_ti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ayomuṣṭi</i> [<a href="#entry-mu_s_ti" class="skt-link">muṣṭi</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ayomu_s_ti" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ayomu_s_ti" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ayomu_s_ti" class="skt-link">f.</a> aux poings d'acier.<br> <a href="#entry-ayas" class="skt-link">ayas</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayoni">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अयोनि</span> <i>ayoni</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-yoni" class="skt-link">yoni</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ayoni" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ayoni" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ayoni" class="skt-link">f.</a> hors de la matrice; spontané, original; sans précédent <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> phil. incréé; sans commencement — <a href="#entry-ayoni" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Ubrahmaa" class="skt-link">Brahmā</a> «l'Incréé».
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayonija">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ayonija</i> [<a href="#entry-ja" class="skt-link">ja</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ayonija" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ayonija" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ayonijaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ayonijā</i> qui n'est pas né du sein maternel <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. np. d'Ayonija, épith. de <a href="#entry-Uhariharaputra" class="skt-link">Hariharaputra</a> «Conçu sans matrice»; on dit qu'il fut recueilli enfant par le roi <a href="#entry-Uraajazekhara_1" class="skt-link">Rājaśekhara_1</a> de Pandalam au <a href="#entry-Ukerala" class="skt-link">Kerala</a>, descendant de la dynastie <a href="#entry-Upaa_n_dya" class="skt-link">Pāṇḍya</a>, qui l'adopta comme son héritier; sous le nom d'Ayyappā (<a href="#entry-Uvi_s_nu" class="skt-link">Viṣṇu</a>-<a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>), il est l'objet d'un culte important au <a href="#entry-Ukerala" class="skt-link">Kerala</a>, not. à Sabarimala; cf. <a href="#entry-Uma_nika_n_tha" class="skt-link">Maṇikaṇṭha</a> — <a href="#entry-ayonijaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ayonijā</i> myth. [«immaculée conception»] épith. de <a href="#entry-Usiitaa" class="skt-link">Sītā</a>, de <a href="#entry-Udraupadii" class="skt-link">Draupadī</a>, etc.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayonisambhava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ayonisambhava</i> [<a href="#entry-sambhava" class="skt-link">sambhava</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ayonisambhava" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ayonisambhava" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ayonisambhavaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ayonisambhavā</i> cf. <a href="#entry-ayonija" class="skt-link">ayonija</a> — <a href="#entry-ayonisambhava" class="skt-link">m.</a> génération spontanée.<br> <a href="#entry-ayoni" class="skt-link">ayoni</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayuddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अयुद्ध</span> <i>ayuddha</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-yuddha" class="skt-link">yuddha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ayuddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ayuddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ayuddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ayuddhā</i> invaincu; invincible, irrésistible — <a href="#entry-ayuddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> absence de combat; état de paix.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayuj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अयुज्</span> <i>ayuj</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-yuj_2" class="skt-link">yuj_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ayuj" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ayuj" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ayuj" class="skt-link">f.</a> non apparié; (en nombre) impair — a. <a href="#entry-ayuja" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ayuja" class="skt-link">n.</a> <i>ayuja</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayukta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अयुक्त</span> <i>ayukta</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-yukta" class="skt-link">yukta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ayukta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ayukta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ayuktaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ayuktā</i> non connecté; non uni <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> non préparé; non attentif <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inadéquat, non conforme; indigne; déraisonnable, absurde.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayuta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अयुत</span> <i>ayuta</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-yuta_1" class="skt-link">yuta_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ayuta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ayuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ayutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ayutā</i> sans entraves, libre; illimité, innombrable <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inséparable, indissoluble — <a href="#entry-ayuta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <i>ayuta</i> [«sans bornes»] dix mille; un milliard (100 <a href="#entry-ko_ti" class="skt-link">koṭi</a>); une myriade.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayutaayus">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ayutāyus</i> [<a href="#entry-aayus" class="skt-link">āyus</a>] <a href="#entry-ayutaayus" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. d'Ayutāyu «Infiniment âgé», roi d'<a href="#entry-Uayodhyaa" class="skt-link">Ayodhyā</a>, fils de <a href="#entry-Usindhudviipa" class="skt-link">Sindhudvīpa</a>, père de <a href="#entry-U_rtupar_na" class="skt-link">Ṛtuparṇa</a>, ancêtre de <a href="#entry-Uraghu" class="skt-link">Raghu</a> et donc de <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> var. <i>ayutāyu</i> id.<br> <a href="#entry-ayuta" class="skt-link">ayuta</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-ayutasiddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>ayutasiddha</i> [<a href="#entry-siddha_1" class="skt-link">siddha_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-ayutasiddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-ayutasiddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-ayutasiddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>ayutasiddhā</i> phil. [<a href="#entry-vaize_sika" class="skt-link">vaiśeṣika</a>] inséparable, uni indissolublement; ajouté en quantité (opp. <a href="#entry-yutasiddha" class="skt-link">yutasiddha</a>) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> intrinsèque.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-az_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">अश्</span> <i>aś_1</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">5</span>] pr. md. <i>(aśnute)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>aṣṭa</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>abhi</i>, <i>ā</i>, <i>upa</i><i>)</i> atteindre, arriver à, parvenir à ⟨acc.⟩; obtenir, acquérir, gagner; jouir de.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-az_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">अश्</span> <i>aś_2</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">9</span>] pr. <i>(aśnāti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>aśita</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>aśitvā</i>, <i>-aśya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>pra</i><i>)</i> manger, dévorer; goûter, jouir de <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> détruire, perdre — ca. <i>(āśayati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>āśita</i><i>)</i> nourrir, faire manger — int. md. <i>(aśāśyate)</i> manger sans cesse <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>esca</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azaastriiya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशास्त्रीय</span> <i>aśāstrīya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-zaastriiya" class="skt-link">śāstrīya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azaastriiya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azaastriiya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azaastriiyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśāstrīyā</i> non conforme aux textes sacrés.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azafka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशङ्क</span> <i>aśaṅka</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-zafkaa" class="skt-link">śaṅkā</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azafka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azafka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azafkaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśaṅkā</i> sans hésitation; sans inquiétude.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azaknuvat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशक्नुवत्</span> <i>aśaknuvat</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-zaknuvat" class="skt-link">śaknuvat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azaknuvat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azaknuvat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azaknuvatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśaknuvatī</i> incapable de ⟨inf.⟩.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azakti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशक्ति</span> <i>aśakti</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-zakti" class="skt-link">śakti</a>] <a href="#entry-azakti" class="skt-link">f.</a> impuissance.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azakya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशक्य</span> <i>aśakya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-zakya" class="skt-link">śakya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azakya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azakya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azakyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśakyā</i> impossible.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azana_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशन</span> <i>aśana_1</i> [agt. <a href="#entry-az_1" class="skt-link">aś_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azana_1" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azana_1" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azanaa_1" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśanā_1</i> qui atteint, qui obtient.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azana_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशन</span> <i>aśana_2</i> [act. <a href="#entry-az_2" class="skt-link">aś_2</a>] <a href="#entry-azana_2" class="skt-link">n.</a> nourriture; repas — <a href="#entry-azanaa_2" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśanā_2</i> ifc. qui mange — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(aśanāyati)</i> désirer manger, avoir faim — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(aśanīyati)</i> id.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azanaayaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśanāyā</i> [<a href="#entry-ayaa" class="skt-link">ayā</a>] <a href="#entry-azanaayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> faim.<br> <a href="#entry-azana_2" class="skt-link">aśana_2</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azara_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशरण</span> <i>aśaraṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-zara_na" class="skt-link">śaraṇa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azara_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azara_na" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azara_naa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśaraṇā</i> sans protection, sans défense; sans refuge.<br> <i>aśaraṇīkṛ</i> priver de protection.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azariira">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशरीर</span> <i>aśarīra</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-zariira" class="skt-link">śarīra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azariira" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azariira" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azariiraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśarīrā</i> sans corps, incorporel — <a href="#entry-azariira" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. épith. de <a href="#entry-Ukaama" class="skt-link">Kāma</a> — <a href="#entry-azariira" class="skt-link">n.</a> gram. absence de verbe dans une phrase.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azariirin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśarīrin</i> [<a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azariirin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azariirin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azariiri_nii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśarīriṇī</i> incorporel; se dit not. d'une voix céleste.<br> <a href="#entry-azariira" class="skt-link">aśarīra</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azauca">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशौच</span> <i>aśauca</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-zauca" class="skt-link">śauca</a>] <a href="#entry-azauca" class="skt-link">n.</a> impureté; malpropreté.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aze_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशेष</span> <i>aśeṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-ze_sa" class="skt-link">śeṣa</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aze_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aze_sa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aze_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśeṣā</i> sans reste, entier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aze_satas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśeṣatas</i> [<a href="#entry--tas" class="skt-link">-tas</a>] adv. entièrement, sans exception.<br> <a href="#entry-aze_sa" class="skt-link">aśeṣa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azeva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशेव</span> <i>aśeva</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-zeva" class="skt-link">śeva</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azeva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azeva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azevaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśevā</i> non amical; hostile.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azi_s_ta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशिष्ट</span> <i>aśiṣṭa</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-zi_s_ta_2" class="skt-link">śiṣṭa_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azi_s_ta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azi_s_ta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azi_s_taa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśiṣṭā</i> mal élevé; inculte <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> interdit <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> fr. inceste.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azi_sya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशिष्य</span> <i>aśiṣya</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-zi_sya" class="skt-link">śiṣya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azi_sya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azi_sya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azi_syaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśiṣyā</i> qui ne doit pas être éduqué <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> inutile à enseigner.<br> <i>liṅgam</i> <i>aśiṣyam</i> [<a href="#entry-Upaa_nini" class="skt-link">Pāṇini</a>] Le genre des substantifs n'est pas enseigné (par la grammaire, il est arbitraire et s'acquiert par l'usage).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aziiti">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशीति</span> <i>aśīti</i> [<a href="#entry-a_s_ta" class="skt-link">aṣṭa</a><a href="#entry--ti" class="skt-link">-ti</a>] num. <a href="#entry-aziiti" class="skt-link">f.</a> sg. quatre-vingt.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aziras">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशिरस्</span> <i>aśiras</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-ziras" class="skt-link">śiras</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aziras" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aziras" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aziras" class="skt-link">f.</a> sans tête.

</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aziraska">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśiraska</i> [<a href="#entry-aziras" class="skt-link">aśiras</a><a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aziraska" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aziraska" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aziraskaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśiraskā</i> id.<br> <a href="#entry-aziras" class="skt-link">aśiras</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशित</span> <i>aśita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-az_2" class="skt-link">aś_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśitā</i> mangé, dévoré.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aziva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशिव</span> <i>aśiva</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-ziva" class="skt-link">śiva</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aziva" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aziva" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azivaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśivā</i> méchant, nuisible, dangereux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. se dit d'êtres surnaturels hostiles.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azle_saa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अश्लेषा</span> <i>aśleṣā</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-zle_sa" class="skt-link">śleṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-azle_saa" class="skt-link">f.</a> astr. np. d'Aśleṣā, astérisme lunaire [<a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a>] de l'Hydre; cf. <a href="#entry-Uaazle_saas" class="skt-link">Āśleṣās</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. np. des Aśleṣās, id. (pour les 5 étoiles la composant).
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azma">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अश्म</span> <i>aśma</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-azman" class="skt-link">aśman</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azmaaropa_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">

  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azmaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśmaka</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-azmaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [BhP.] np. du roi Aśmaka_1 «né (par césarienne) d'une pierre», fils du roi <a href="#entry-Ukalmaa_sapaada" class="skt-link">Kalmāṣapāda</a> de la lignée solaire [<a href="#entry-suuryava_mza" class="skt-link">sūryavaṃśa</a>]; il est père de <a href="#entry-Umuulaka" class="skt-link">Mūlaka</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pl. <i>aśmakās</i> géo. np. du pays Aśmaka du sud de l'Inde et de son peuple guerrier les Aśmakās.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अश्मन्</span> <i>aśman</i> <a href="#entry-azman" class="skt-link">m.</a> pierre, roc <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> (coup de) foudre <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> voûte des cieux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. ακμων.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azmavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśmavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azmavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azmavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azmavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśmavatī</i> de pierre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azmavat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśmavat</i> [<a href="#entry--vat" class="skt-link">-vat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azmavat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azmavat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azmavatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśmavatī</i> de pierre.<br> <a href="#entry-azman" class="skt-link">aśman</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-aznat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अश्नत्</span> <i>aśnat</i> [ppr. <a href="#entry-az_2" class="skt-link">aś_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-aznat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-aznat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-aznatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśnatī</i> qui mange.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azoka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशोक</span> <i>aśoka</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-zoka" class="skt-link">śoka</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azoka" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azoka" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azokaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśokā</i> qui ne cause pas de peine; gai, qui n'éprouve pas de chagrin; qui apporte la consolation — <a href="#entry-azoka" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. bot. <i>Saraca asoka</i>, arbre Ashok à fleurs oranges en globules très odorants, à feuilles pennées; myth. c'est dans un bois d'ashoks que <a href="#entry-Uraava_na" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇa</a> emprisonna <a href="#entry-Usiitaa" class="skt-link">Sītā</a>; l'arbre est sacré, et considéré comme écartant les calamités; on dit qu'il ne fleurit que s'il est touché par le pied d'une jeune femme <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> hist. np. de l'empereur Aśoka «(accouché) Sans douleur», de la dynastie <a href="#entry-Umaurya" class="skt-link">Maurya</a>; il régnait à <a href="#entry-Upaa_taliputra" class="skt-link">Pāṭaliputra</a> au 3⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ siècle ant.; il conquit le <a href="#entry-Ukalifga" class="skt-link">Kaliṅga</a> par une guerre sanglante; il se convertit ensuite au bouddhisme sous l'influence de son épouse et publia des édits moraux dans toute l'Inde; cf. <a href="#entry-Udevaanaampriya" class="skt-link">Devānāṃpriya</a>, <a href="#entry-Upriyadarzin" class="skt-link">Priyadarśin</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>Asoka</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azokaa_s_tamii">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśokāṣṭamī</i> [<a href="#entry-a_s_tamii" class="skt-link">aṣṭamī</a>] <a href="#entry-azokaa_s_tamii" class="skt-link">f.</a> soc. festival d'Aśokāṣṭamī, au 8⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ jour de la quinzaine claire du mois <a href="#entry-caitra" class="skt-link">caitra</a>, fêté au Bengale et en Orissa; il célèbre la <a href="#entry-puujaa" class="skt-link">pūjā</a> de <a href="#entry-Uraama" class="skt-link">Rāma</a> priant <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a> et <a href="#entry-Ubhavaanii" class="skt-link">Bhavānī</a> afin de vaincre <a href="#entry-Uraava_na" class="skt-link">Rāvaṇa</a>, à l'instigation de <a href="#entry-Uvibhii_sa_na" class="skt-link">Vibhīṣaṇa</a>; il est l'occasion du festival de chariot [<a href="#entry-rathayaatraa" class="skt-link">rathayātrā</a>] de <a href="#entry-Ulifgaraaja" class="skt-link">Liṅgarāja</a>, où <a href="#entry-Uziva" class="skt-link">Śiva</a>-<a href="#entry-Ucandrazekhara" class="skt-link">Candraśekhara</a> est transporté pour 4 jours au temple <a href="#entry-Uraamezvara_1" class="skt-link">Rāmeśvara_1</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-azoka" class="skt-link">aśoka</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azra_1">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अश्र</span> <i>aśra_1</i> cf. <a href="#entry-asra" class="skt-link">asra</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azra_2">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अश्र</span> <i>aśra_2</i> ifc. de <a href="#entry-azri" class="skt-link">aśri</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azraaddha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अश्राद्ध</span> <i>aśrāddha</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-zraaddha" class="skt-link">śrāddha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azraaddha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azraaddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azraaddhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśrāddhā</i> soc. qui ne sacrifie pas aux mânes — <a href="#entry-azraaddha" class="skt-link">n.</a> nourriture ne servant pas d'offrande aux mânes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azraaddhabhogin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśrāddhabhogin</i> [<a href="#entry-bhogin_2" class="skt-link">bhogin_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azraaddhabhogin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azraaddhabhogin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azraaddhabhoginii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśrāddhabhoginī</i> soc. qui a fait le vœu de jeûner pendant le rite aux mânes.<br> <a href="#entry-azraaddha" class="skt-link">aśrāddha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azrapa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśrapa</i> [<a href="#entry-pa_1" class="skt-link">pa_1</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azrapa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azrapa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azrapaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśrapā</i> buveur de sang.<br> <a href="#entry-azra_1" class="skt-link">aśra_1</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azri">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अश्रि</span> <i>aśri</i> <a href="#entry-azri" class="skt-link">f.</a> angle, coin, sommet; fil d'une arme, tout objet aiguisé — <a href="#entry-azra_2" class="skt-link">m.</a> <i>aśra_2</i> cl. après num. qui a tant de sommets <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>acer</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azru">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अश्रु</span> <i>aśru</i> <a href="#entry-azru" class="skt-link">n.</a> larme, pleur.<br> <i>aśru</i> <i>kṛ</i> pleurer.<br> <i>aśrupūrṇākulekṣaṇam</i> [<a href="#entry-puur_na" class="skt-link">pūrṇa</a>-<a href="#entry-aakula" class="skt-link">ākula</a>-<a href="#entry-iik_sa_na" class="skt-link">īkṣaṇa</a>] adv. avec les yeux chavirés et remplis de larmes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azruka_n_tha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśrukaṇṭha</i> [<a href="#entry-ka_n_tha" class="skt-link">kaṇṭha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azruka_n_tha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azruka_n_tha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azruka_n_thaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśrukaṇṭhā</i> avec des larmes dans la voix.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azruka_n_thya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśrukaṇṭhya</i> [<a href="#entry-ka_n_thya" class="skt-link">kaṇṭhya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azruka_n_thya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azruka_n_thya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azruka_n_thyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśrukaṇṭhyā</i> avec la voix noyée de larmes.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azruta">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अश्रुत</span> <i>aśruta</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-zruta" class="skt-link">śruta</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azruta" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azruta" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azrutaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśrutā</i> non entendu; dont on n'a pas entendu parler <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> non instruit; ignorant.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azruvindu">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśruvindu</i> [<a href="#entry-vindu_1" class="skt-link">vindu_1</a>] <a href="#entry-azruvindu" class="skt-link">m.</a> larme.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azruvindumat">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśruvindumat</i> [<a href="#entry--mat" class="skt-link">-mat</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azruvindumat" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azruvindumat" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azruvindumatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśruvindumatī</i> qui fait pleurer — <a href="#entry-azruvindumatii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśruvindumatī</i> myth. np. d'Aśruvindumatī «qui fait pleurer», fille de <a href="#entry-Ukaama" class="skt-link">Kāma</a>, envoyée par <a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a> pour séduire <a href="#entry-Uyayaati" class="skt-link">Yayāti</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-azruvindu" class="skt-link">aśruvindu</a> <br> <a href="#entry-azru" class="skt-link">aśru</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azubha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशुभ</span> <i>aśubha</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-zubha" class="skt-link">śubha</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azubha" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azubha" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azubhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśubhā</i> désagréable; défavorable, de mauvais augure; vicieux — <a href="#entry-azubha" class="skt-link">n.</a> impureté; mal, péché; malheur <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bd. pratique spirituelle d'évocation de l'aspect répugnant du corps physique pour contrôler le désir <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>asubha</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azuci">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशुचि</span> <i>aśuci</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-zuci" class="skt-link">śuci</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azuci" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azuci" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azuci" class="skt-link">f.</a> impur.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azuudra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अशूद्र</span> <i>aśūdra</i> [<a href="#entry-a" class="skt-link">a</a>-<a href="#entry-zuudra" class="skt-link">śūdra</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azuudra" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azuudra" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azuudraa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśūdrā</i> soc. de classe noble.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azva">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अश्व</span> <i>aśva</i> <a href="#entry-azva" class="skt-link">m.</a> cheval <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> cavalier aux échecs [<a href="#entry-caturafgaa" class="skt-link">caturaṅgā</a>]; syn. <a href="#entry-turafga" class="skt-link">turaṃga</a> — <a href="#entry-azvaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśvā</i> jument — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(aśvāyati)</i> chercher des chevaux — v. [<span class="skt-grammar">11</span>] pr. <i>(aśvasyati)</i> désirer l'étalon (se dit de la jument) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>eqūs</i>; gr. ιππος.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvadaghna">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśvadaghna</i> [<a href="#entry-daghna" class="skt-link">daghna</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azvadaghna" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azvadaghna" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azvadaghnaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśvadaghnā</i> <a href="#entry-azvadaghnii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśvadaghnī</i> qui a (de l'eau) jusqu'à hauteur d'un cheval.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvagandhaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśvagandhā</i> [<a href="#entry-gandhaa" class="skt-link">gandhā</a>] <a href="#entry-azvagandhaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> natu. bot. <i>Physalis Flexuosa</i> (ou bot. <i>Withania somnifera</i>), plante solanacée aux baies orange à l'intérieur du calice; utilisée en médecine pour traiter l'anxiété et l'insomnie.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvaghaasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśvaghāsa</i> [<a href="#entry-ghaasa" class="skt-link">ghāsa</a>] <a href="#entry-azvaghaasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> fourrage pour les chevaux.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvaghaasakaayastha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśvaghāsakāyastha</i> [<a href="#entry-kaayastha" class="skt-link">kāyastha</a>] <a href="#entry-azvaghaasakaayastha" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. maréchal des logis.<br> <a href="#entry-azvaghaasa" class="skt-link">aśvaghāsa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvagho_sa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśvaghoṣa</i> [<a href="#entry-gho_sa" class="skt-link">ghoṣa</a>] <a href="#entry-azvagho_sa" class="skt-link">m.</a> hist. np. d'Aśvaghoṣa «Celui qui hennit», poète et dramaturge contemporain de <a href="#entry-Ukani_ska_1" class="skt-link">Kaniṣka_1</a> (1⟨sup⟩er⟨/sup⟩ siècle); il vécut à <a href="#entry-Upaa_taliputra" class="skt-link">Pāṭaliputra</a> puis à <a href="#entry-Upuru_sapura" class="skt-link">Puruṣapura</a> à la cour de <a href="#entry-Ukani_ska_1" class="skt-link">Kaniṣka_1</a>; fils d'un brâhmane, il se convertit au bouddhisme; il composa le <a href="#entry-Ubuddhacarita" class="skt-link">Buddhacarita</a>, le <a href="#entry-Usaundarananda" class="skt-link">Saundarananda</a> et le <a href="#entry-Uzaariputraprakara_na" class="skt-link">Śāriputraprakaraṇa</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvagopa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśvagopa</i> [<a href="#entry-gopa" class="skt-link">gopa</a>] <a href="#entry-azvagopa" class="skt-link">m.</a> palefrenier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvah_rdaya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśvahṛdaya</i> [<a href="#entry-h_rdaya" class="skt-link">hṛdaya</a>] <a href="#entry-azvah_rdaya" class="skt-link">n.</a> expertise équestre — <a href="#entry-azvah_rdayaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśvahṛdayā</i> myth. np. de la jument Aśvahṛdayā, réincarnation de la nymphe <a href="#entry-Urambhaa" class="skt-link">Rambhā</a> maudite par le sage <a href="#entry-Usthuulaziraa_a" class="skt-link">Sthūlaśirāa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-azva" class="skt-link">aśva</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvaka">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अश्वक</span> <i>aśvaka</i> [<a href="#entry-azva" class="skt-link">aśva</a><a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-azvaka" class="skt-link">m.</a> petit cheval <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> mauvais cheval <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> cheval inconnu (sauvage ou échappé) <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> cheval-jouet <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> géo. clan de la tribu <a href="#entry-kamboja" class="skt-link">kamboja</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> jade — <a href="#entry-azvikaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśvikā</i> petite jument.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvakar_na">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśvakarṇa</i> [<a href="#entry-kar_na" class="skt-link">karṇa</a>] <a href="#entry-azvakar_na" class="skt-link">m.</a> oreille de cheval <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> natu. épith. de l'arbre <a href="#entry-zaala" class="skt-link">śāla</a> [bot. <i>Shorea robusta</i>], dont les feuilles ressemblent à une oreille de cheval.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvakhura">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśvakhura</i> [<a href="#entry-khura" class="skt-link">khura</a>] <a href="#entry-azvakhura" class="skt-link">m.</a> sabot de cheval.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvakovida">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśvakovida</i> [<a href="#entry-kovida" class="skt-link">kovida</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azvakovida" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azvakovida" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azvakovidaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśvakovidā</i> habile cavalier.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अश्वल</span> <i>aśvala</i> [<a href="#entry-azva" class="skt-link">aśva</a><a href="#entry--la" class="skt-link">-la</a>] <a href="#entry-azvala" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. d'Aśvala, prêtre-récitant [<a href="#entry-hot_r" class="skt-link">hotṛ</a>] du roi <a href="#entry-Ujanakaraaja" class="skt-link">Janakarāja</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvamedha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśvamedha</i> [<a href="#entry-medha" class="skt-link">medha</a>] <a href="#entry-azvamedha" class="skt-link">m.</a> soc. sacrifice du cheval, cérémonie védique de conquête d'un empire parcouru en un an par un cheval.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvapati">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśvapati</i> [<a href="#entry-pati" class="skt-link">pati</a>] <a href="#entry-azvapati" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Uraamaaya_na" class="skt-link">Rām.</a>] np. d'Aśvapati «Maître du cheval», roi du <a href="#entry-Ukekaya" class="skt-link">Kekaya</a>; son fils aîné est <a href="#entry-Uyudhaajit" class="skt-link">Yudhājit</a>, <a href="#entry-Ukaikeyii" class="skt-link">Kaikeyī</a> est sa fille.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvasena">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśvasena</i> [<a href="#entry-senaa" class="skt-link">senā</a>] <a href="#entry-azvasena" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. du serpent [<a href="#entry-naaga" class="skt-link">nāga</a>] Aśvasena, fils de <a href="#entry-Utak_saka" class="skt-link">Takṣaka</a>; il échappa à l'incendie de la forêt <a href="#entry-Ukhaa_n_dava" class="skt-link">Khāṇḍava</a> grâce au sacrifice de sa mère, dans le corps de laquelle il s'était caché; vouant une haine infinie à <a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a>, il se glissa comme flèche magique dans le carquois de <a href="#entry-Ukar_na" class="skt-link">Karṇa</a>, mais <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> enfonça son char à temps pour prévenir sa morsure, et <a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a> le tua.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvatara">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśvatara</i> [<a href="#entry--tara" class="skt-link">-tara</a>] <a href="#entry-azvatara" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. zoo. mulet — <a href="#entry-azvatarii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśvatarī</i> mule.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvattha">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अश्वत्थ</span> <i>aśvattha</i> [<a href="#entry-azva" class="skt-link">aśva</a>-<a href="#entry-stha" class="skt-link">stha</a>] <a href="#entry-azvattha" class="skt-link">m.</a> natu. bot. <i>Ficus religiosa</i>, figuier sacré, pipal [«sous lequel s'abritent les chevaux»]; syn. <a href="#entry-pippala" class="skt-link">pippala</a>, <a href="#entry-bodhitaru" class="skt-link">bodhitaru</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> bâton à feu [<a href="#entry-ara_ni" class="skt-link">araṇi</a>], fait de son bois — <a href="#entry-azvatthaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśvatthā</i> pleine lune [<a href="#entry-puur_nimaa" class="skt-link">pūrṇimā</a>] du mois <a href="#entry-aazvina" class="skt-link">āśvina</a>; aussi appelée <a href="#entry-kumaarapuur_nimaa" class="skt-link">kumārapūrṇimā</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> pali <i>assattha</i>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvatthaaman">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अश्वत्थामन्</span> <i>aśvatthāman</i> [<a href="#entry-azva" class="skt-link">aśva</a>-<a href="#entry-sthaaman" class="skt-link">sthāman</a>] <a href="#entry-azvatthaaman" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. du héros Aśvatthāmā «Hennissement de cheval», fils de <a href="#entry-Udro_na" class="skt-link">Droṇa</a> et <a href="#entry-Uk_rpii" class="skt-link">Kṛpī</a>; il apprit l'art des armes de son oncle le maître <a href="#entry-Uk_rpaacaarya" class="skt-link">Kṛpācārya</a>; lors de la grande guerre, après que <a href="#entry-Uduryodhana" class="skt-link">Duryodhana</a> ait été vaincu par <a href="#entry-Ubhiima" class="skt-link">Bhīma</a>, et inspiré par l'attaque nocturne de corbeaux par un hibou, il attaqua par surprise le camp des <a href="#entry-paa_n_davaas" class="skt-link">pāṇḍavās</a> pendant leur sommeil, le détruisit, et tua <a href="#entry-Udh_r_s_tadyumna" class="skt-link">Dhṛṣṭadyumna</a> et les <a href="#entry-Upaa_ncaalaas" class="skt-link">Pāñcālās</a>; il combattit <a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a> avec l'arme céleste <a href="#entry-brahmaziras" class="skt-link">brahmaśiras</a>, qu'il ne sut arrêter qu'en maudissant la descendance des <a href="#entry-paa_n_davaas" class="skt-link">pāṇḍavās</a>; pour ce mauvais usage, <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a> le condamna à errer dans des lieux désolés pendant 3000 ans, avec une plaie au front (son joyau princier arraché) qui ne guérirait pas; c'est l'un des 7 immortels [<a href="#entry-cira_njiivin" class="skt-link">ciraṃjīvin</a>]; cf. <a href="#entry-Udrau_ni" class="skt-link">Drauṇi</a> <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. de l'éléphant tué par <a href="#entry-Ubhiima" class="skt-link">Bhīma</a>, et dont <a href="#entry-Uyudhi_s_thira" class="skt-link">Yudhiṣṭhira</a> annonça la mort à <a href="#entry-Udro_na" class="skt-link">Droṇa</a>, à la suggestion de <a href="#entry-Uk_r_s_na" class="skt-link">Kṛṣṇa</a>, lui faisant croire que son fils venait d'être tué afin de le démoraliser.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvatthopanayana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśvatthopanayana</i> [<a href="#entry-upanayana" class="skt-link">upanayana</a>] <a href="#entry-azvatthopanayana" class="skt-link">n.</a> soc. cérémonie d'investiture d'un pipal sacré.<br> <a href="#entry-azvattha" class="skt-link">aśvattha</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvayuj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśvayuj</i> [<a href="#entry-yuj_2" class="skt-link">yuj_2</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azvayuj" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azvayuj" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azvayuj" class="skt-link">f.</a> qui attelle ou maîtrise des chevaux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> du. <i>aśvayujau</i> astr. np. du <a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a> Aśvayujau «les deux Cavaliers»; cf. <a href="#entry-Uazvinii" class="skt-link">Aśvinī</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvazaastra">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśvaśāstra</i> [<a href="#entry-zaastra" class="skt-link">śāstra</a>] <a href="#entry-azvazaastra" class="skt-link">n.</a> hippologie <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lit. np. de l'Aśvaśāstra, ouvrage d'hippologie dû à Nakula_1.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvi">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अश्वि</span> <i>aśvi</i> iic. de <a href="#entry-azvin" class="skt-link">aśvin</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvin">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अश्विन्</span> <i>aśvin</i> [<a href="#entry-azva" class="skt-link">aśva</a><a href="#entry--in" class="skt-link">-in</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azvin" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azvin" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azvinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśvinī</i> cavalier <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> du. <i>aśvinau</i> myth. véd. np. des Aśvinau «les deux Cavaliers», appelés aussi <a href="#entry-Unaasatyau" class="skt-link">Nāsatyau</a> ou <a href="#entry-Uazviyujau" class="skt-link">Aśviyujau</a> «Chevaux jumeaux» (plus tard distingués comme <a href="#entry-Udasra" class="skt-link">Dasra</a> et <a href="#entry-Unaasatya" class="skt-link">Nāsatya</a>); ils sont fils de <a href="#entry-Usara_nyuu" class="skt-link">Saraṇyū</a> et <a href="#entry-Uvivasvaan" class="skt-link">Vivasvān</a>; ils burent le <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a> lors du <a href="#entry-yaj_na" class="skt-link">yajña</a> que <a href="#entry-Ucyavana" class="skt-link">Cyavana</a> exécuta pour le roi <a href="#entry-Uzaryaati" class="skt-link">Śaryāti</a>, contre la volonté d'<a href="#entry-Uindra" class="skt-link">Indra</a>; jeunes dieux jumeaux d'une grande beauté, ils ont pour commune épouse <a href="#entry-Uu_saa" class="skt-link">Uṣā</a> l'Aurore ou leur sœur <a href="#entry-Usuuryaa" class="skt-link">Sūryā</a>; ils sont patrons de la médecine, de l'agriculture, et du mariage; ils aident les nécessiteux et les malades; ils montent des chevaux, ou conduisent un char à 3 roues en or tiré par des ânes [<a href="#entry-raasabha" class="skt-link">rāsabha</a>] ou des oiseaux, et rapide comme la pensée [<a href="#entry-manojava" class="skt-link">manojava</a>]; phil. [<a href="#entry-saafkhya" class="skt-link">sāṃkhya</a>] ils sont régents [<a href="#entry-niyant_r" class="skt-link">niyantṛ</a>] du sens de l'odorat [<a href="#entry-ghraa_na" class="skt-link">ghrāṇa</a>] — <a href="#entry-azvinii" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśvinī</i> astr. np. de la nymphe Aśvinī, épith. de <a href="#entry-Usara_nyuu" class="skt-link">Saraṇyū</a>; elle habite le 27⟨sup⟩e⟨/sup⟩ (plus tard 1⟨sup⟩er⟨/sup⟩) astérisme lunaire [<a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a>], corr. aux étoiles βζ de la tête du Bélier; les <a href="#entry-Uazvinau" class="skt-link">Aśvinau</a> y président, son symbole est une tête de cheval.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azviyuj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>aśviyuj</i> [<a href="#entry-yuj_2" class="skt-link">yuj_2</a>] <a href="#entry-azviyuj" class="skt-link">m.</a> du. <i>aśviyujau</i> myth. np. d'Aśviyujau «les deux cavaliers»; désignent les dieux <a href="#entry-Uazvinau" class="skt-link">Aśvinau</a> et le <a href="#entry-nak_satra" class="skt-link">nakṣatra</a> d'<a href="#entry-Uazvinii" class="skt-link">Aśvinī</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-azvi" class="skt-link">aśvi</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-azvya">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अश्व्य</span> <i>aśvya</i> [<a href="#entry-azvi" class="skt-link">aśvi</a><a href="#entry--ya" class="skt-link">-ya</a>] a. <a href="#entry-azvya" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-azvya" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-azvyaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>aśvyā</i> composé de chevaux <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> concernant le cheval, chevalin.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_nc">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">अञ्च्</span> <i>añc</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(añcati)</i> ps. <i>(acyate)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>añcita</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ut</i>, <i>ni</i><i>)</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">1</span>] pr. <i>(acati)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>akna</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>ā</i><i>)</i> courber, ployer — pr. md. <i>(añcate)</i> se courber, saluer — ca. <i>(añcayati)</i> dérouler; produire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> gr. αγκοω; lat. <i>uncus</i>; ang. ankle; all. Enkel; fr. angle, ancre.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_ncala">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अञ्चल</span> <i>añcala</i> [<a href="#entry-a_nc" class="skt-link">añc</a><a href="#entry--ala" class="skt-link">-ala</a>] <a href="#entry-a_ncala" class="skt-link">m.</a> frange d'un vêtement (de femme), d'une écharpe <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> œillade.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_ncana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अञ्चन</span> <i>añcana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-a_nc" class="skt-link">añc</a>] <a href="#entry-a_ncana" class="skt-link">n.</a> fait de ployer, de se courber; inclinaison, flexion.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_ncita">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अञ्चित</span> <i>añcita</i> [pp. <a href="#entry-a_nc" class="skt-link">añc</a>] a. <a href="#entry-a_ncita" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-a_ncita" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-a_ncitaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>añcitā</i> recourbé; bouclé (cheveux); dressé.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_nj">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    √ <span class="deva" lang="sa">अञ्ज्</span> <i>añj</i> v. [<span class="skt-grammar">7</span>] pr. <i>(anakti)</i> pp. <i>(</i><i>akta</i><i>)</i> abs. <i>(</i><i>aktvā</i>, <i>-añjya</i><i>)</i> pf. <i>(</i><i>abhi</i>, <i>ā</i>, <i>vi</i>, <i>sam</i><i>)</i> oindre, enduire; orner — pr. md. <i>(aṅkte)</i> s'enduire, s'oindre de; se farder — ps. <i>(ajyate)</i> être fardé, être beau — ca. <i>(añjayati)</i> oindre, enduire <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> lat. <i>ungo</i>; fr. oindre, onguent.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_nja_hsava">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>añjaḥsava</i> [<a href="#entry-sava_1" class="skt-link">sava_1</a>] <a href="#entry-a_nja_hsava" class="skt-link">m.</a> pressurage rapide (not. du <a href="#entry-soma" class="skt-link">soma</a>).<br> <a href="#entry-a_njasa" class="skt-link">añjasa</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_njali">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अञ्जलि</span> <i>añjali</i> <a href="#entry-a_njali" class="skt-link">m.</a> posture [<a href="#entry-mudraa" class="skt-link">mudrā</a>] de salut: mains ouvertes jointes en signe d'hommage, levées devant la poitrine (égal), le front (<a href="#entry-guru" class="skt-link">guru</a>), ou au-dessus de la tête (Dieu); cf. <a href="#entry-mastakaa_njali" class="skt-link">mastakāñjali</a>.<br> <i>añjaliṃ</i> <i>kṛ</i> saluer en posture d'<a href="#entry-a_njali" class="skt-link">añjali</a>.<br> <i>prāñjali</i> adv. en posture d'<a href="#entry-a_njali" class="skt-link">añjali</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_njalika">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>añjalika</i> [<a href="#entry--ka" class="skt-link">-ka</a>] <a href="#entry-a_njalika" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. [<a href="#entry-Umahaabhaarata" class="skt-link">Mah.</a>] np. d'Añjalika, flèche magique par laquelle <a href="#entry-Uarjuna" class="skt-link">Arjuna</a> tua <a href="#entry-Ukar_na" class="skt-link">Karṇa</a>.<br> <a href="#entry-a_njali" class="skt-link">añjali</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_njana">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अञ्जन</span> <i>añjana</i> [act. <a href="#entry-a_nj" class="skt-link">añj</a>] <a href="#entry-a_njana" class="skt-link">n.</a> onguent, collyre, fard — <a href="#entry-a_njana" class="skt-link">m.</a> myth. np. de l'éléphant céleste Añjana «Fardé», <a href="#entry-diggaja" class="skt-link">diggaja</a> de l'Ouest — <a href="#entry-a_njanaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>añjanā</i> myth. np. de la nymphe [<a href="#entry-apsaras" class="skt-link">apsaras</a>] Añjanā «Collyre», réincarnation de <a href="#entry-Upu_njikasthalaa" class="skt-link">Puñjikasthalā</a> changée en singe par la malédiction d'un <a href="#entry-_r_si" class="skt-link">ṛṣi</a> qu'elle avait insulté; son époux était le singe <a href="#entry-Ukesarii" class="skt-link">Kesarī</a>; pour avoir un fils, elle pria le dieu Vent [<a href="#entry-Upavana" class="skt-link">Pavana</a>] dont elle reçut la semence dans les oreilles, et enfanta ainsi de <a href="#entry-Uhanumaan" class="skt-link">Hanumān</a>.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_njanazalaakaa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <i>añjanaśalākā</i> [<a href="#entry-zalaakaa" class="skt-link">śalākā</a>] <a href="#entry-a_njanazalaakaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> jn. rite de peinture des yeux d'une idole [<a href="#entry-muurti" class="skt-link">mūrti</a>] aux fins de la consacrer.<br> <a href="#entry-a_njana" class="skt-link">añjana</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_njas">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अञ्जस्</span> <i>añjas</i> [<a href="#entry-a_nj" class="skt-link">añj</a>] <a href="#entry-a_njas" class="skt-link">n.</a> onguent, pommade — adv. rapidement, instantanément, soudainement — i. <i>añjasā</i> adv. tout droit; avec droiture, correctement; vraiment, exactement <span class="skt-pipe">|</span> rapidement, immédiatement.
  </div>
</div>

<div class="skt-entry" id="entry-a_njasa">
  <div class="skt-entry-content">
    <span class="deva" lang="sa">अञ्जस</span> <i>añjasa</i> [<a href="#entry-a_njas" class="skt-link">añjas</a>] a. <a href="#entry-a_njasa" class="skt-link">m.</a> <a href="#entry-a_njasa" class="skt-link">n.</a> <a href="#entry-a_njasaa" class="skt-link">f.</a> <i>añjasā</i> droit, direct; honnête.
  </div>
</div>
